scope_limitations_en: Names are predicted as unordered word sets from a fixed training vocabulary and scored with word-level precision, recall and F1, with CodeWordNet counting semantically similar words as matches. This is not exact source-name recovery, and out-of-vocabulary words cannot be produced. Binaries were built with GCC 7.5 for Linux and split by binary within the same 27 projects. On 540 binaries from 12 unseen projects, overall performance remains lower, which the authors partly attribute to vocabulary mismatch; a later NDSS 2025 comparison on deduplicated data reports SymLM’s average F1 at 0.105. NFRE comparisons are x64-only, and NERO comparisons use NERO’s dataset. Obfuscation covers four Hikari passes, not packing or encryption. In the firmware case study, 172 of 1,061 functions in eight 32-bit ARM firmware images received partially correct names.
scope_limitations_zh: 函数名被预测为来自固定训练词表的无序单词集合，并按单词级精确率、召回率和 F1 评分，CodeWordNet 会将语义相近的单词计为匹配。这并非精确恢复源码名称，且无法生成词表外的单词。二进制由 GCC 7.5 为 Linux 构建，并在同样的 27 个项目内按二进制划分数据集。在来自 12 个未见项目的 540 个二进制上，整体表现仍然较低，作者将部分原因归于词表不匹配；后来一项 NDSS 2025 研究在去重数据上比较时，报告 SymLM 的平均 F1 为 0.105。与 NFRE 的比较仅针对 x64，与 NERO 的比较使用 NERO 的数据集。混淆实验覆盖四种 Hikari 混淆，不包括加壳或加密。固件案例中，八个 32 位 ARM 固件映像的 1,061 个函数里有 172 个得到部分正确的名称。
why_fits_en: Adds execution-aware, calling-context function-name prediction for stripped binaries, evaluated across architectures, optimizations and obfuscations, complementing variable-name, type and data-structure recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合执行语义与调用上下文的去符号二进制函数名预测方法，并在多种架构、优化级别和混淆设置下评估，与变量名、类型及数据结构恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref truncates the title to “SymLM”; the full title follows the ACM page and the author-hosted PDF, which carries the CCS ’22 header and DOI. ACM and Crossref agree on the four-author order and pages 1631–1645, and ACM marks the article free to read. An arXiv title search found no preprint. The reviewed 2025-07-06 repository snapshot is MIT-licensed and includes a vendored fairseq, dataset-generation scripts, a sample x64 dataset, training, prediction and evaluation scripts, and CodeWordNet training code. Its README sets up Python 3.8 with CUDA 11.3 PyTorch and pinned requirements such as transformers 4.16.2 and gensim 3.8.1; training needs a December 2021 Trex checkpoint and CodeWordNet models from Google Drive links, and it warns that newer Trex checkpoints may be incompatible. The full dataset is Zenodo record 8306055 (about 9.4 GB; CC BY 4.0 in its metadata), which is registered under the paper’s DOI rather than a separate dataset DOI. The paper reports 8 days of training on top of the Trex pretraining.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 将标题截断为“SymLM”；完整标题以 ACM 页面和作者托管的 PDF 为准，该 PDF 带有 CCS ’22 页眉及 DOI。ACM 与 Crossref 的四位作者顺序和页码 1631–1645 一致，ACM 将文章标为免费阅读。按标题检索 arXiv 未发现预印本。所审阅的 2025-07-06 仓库快照采用 MIT 许可证，包含内置的 fairseq、数据集生成脚本、x64 样例数据集、训练、预测与评估脚本以及 CodeWordNet 训练代码。其 README 使用 Python 3.8 与 CUDA 11.3 版 PyTorch，并固定 transformers 4.16.2、gensim 3.8.1 等依赖；训练需要通过 Google Drive 链接获取 2021 年 12 月的 Trex 检查点和 CodeWordNet 模型，README 并提示较新的 Trex 检查点可能不兼容。完整数据集位于 Zenodo 记录 8306055（约 9.4 GB；元数据标注 CC BY 4.0），该记录登记的是论文 DOI，而非单独的数据集 DOI。论文报告在 Trex 预训练之外还需训练 8 天。

title: Nova: Generative Language Models for Assembly Code with Hierarchical Attention and Contrastive Learning
title_zh: Nova：结合层次注意力与对比学习的汇编代码生成式语言模型
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2025-05-01 is not adopted, and the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。论文集页面 2025-05-01 的引用日期未被采用，也不以 arXiv 日期代替。
description_en: Nova is a generative LLM for x86-64 assembly, trained from DeepSeek-Coder checkpoints on stripped, normalized gcc -O0 to -O3 assembly built from AnghaBench and The Stack. It adds hierarchical attention that builds per-instruction summaries, and contrastive objectives that keep a function's source and O0–O3 assembly close while ordering them by optimization level. Fine-tuned for decompilation, Nova-1.3B and Nova-6.7B reach 25.17% and 34.36% average Pass@1 on HumanEval-Decompile, 14.84 and 12.41 points above same-size LLM4Decompile; separately fine-tuned models report the highest average Recall@1 for O0-to-O3 binary code similarity on six real-world projects.
description_zh: Nova 是面向 x86-64 汇编的生成式大语言模型，从 DeepSeek-Coder 检查点出发，以 AnghaBench 与 The Stack 代码经 gcc -O0 至 -O3 编译、剥离符号并规范化后的汇编训练。它加入为每条指令构建摘要的层次注意力，以及对比学习目标：使同一函数的源码与 O0–O3 汇编表示彼此接近，并按优化级别排序。针对反编译微调后，Nova-1.3B 与 Nova-6.7B 在 HumanEval-Decompile 上的平均 Pass@1 分别为 25.17% 和 34.36%，比同规模 LLM4Decompile 高 14.84 和 12.41 个百分点；另行微调的模型在六个真实项目上的 O0 对 O3 二进制代码相似性检测中取得最高的平均 Recall@1。
scope_limitations_en: Decompilation is evaluated function by function on the 164 HumanEval-Decompile C problems, each compiled for x86-64 at O0–O3, by running 20 samples per function against the problems' test cases; Pass@k on these tests is neither whole-program nor equivalence evidence. Baselines other than LLM4Decompile and Nova were prompted with three-shot examples rather than fine-tuned. Similarity results cover O0 queries against O3 candidates in pools of 50–500 functions from Binutils, Curl, ImageMagick, SQLite, OpenSSL and PuTTY, after fine-tuning on BinaryCorp-3M. Decompilation fine-tuning used a 2.16M-pair sample, the README says only 50K files came from The Stack, and the paper limits Nova to x86-64 assembly and 1.3B and 6.7B models. Inputs require the paper's assembly normalization.
scope_limitations_zh: 反编译以函数为单位，在 HumanEval-Decompile 的 164 个 C 问题上评测；每个问题在 O0–O3 下编译为 x86-64，每个函数采样 20 次并以题目测试用例运行。基于这些测试的 Pass@k 既不能证明整程序反编译能力，也不能证明等价性。除 LLM4Decompile 与 Nova 外，其他基线采用三样例提示而非微调。相似性结果针对 O0 查询与 O3 候选，候选池为来自 Binutils、Curl、ImageMagick、SQLite、OpenSSL 与 PuTTY 的 50–500 个函数，模型先在 BinaryCorp-3M 上微调。反编译微调使用抽样的 216 万对数据，README 称仅从 The Stack 获取 5 万个文件；论文也说明 Nova 仅支持 x86-64 汇编，模型规模限于 1.3B 和 6.7B。输入需要按论文方式规范化汇编。
why_fits_en: Adds an assembly-specialized foundation model evaluated on both decompilation and binary code similarity, complementing the decompilation-specific LLM papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个面向汇编的基础模型，同时评测反编译与二进制代码相似性，与本节专注反编译的大语言模型论文互补。
metadata_notes: Authors follow the proceedings, which list pages 95905–95926. arXiv has seven versions: v1 of 2023-11-22 was titled 'Nova+: Generative Language Models for Binaries' (written Nova$^+$ in the arXiv metadata) and listed six authors, without Petr Babkin; the checked later versions (v3, v5, v7) use the final title, and v7 of 2025-11-11 states ICLR 2025 publication. The repository README's abstract gives a relative decompilation gain of up to 146.54%, while the paper reports absolute percentage points. The reviewed 2026-01-04 repository commit carries a BSD 3-Clause LICENSE, and the Hugging Face cards for nova-1.3b, nova-6.7b and their -bcr decompilation variants are tagged bsd-3-clause-clear; the models start from DeepSeek-Coder checkpoints. requirements.txt pins torch 2.3.0, transformers 4.40.2, vllm 0.5.0 and deepspeed 0.14.4 for a Python 3.10 environment, and training examples use four GPUs.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者以论文集为准，论文集列出第 95905–95926 页。arXiv 共有七个版本：2023-11-22 的 v1 题为“Nova+: Generative Language Models for Binaries”（arXiv 元数据写作 Nova$^+$），列出六位作者，不含 Petr Babkin；本次核查的后续版本（v3、v5、v7）均使用最终标题，2025-11-11 的 v7 注明发表于 ICLR 2025。仓库 README 的摘要称反编译相对提升最高达 146.54%，论文报告的则是绝对百分点。所审阅的 2026-01-04 仓库提交附有 BSD 3-Clause LICENSE，Hugging Face 上 nova-1.3b、nova-6.7b 及其 -bcr 反编译变体的模型卡均标注 bsd-3-clause-clear；模型从 DeepSeek-Coder 检查点出发。requirements.txt 为 Python 3.10 环境固定 torch 2.3.0、transformers 4.40.2、vllm 0.5.0 与 deepspeed 0.14.4，训练示例使用四块 GPU。

title: Unleashing the Power of Generative Model in Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary
title_zh: 释放生成式模型在剥离符号二进制变量名恢复中的能力
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and the publisher’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2025. The conference dates and the arXiv versions do not establish a publication day.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2025；会议日期与各 arXiv 版本日期不能据此推定具体出版日。
description_en: GenNm suggests names for placeholder variables in decompiled code of stripped binaries by fine-tuning generative code models (CodeGemma-2B by default; CodeLlama-7B and a LoRA-tuned CodeLlama-34B are also tested). Queries add renamed caller code and callee signatures propagated along the call graph; a DPO-style symbol-preference optimization (SymPO) counters bias toward frequent training names, and a data-flow name-validation step chooses among candidates over iterative rounds. The authors report 5.6–11.4-point precision gains over VarBERT and ReSym on rebuilt DIRTY and VarCorpus datasets, and 22.8% precision on names unseen in training against 17.3% for the strongest baseline.
description_zh: GenNm 通过微调生成式代码模型（默认 CodeGemma-2B，另测试 CodeLlama-7B 及经 LoRA 微调的 CodeLlama-34B），为剥离符号二进制反编译代码中的占位变量建议名称。查询会加入沿调用图传播、已重命名的调用者代码与被调用者签名；类 DPO 的符号偏好优化（SymPO）抑制模型偏向训练集中高频名称，基于数据流的名称验证步骤则在多轮迭代中从候选名称里选择。作者报告，在重建的 DIRTY 与 VarCorpus 数据集上，其精确率比 VarBERT 和 ReSym 高 5.6–11.4 个百分点；对训练中未出现的名称，精确率为 22.8%，最强基线为 17.3%。
scope_limitations_en: Predictions are scored against debug-symbol names by token matching with SymLM's word clusters and rules, plus a GPT-4 evaluator for context relevance and semantic accuracy; neither shows that outputs are the original identifiers, and overall split-by-binary precision is 35.8% (DIRTY) and 41.2% (VarCorpus). Precision is about 30% for projects unseen in training, and gains are smaller at -O2 and -O3. Ground truth comes from debug information in Linux binaries rebuilt from GitHub projects or Gentoo packages, with IDA Pro output in the paper's examples. GenNm needs each binary's call graph, which is why the DIRTY dataset was rebuilt; split-by-function VarCorpus results use a 15% binary sample, and the black-box GPT-3.5/GPT-4 comparison uses 1,000 sampled functions. It recovers variable names only, not types, function names or full decompiled code.
scope_limitations_zh: 预测结果依据调试符号中的名称评分：一方面借助 SymLM 的词簇与规则进行词元匹配，另一方面由 GPT-4 评估器判断上下文相关性与语义准确性；两者都不能说明输出就是原始标识符，按二进制划分时整体精确率为 35.8%（DIRTY）和 41.2%（VarCorpus）。对训练中未出现的项目，精确率约为 30%，在 -O2 与 -O3 下的提升也较小。真实标签来自由 GitHub 项目或 Gentoo 软件包重建的 Linux 二进制文件中的调试信息，论文示例使用 IDA Pro 输出。GenNm 需要每个二进制的调用图，这也是重建 DIRTY 数据集的原因；VarCorpus 按函数划分的结果只使用 15% 的二进制样本，与黑盒 GPT-3.5／GPT-4 的比较使用 1,000 个抽样函数。它只恢复变量名，不恢复类型、函数名或完整的反编译代码。
why_fits_en: Adds generative, call-graph-aware variable-name recovery with explicit treatment of name-frequency bias, extending the learned-naming line of work in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合调用图上下文、并专门处理名称频率偏差的生成式变量名恢复方法，延续了本节的学习式命名研究。
metadata_notes: The record uses the NDSS title and the 11 authors in the NDSS paper's order, which match Crossref; Crossref gives year 2025 without pages. The arXiv record has carried three titles. v1 of 2023-06-05, 'LmPa: Improving Decompilation by Synergy of Large Language Model and Program Analysis', listed nine authors, without Ziyang Huang and Danning Xie; its title framed the work as improving decompilation in general, although its abstract already targeted variable-name recovery. v2 of 2024-05-01 was 'Leveraging Generative Models to Recover Variable Names from Stripped Binary'. v3 of 2024-07-20 and v4 of 2024-12-09, with the 11 NDSS authors, are 'Symbol Preference Aware Generative Models for Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary'; the NDSS paper defers implementation details to this extended version. The paper cites the artifact as Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14220042, a v1.0 code snapshot under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14220041 as in the README badge. The reviewed 2026-01-29 repository commit is MIT-licensed, and Zenodo record 14287032 holds a 9.8 GB CC-BY-4.0 data package with intermediate results and model checkpoints. The README asks for Ubuntu 20.04+, Python 3.10 with vllm 0.5.3.post1, at least 24 GB of GPU memory for inference and 96 GB for training.
metadata_notes_zh: 本条目采用 NDSS 标题，并按 NDSS 论文顺序列出 11 位作者，与 Crossref 一致；Crossref 仅给出 2025 年，未列页码。arXiv 记录先后使用过三个标题。2023-06-05 的 v1 题为“LmPa: Improving Decompilation by Synergy of Large Language Model and Program Analysis”，列出九位作者，不含 Ziyang Huang 与 Danning Xie；该标题将工作表述为泛化的反编译改进，但其摘要已聚焦变量名恢复。2024-05-01 的 v2 题为“Leveraging Generative Models to Recover Variable Names from Stripped Binary”。2024-07-20 的 v3 与 2024-12-09 的 v4 列出 NDSS 的 11 位作者，题为“Symbol Preference Aware Generative Models for Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary”；NDSS 论文将实现细节留给这一扩展版本。论文将产物引用为 Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14220042，即概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14220041（与 README 徽章一致）下的 v1.0 代码快照。所审阅的 2026-01-29 仓库提交采用 MIT 许可，Zenodo 记录 14287032 提供 9.8 GB、采用 CC-BY-4.0 的数据包，内含中间结果与模型检查点。README 要求 Ubuntu 20.04+、带 vllm 0.5.3.post1 的 Python 3.10，推理至少需要 24 GB 显存，训练建议 96 GB。

title: BinaryAI: Binary Software Composition Analysis via Intelligent Binary Source Code Matching
title_zh: BinaryAI：基于智能二进制—源代码匹配的二进制软件成分分析
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2024-04-12, two days before the April 14–20 ICSE 2024 conference; the conference dates and arXiv dates are not substituted for it.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-04-12，早于 4 月 14–20 日举行的 ICSE 2024 两天；本条目不以会议日期或 arXiv 日期替代该日期。
description_en: BinaryAI identifies which open-source C/C++ libraries a stripped binary reuses by matching its functions to source code. Ghidra decompiles each binary function to pseudo-C, and a Pythia-410M model, trained with a CLIP-style contrastive loss on about 10 million binary–source function pairs, embeds pseudo-code and source functions in one space. Candidates retrieved from a corpus of 56,342,179 source functions from 12,013 libraries are refined with link-time locality and the call graph, and a library is reported when the share of its matched functions exceeds a threshold. The authors report 22.54% recall@1 against 10.75% for CodeCMR, and library-detection precision and recall of 85.84% and 64.98% against 73.36% and 59.81% for an unnamed commercial tool.
description_zh: BinaryAI 通过将剥离符号的二进制中的函数与源代码匹配，识别其复用了哪些开源 C/C++ 库。它先用 Ghidra 将每个二进制函数反编译为类 C 伪代码，再用以 CLIP 式对比损失、在约 1,000 万对二进制—源码函数上训练的 Pythia-410M 模型，把伪代码与源码函数嵌入同一向量空间。从包含 12,013 个库、56,342,179 个源码函数的语料中检索出候选后，方法借助链接时的位置局部性和调用图加以精炼；当某个库中被匹配函数的比例超过阈值时，即判定二进制包含该库。作者报告其 recall@1 为 22.54%，CodeCMR 为 10.75%；库识别的精确率与召回率分别为 85.84% 和 64.98%，一款未具名商业工具为 73.36% 和 59.81%。
scope_limitations_en: Training pairs come from ArchLinux and AUR packages compiled automatically with DWARF debug information, and the corpus and test set cover C/C++ projects only. The SCA test set is 150 stripped binaries the authors compiled from 85 GitHub projects, with 1,045 reused libraries labeled manually from build files, headers and license metadata; function-level ground truth covers 15 of those binaries (23,529 pairs). The recall@1 figures combine the model's validation set with those 15 binaries. The two commercial baselines are anonymized under confidentiality agreements, and every baseline was rebuilt on the authors' 12,013-library dataset. The 112 false positives the authors examined all trace to incomplete library-dependency data. The model, training pairs, source-function corpus and labeled test set are not public, and the hosted service the paper links may run a different model and corpus from the evaluated 2024 system. Matches identify reused source; they are not a decompilation or proof that the binary is unmodified.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练函数对来自自动编译并保留 DWARF 调试信息的 ArchLinux 与 AUR 软件包，语料和测试集均只涵盖 C/C++ 项目。软件成分分析测试集是作者由 85 个 GitHub 项目编译出的 150 个剥离符号的二进制，其中 1,045 个被复用库依据构建文件、头文件和许可证元数据人工标注；函数级真实标签仅覆盖其中 15 个二进制（23,529 对）。recall@1 数据合并了模型验证集与这 15 个二进制。两款商业基线依保密协议匿名，所有基线均在作者的 12,013 个库数据集上重建。作者检查的 112 个误报都可追溯到不完整的库依赖数据。模型、训练函数对、源码函数语料和带标注的测试集均未公开；论文链接的在线服务所用模型与语料可能不同于 2024 年评测的系统。匹配结果说明复用了哪些源码，并不是反编译结果，也不能证明二进制未被修改。
why_fits_en: Adds binary-to-source function matching and binary software composition analysis, which identify reused open-source code inside stripped binaries, complementing binary-to-binary similarity and decompilation research.
why_fits_zh: 补充二进制到源代码的函数匹配和二进制软件成分分析，用于识别剥离符号的二进制中复用的开源代码，与二进制间相似性及反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the ICSE 2024 proceedings article, pages 1–13, and its seven-author order matches arXiv. arXiv v1 is dated 2024-01-20, v2 2024-01-23 and v3 2024-08-26; the reviewed v3 carries the ICSE '24 ACM reference format and DOI. The ACM landing page refused automated access. The abstract links binaryai.net, which now redirects to the binaryai.cn web service, and the GPL-3.0 binaryai/sdk repository is a client for that service that needs a service credential. Neither releases the model, training pairs, corpus or labeled test set. A footnote says the module is deployed in industry with a growing corpus; another says the base model went through earlier OPT and BLOOM iterations before Pythia.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录该文为 ICSE 2024 论文集文章，页码 1–13，七位作者顺序与 arXiv 一致。arXiv v1 发布于 2024-01-20，v2 为 2024-01-23，v3 为 2024-08-26；所审阅的 v3 带有 ICSE '24 的 ACM 引用格式与 DOI。ACM 文章页面拒绝自动访问。摘要链接 binaryai.net，该地址现重定向至 binaryai.cn 在线服务；采用 GPL-3.0 许可的 binaryai/sdk 仓库是该服务的客户端，使用时需要服务凭据。两者都未发布模型、训练函数对、语料或带标注的测试集。论文脚注说明该模块已在工业界部署且语料持续扩充；另一脚注说明基础模型此前曾采用 OPT 与 BLOOM，后改用 Pythia。

title: LLM Agent-Assisted Reverse Engineering with Quantitative Readability Metrics
title_zh: 以量化可读性指标引导 LLM 智能体辅助逆向工程
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期。
description_en: Uses a composite Quantitative Readability Score (QRS) to guide agents refining decompiled C. Lexical familiarity, structural simplicity and coding idioms are combined with a binary-structure similarity gate. Experiments compare refinement with and without shell access on 210 simple C binaries.
description_zh: 用综合量化可读性分数（QRS）引导智能体改进反编译 C 代码，将词汇熟悉度、结构简洁度和编程惯用法与二进制结构相似性门槛结合，在 210 个简单 C 二进制程序上比较有无 shell 访问的迭代。
scope_limitations_en: Structural similarity does not prove semantic equivalence. QRS both guides and evaluates refinement; human readability validation remains future work. The selected synthetic corpus limits generalization. Recovering compilable, behaviorally correct code from difficult binaries is outside the claimed contribution.
scope_limitations_zh: 结构相似性不能证明语义等价。QRS 同时用于指导和评价改进，仍缺少人工可读性验证；经过筛选的合成语料限制了泛化。处理困难二进制并恢复可编译、行为正确代码，不属于本文的贡献范围。
why_fits_en: Connects agent feedback design with the readability of recovered code.
why_fits_zh: 把智能体反馈机制与恢复代码的可读性联系起来。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the v1 abstract and full HTML. No implementation artifact identified.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 v1 摘要与完整 HTML；未确认实现产物。

title: Decoupling is a Necessity: Transformation-Agnostic Decompiled Code Recovery under Optimization and Obfuscation
title_zh: 解耦的必要性：面向优化与混淆、无需识别具体变换的反编译代码恢复
date_basis: arXiv v1 first-submission date.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期。
description_en: ReSource refines decompiled functions affected by compiler optimization and obfuscation. Its stages retrieve guidance from a Semantic Distortion Database, predict a control-flow skeleton, and refine names and formatting. Evaluation measures code similarity and retrieval of the corresponding original function from a source corpus.
description_zh: ReSource 针对受编译优化与混淆影响的反编译函数进行修复：先从语义失真数据库检索指导信息，再预测控制流骨架，最后调整名称与格式。评估衡量代码相似性，以及能否从源码语料中检索到对应的原始函数。
scope_limitations_en: Function-level similarity and retrieval are proxies; they do not establish compilability, executable equivalence or complete program recovery. Section 5.2 notes missing global context and untested custom obfuscation. The author-linked artifact page describes a simplified dataset and explicitly says the database-construction and control-flow-prediction modules are not yet available.
scope_limitations_zh: 函数级相似性与检索指标属于替代指标，不能证明代码可编译、可执行等价或完整程序恢复。第 5.2 节指出全局上下文缺失，以及定制混淆尚未测试。作者链接的产物页面介绍了简化数据集，并明确说明数据库构建与控制流预测模块尚未提供。
why_fits_en: Adds staged refinement of optimized and obfuscated decompiler output, with explicit limits on what retrieval-based evaluation establishes.
why_fits_zh: 补充对优化及混淆后反编译代码的分阶段修复研究，并明确检索评估能够支持的结论边界。
metadata_notes: Title, six-author order and preprint status agree across arXiv metadata and v1 full text. The project page links an anonymous artifact that returned HTTP 403 during review.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 元数据与 v1 正文的标题、六位作者顺序及预印本状态一致。项目页面链接的匿名产物在审阅时返回 HTTP 403。

title: Automatically Attacking Software Reverse Engineering AI Agents
title_zh: 针对软件逆向工程 AI 智能体的自动化攻击
date_basis: Publisher and Crossref online publication date; arXiv submission is recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用出版方与 Crossref 的在线出版日期，arXiv 首次提交日期另行记录。
description_en: A proof of concept for indirect prompt injection against Cline/GhidraMCP binary-analysis agents. An adapted AutoDAN generates embedded strings that make the agent describe different behavior. The authors demonstrate four small C programs with Qwen3-8B and transfer the examples to GPT-OSS-120B.
description_zh: 研究针对 Cline/GhidraMCP 二进制分析智能体的间接提示注入。改造后的 AutoDAN 生成嵌入字符串，使分析报告偏离程序实际行为。作者以四个小型 C 程序在 Qwen3-8B 上演示，并将样例迁移到 GPT-OSS-120B。
scope_limitations_en: Four illustrative programs, each with one or two functions; no repeated-trial success rate, realistic malware corpus or defense evaluation. The reported decompiler setting truncates strings beyond 2,048 characters. These examples do not establish general reliability across models or complex binaries.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅有四个单函数或双函数示例，没有重复试验成功率、真实恶意软件语料或防御评测。论文所用反编译设置会截断超过 2,048 字符的字符串，结果不能推及其他模型或复杂二进制。
why_fits_en: Adds direct evidence of a trust-boundary failure in agent-assisted reverse engineering.
why_fits_zh: 补充智能体辅助逆向工程中信任边界失效的直接研究证据。
metadata_notes: ECCWS proceedings, pages 199–205; Crossref labels its deposit journal-article. Author order agrees across publisher, Crossref and arXiv. No implementation or dataset is linked in the reviewed primary sources.
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 ECCWS 论文集，第 199–205 页；Crossref 将该元数据条目标为 journal-article。三处一手来源的作者顺序一致。所审阅的一手来源未链接实现或数据集。

title: The CodeInverter Suite: Structure- and Data-Aware Binary Decompilation with Efficient LLMs
title_zh: CodeInverter 套件：利用高效大语言模型进行结构与数据感知的二进制反编译
date_basis: Online and print publication date in ACM’s Crossref deposit; arXiv first submission is recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 向 Crossref 提交的在线及印刷出版日期，另行保留 arXiv 首次提交日期。
description_en: CodeInverter studies function-level LLM decompilation using control-flow graphs and memory-to-data mappings extracted with IDA/objdump. It presents a prompt workflow, training corpus and model family, evaluated through compilation, benchmark input/output tests and edit similarity.
description_zh: CodeInverter 研究函数级 LLM 反编译，使用 IDA／objdump 提取的控制流图和内存到数据映射补充输入。论文提出提示工作流、训练语料与模型系列，并以编译、基准输入输出测试和编辑相似性评估结果。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers individual C functions under 32/64-bit GCC settings. Whole-program recovery, aggressive optimization and protected binaries remain limitations. The text reports one epoch (15 steps), while the pinned launch example sets one epoch and 100 warmup steps; the exact training schedule remains unresolved.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估针对 32／64 位 GCC 设置下的单个 C 函数。完整程序恢复、激进优化和受保护二进制仍有局限。正文写有 1 个 epoch（15 步），固定版本启动示例设置 1 个 epoch 及 100 个预热步，尚无法据此核实精确训练日程。
why_fits_en: Adds structure- and data-informed LLM decompilation with separate compilation, execution-test and similarity evidence.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合程序结构与数据上下文的 LLM 反编译研究，并区分编译、执行测试与相似性证据。
metadata_notes: The v3 title and ten-author order match ACM’s Crossref deposit. The repository README at 548e59c still cites v2/2025. Direct ACM access returned HTTP 403. Artifact snapshots are separately versioned. The training directory contains MIT and DeepSeek notices; the CIM-1.3B card declares CC BY 4.0.
metadata_notes_zh: v3 的标题和十位作者顺序与 ACM 的 Crossref 元数据一致，仓库 548e59c 版本的 README 仍引用 v2／2025。直接访问 ACM 返回 HTTP 403。各产物使用独立版本。训练目录包含 MIT 与 DeepSeek 许可说明，CIM-1.3B 模型卡声明 CC BY 4.0。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering

title: FirmPilot: Evidence-Guided Multi-Agent Environment Recovery for IoT Firmware Rehosting
title_zh: FirmPilot：证据引导的多智能体物联网固件运行环境恢复
date_basis: arXiv first submission date; no separate publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期，未核实另行出版的版本。
description_en: FirmPilot reconstructs QEMU execution environments through coordinated retrieval, planning, filesystem, persistent-state and network recovery. Proposed changes are applied as constrained artifact deltas, then checked by rerunning the firmware and fixed probes.
description_zh: FirmPilot 协调检索、规划、文件系统、持久状态与网络恢复来重建 QEMU 执行环境。候选修改被落实为受约束的产物差异，再通过重新运行固件与固定探测检查。
scope_limitations_en: The main denominator is 10,033 obtainable LFwC images, not all 10,913 metadata records. Reachability under a 2,400-second budget is not whole-device equivalence; HTTP success can include redirects or authentication gates. Reported results use one LLM backend and fixed probes.
scope_limitations_zh: 主要分母为可取得的 10,033 个 LFwC 镜像，而非全部 10,913 条元数据记录。2,400 秒预算内的可达性不等于完整设备等价，HTTP 成功也包含重定向与认证入口。报告结果使用单一模型后端及固定探测。
why_fits_en: Uses execution evidence to recover the missing environment needed to inspect firmware behavior.
why_fits_zh: 利用执行证据恢复观察固件行为所需的缺失运行环境。
metadata_notes: arXiv v1 as a preprint; its baseline and corpus references are separate works.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v1 预印本；文中引用的基线与固件语料是另行发布的工作。

title: FirmCure:Towards Autonomous and Adaptive Rehosting of Linux-Based Firmware
title_zh: FirmCure：面向自主、自适应的 Linux 固件运行环境迁移
date_basis: arXiv first submission date; no separate publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期，未核实另行出版的版本。
description_en: FirmCure combines static dependency analysis, iterative boot-configuration repair and runtime fault diagnosis to rehost Linux firmware in QEMU. Specialized agents apply targeted repairs and use execution feedback to recover service behavior.
description_zh: FirmCure 将静态依赖分析、启动配置迭代修复与运行时故障诊断结合起来，在 QEMU 中迁移 Linux 固件。专门的智能体执行针对性修复，并利用执行反馈恢复服务行为。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers 21 images from ten vendors and five architectures: all opened ports, but only 19 reached full service interactivity within 45 minutes. Substituting an approximate kernel cannot preserve original-kernel or dedicated-hardware vulnerabilities. LLM reasoning loops caused residual failures. These author-reported results.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测覆盖十家厂商、五种架构的 21 个镜像：全部打开了端口，但只有 19 个在 45 分钟内实现完整服务交互。近似内核替换不能保留依赖原内核或专用硬件的漏洞，模型推理循环仍会导致失败。这些作者报告的结果。
why_fits_en: Connects binary inspection and failure diagnosis to evidence-driven firmware environment repair.
why_fits_zh: 将二进制观察和故障诊断连接到依据证据进行的固件环境修复。
metadata_notes: ArXiv v1 is a preprint. Open Science mentions an anonymous repository without a locatable link. A same-named GitHub repository was not bound to this paper or its authors.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v1 为预印本。开放科学部分提到匿名仓库，却未给出可定位链接；同名 GitHub 仓库与论文及作者的关联尚未核实。

title: Reactive Peripheral Modeling for Faithful Firmware Rehosting
title_zh: 面向忠实固件运行迁移的响应式外设建模
date_basis: arXiv first submission date; no separate publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期，未核实另行出版的版本。
description_en: Bluezz models peripherals as stateful event-condition-action systems, coordinating interrupts, MMIO and DMA rather than treating accesses independently. It uses these models to rehost BLE firmware and reach connected protocol states for analysis and fuzzing.
description_zh: Bluezz 将外设建模为具有状态的事件—条件—动作系统，协调中断、MMIO 与 DMA，而非孤立处理各次访问；据此迁移 BLE 固件，进入已连接协议状态进行分析与模糊测试。
scope_limitations_en: The BLE evaluation covers 18 targets, with additional limited MCU examples. Hardware specifications, behavioral rules and use-case drivers require preparation and human validation.
scope_limitations_zh: BLE 评测覆盖 18 个目标，并补充了有限的其他 MCU 案例。硬件规格、行为规则与用例驱动仍需准备和人工验证。
why_fits_en: Reconstructs missing peripheral semantics so firmware and protocol behavior can be inspected in emulation.
why_fits_zh: 重建缺失的外设语义，使固件及协议行为可以在仿真中被观察。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1 as a preprint: earlier conference submissions are not acceptance. The paper links an anonymous review artifact and describes release upon acceptance; its landing page was reachable, but implementation availability and licensing were not verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 按预印本审阅 arXiv v1：此前向会议投稿不等于录用。论文给出匿名评审产物链接，并说明录用后发布；入口页可访问，但未核实实现的可获取性及许可。

title: Recovering Process Variables from Industrial Network Traffic via Search-Based Optimization
title_zh: 基于搜索优化从工业网络流量恢复过程变量
date_basis: The official CCS 2026 accepted-paper list and arXiv v2 establish acceptance; a publication date was not verified.
date_basis_zh: CCS 2026 官方录用名单与 arXiv v2 确认录用；未核实正式出版日期。
description_en: PVParser recovers process-variable layouts from industrial traffic and historian records. Periodic-pattern detection locates relevant payloads; a modified Monte Carlo tree search proposes field boundaries, types and endianness, then aligns decoded sequences with observed process variables.
description_zh: PVParser 根据工业流量与历史过程记录恢复过程变量布局：周期模式检测定位相关载荷，改进的蒙特卡洛树搜索推断字段边界、类型和字节序，再将解码序列与已观察的过程变量对齐。
scope_limitations_en: Payload localization uses SCADA-N, SWaT and WADI; field/semantic recovery uses SWaT and WADI. Recovery depends on traffic and historian observations plus recurrent, stable plaintext byte layouts. Encrypted traffic, bit-level buses and event-driven messages whose PV lists vary are outside scope. It complements protocol dissectors.
scope_limitations_zh: 载荷定位评测采用 SCADA-N、SWaT 与 WADI；字段及语义恢复评测采用 SWaT 与 WADI。恢复依赖流量和历史记录，以及重复出现、布局稳定的明文字节载荷；加密流量、位级总线及变量列表动态变化的事件消息不在范围内。该方法补充协议解析器。
why_fits_en: Infers deployment-specific message fields and semantics from observed communication instead of supplied format specifications.
why_fits_zh: 从通信观测中推断部署相关的消息字段和语义，而非依赖既有格式说明。
metadata_notes: ArXiv v2 and the CCS 2026 accepted list name four authors; v1 listed eight. The author-supplied DOI 10.1145/3830454.3846584 did not resolve at review, and no publication date or proceedings container was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v2 与 CCS 2026 录用名单均列四位作者，v1 则列八位。作者提供的 DOI 10.1145/3830454.3846584 在复核时未解析成功，正式出版日期及论文集信息尚未核实。

title: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
title_zh: TaoD2C-Bench：超越视觉相似度的工业界面代码生成评测
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的提交日期，未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: TaoD2C-Bench reconstructs interfaces from design images, layer metadata and component-library documentation. It separates requirement inference from implementation, checking component choices and layout relations through source/runtime evidence alongside rendered appearance.
description_zh: TaoD2C-Bench 根据设计图、图层元数据与组件库文档重建界面，将需求推断与代码实现分别评测，并结合源码、运行时结构及渲染结果检查组件选择与布局关系。
scope_limitations_en: Eight models are evaluated on 421 designs, not the full 2,861-design collection. Results include specified retries and one output-repair attempt. The tasks assess component/layout constraints and visual fidelity, not complete application behavior; all designs come from one commercial ecosystem.
scope_limitations_zh: 八个模型的实测范围为 421 个设计，而非完整的 2,861 个设计。结果包含规定的重试与一次输出修复；任务衡量组件、布局约束及视觉相似度，不验证完整应用行为，设计来源也集中于同一商业生态。
why_fits_en: Adds requirement-level checks for screenshot- and metadata-guided interface reconstruction.
why_fits_zh: 为截图及元数据驱动的界面重建补充需求级检查。
metadata_notes: The linked repository at d4547c4 contains evaluation JSON only; no scorer or license file was found. Paper Appendix F assigns CC BY-NC 4.0 to annotations and separate restrictive terms to platform-owned assets.
metadata_notes_zh: 所链接仓库的 d4547c4 版本仅含评测 JSON，未找到评分器或许可证文件。论文附录 F 将标注列为 CC BY-NC 4.0，并为平台自有素材规定另行限制条款。

title: From Visual Widgets to UI Code: Efficient Tool-Grounded Generation
title_zh: 从视觉组件到界面代码：借助工具证据的高效生成
date_basis: The official 2026 MUCG workshop program confirms inclusion; a proceedings publication date was not verified.
date_basis_zh: MUCG 2026 官方研讨会日程确认收录，尚未核实正式论文集的出版日期。
description_en: WidgetGen reconstructs widget screenshots as React JSX. OCR text boxes and color palettes guide whole-widget layout reasoning and optional chart generation before one terminal render; generated render/code pairs also support model fine-tuning.
description_zh: WidgetGen 将组件截图重建为 React JSX，利用 OCR 文本框与调色板支持整体布局推理及可选图表生成，最后渲染一次；生成的渲染图与代码配对还用于模型微调。
scope_limitations_en: The main comparison uses six models and 1,000 test widgets from one dataset. Its nine image-based metrics do not test interaction, accessibility or maintainability. The supervision experiment covers six Qwen-family checkpoints; broader UI and model-family generalization remains open.
scope_limitations_zh: 主要对比使用六个模型与单一数据集中的 1,000 个测试组件。九项图像指标不检验交互、无障碍或可维护性；监督学习实验仅覆盖六个 Qwen 系列模型，更多界面分布与模型系列的泛化尚未确定。
why_fits_en: Studies evidence-assisted recovery of executable interface code from compact visual references.
why_fits_zh: 研究根据紧凑视觉参考与工具证据恢复可执行界面代码。
metadata_notes: The official MUCG 2026 program lists this paper; proceedings publication was not verified, and OpenReview required browser verification. The arXiv paper is CC BY 4.0. No dedicated implementation or weight link was found in the reviewed paper/program; Widget2Code is the separate benchmark source.
metadata_notes_zh: MUCG 2026 官方日程列出本论文，但未核实正式论文集出版；OpenReview 页面要求浏览器验证。arXiv 论文采用 CC BY 4.0。所审论文及日程未给出专门的实现或权重链接，Widget2Code 是另行引用的基准来源。

title: Does It Render Everywhere? A Study of Cross-Environment Compatibility in MLLM-Generated Webpages
title_zh: 能否处处正确渲染？多模态模型生成网页的跨环境兼容性研究
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的提交日期，未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: WebCompat evaluates screenshot-reconstructed webpages across browsers and devices. Its XCompat detector combines rendered DOM geometry, viewport metadata and screenshots to identify layout and element failures, independently of similarity to the original design.
description_zh: WebCompat 评测由截图重建的网页在不同浏览器与设备中的表现。XCompat 结合渲染后 DOM 几何信息、视口元数据及截图检测布局与元素问题，并将跨环境一致性与原始设计的相似度区分开。
scope_limitations_en: Filtering retains 254 static pages from 480 generations, producing 2,032 comparison pairs. The held-out detector test uses 51 pages/408 pairs. Failed renders and interaction-dependent layouts are excluded; heuristic errors and subjective design intent limit generalization to dynamic sites or every environment.
scope_limitations_zh: 从 480 次生成中筛留 254 个静态网页，组成 2,032 个对照样本；保留测试集为 51 页、408 对。失败渲染与依赖交互的布局被排除，启发式误差及设计意图的主观性限制了对动态网站或所有环境的泛化。
why_fits_en: Adds cross-environment validation for reconstructed frontends beyond single-screenshot similarity.
why_fits_zh: 为重建前端补充跨环境验证，超出单张截图相似度的范围。
metadata_notes: The pinned public snapshot contains 203 empirical pages; the paper’s 51-page test split was not found. README reports no license and incomplete collection/metric packaging. Its 56 passing tests are author-reported.
metadata_notes_zh: 固定版本的公开快照包含 203 个实证分析网页，未找到论文所述的 51 页测试集。README 说明缺少许可证，采集与指标流程的打包也不完整。56 项测试通过是作者报告。

title: UniCoder: Unified Visual-to-Code Generation via Symbolic Rewards and Reference-Guided Code Optimization
title_zh: UniCoder：利用符号奖励与参考代码引导优化的统一视觉到代码生成
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的提交日期，未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: UniCoder trains a visual-to-code model for charts, SVGs and webpages. Its reinforcement-learning objective combines rendering checks, image similarity and code-derived visual attributes; low-reward training groups receive reference-code trajectories to improve exploration.
description_zh: UniCoder 面向图表、SVG 与网页训练视觉到代码模型。强化学习目标结合渲染检查、图像相似度和代码中的视觉属性，并向低奖励训练组加入参考代码轨迹以改善探索。
scope_limitations_en: Experiments concern static visual reconstruction with one 8B backbone, including Design2Code and ScreenBench. Reference code is used during training; successful rendering does not prove interactive behavior. Extending the attribute extractor to new domains requires new schemas/prompts. Interactive interfaces, animation and mobile-app behavior are not evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: 实验以一个 8B 基座模型研究静态视觉重建，包含 Design2Code 与 ScreenBench。参考代码用于训练，渲染成功不证明交互行为正确；新领域需要调整属性模式与提示词。交互界面、动画及移动应用行为未被评测。
why_fits_en: Explores training signals for recovering code from visual website references.
why_fits_zh: 探索根据网页视觉参考恢复代码的训练信号。
metadata_notes: At 2844ebd, the repository releases ChartMimic/UniSVG evaluation wrappers, not model weights, full training code or datasets. Original repository code is Apache-2.0; adapted benchmarks retain their own terms. The arXiv title includes “UniCoder”; the HTML heading and software citation omit that prefix.
metadata_notes_zh: 仓库 2844ebd 版本发布 ChartMimic／UniSVG 评测封装，未发布模型权重、完整训练代码或数据集。仓库原创代码采用 Apache-2.0，改编基准仍保留原条款。arXiv 标题包含“UniCoder”前缀，HTML 标题及软件引用则省略该前缀。

title: NotDec: WebAssembly Decompilation With Inter-Procedural Type Recovery
title_zh: NotDec：通过跨过程类型恢复进行 WebAssembly 反编译
date_basis: Publisher-deposited print publication date; online and arXiv dates are recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用出版方提交的印刷出版日期；在线及 arXiv 日期另行说明。
description_en: NotDec lifts WebAssembly into SSA-based IR, uses Retypd-derived type constraints and pointer/value distinctions to recover structures, and emits C. Its study separates full interprocedural analysis from a faster intraprocedural variant.
description_zh: NotDec 将 WebAssembly 提升为 SSA 中间表示，通过基于 Retypd 的类型约束及指针／数值区分恢复结构，并生成 C。研究区分完整跨过程分析与较快的过程内变体。
scope_limitations_en: The study uses Juliet and five Howard programs at O0/O3. Howard binaries omit actual library linking and cannot be executed, so recompilation does not demonstrate behavioral equivalence. Full analysis timed out on six Howard variants at 24 hours; recompilation results cover successful decompilations. The inspected README also warns about backend syntax errors on complex statements.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究使用 O0／O3 下的 Juliet 样例和五个 Howard 程序。Howard 二进制未实际链接所需库，无法执行，因此重编译不证明行为等价。完整分析有六个 Howard 变体在 24 小时超时；重编译结果仅覆盖成功反编译的样例。已检查的 README 也提醒复杂语句可能产生后端语法错误。
why_fits_en: Adds a concrete WebAssembly type-recovery and decompilation study with explicit scaling and execution limits.
why_fits_zh: 补充具体的 WebAssembly 类型恢复与反编译研究，并保留扩展性及执行验证的边界。
metadata_notes: Publisher metadata gives print/publication 2026-04-12 and online 2026-09-11; the arXiv deposit is 2026-08-04. ACM returned HTTP 403, so publication identity uses its Crossref deposit and author HTML. The paper is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The linked repository README at 0399bf0 describes ongoing work; its evaluated revision and repository-wide code/data license were not established. No root LICENSE/COPYING was present in the inspected tree.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版元数据给出印刷／出版日期 2026-04-12、在线日期 2026-09-11；arXiv 提交于 2026-08-04。ACM 直接访问返回 HTTP 403，出版身份依据其 Crossref 元数据及作者 HTML。论文采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0。关联仓库 0399bf0 的 README 仍描述进行中的工作；尚未确定实验对应版本及覆盖全仓库代码／数据的许可，检查的根目录未出现 LICENSE／COPYING。

title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
title_zh: 超越文本匹配：面向人的二进制逆向工程的无参考评估
date_basis: Publisher-deposited print publication date; online and arXiv dates are recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用出版方提交的印刷出版日期；在线及 arXiv 日期另行说明。
description_en: BinJudgeBench collects expert judgments for function naming, binary-code summaries and decompilation refinement. BinJudge learns to select a judge configuration for each input and task, evaluating agreement with human scores rather than executable correctness.
description_zh: BinJudgeBench 收集函数命名、二进制代码摘要及反编译改进的专家评分。BinJudge 学习为每个输入及任务选择评审配置，评估与人工评分的一致性，而非可执行正确性。
scope_limitations_en: The router uses five-fold validation on 1,233 annotated outputs. Initial annotators are three authors, with an independent industrial expert checking a subset. Human scores are subjective, and fluent unsupported answers can mislead judges. Correlation on these tasks neither proves program equivalence nor establishes that judges can replace human review.
scope_limitations_zh: 路由器在 1,233 个已标注输出上进行五折验证。初始标注者是三位作者，另有独立产业专家复核子集。人工评分具有主观性，流畅但无依据的回答也可能误导评审。任务上的相关性既不证明程序等价，也不能据此认定评审模型可替代人工复核。
why_fits_en: Provides evidence-oriented evaluation resources for interpreting names, summaries and refined pseudocode.
why_fits_zh: 补充解释恢复名称、代码摘要及改进后伪代码时所需的评估证据。
metadata_notes: The arXiv abstract still says accepted, while ACM’s Crossref deposit records ASE 2026 publication on 2026-10-07. Direct ACM access returned HTTP 403. The paper-linked Zenodo concept 19247812 resolves to version 19310393, titled Artifact for BinJudge, with anonymous creator metadata and CC BY 4.0.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 摘要页仍写已录用，ACM 的 Crossref 元数据则记录 ASE 2026 于 2026-10-07 出版。ACM 直接访问返回 HTTP 403。论文链接的 Zenodo 概念记录 19247812 解析到版本 19310393，标题为 Artifact for BinJudge，创建者元数据匿名，声明 CC BY 4.0。

title: Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation
title_zh: Echo：基于可信回译的学习式匹配反编译
date_basis: First arXiv submission date from the reviewed submission history; no formal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用已核对的 arXiv 首次提交日期；尚未核实正式出版信息。
description_en: Echo iteratively generates source and compiler configurations, recompiles candidates, and uses assembly differences to guide configuration search and code refinement. It evaluates matching on function benchmarks and selected functions from a Mirai binary.
description_zh: Echo 迭代生成源码及编译配置，重新编译候选，并使用汇编差异指导配置搜索与代码修正。研究在函数基准和一个 Mirai 二进制的部分函数上评估匹配结果。
scope_limitations_en: Matching means equality of normalized function assembly under evaluated compilation settings, not byte-for-byte recovery of a whole executable. Tests cover selected x86 GCC/LLVM settings and 62 Mirai functions; passing finite harness tests is not a general equivalence proof. Long optimized functions and configurations outside the searched space remain limitations.
scope_limitations_zh: 匹配指评估配置下归一化函数汇编相同，并非逐字节恢复完整可执行文件。测试覆盖选定的 x86 GCC／LLVM 设置及 62 个 Mirai 函数；通过有限测试框架不是一般等价证明。较长的优化函数及搜索空间外的编译配置仍是限制。
why_fits_en: Adds compiler-feedback-driven matching decompilation while separating its matching criterion from test-only recovery.
why_fits_zh: 补充由编译反馈驱动的匹配反编译，并区分其匹配标准与仅依据测试的恢复判断。
metadata_notes: Latest reviewed version is arXiv v1. The Open Science section uses the placeholder anonymous.4open.science/xxxx, so no usable author artifact, model revision or code/data license was verified. The article uses the arXiv non-exclusive distribution license.
metadata_notes_zh: 最新核对版本为 arXiv v1。开放科学段落使用 anonymous.4open.science/xxxx 占位链接，尚未核实可用的作者产物、模型版本或代码／数据许可。文章采用 arXiv 非独占传播许可。

title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less
title_zh: 当 LLM 反编译器更易重编译，却更少保留原始行为
date_basis: First arXiv submission date from the reviewed submission history; no formal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用已核对的 arXiv 首次提交日期；尚未核实正式出版信息。
description_en: Decompile-Diverge builds function-level behavioral comparisons from source-derived drivers and fuzzed reference inputs. The study compares reconstructed functions on the same inputs and examines divergences and missing crashes that compilation and supplied tests can miss.
description_zh: Decompile-Diverge 基于源码生成驱动，并对参考实现进行模糊测试，以构建函数级行为比较。研究让重建函数使用相同输入，检查编译及既有测试可能漏掉的行为差异与崩溃消失。
scope_limitations_en: The oracle requires reference source, supported inputs and buildable harnesses. It compares a finite corpus and bounded observable state; Matched does not prove all-input equivalence. Nine of 300 GitHub reference functions failed harness builds, leaving 291. Some types/functions are excluded. DeGPT-Qwen is a substituted-backend configuration, not the originally published DeGPT model.
scope_limitations_zh: 该判定器需要参考源码、受支持输入及可构建的测试框架。比较仅覆盖有限输入语料和有界可观测状态；Matched 不代表所有输入上的等价。300 个 GitHub 参考函数中九个无法构建，最终保留 291 个；部分类型与函数被排除。DeGPT-Qwen 使用替换后的后端，并非原始发表的 DeGPT 模型。
why_fits_en: Offers a concrete check on what recompilation and benchmark pass rates do not establish about recovered code.
why_fits_zh: 具体说明重编译及基准通过率无法证明恢复代码的哪些行为属性。
metadata_notes: Latest reviewed version is arXiv v1, licensed CC BY 4.0. No author-linked code or dataset URL was verified in the reviewed paper and focused artifact search; availability and artifact licenses remain unverified. Reported measurements.
metadata_notes_zh: 最新核对版本为 arXiv v1，文章采用 CC BY 4.0。已读论文及定向产物检索未核实作者代码或数据集链接；产物可用性与许可仍未确定。文中测量结果。

title: ASAP: Assembly-Source Aligned Pseudocode Refinement For Binary Decompilation
title_zh: ASAP：通过汇编与源码对齐改进二进制反编译伪代码
date_basis: First arXiv submission date from the reviewed submission history; no formal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用已核对的 arXiv 首次提交日期；尚未核实正式出版信息。
description_en: ASAP aligns assembly and source representations during training, compresses assembly features into tokens, and supplies them alongside decompiler pseudocode to an LLM refiner. Masking and an assembly-advantage objective encourage the refiner to use low-level evidence.
description_zh: ASAP 在训练中对齐汇编与源码表示，将汇编特征压缩为标记，并与反编译伪代码一起交给 LLM 改进。掩码及汇编优势目标用于鼓励模型利用低层证据。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses C adaptations of HumanEval and MBPP, x86-64 GCC 11.4 at O0–O3, and Ghidra 11.0.3 pseudocode. Re-execution means passing supplied tests, not proving equivalence. Identifier/comment recovery is not a dedicated component, and frontier-scale model training is not exhaustively evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估使用 HumanEval、MBPP 的 C 改编版本，采用 x86-64 GCC 11.4 的 O0–O3 及 Ghidra 11.0.3 伪代码。重新执行率指通过既有测试，并非等价证明。方法没有专门的标识符／注释恢复模块，也未穷尽评估前沿规模模型的训练。
why_fits_en: Adds an assembly-informed refinement approach that explicitly documents the limits of its execution-test evidence.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合汇编证据的反编译改进方法，并明确执行测试证据的边界。
metadata_notes: Both the abstract history and v1 HTML give 2026-09-30, despite the 2610 identifier prefix. The article is CC BY 4.0. No author artifact URL or code/model/data license was verified from the reviewed sources and focused search; referenced training datasets retain their own terms.
metadata_notes_zh: 尽管编号以 2610 开头，摘要历史与 v1 HTML 均给出 2026-09-30。文章采用 CC BY 4.0。已核对来源及定向检索未确认作者产物链接或代码／模型／数据许可；引用的训练数据集保留自身条款。

title: STILL: Recovering Lowered STL Semantics for LLM-assisted C++ Decompilation
title_zh: STILL：为 LLM 辅助 C++ 反编译恢复编译后隐藏的 STL 语义
date_basis: First arXiv submission date from the reviewed submission history; no formal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用已核对的 arXiv 首次提交日期；尚未核实正式出版信息。
description_en: STILL predicts function-level STL container presence from stripped control-flow graphs and turns those predictions into compact hints for LLM refinement of Ghidra output. StlBench supplies controlled labels for five container classes.
description_zh: STILL 从去符号控制流图预测函数级 STL 容器的存在情况，并将预测转成紧凑提示，供 LLM 改进 Ghidra 输出。StlBench 为五类容器提供受控标注。
scope_limitations_en: The interface covers map, queue, set, string and vector, not full variable types, template arguments, nesting, iterators or std::array. Experiments use g++/x86-64/libstdc++ with angr and Ghidra; transfer to other toolchains is unverified. Test-suite executability is not equivalence, and hint benefits depend on the downstream model and adaptation.
scope_limitations_zh: 接口覆盖 map、queue、set、string、vector，不恢复完整变量类型、模板参数、嵌套关系、迭代器或 std::array。实验采用 g++／x86-64／libstdc++、angr 及 Ghidra，未验证向其他工具链的迁移。测试集可执行性不等于等价；提示收益也取决于下游模型及适配。
why_fits_en: Connects explicit container-semantic recovery with LLM-assisted C++ decompilation without claiming full type reconstruction.
why_fits_zh: 连接显式容器语义恢复与 LLM 辅助 C++ 反编译，同时保留其并非完整类型重建的边界。
metadata_notes: Latest reviewed version is arXiv v1, under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The appendix describes an artifact and a planned public StlBench release but gives no verified access URL. Its code, model and dataset licensing was not established.
metadata_notes_zh: 最新核对版本为 arXiv v1，文章采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0。附录描述产物及计划公开的 StlBench，但未提供已核实的访问链接。代码、模型及数据集许可尚未确定。

title: CHISEL-ing Back Source Code with AI-enabled Iterative Recovery
title_zh: CHISEL：借助 AI 迭代恢复源码
date_basis: Acceptance is reported in the author arXiv record and publications page; proceedings publication is not verified.
date_basis_zh: 作者的 arXiv 记录及论文页面报告已录用；未核实正式论文集出版。
description_en: CHISEL refines Ghidra pseudocode using compiler diagnostics and type-aware differential fuzzing against the original function. It retains counterexamples and candidate history; existing I/O pairs are held out for evaluation rather than supplied to the recovery loop.
description_zh: CHISEL 利用编译诊断及针对原函数的类型感知差分模糊测试改进 Ghidra 伪代码，并保留反例与候选历史。既有 I/O 样例用于保留评测，不提供给恢复循环。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers 120 selected ExeBench functions, x86-64 O0–O3, stripped/unstripped variants and a fixed Gemma4:31b model. The feedback oracle still falsely accepts candidates; finite fuzzing and held-out tests do not establish equivalence. Signature recovery and possible benchmark exposure remain limitations.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估覆盖 120 个选定 ExeBench 函数、x86-64 的 O0–O3、有／无符号变体及固定的 Gemma4:31b 模型。反馈判定器仍会错误接受候选；有限模糊测试及保留测试不证明等价。签名恢复及基准可能进入预训练语料仍是限制。
why_fits_en: Adds test-suite-free in-loop refinement while explicitly separating oracle acceptance from verified behavior.
why_fits_zh: 补充循环内不依赖既有测试集的修正方法，并区分判定器接受与行为验证。
metadata_notes: Author sources report acceptance to SURE 2026; the manuscript DOI remains a placeholder, so no proceedings publication date or DOI is assigned. The paper says selection requires at least 200 tests, while the pinned README says at least 100 held-out I/O pairs; exact evaluated artifact alignment remains unresolved. The article is CC BY 4.0, but the inspected root/README did not establish a code/data license.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者来源报告已被 SURE 2026 录用；手稿 DOI 仍是占位值，因此不填入正式论文集出版日期或 DOI。论文的筛选要求至少 200 个测试，固定版本 README 则写至少 100 个保留 I/O 样例，尚未确定与实际评估产物的精确对应。文章采用 CC BY 4.0，但所查根目录及 README 未确立代码／数据许可。

title: Decaf: Improving Neural Decompilation with Automatic Feedback and Search
title_zh: Decaf：通过自动反馈与搜索改进神经反编译
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: Decaf samples multiple candidate decompilations, recompiles them and ranks them using compiler-derived byte distance or a learned reranker. The work studies candidate selection as a way to improve neural decompilation without an iterative source-repair conversation.
description_zh: Decaf 采样多个反编译候选，重新编译后利用字节距离或学习式重排序器排序。研究通过候选选择改进神经反编译，而非使用迭代源码修复对话。
scope_limitations_en: Byte matching assumes access to the reference compiler/configuration. Experiments subsample ExeBench and exclude examples Hex-Rays cannot decompile; stripped Synth is not execution-scored because call targets cannot be linked. Supplied tests can miss errors. Alternate architectures and obfuscated code are not evaluated, and Juliet results need not generalize to complex vulnerabilities.
scope_limitations_zh: 字节匹配假设能取得参考编译器及配置。实验对 ExeBench 抽样，并排除 Hex-Rays 无法反编译的样例；去符号 Synth 因调用目标无法链接而未进行执行评分。既有测试可能漏错，实验未覆盖其他架构及混淆代码，Juliet 结果也不必然泛化到复杂漏洞。
why_fits_en: Provides a compiler-feedback and candidate-ranking approach with clear distinctions between matching and test-based evidence.
why_fits_zh: 补充编译反馈与候选排序方法，并区分匹配证据和基于测试的判断。
metadata_notes: This May 2026 preprint is within the six-month fallback window and is explicitly under review. The pinned code root has no license file; inspected generator/test-set metadata exposes no license declaration.
metadata_notes_zh: 该预印本首投于 2026 年 5 月，属于六个月备用窗口，来源明确写仍在审稿。固定代码根目录没有许可证文件，检查的生成器／测试集元数据也未给出许可声明。

title: Binary Decompilation LLM with Feedback-Driven Multi-Turn Refinement
title_zh: 基于反馈驱动多轮修正的二进制反编译大语言模型
date_basis: First arXiv submission on 2026-06-15; the reviewed v2 revision is 2026-10-03, not a separate publication.
date_basis_zh: 采用 2026-06-15 的 arXiv 首投日期；本次核对的 v2 修订日期为 2026-10-03，并非另一次出版。
description_en: AutoDecompiler trains function-level decompilation models to revise assembly- or pseudocode-derived outputs using compilation, execution and I/O feedback. Its reinforcement-learning design combines diagnostic feedback with rewards for valid code, tested behavior, syntax and data-flow structure.
description_zh: AutoDecompiler 训练函数级反编译模型，利用编译、执行及 I/O 反馈修正汇编或伪代码输入产生的输出。其强化学习设计结合诊断反馈及代码有效性、测试行为、语法和数据流结构奖励。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses C adaptations of HumanEval and MBPP with validation feedback; finite tests do not establish general equivalence. HumanEval also informs reward-weight selection, and base-model pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out. Refinement is context-limited, whole-program dependencies are not recovered, and unseen toolchains or protected binaries remain limitations.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估采用 HumanEval、MBPP 的 C 改编版本及验证反馈，有限测试不证明一般等价。HumanEval 还用于选择奖励权重，无法排除基座模型预训练时接触基准。修正受上下文长度限制，不恢复完整程序依赖，对未见工具链或受保护二进制仍有局限。
why_fits_en: Adds reinforcement-learning-trained use of program feedback, with separately recorded first submission and latest revision.
why_fits_zh: 补充通过强化学习学习利用程序反馈的方案，并分别记录首投与最新修订。
metadata_notes: First submitted 2026-06-15; reviewed v2 is dated 2026-10-03. The arXiv record uses the shorter catalog title, while the v2 PDF/HTML use a longer title beginning “AutoDecompiler: Reinforcement-Learning-Trained”; eight authors match. Zenodo version 23120286 lists code/data archives under CC BY 4.0. The inspected Hugging Face model has no license metadata.
metadata_notes_zh: 首投日期为 2026-06-15，本次核对的 v2 日期为 2026-10-03。目录采用 arXiv 记录的较短标题，v2 PDF／HTML 采用以“AutoDecompiler: Reinforcement-Learning-Trained”开头的更长标题，八位作者一致。Zenodo 版本 23120286 列出采用 CC BY 4.0 的代码／数据归档。已查 Hugging Face 模型未提供许可元数据。

title: The Evolution of Binary Decompilation in the Modern Era: A Taxonomy, Literature Review, and Future Perspectives
title_zh: 现代二进制反编译的演进：分类体系、文献回顾与未来展望
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: This survey maps traditional, dynamic, matching and neural decompilation approaches, then organizes type recovery, control-flow restructuring, naming and refinement tasks alongside evaluation metrics and benchmark choices. An accompanying repository provides the reviewed literature list.
description_zh: 该综述梳理传统、动态、匹配及神经反编译方法，并组织类型恢复、控制流重构、命名和改进等任务及其评估指标、基准选择。配套仓库提供所审文献列表。
scope_limitations_en: The search ends in December 2025 and focuses on peer-reviewed studies of C-origin binaries. Selection and categorization involve manual judgment. Reported tool capabilities reflect surveyed publications, not necessarily current implementations. It is a literature synthesis, not a newly reproduced cross-tool performance benchmark or a complete account of 2026 preprints.
scope_limitations_zh: 文献搜索截止 2025 年 12 月，重点是源自 C 的二进制及经过同行评审的研究。筛选和分类含人工判断。工具能力描述反映所审出版物，不必然对应当前实现。这是文献综合，而非新近复现的跨工具性能基准，也不是完整的 2026 年预印本汇总。
why_fits_en: Provides a structured map for finding decompilation techniques, benchmarks and the assumptions behind their evaluation.
why_fits_zh: 为检索反编译技术、基准及其评估假设提供结构化索引。
metadata_notes: The manuscript says under review at ACM Computing Surveys. The paper is CC BY 4.0. The pinned repository has a README and 72-row bibliography CSV, not a decompiler implementation; no separate repository license was established.
metadata_notes_zh: 手稿写正在 ACM Computing Surveys 审稿。论文采用 CC BY 4.0。固定仓库包含 README 与 72 行文献 CSV，并非反编译器实现；尚未确立独立仓库许可。

title: SoK: Are LLMs Reliable at Source Code Recovery? A Taxonomy and Empirical Evaluation
title_zh: SoK：LLM 恢复源码是否可靠？分类体系与实证评估
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; no separate proceedings or journal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；未核实另行出版的会议论文集或期刊版本。
description_en: This SoK organizes LLM-assisted source-recovery designs and separates compilation, readability, structural and behavioral metrics. Its controlled study varies architecture, compiler optimization and symbol availability, with smaller ablations for input representation, model roles and source language.
description_zh: 该 SoK 组织 LLM 辅助源码恢复方案，并区分编译、可读性、结构与行为指标。受控研究改变架构、编译优化及符号状态，并以较小的消融实验考察输入表示、模型角色和源语言。
scope_limitations_en: The 45,000 cases are variants of 500 functions, not independent programs. Input/language ablations use 50 functions; translated language variants were produced with an LLM and checked using finite I/O tests. The study assumes a derivable call interface, is prompt-sensitive and cannot exclude ExeBench pretraining exposure. Test agreement and relocation-masked byte matching have different assumptions.
scope_limitations_zh: 45,000 个案例是 500 个函数的变体，并非独立程序。输入／语言消融使用 50 个函数，跨语言变体由 LLM 翻译后以有限 I/O 测试检查。研究假设调用接口可推导，结果受提示影响，也无法排除 ExeBench 进入预训练。测试一致性与屏蔽重定位位置的字节匹配具有不同假设。
why_fits_en: Adds a recent evaluation taxonomy and controlled evidence for comparing source-recovery methods without collapsing distinct correctness signals.
why_fits_zh: 补充近期评估分类与受控证据，用于比较源码恢复方法，并避免混同不同正确性信号。
metadata_notes: The arXiv v1 article is CC BY 4.0. Its anonymous artifact was readable in a browser; the page shows an October 1 snapshot available until 2027-03-29, without a full Git commit. The inspected README says a fresh database cannot directly re-score shipped generation files; redrawing supplied CSV results is a separate step. Artifact licensing was not established from the inspected README/root list.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v1 文章采用 CC BY 4.0。匿名产物可在浏览器中读取，页面显示 10 月 1 日快照、开放至 2027-03-29，但未暴露完整 Git 提交。已读 README 说明新数据库无法直接对所附生成文件重新评分，重画已有 CSV 结果属于另一层步骤。所查 README 及根目录未确立产物许可。

title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
title_zh: PrismaCoder：通过分解式评分准则生成提升开放多模态代码能力
date_basis: First arXiv submission; no reviewed venue publication is established.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期；未确立正式期刊或会议出版。
description_en: Trains visual-code models using separate code and rendered-output rubrics for data filtering and reinforcement learning. Relevant evaluations include rebuilding webpages, charts and vector graphics from images.
description_zh: 以代码与渲染结果的独立评分准则筛选数据并训练视觉代码模型，相关评测包括根据图像重建网页、图表和矢量图。
scope_limitations_en: Combines visual reconstruction with text-driven generation. Judge scores do not establish behavioral equivalence. Training and evaluation share some judge families; the human check uses 100 samples. Instruction n-gram filtering cannot exclude all pretraining exposure.
scope_limitations_zh: 同时涵盖视觉重建与文本生成，裁判评分不证明行为等价。训练与评测部分共用裁判模型家族，人工检查使用 100 个样本；指令 n-gram 过滤不能排除所有预训练接触。
why_fits_en: Provides a recent approach to reconstruction from rendered evidence.
why_fits_zh: 补充依据渲染结果进行重建的近期方法。
metadata_notes: Work in progress. DataCite confirms the DOI despite the arXiv pending label. The project code link is pending; the dataset API returned HTTP 401 anonymously. Reviewed model inventories include 9B and 35B-A3B-SFT with MIT card metadata.
metadata_notes_zh: 仍在进行中的工作。DataCite 已确认 DOI，arXiv 的待注册标记未同步。项目代码链接待发布，匿名数据集 API 返回 HTTP 401。已查模型文件清单包括 9B、35B-A3B-SFT，模型卡声明 MIT。

title: Reveree: Diagnosing LLM Reverse-Engineering Agents
title_zh: Reveree：诊断大语言模型逆向工程智能体
date_basis: First arXiv submission; no reviewed venue publication is established.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期；未确立正式期刊或会议出版。
description_en: Evaluates reverse-engineering agent traces through flag recovery, eight analysis milestones and action profiles. Deterministic checks and an outcome-blinded LLM judge help locate failures beyond a single solve-rate score.
description_zh: 从旗标恢复、八个分析阶段和操作特征评估逆向智能体轨迹，通过确定性检查与不知道最终结果的模型裁判定位失败环节。
scope_limitations_en: Uses 88 public CTF challenges and nine models; all four prompting strategies are compared on four models. Evaluation fixes the D-CIPHER harness and uses one attempt per setting. One expert checks 15 traces; agreement on judged comprehension stages is 53/60. Recall and surface-perturbation probes do not eliminate contamination.
scope_limitations_zh: 涵盖 88 个公开 CTF 题和九种模型，仅其中四种比较全部四种提示策略；固定 D-CIPHER 框架，每配置仅一次尝试。一位专家检查 15 条轨迹，理解阶段一致为 53/60；记忆与表面扰动探测不能消除数据污染。
why_fits_en: Adds process-level evaluation for binary-analysis agents.
why_fits_zh: 补充二进制分析智能体的过程评测。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1 and registered DOI. The paper announces a release, but the reviewed manuscript does not identify a dedicated artifact URL.
metadata_notes_zh: 已核对 arXiv v1 及注册 DOI。论文宣布发布，但所查手稿未给出专用产物链接。

title: From Code to Requirements: Agentic Reverse Engineering of Business Rules at Enterprise Scale
title_zh: 从代码到需求：企业规模的智能体业务规则逆向恢复
date_basis: First arXiv submission; no reviewed venue publication is established.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期；未确立正式期刊或会议出版。
description_en: Uses seven agents and human review to recover business requirements from source, tests, configuration and documentation. A reported enterprise migration checks extracted rules against production-defect records.
description_zh: 利用七个智能体与人工审查，从源码、测试、配置及文档恢复业务需求；企业迁移案例以生产缺陷记录核对提取的规则。
scope_limitations_en: Evidence covers one enterprise Java programme and one legacy pilot. The cost comparison uses a modeled manual baseline with asymmetric accounting. Static analysis misses some runtime and external rules; coverage does not establish completeness. Confidential inputs limit independent reproduction.
scope_limitations_zh: 证据来自一个企业 Java 项目及一个遗留系统试点。成本比较采用估算的人工基线，核算口径不对称。静态分析遗漏部分运行时与外部规则，覆盖率不证明完整性；保密输入限制独立复现。
why_fits_en: Extends application reconstruction to recovering behavioral specifications.
why_fits_zh: 将应用逆向恢复扩展至行为规格与业务规则。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the September 2026 preprint and registered DOI. No dedicated public code or dataset was verified. Reported efficiency is an author case-study result.
metadata_notes_zh: 已核对 2026 年 9 月预印本及注册 DOI，未核实专用公开代码或数据集。效率数字属于作者案例结果。

title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
title_zh: SWE-Game：编程智能体能否构建符合预期的游戏？
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is identified separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期，另列所复核版本。
description_en: Evaluates construction, completion, repair and Godot-to-Unity porting against executable reference games. Evaluator-owned probes and input replays check gameplay behavior, while visual rubrics assess presentation separately.
description_zh: 以可执行参考游戏评估构建、补全、修复及 Godot 到 Unity 的移植；由评测方控制的探针与输入回放检查玩法行为，视觉评分准则另行评价表现。
scope_limitations_en: The 247 tasks derive from 41 games. Inputs vary by task; porting receives Godot source, so this is not purely black-box reconstruction. Each model uses one framework, confounding their effects. Finite scenario checks and 100-game functional validation do not establish general gameplay equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 247 项任务来自 41 款游戏。各任务输入不同，移植任务提供 Godot 源码，因此并非纯黑盒重建。每个模型仅配一种框架，二者影响未分离；有限场景检查及 100 款游戏的功能验证不证明通用玩法等价。
why_fits_en: Adds executable checks for reference-guided game reconstruction and cross-engine behavior preservation.
why_fits_zh: 补充参考引导的游戏重建及跨引擎行为保留所需的可执行检查。
metadata_notes: First submitted September 27; reviewed v3 dated October 7. No author-linked code or dataset release was verified in the reviewed manuscript.
metadata_notes_zh: 首次提交为 9 月 27 日，本次复核 10 月 7 日 v3；所查手稿未核实作者关联的代码或数据发布。

title: MirrorCode: AI can rebuild entire programs from behavior alone
title_zh: MirrorCode：仅凭行为重建完整程序的评测
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is identified separately.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期，另列所复核版本。
description_en: Tests reimplementation of 25 command-line programs using execute-only reference access, documentation and visible examples. Separate scoring environments compare exact outputs on visible and held-out end-to-end tests.
description_zh: 利用仅可执行的参考程序、文档及可见样例，评测 25 个命令行程序的重新实现；在独立评分环境中对可见及留出端到端测试进行精确输出比较。
scope_limitations_en: Targets are scoped, deterministic, stateless programs with text output. Test agreement is not universal equivalence or code-quality assessment. A memorization screen flags possible exposure for 17 targets. Large inference budgets and scaffold choices limit comparisons with cheaper benchmarks; three targets remain private.
scope_limitations_zh: 目标限于指定范围内、确定性、无状态且输出文本的程序。测试一致不等于普遍等价或代码质量评估；记忆探测发现 17 个目标可能已被接触。较大推理预算及框架选择限制与低成本基准的比较，三个目标仍未公开。
why_fits_en: Directly evaluates sustained reconstruction from observable software behavior.
why_fits_zh: 直接评估依据可观察的软件行为开展长期重建的能力。
metadata_notes: June 29 first submission, July 17 v2: a six-month-window candidate. Distinct from ProgramBench, explicitly compared in the paper. The pinned repository has an MIT root license and public harness/task definitions, excluding private tasks; target-program licensing is separate.
metadata_notes_zh: 首投为 6 月 29 日，v2 为 7 月 17 日，属于近六个月补充候选。与 ProgramBench 不同，论文专门比较两者。固定仓库的根许可证为 MIT，包含公开框架与任务定义，不含私有任务；目标程序许可另行适用。

title: On the Viability of Requirements Generation from Code: An Experience Report
title_zh: 从代码生成需求是否可行：一份经验报告
date_basis: IEEE-deposited Crossref proceedings month; first arXiv submission was June 24, 2026.
date_basis_zh: 采用 IEEE 向 Crossref 登记的会议录出版月份；首次 arXiv 提交为 2026 年 6 月 24 日。
description_en: Studies a RAG-based, human-supervised pipeline for recovering requirements and code traces from two projects. It also tests deliberate generation of unimplemented requirements and requirements smells (potential quality issues), exposing verification and labeling difficulties.
description_zh: 研究以 RAG 和人工监督从两个项目恢复需求与代码追踪关系的流程，并测试刻意生成未实现需求及需求异味（潜在质量问题），揭示验证与标注的困难。
scope_limitations_en: The 188 generated requirements come from a student web application and Mattermost Desktop, using one model and PhD evaluators. Prompt choices, accumulated feedback and author-resolved labels affect validity. Findings concern this small experience study, not all code-to-requirements methods.
scope_limitations_zh: 188 条生成需求来自学生网页应用与 Mattermost Desktop，使用单一模型及博士生评估者。提示选择、累积反馈及作者裁定的标签影响有效性；结论限于这一小规模经验研究，不代表所有代码到需求方法。
why_fits_en: Adds negative evidence and validation limits for recovering application specifications from code.
why_fits_zh: 为从代码恢复应用规格补充负面证据及验证局限。
metadata_notes: Publication identity is verified through IEEE-deposited Crossref metadata and the official AIRE program; direct IEEE access returned an empty HTTP 202 response. Fulltext review uses arXiv v1. Figshare v4 declares CC BY 4.0 and its README describes data, prompts and an implementation.
metadata_notes_zh: 通过 IEEE 登记的 Crossref 元数据及 AIRE 官方议程核实出版身份；直接访问 IEEE 返回空 HTTP 202 响应。全文复核采用 arXiv v1。Figshare v4 声明 CC BY 4.0，其 README 介绍数据、提示及实现。

title: Khost: KVM-based Near Native MCU Firmware Rehosting
title_zh: Khost：基于 KVM 的近原生 MCU 固件重托管
date_basis: Publication month in the official USENIX proceedings BibTeX.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方会议录 BibTeX 的出版月份。
description_en: Extends KVM with MCU instruction handling, memory mapping and interrupt modeling to rehost firmware on ARMv8-A hosts. An MMIO monitor and firmware wrapper support peripheral interaction and coverage-guided testing.
description_zh: 扩展 KVM 的 MCU 指令处理、内存映射及中断建模，在 ARMv8-A 主机上重托管固件；MMIO 监控器与固件包装层支持外设交互及覆盖率引导测试。
scope_limitations_en: The prototype needs ARMv8-A with 32-bit compatibility and EL2 virtualization. Some coprocessor operations need added emulation, and entry-point or basic-block recovery can require manual correction. Peripheral approximations can cause false positives; evaluation covers two benchmarks and 12 firmware images, not arbitrary devices.
scope_limitations_zh: 原型需要支持 32 位兼容和 EL2 虚拟化的 ARMv8-A。部分协处理器操作需补充模拟，入口或基本块恢复可能需要人工修正。外设近似可能造成误报；评测覆盖两个基准及 12 个固件镜像，并非任意设备。
why_fits_en: Adds a concrete firmware execution-recovery substrate and its architecture constraints.
why_fits_zh: 补充固件执行环境恢复的具体基础设施及架构限制。
metadata_notes: Official proceedings give August 2026, pages 573–592. Reviewed pinned README and Apache-2.0 root license; dependencies and firmware licensing are separate. The paper-linked Zenodo v1.02 metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and lists a 65.7 MB archive.
metadata_notes_zh: 官方会议录列出 2026 年 8 月及 573–592 页。已读固定 README 与 Apache-2.0 根许可证，依赖及固件许可另计。论文所链 Zenodo v1.02 元数据声明 CC BY 4.0，并列出 65.7 MB 归档。

title: RFCLLM: Evaluating LLMs' Reasoning Ability of Network Protocol State Machines
title_zh: RFCLLM：评估大语言模型对网络协议状态机的推理能力
date_basis: Author arXiv record reports acceptance to Findings of EMNLP 2026; a proceedings publication date was not verified.
date_basis_zh: 作者的 arXiv 记录报告已被 Findings of EMNLP 2026 录用，未核实论文集正式出版日期。
description_en: Tests reasoning over protocol state machines using 1,482 questions across 16 protocols. Four context settings distinguish RFC retrieval from reasoning over supplied transitions; tasks cover next states, conditions, predecessor states and paths.
description_zh: 以 16 种协议的 1,482 个问题评测协议状态机推理。四种上下文设置区分 RFC 检索与依据给定转换进行推理，任务涵盖后继状态、条件、前驱状态及路径。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluates reasoning, not a new FSM extractor or implementation reconstruction. Gold FSMs were prepared by one author; judge agreement was checked on 50 instances by the three authors. Packet formats, error handling, configurations and real code mappings are outside scope. Results depend on context, judges and output budgets.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测的是推理，并非新的状态机提取器或实现重建方法。标准状态机由一名作者构建，三位作者仅在 50 个样例上核对判定器一致性。报文格式、错误处理、配置及真实代码映射不在范围内；结果受上下文、判定器及输出预算影响。
why_fits_en: Provides a bounded validation reference for using LLMs to interpret recovered or documented protocol models.
why_fits_zh: 为使用 LLM 理解恢复所得或文档描述的协议模型提供有明确边界的验证参考。
metadata_notes: Reviewed September 11 v1. Acceptance is author-reported. The author-linked anonymous artifact exposes README, scripts and results; its UI lists access until December 16, 2026, but no full Git commit or root license was established.
metadata_notes_zh: 复核 9 月 11 日 v1。录用信息来自作者。作者链接的匿名产物可读到 README、脚本及结果，界面列明开放至 2026 年 12 月 16 日，但未确立完整 Git 提交或根许可证。

title: SoK: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Emulation-Based Dynamic Analysis Research for ARM Cortex-M Firmware (Extended Version)
title_zh: ARM Cortex-M 固件仿真动态分析研究的大规模实证综述（扩展版）
date_basis: Dates this extended arXiv release. Author-reported NDSS 2027 acceptance is recorded separately and is not a 2027 publication claim.
date_basis_zh: 日期指此扩展版的 arXiv 发布；另行注明作者报告的 NDSS 2027 录用，不作 2027 年已出版声明。
description_en: Organizes 24 MCU analysis tools into configuration recovery, emulation, fuzzing and diagnosis stages, then evaluates the runnable, pipeline-compatible subset on 4,571 filtered Cortex-M firmware images. Studies where recovered configurations and emulation artifacts fail to support later analysis.
description_zh: 将 24 项 MCU 分析工具组织为配置恢复、仿真、模糊测试及诊断阶段，并在 4,571 个筛选后的 Cortex-M 固件镜像上评估可运行且兼容流程的子集，研究恢复的配置和仿真产物为何无法支撑后续分析。
scope_limitations_en: Excludes tools requiring unavailable manuals, source or hardware context, so this is not a uniform execution comparison of all 24 tools. ISA identification, admission thresholds and sampled crash diagnosis involve empirical judgments; findings do not generalize to other architectures. Reported crashes are not confirmed vulnerabilities.
scope_limitations_zh: 排除需要无法取得的手册、源码或硬件上下文的工具，因此不是对全部 24 项工具的统一执行比较。指令集识别、准入阈值及抽样崩溃诊断含经验判断，结论不能直接泛化到其他架构；报告的崩溃不等于已确认漏洞。
why_fits_en: Adds evidence on the practical limits of reconstructing executable environments for black-box firmware.
why_fits_zh: 补充为黑盒固件重建可执行环境时实际能力边界的证据。
metadata_notes: The arXiv comment calls this an extended version of a paper accepted to NDSS 2027; the manuscript has a placeholder DOI and no final proceedings date is assigned. Pinned framework README describes a 20-image functional check. Firmware is not redistributed; OTACap access is under NDA. No root code license was established.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 备注称这是 NDSS 2027 已录用论文的扩展版，手稿 DOI 仍为占位值，未填写最终会议录日期。固定框架 README 描述 20 镜像功能检查。固件不随仓库重分发，OTACap 访问受保密协议约束。未确立根代码许可证。

title: Protocol Reverse Engineering via Deep Transfer Learning
title_zh: 通过深度迁移学习进行协议逆向工程
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print/online publication date; the author-hosted manuscript retains placeholder publication metadata.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 向 Crossref 登记的纸质／在线出版日期，作者托管手稿仍保留占位出版元数据。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering / FSE 2026
description_en: Transfers field-boundary patterns from standardized protocol traces labeled by Tshark to poorly documented target protocols. A source-selection stage chooses related protocols, and a neural domain-adaptation model infers message syntax from their shared patterns.
description_zh: 将 Tshark 标注的标准协议流量中的字段边界模式迁移到文档不足的目标协议。先选择相关源协议，再通过神经网络领域适应模型依据共享模式推断消息语法。
scope_limitations_en: Recovers message syntax, not state transitions. Evaluation uses 12 protocol variants; payload noise can distort source selection, while encrypted, compressed or obfuscated traffic needs separate preprocessing. Camera experiments supplement format metrics, but the four reported issues were vendor-known and do not establish complete protocol recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: 恢复的是消息语法，而非状态转换。评估采用 12 种协议变体；载荷噪声可能干扰源协议选择，加密、压缩或混淆流量需要另行预处理。摄像头实验补充格式指标，但四个报告问题为厂商已知问题，也不证明协议已完整恢复。
why_fits_en: Adds a transfer-learning approach to recovering undocumented message formats without parser source code.
why_fits_zh: 补充无需解析器源码、利用迁移学习恢复未公开消息格式的方法。
metadata_notes: June 2026 is a strong six-month-window supplement. Fulltext was read from the public PDF explicitly linked by coauthor Fuchen Ma; its February date and placeholder DOI are not used as final metadata. The publisher PDF previously returned 403. Crossref confirms nine authors, volume 3(FSE), pages 636–656 and CC BY 4.0 for the version of record. No author-linked implementation release or code license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 该工作发表于 2026 年 6 月，作为近六个月的强相关补充。全文来自共同作者 Fuchen Ma 明确链接的公开 PDF，不采用其中二月日期或占位 DOI 作为最终元数据；出版商 PDF 此前返回 403。Crossref 确认九位作者、卷 3(FSE)、636–656 页及正式版本 CC BY 4.0 许可。未核实作者关联的实现发布或代码许可。

title: Decompiling Quantum Assembly into Structured Programs
title_zh: 将量子汇编反编译为结构化程序
date_basis: First arXiv submission; no formal proceedings publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期，未核实正式会议录出版。
description_en: Quelle recovers library calls, loops, functions and symbolic parameters from compiled OpenQASM. It removes routing artifacts, proposes structured reconstructions and checks them against circuit semantics, retaining gate-level fallbacks when recovery fails.
description_zh: Quelle 从编译后的 OpenQASM 恢复库调用、循环、函数及符号参数，通过消除路由痕迹、提出结构化重建并核对电路语义，在恢复失败时保留门级表示。
scope_limitations_en: Scope is quantum circuits with ideal-device semantics, not original-source identity. Dense checks use a 1e-6 tolerance; larger circuits additionally trust rewrite bookkeeping, an unchecked wide H-conjugation identity and QCEC. Dynamic circuits and timed-out checks remain unverified. Algorithm naming needs templates, and deliberate obfuscation is outside the evaluated scope.
scope_limitations_zh: 范围限于理想设备语义下的量子电路，不保证恢复原作者源码。稠密检查采用 1e-6 容差，大电路还依赖可信重写记录、未检查的宽区域 H 共轭恒等式及 QCEC；动态电路及超时检查保持未验证。算法命名需要模板，刻意混淆不在评估范围内。
why_fits_en: Adds compiler-output structure recovery with explicit correctness-check boundaries in quantum software.
why_fits_zh: 补充量子软件编译产物的结构恢复方法，并明确正确性检查的边界。
metadata_notes: Reviewed October 4 v1 and DataCite identity. The article is CC BY 4.0. No dedicated author-linked implementation or artifact release was verified from the manuscript and targeted searches.
metadata_notes_zh: 已复核 10 月 4 日 v1 与 DataCite 身份，文章采用 CC BY 4.0。手稿及定向检索中未核实作者关联的专用实现或产物发布。

title: Stage-Supervised Latent Reasoning for Single-Shot JavaScript Deobfuscation
title_zh: 阶段监督的潜空间推理：单次生成的 JavaScript 去混淆
date_basis: First arXiv submission; no formal proceedings publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用首次 arXiv 提交日期，未核实正式会议录出版。
description_en: Uses intermediate Webcrack rewrites to supervise Coconut-style latent reasoning for JavaScript deobfuscation. Training exposes staged code transformations; inference receives obfuscated code and generates a cleaned program in one shot.
description_zh: 利用 Webcrack 的中间重写结果监督 Coconut 式潜空间推理，以完成 JavaScript 去混淆。训练阶段提供分步代码转换，推理阶段仅接收混淆代码并一次生成清理后的程序。
scope_limitations_en: A work-in-progress study of one 3B backbone: 100 programs sampled from the 300 smallest benchmark inputs, split 60/20/20. Of 20 test outputs, 10 parsed and 8 matched teacher-derived outputs; the reported 80% is conditional on valid syntax. Semantic checks include manual inspection; stronger baselines and stage ablations remain future work.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是单一 3B 基础模型的进行中研究：从基准最小的 300 个输入中抽取 100 个程序，按 60/20/20 划分。20 个测试输出中 10 个可解析、8 个与教师流程输出匹配；所报 80% 以语法有效为条件。语义检查含人工检查，更强基线及阶段消融仍待完成。
why_fits_en: Explores how deterministic recovery stages can supervise learned code deobfuscation.
why_fits_zh: 探索如何利用确定性恢复阶段监督学习式代码去混淆。
metadata_notes: Reviewed September 22 v1, explicitly labeled WIP, with a registered arXiv DOI. Article license is CC BY 4.0. Webcrack is a cited upstream supervision tool, not this paper’s implementation release; no dedicated author code, weights or training-artifact license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 已复核 9 月 22 日 v1，原文明确标为 WIP，arXiv DOI 已注册。文章许可为 CC BY 4.0；Webcrack 是引用的上游监督工具，不是本文的实现发布。未核实专用作者代码、权重或训练产物许可。

title: Faultless: A Program Equivalence Technique for Validating and Evaluating Neural Decompilers
title_zh: Faultless：验证和评估神经反编译器的程序等价性方法
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no formal publication venue was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未核实正式发表场所。
description_en: Compares neural-decompiler C output with deterministic decompilation or reference functions using symbolic execution and a specialized memory model. It supports both analyst-facing validation and model evaluation without requiring the surrounding codebase.
description_zh: 利用符号执行与专门的内存模型，将神经反编译器生成的 C 代码与确定性反编译结果或参考函数比较，无需完整周边代码库，可用于分析人员的结果核查及模型评估。
scope_limitations_en: Function-level checks abstract away side-effect ordering and some compiler details; configurable options further relax return, argument and type conditions. The implementation has explicit heap-related soundness limitations and requires compatible loop structure; unsupported C features and context-independent dependency assumptions also limit coverage. Failure to establish equivalence is not proof of inequivalence. Evaluations use filtered realtype and ExeBench pairs, not unrestricted whole-program equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 检查限定于函数级，抽象掉副作用顺序和部分编译器细节，选项还可放宽返回值、实参及类型条件。实现明确存在与堆有关的可靠性缺口，并要求兼容的循环结构；不支持的 C 特性及脱离上下文的依赖假设也限制覆盖。未能建立等价关系并不证明不等价。实验使用筛选后的 realtype 与 ExeBench 函数对，不代表任意整程序等价。
why_fits_en: Adds a concrete validation method for recovered code while exposing the assumptions and unsound cases hidden by an unconditional equivalence label.
why_fits_zh: 为恢复代码提供具体核查方法，同时揭示无条件“等价”标签可能掩盖的假设与不可靠情形。
metadata_notes: The three-author order and first-submission date follow arXiv v1. DataCite records the arXiv DOI as findable, registered on 2026-09-29, despite the abstract page’s pending-registration label. The paper is CC BY-SA 4.0. The author-linked public repository was reviewed at 059023d874f4103b5e645a9d6d6ddbdb2bbb6da0; its root license is MIT and README calls the Python/tree-sitter/Z3 implementation a proof of concept.
metadata_notes_zh: 三位作者顺序与首投日期依据 arXiv v1。摘要页虽仍显示 DOI 待登记，DataCite 已将其列为可检索，登记于 2026-09-29。论文采用 CC BY-SA 4.0。作者链接的公开仓库固定核查于 059023d874f4103b5e645a9d6d6ddbdb2bbb6da0；根目录为 MIT 许可，README 将基于 Python、tree-sitter 与 Z3 的实现称为概念验证。

title: A Memorization Floor for LLM Refinement of Decompiled Code
title_zh: 大语言模型改进反编译代码中的记忆基线
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; the artifact deposit date is separate.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；产物存档日期单独区分。
description_en: Studies whether LLM refinement of decompiled C recovers identifiers from input evidence or prior knowledge. Within-item ablations and output-matched chance baselines test naming gains on textbook and newly authored functions, including a second-model replication.
description_zh: 研究大语言模型改进反编译 C 代码时，标识符恢复来自输入证据还是先验知识。通过同一条目的消融实验和与输出词汇匹配的随机基线，比较教材式函数与新编写函数的命名增益，并进行第二模型复核。
scope_limitations_en: The study uses 25 textbook and 20 author-written small functions, GCC/Ghidra on x86-64, and one prompt per model. Operations remain visible and the ablation also changes idiom-recognition cues, so its bounded null does not prove memorization or absence of input use. No registered hypothesis was confirmed; the correctness measure failed its discrimination gate; original T3 per-item artifacts were lost and re-executed, changing precision. Most findings use one refiner, and the later second-model extension is distinct from the initial preregistration.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究仅含 25 个教材式函数和 20 个作者编写的小函数，使用 x86-64 上的 GCC/Ghidra，每个模型只有一种提示。操作仍可观察，消融也改变惯用模式识别线索，因此有限检出能力下的零结果不能证明记忆或完全不利用输入。没有预登记假设得到确认，正确性指标未通过区分能力门槛；原 T3 逐项产物丢失后重新执行，精度随之改变。多数结果只来自一个改进模型，后续第二模型扩展与最初预登记分开报告。
