why_fits_en: Provides controls for interpreting apparently readable or well-named recovered code and cautions against treating naming scores as semantic recovery.
why_fits_zh: 为解释可读性好、命名合理的恢复代码提供对照方法，避免把命名分数当作语义恢复证明。
metadata_notes: Single-author arXiv v1; no formal venue was verified. DataCite confirms the arXiv DOI was registered on 2026-09-16 despite the abstract page’s pending label. The manuscript uses arXiv’s non-exclusive distribution license. The paper’s Zenodo concept DOI resolves to record 22121473, version 1.1.0, dated 2026-08-27, declaring CC BY 4.0 for a 9,639,907-byte replication ZIP.
metadata_notes_zh: 采用单作者的 arXiv v1，未核实正式发表场所。摘要页仍显示待登记，但 DataCite 确认 arXiv DOI 已于 2026-09-16 登记。手稿使用 arXiv 非独占分发许可。论文链接的 Zenodo 概念 DOI 解析到记录 22121473，版本为 1.1.0、日期为 2026-08-27，元数据为 9,639,907 字节的复现 ZIP 声明 CC BY 4.0。

title: The Deception Delta: Adversarial Evaluation of LLM-Based Smart Contract Bytecode Forensics
title_zh: Deception Delta：基于大语言模型的智能合约字节码取证对抗评测
date_basis: Official ACM CCS 2026 accepted-paper list confirms acceptance, not a publication date. The reviewed arXiv v2 revision is dated 2026-10-06.
date_basis_zh: ACM CCS 2026 官方接收名单确认录用，不能据此推定出版日期。审阅的 arXiv v2 修订日期为 2026-10-06。
description_en: Evaluates how language models interpret raw EVM bytecode from purpose-built deceptive and control contracts. It distinguishes recognizing a hidden transfer mechanism from correctly judging its risk, using model judges alongside judge-independent checks.
description_zh: 评估语言模型如何解释人工构造的欺骗性合约与对照合约的原始 EVM 字节码，区分识别隐藏转账机制与正确判断其风险，并结合模型评审和不依赖评审模型的检查。
scope_limitations_en: The main evaluation covers 22 models and 13 synthetic contracts using single-shot raw bytecode, without execution tools, source retrieval or on-chain context. Its 8,528 analyzed responses exclude refusals and pending runs. Gold labels come from one expert; some judges also belong to evaluated model families. Ground-truth checks vary across contracts, including owner/selector-only checks and no dedicated EVM tests for two injection variants. These results neither measure deployed-contract prevalence nor generalize to interactive reverse-engineering agents.
scope_limitations_zh: 主要评测覆盖 22 个模型与 13 个合成合约，仅单轮提供原始字节码，不含执行工具、源码检索或链上上下文。8,528 条纳入分析的回答排除了拒答及待完成运行。金标准来自一位专家，部分评审模型与被测模型属于相同系列。各合约的真值检查不一致，包括仅检查所有者权限或选择器，以及两个注入变体没有专门 EVM 测试。结果不能估计真实部署合约中的发生率，也不能推广到交互式逆向智能体。
why_fits_en: Adds a bounded failure-mode evaluation for interpreting executable bytecode, especially the gap between describing behavior and assigning a trustworthy safety verdict.
why_fits_zh: 为解释可执行字节码补充有明确边界的失效评测，尤其关注描述行为与给出可信安全判断之间的差距。
metadata_notes: The official CCS list confirms the single-author title; arXiv v2 corrects the September v1. The manuscript prints ACM DOI 10.1145/3830454.3846626 and future conference details, but its Crossref lookup returned 404 during review; no publisher publication date or container fields are asserted. The DOI field is the separately registered arXiv DOI. Article and Zenodo metadata declare CC BY 4.0. The concept artifact resolves to record 23164989, v1.0.2, dated 2026-10-05; its metadata describes ERRATA and a 53,006,308-byte ZIP.
metadata_notes_zh: 官方 CCS 名单确认单作者及标题；arXiv v2 对九月的 v1 作了修订。手稿列出 ACM DOI 10.1145/3830454.3846626 及尚未来临的会议安排，但本次 Crossref 查询返回 404，因此不填写出版方的出版日期或容器字段。DOI 字段使用已另行登记的 arXiv DOI。论文及 Zenodo 元数据声明 CC BY 4.0。产物概念链接解析到记录 23164989，版本 1.0.2、日期 2026-10-05；元数据说明存在勘误，ZIP 大小为 53,006,308 字节。

title: Decoding What iOS Location Services Send to Apple: An LLM Is an Unreliable Analyst but a Useful Toolmaker
title_zh: 解码 iOS 定位服务发送给 Apple 的数据：大语言模型并非可靠分析员，却能辅助构建工具
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is v1, not a verified proceedings publication.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；审阅版本为 v1，并非已经核实的会议录出版。
description_en: Compares direct LLM recovery of Apple PBCodable schemas with an AI-written Extractor checked against compiled synthetic fixtures, published descriptors and captured traffic. It shows how plausible recovered schemas can silently decode values incorrectly.
description_zh: 比较直接用大语言模型恢复 Apple PBCodable 模式与构建 Extractor 工具两种路径；工具以编译后的合成样本、既有描述文件和捕获流量交叉检查，说明看似合理的模式也可能静默解码出错误值。
scope_limitations_en: The direct-agent study uses 17 seeds with 7,788 field occurrences, 4,987 distinct. Apple's true schemas remain unpublished; synthetic tests share the recovered template's assumptions. Traffic comes from one jailbroken iPhone 8 on iOS 16.7.11. Matching fields in newer OS binaries does not verify their network behavior. The maintained code also documents estimated or unresolved fields.
scope_limitations_zh: 直接智能体评测采用 17 个种子，共 7,788 次字段出现，其中 4,987 个不同字段。Apple 的真实模式未公开，合成测试共享恢复模板的假设。流量来自一台运行 iOS 16.7.11 的越狱 iPhone 8；较新系统二进制中的字段一致，不等于其联网行为已验证。维护中的代码也明确记录估计或尚未解决的字段。
why_fits_en: A concrete binary-to-protocol-schema recovery study that separates parseable output from verified interpretation.
why_fits_zh: 具体研究从二进制恢复协议模式，并区分可解析输出与经过验证的解释。
metadata_notes: ArXiv names Douglas Leith; the manuscript uses D.J. Leith. No repository-wide license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 列名 Douglas Leith，手稿使用 D.J. Leith。未核实仓库整体许可。

title: Recall-Oriented Precise Binary-to-Source Function Matching
title_zh: 面向召回率的精确二进制到源码函数匹配
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is v1, not a verified proceedings publication.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；审阅版本为 v1，并非已经核实的会议录出版。
description_en: BScout matches decompiled functions to a source corpus using chunked embeddings and inlining-aware training. Existing matches provide positional clues to expand candidates; LLM selection and structural filters refine the resulting correspondences.
description_zh: BScout 通过分块嵌入及考虑内联的训练，将反编译函数匹配到源码语料；已有匹配提供位置线索以扩充候选，再由大语言模型选择及结构过滤改进对应关系。
scope_limitations_en: BinKit-BCSA covers 3,904 small-utility binaries; Large-10 covers larger projects only at x86-64/O2. Some anomaly thresholds come from FreeCAD in Large-10. Incomplete ground truth, sparse anchors and source-corpus coverage limit conclusions. Function chunks are encoded independently, and extra refinement trades precision and cost against recall. This is correspondence retrieval, not proof of source recovery or semantic equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: BinKit-BCSA 包含 3,904 个小型工具二进制，Large-10 的较大项目仅采用 x86-64/O2 构建；部分异常阈值来自 Large-10 中的 FreeCAD。不完整真值、稀疏锚点及源码语料覆盖限制结论。函数分块独立编码，增加改进轮次会在召回、精度和成本之间权衡。这是对应关系检索，不是源码恢复或语义等价证明。
why_fits_en: Helps identify source origins and reused components in stripped binaries, including inlined functions.
why_fits_zh: 帮助识别去符号二进制中的源码来源及复用组件，并考虑内联函数。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1 and its four-author order. The paper promises a replication package upon formal peer-reviewed publication; no dedicated public implementation or license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅 arXiv v1 并采用其四位作者顺序。论文承诺在同行评审版本正式出版后发布复现包，未核实专用公开实现或许可。

title: SatBleed: Security of Commoditized Communication Modules in Satellites
title_zh: SatBleed：卫星商用通信模块的安全性
date_basis: IEEE's Crossref publication date, corroborated by CISPA; October 5 is the later arXiv deposit.
date_basis_zh: 采用 IEEE 提交至 Crossref、并由 CISPA 确认的出版日期；10 月 5 日是后续 arXiv 提交日期。
description_en: Studies satellite communication modules through hardware inspection, firmware reverse engineering, protocol analysis, partial rehosting and targeted testing. A component-level threat model connects recovered data flows to security boundaries.
description_zh: 通过硬件检查、固件逆向、协议分析、部分重托管及针对性测试研究卫星通信模块，以组件级威胁模型将恢复的数据流与安全边界联系起来。
scope_limitations_en: Detailed assessment covers three vendors in isolated laboratory setups, not operational satellite links. The reported 28 of 64 active missions are passively inferred as plausibly vulnerable, not actively compromised; encrypted or compressed telemetry is excluded. Manual analysis cannot establish completeness, and vendor-specific findings do not generalize to all modules. LLM use was editorial, not an evaluated reversing agent.
scope_limitations_zh: 详细评估针对三个厂商的隔离实验环境，并未接触在轨卫星链路。所报告的 64 个活跃任务中有 28 个可能受影响，来自被动推断而非实际入侵；加密或压缩遥测被排除。人工分析不能证明完整性，厂商特定结果也不能推广到全部模块。大语言模型仅用于编辑，并非接受评测的逆向智能体。
why_fits_en: Documents firmware and undocumented-protocol recovery with explicit hardware and evidence constraints.
why_fits_zh: 记录固件及未公开协议的恢复，并明确硬件与证据限制。
metadata_notes: IEEE and CISPA establish May publication; the October arXiv v1 is the reviewed full text. The pinned supplement README describes a trimmed fuzzer without case-specific oracles and STIX bundles. Working exploit payloads and the inferred mission list are withheld. No repository-wide license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE 与 CISPA 确认 5 月出版；本次读取 10 月提交的 arXiv v1 全文。固定补充材料 README 描述裁剪后的模糊测试器及 STIX 包，其中不含案例专用判定器；可运行利用载荷和推断的任务名单未发布。未核实仓库整体许可。

citation.container_title: 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (SP)

title: POZZER: A Power Side Channel-guided Fuzzer for Black-Box Embedded Systems
title_zh: POZZER：面向黑盒嵌入式系统的功耗侧信道引导模糊测试器
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is v1, not a verified proceedings publication.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；审阅版本为 v1，并非已经核实的会议录出版。
description_en: Builds a noise-tolerant pseudo execution-flow graph from one power trace per test input, using newly observed behavior as LibAFL feedback. It explores embedded firmware without access to its binary, source or instrumentation.
description_zh: 根据每个测试输入的一条功耗轨迹构建可容忍噪声的近似执行流图，将新观察到的行为用作 LibAFL 反馈；无需取得固件二进制、源码或插桩即可探索嵌入式固件。
scope_limitations_en: Requires physical power measurement, known input pins and setup calibration. Evaluation covers 15 targets on two Cortex-M platforms and two commercial devices; benchmark coverage is measured by later instrumented replay, not recovered directly from power traces. Results depend on seeds and hardware, and long traces reduce throughput. The graph is not a proven control-flow graph or recovered program. Real-device harnesses are withheld.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要物理功耗测量、已知输入引脚和实验装置校准。评测覆盖两个 Cortex-M 平台上的 15 个目标及两个商用设备；基准覆盖率通过事后插桩回放测量，并非直接由功耗轨迹恢复。结果受种子和硬件影响，长轨迹会降低吞吐量；该图不是经过证明的控制流图或恢复出的程序。真实设备测试框架未公开。
why_fits_en: Provides evidence-driven behavior exploration when firmware bytes and conventional tracing are unavailable.
why_fits_zh: 在无法取得固件字节或常规执行轨迹时，提供基于证据的行为探索方法。
metadata_notes: The first submission is September 20, not the later announcement date. Reviewed the full eight-author v1 list. Open Science promises code and results after acceptance; no dedicated public artifact or license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: 首次提交日期为 9 月 20 日，而非后续公告日期；采用 v1 完整八位作者列表。Open Science 段承诺录用后发布代码和结果，未核实专用公开产物或许可。

title: Between the Commits: Process, Error, and Claim Reliability in a Wholly AI-Authored Codebase
title_zh: 提交之间：一个完全由 AI 编写的代码库中的过程、错误与陈述可靠性
date_basis: First arXiv submission; the reviewed version is v1, not a verified proceedings publication.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期；审阅版本为 v1，并非已经核实的会议录出版。
description_en: Studies development of the Extractor reverse-engineering tool through commits, available session logs and code-provenance tracing. Taxonomies separate instruction intent, change triggers and agent claims, exposing errors corrected before commits that ordinary repository history misses.
description_zh: 通过提交、可用会话日志及代码溯源研究 Extractor 逆向工具的开发，用分类体系区分指令意图、变更触发因素及智能体陈述，揭示普通仓库历史无法反映的提交前纠错。
scope_limitations_en: One codebase with human-directed work, no human-coded comparison. The 14.3% figure is 15 of 105 audited generation events, including test defects and stale tests, not a defect rate per source line or in shipped code. LLM scoring has sampled human calibration; transcripts are incomplete and the archive omits per-response evidence bundles. This companion study does not independently corroborate the related schema-recovery results.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅研究一个由人指导开发的代码库，没有人工编写代码的对照。14.3% 指 105 次已审计生成事件中的 15 次，包含测试缺陷及未同步更新的测试，不是源码行或已交付代码的缺陷比例。大语言模型评分接受抽样人工校准，但会话记录不完整，归档缺少逐响应评分证据包。该配套研究并不独立佐证相关模式恢复结果。
why_fits_en: Adds provenance and claim-auditing methods for agent-built reverse-engineering tools.
why_fits_zh: 补充智能体构建逆向工具时的溯源与陈述审计方法。
metadata_notes: The author's pinned reproducibility-archive README documents lost sessions and unreproducible response-scoring evidence. The repository exposes an archive and Git-history material. No repository-wide license was verified; the project link points to the artifact landing page.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者固定版本复现归档 README 记载丢失的会话及缺少证据而无法复现的响应评分。仓库提供归档和 Git 历史材料。未核实仓库整体许可，项目链接指向产物页面。

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
title_zh: Schema：通过智能体程序归纳发现未知环境机制
date_basis: arXiv v1 first-submission date; the July project announcement and October repository revision are separate.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；七月项目公告及十月仓库版本单独区分。
description_en: Infers executable models of game state and transition rules from interaction. Agents revise these models against recorded history, search within them, and compare predicted observations with real outcomes while executing plans.
description_zh: 通过交互推断可执行的游戏状态与转移规则模型。智能体依据已记录的历史修订模型，在模型中搜索方案，并在执行计划时将预测观察与真实结果比较。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, 21 public DiG-bench games and MazeBench. Matching recorded transitions establishes history consistency, not original-source recovery or correctness on unseen states. RHAE measures completion and environment-action efficiency, not elapsed time or total computation. Component ablations cover ten ARC games; MazeBench compares recorded trajectories with a leaderboard median rather than a controlled human experiment. Transfer to arbitrary software or stochastic environments is not demonstrated.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测使用 25 个公开 ARC-AGI-3 游戏、21 个公开 DiG-bench 游戏及 MazeBench。匹配已记录的状态转移只说明与历史一致，不代表恢复原始源码或在未见状态上正确。RHAE 衡量完成度与环境动作效率，不是耗时或总计算量。组件消融覆盖十个 ARC 游戏；MazeBench 将记录轨迹与排行榜中位数比较，并非受控人类实验。对任意软件或随机环境的迁移尚未展示。
why_fits_en: Provides a concrete observation-to-program-and-replay loop for black-box behavioral reconstruction, while distinguishing a useful predictive model from a complete game clone.
why_fits_zh: 为黑盒行为重建提供具体的“观察—程序—回放”闭环，并区分有用的预测模型与完整游戏复刻。
metadata_notes: The eleven-author v1 list and title match arXiv and the current project. DataCite registered the arXiv DOI on 2026-10-01; the article uses arXiv’s non-exclusive distribution license. The author-linked MIT code was inspected at 84c075fadfe937b97a3d1ad2acb42d1233f55ffe. Benchmark engines/services retain separate requirements. The linked trace dataset README at 0a0858a9e61a68d1e83142d9e4e3d66fc779c403 describes 50 July ARC trajectories, including a mixed-model collection. No trace-data license was verified.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 与当前项目页面的标题及 v1 十一位作者名单一致。DataCite 于 2026-10-01 登记 arXiv DOI；论文使用 arXiv 非独占分发许可。作者链接的 MIT 代码固定核查于 84c075fadfe937b97a3d1ad2acb42d1233f55ffe，基准引擎与服务另有使用条件。所链轨迹数据集在 0a0858a9e61a68d1e83142d9e4e3d66fc779c403 的 README 描述七月的 50 条 ARC 轨迹，其中一组混用不同模型；未核实轨迹数据许可。

title: Agentic Reverse Engineering: From I/O to Code with Discovery Agent
title_zh: 智能体逆向工程：利用发现智能体从输入输出行为恢复代码
date_basis: Official NeurIPS 2026 poster listing confirms acceptance, not a proceedings publication date. First arXiv submission was 2026-05-14; reviewed v2 was revised on 2026-10-18.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 2026 官方海报页面确认接收，不据此认定论文集出版日期。arXiv 首投为 2026-05-14；所审阅 v2 修订于 2026-10-18。
description_en: Synthesizes executable programs from input/output observations using LLM-guided evolutionary search, progressively revealed examples, simple-to-complex mutations and execution-error feedback. An active variant chooses inputs and queries a hidden reference program.
description_zh: 通过 LLM 引导的演化搜索、逐步展示的样例、由简到繁的修改及执行错误反馈，从输入输出观察合成可执行程序；主动变体自行选择输入并查询隐藏的参考程序。
scope_limitations_en: IO2CodeBench has 125 generated tasks spanning basic operations, algorithms, geometry and image-to-value mappings, normally with eight visible and fifteen held-out examples. Active exploration covers a 25% subset from each level. Multimodal results average sample pass ratios, while other levels count tasks passing every held-out example. Finite test success does not establish original-source recovery or complete equivalence; arbitrary applications and stateful services are not evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: IO2CodeBench 包含 125 个生成任务，覆盖基础运算、算法、几何及图像到数值的映射，通常每题提供八个可见样例和十五个留出样例。主动探索只覆盖各层级的 25% 子集。多模态结果采用样例通过比例的均值，其他层级按通过全部留出样例的任务计数。有限测试通过不代表恢复原源码或完全等价；未评测任意应用及有状态服务。
why_fits_en: Provides a concrete observation-to-program reconstruction workflow and separates visible-example fitting from held-out behavior checks.
why_fits_zh: 提供从行为观察到程序重建的具体流程，并区分可见样例拟合与留出行为检查。
metadata_notes: The official poster and pinned repository retain the earlier title From I/O to Code with Discovery Agent; all ten authors match v2 and DataCite. The registered DOI identifies the arXiv work. The paper uses the arXiv non-exclusive license. Author-linked code was checked at ef15827ab7090bf2d227fb1eef51d91b0163339e: its README documents Python 3.10+, provider credentials, benchmark/oracle tasks and experiment runners. No repository-wide code/data license was verified in the reviewed README and root tree.
metadata_notes_zh: 官方海报与固定仓库保留早期标题 From I/O to Code with Discovery Agent，十位作者与 v2 及 DataCite 一致。已注册 DOI 标识 arXiv 工作。论文采用 arXiv 非独占许可。作者链接代码固定核查于 ef15827ab7090bf2d227fb1eef51d91b0163339e；README 说明 Python 3.10+、服务商凭据、基准／参考程序任务和实验入口。所审阅 README 与根目录树未核实覆盖整个仓库的代码／数据许可。

title: Locate, Then Reason: End-to-End Patch Presence Testing in Stripped Binaries
title_zh: 先定位再推理：剥离符号二进制中的端到端补丁存在性测试
date_basis: First arXiv v1 submission; no formal venue publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未核实正式会议或期刊出版。
description_en: Locates patch-relevant code in stripped binaries using instruction-aligned retrieval and caller/callee context, then uses an LLM to screen candidate matches and compare patch-specific behavior with vulnerable and patched references.
description_zh: 结合指令对齐检索及调用者／被调用者上下文，在剥离符号的二进制中定位补丁相关代码，再由 LLM 筛选候选匹配并对照漏洞版与修复版参考程序判断补丁特定行为。
scope_limitations_en: Requires the known source patch and vulnerable/patched reference binaries; it is not source recovery or undisclosed-vulnerability discovery. Evaluation covers 62 CVEs from four C/C++ projects, 124 reference and 496 target binaries, restricted to x86-64, GCC/Clang configurations and one reported reasoning model. Balanced labels do not reproduce deployment prevalence; public patches may be in training data. Uncertain and missing-localization outcomes are reported separately, but binary metrics map them to vulnerable and negative outcomes, respectively; selected accuracy excludes both.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要已知源码补丁以及漏洞版／修复版参考二进制，并非源码恢复或未公开漏洞发现。评测覆盖四个 C/C++ 项目的 62 个 CVE、124 个参考二进制及 496 个目标二进制，限于 x86-64、指定 GCC／Clang 配置和一个报告的推理模型。标签平衡不代表实际部署分布；公开补丁可能出现在训练数据中。不确定与定位失败结果虽单独报告，但二分类指标分别将其计为仍有漏洞的正类及负类；选定子集准确率则排除两者。
why_fits_en: Studies evidence-guided localization and semantic comparison of binary code, including the limits of decompiler-inferred types when judging small fixes.
why_fits_zh: 研究由证据引导的二进制代码定位与语义比较，并展示反编译器推断类型在判断小规模修复时的局限。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the nine-author v1 abstract and full text. The article uses the arXiv non-exclusive license. Its data-availability section promises code, models, data and instructions upon publication; no paper-specific public artifact or artifact license was verified in the reviewed text and focused search. Cited baseline tools are not the PatchAlign release. DataCite registered the matching arXiv DOI on 2026-10-20, despite the abstract page still saying pending.
metadata_notes_zh: 已审阅九位作者的 v1 摘要与全文。文章采用 arXiv 非独占许可。数据可用性部分承诺在出版时发布代码、模型、数据及说明；所审阅全文和定向检索未核实论文专属公开产物或其许可，引用的基线工具不等于 PatchAlign 发布。DataCite 于 2026-10-20 登记匹配的 arXiv DOI，尽管摘要页仍标为待注册。

title: Semantic Validation of Packer Identification Tools: Characterization, Repair, and Downstream Impact
title_zh: 加壳识别工具的语义验证：特征分析、修正与下游影响
date_basis: First arXiv submission was 2026-05-25; reviewed v3 was revised on 2026-10-19. No formal publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交为 2026-05-25；所审阅 v3 修订于 2026-10-19。未核实正式出版。
description_en: Uses unpacking outcomes as reference evidence to assess packer labels, normalizes heterogeneous tool results, and evaluates complementary signature/heuristic pools with static predicates derived from unpacker implementations. It traces how identification errors affect later unpacking and malware classification.
description_zh: 以脱壳结果作为参考证据评估壳标签，规范化不同工具的输出，并评估互补签名／启发式规则池及从脱壳器实现提取的静态判定条件；同时追踪识别错误对后续脱壳和恶意软件分类的影响。
scope_limitations_en: The corpus is approximately 160,000 Windows PE samples, split into roughly 130,000 for analysis/rule construction and 30,000 for testing. Unpacker failures or partial recovery can compromise the derived reference labels. Family-identification improvements use common pooled-rule configurations, not independently validated patches to seven separate tools. Repair evaluation excludes proprietary implementations and graph/learning-based methods. Results do not establish coverage of other executable formats, all packer families or general semantic equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 语料约含 160,000 个 Windows PE 样本，其中约 130,000 个用于分析与构造规则，约 30,000 个用于测试。脱壳失败或仅部分恢复可能影响由此生成的参考标签。壳家族识别改进采用公共规则池配置，并非对七个独立工具分别验证补丁。修正评测不涵盖专有实现及基于图或学习的方法；结果不证明覆盖其他可执行格式、所有壳家族或一般语义等价。
why_fits_en: Examines the reliability of packer identification as a prerequisite for recovering analyzable binary content; it is a foundation-tool evaluation rather than an agent benchmark.
why_fits_zh: 评估加壳识别作为恢复可分析二进制内容的前置步骤是否可靠；它属于基础工具评估，而非智能体基准。
metadata_notes: October v3 while retaining the May first-submission date. Its six-author list agrees across the current abstract, versioned PDF and updated DataCite record; v2 lists seven authors and is not combined with v3. The article is CC BY-SA 4.0, which does not license malware samples or third-party tools. Reviewed sources and focused search did not establish a paper-specific public release or its license.
metadata_notes_zh: 十月 v3，同时保留五月首投日期。当前摘要、固定版本 PDF 与已更新 DataCite 记录的六位作者名单一致；v2 列七位作者，不与 v3 混用。文章采用 CC BY-SA 4.0，不构成恶意软件样本或第三方工具的许可。所审阅来源及定向检索未确立论文专属公开发布或其许可。

title: State-Aware Generation of Deployable Websites from Visual Prototypes and Requirements
title_zh: 从视觉原型与需求生成可部署网站的状态感知方法
date_basis: First arXiv v1 submission; no formal venue publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未核实正式会议或期刊出版。
description_en: VisStateCoder links visual prototype elements, project files, interaction requirements and render evidence in a project state graph, then uses those links to generate websites and limit subsequent repairs to selected files.
description_zh: VisStateCoder 以项目状态图连接视觉原型元素、项目文件、交互需求与渲染证据，据此生成网站，并将后续修复限制在选定文件内。
scope_limitations_en: Requires visual prototypes and textual workflow requirements. The five-model Vision2Web evaluation covers up to seven-page HTML/CSS/JavaScript sites with an optional Node.js server; larger projects and React/Vue are untested. Each configuration runs once, without variance or significance estimates. Internal repair checks do not execute interaction workflows; functional scores come from separate benchmark tests. Visual judges and incomplete tests limit conclusions about behavior, maintainability and accessibility.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要视觉原型及文字形式的交互流程需求。五个模型上的 Vision2Web 评测覆盖最多七页的 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 网站，可选 Node.js 服务端；未测试更大项目或 React／Vue。每种配置仅运行一次，没有方差或显著性估计。内部修复检查不执行交互流程，功能分数来自独立的基准测试。视觉评判器及不完备测试限制了对行为、可维护性和可访问性的结论。
why_fits_en: Studies visual-reference website reconstruction with explicit links between reference elements, code files and repair evidence.
why_fits_zh: 研究以视觉参照重建网站，并显式关联参照元素、代码文件和修复证据。
metadata_notes: DataCite registered the matching arXiv DOI on 2026-10-14. The article uses the arXiv non-exclusive license. The paper states that its implementation, prompts, projects, logs and annotations are released, but an author-linked artifact and code/data license were not verified in the reviewed sources and bounded search.
metadata_notes_zh: DataCite 于 2026-10-14 登记匹配的 arXiv DOI。文章采用 arXiv 非独占许可。论文声明已发布实现、提示、项目、日志和标注，但所审阅来源及有界检索未核实作者链接的产物或代码／数据许可。

title: From Dead Code and Static Requirements to Working Engines: Software Revival with Coding Agents
title_zh: 从失效代码与静态需求到可运行引擎：利用编程智能体恢复软件
date_basis: First arXiv v1 submission; no formal venue publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未核实正式会议或期刊出版。
description_en: ReviveBench evaluates repair of nonrunning software and source-unavailable implementation of bounded computational and transactional engines from open specifications, using hidden reference-based checks. It also audits grading defects that can wrongly accept or reject reconstructions.
description_zh: ReviveBench 利用隐藏的参考检查，评估无法运行的软件修复，以及依据公开规范、在无法访问目标源码时实现限定范围的计算与事务引擎；同时审计可能误收或误拒重建结果的评分缺陷。
scope_limitations_en: Studies ten revival and thirteen bounded engine tasks; reconstruction receives public specifications and three worked examples. Most model/task cells have one or two seeds; the reconstruction matrix reports the best eligible run. Excluded infrastructure failures and differing API adapters limit comparisons. Task-level pass thresholds do not require every check to pass, and CFD passes cannot establish numerical-solver capability. Verifier audits and contamination controls do not prove general equivalence or rule out prior exposure.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究十个软件恢复任务及十三个限定范围的引擎任务；重建时提供公开规范与三个示例。大多数模型／任务组合只有一两个随机种子；重建结果矩阵报告符合条件的最佳运行。排除基础设施失败及使用不同 API 适配器会限制比较。任务通过阈值不要求每项检查全部通过，CFD 通过结果也不能证明数值求解器能力。验证器审计与污染控制不构成一般等价证明，也无法排除先前接触相关内容。
why_fits_en: Connects software reconstruction with audits of the tests used to judge its correctness.
why_fits_zh: 将软件重建与用于判断其正确性的测试审计联系起来。
metadata_notes: The four-author v1 identity matches arXiv and DataCite, which registered the arXiv DOI on 2026-09-30. The article uses the arXiv non-exclusive license. No author-linked public benchmark/verifier package or its code/data license was verified in the reviewed full text and focused search.
metadata_notes_zh: 四位作者的 v1 身份与 arXiv、DataCite 一致；后者于 2026-09-30 登记 arXiv DOI。文章采用 arXiv 非独占许可。所审阅全文及定向检索未核实作者链接的公开基准／验证器包或其代码／数据许可。

title: IChart2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Interactive Chart Code Generation
title_zh: IChart2Code：面向交互图表代码生成的多模态大语言模型评测
date_basis: First arXiv v1 submission; no formal venue publication was verified.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未核实正式会议或期刊出版。
description_en: Benchmarks reconstruction of interactive charts from a reference screenshot, local data and specified actions. Its TRAIL framework uses Developer and Inspector agents with browser interaction traces to diagnose errors and revise the HTML/JavaScript implementation.
description_zh: 评测根据参照截图、本地数据和指定动作重建交互图表。其 TRAIL 框架结合开发与检查智能体及浏览器交互轨迹，诊断错误并修订 HTML／JavaScript 实现。
scope_limitations_en: Covers 377 single-file HTML/JavaScript tasks with supplied data and explicit interaction requirements. Four models are evaluated with at most one repair round. Failing the Executability gate gives zero on scored dimensions; other rubric judgments use an MLLM, with human validation on 200 Direct outputs from 100 tasks and two models. Finite interactions and judge agreement do not establish complete application equivalence or recovery of hidden data and unspecified behavior.
scope_limitations_zh: 覆盖 377 个单文件 HTML／JavaScript 任务，提供数据及明确交互要求。评测四个模型，最多进行一轮修复。未通过可执行性检查时，各评分维度计零分；其他评分规则由多模态模型判断，人类验证只覆盖两个模型在 100 个任务上的 200 份 Direct 输出。有限交互及评判一致性不证明完整应用等价，也不代表恢复隐藏数据或未指定行为。
why_fits_en: Adds an execution-aware benchmark for reproducing visual charts and their specified interactive state changes.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向视觉图表及其指定交互状态变化的执行感知复现基准。
metadata_notes: The six-author v1 identity matches arXiv and DataCite, which registered the arXiv DOI on 2026-09-29. The article uses the arXiv non-exclusive license. No author-linked public implementation, dataset release or corresponding license was verified in the reviewed full text and focused search.
metadata_notes_zh: 六位作者的 v1 身份与 arXiv、DataCite 一致；后者于 2026-09-29 登记 arXiv DOI。文章采用 arXiv 非独占许可。所审阅全文及定向检索未核实作者链接的公开实现、数据集发布或相应许可。

title: NYU CTF Bench: A Scalable Open-Source Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating LLMs in Offensive Security
title_zh: NYU CTF Bench：用于评估大语言模型攻击性安全能力的可扩展开源基准数据集
date_basis: The official NeurIPS proceedings and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata identify publication year 2024; the proceedings page’s citation_publication_date metadata reads 2024-12-16, but neither Crossref nor a publisher statement confirms that day, so only the year is recorded. The first arXiv submission date is recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 官方论文集与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据标明出版年份为 2024；论文集页面的 citation_publication_date 元数据为 2024-12-16，但 Crossref 与出版方说明均未确认该日期，因此仅记录年份。首次提交 arXiv 的日期另行记录。
description_en: NYU CTF Bench packages 200 manually validated challenges from CSAW CTF qualifying and final rounds held between 2017 and 2023, spanning cryptography, forensics, pwn, reverse engineering, web and miscellaneous tasks, with challenge.json metadata and Docker images for server-side challenges. The paper also presents an automated framework that gives LLMs function-calling tools for shell commands, file creation, Ghidra disassembly and decompilation, flag checking and giving up. It evaluates five LLMs and compares their scores with human teams at CSAW 2022 and 2023.
description_zh: NYU CTF Bench 收录 2017–2023 年 CSAW CTF 资格赛与决赛中经人工验证的 200 道题目，涵盖密码学、取证、二进制漏洞利用、逆向工程、Web 与杂项任务，并为题目提供 challenge.json 元数据，为需要服务端的题目提供 Docker 镜像。论文还提出一个自动化框架，通过函数调用为大语言模型提供执行 Shell 命令、创建文件、使用 Ghidra 反汇编与反编译、检查 flag 和放弃求解等工具。论文评测了五种大语言模型，并将其得分与 CSAW 2022 和 2023 的人类参赛队伍比较。
scope_limitations_en: Only 51 of the 200 challenges are reverse engineering (31 qualifying and 20 final), so overall solve rates are not reverse-engineering accuracy. All challenges come from one competition series, categories are imbalanced, and the remaining 367 of the initial 567 challenges, including incident-response tasks, are excluded pending validation. The baseline counts a challenge as solved if any of five attempts succeeds, within a 48-hour limit per model; no statistical tests were run. Among GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Claude 3, Mixtral and LLaMA, the best reverse-engineering rate was 9.80% (GPT-4), and the open models solved nothing. The human comparison uses competition scores from four CSAW events, and the public repository has continued to change after publication, so later runs may not match the paper’s challenge set or framework.
scope_limitations_zh: 200 道题中只有 51 道为逆向工程题（资格赛 31 道、决赛 20 道），因此总体解题率并不等于逆向工程准确率。所有题目均来自同一系列赛事，各类别数量不均衡；最初 567 道题中其余 367 道（包括事件响应类任务）因尚未完成验证而未收录。基线评测中，五次尝试中任意一次成功即算解出，每个模型限时 48 小时，且未进行统计检验。在 GPT-3.5、GPT-4、Claude 3、Mixtral 与 LLaMA 中，逆向工程类最佳解题率为 9.80%（GPT-4），两个开源模型未解出任何题目。与人类的比较基于四场 CSAW 赛事的比赛得分；公开仓库在论文发表后仍持续变化，后续运行未必与论文中的题目集或框架一致。
why_fits_en: Supplies a public, dockerized CTF challenge set with a reverse-engineering subset; later agent work such as EnIGMA evaluates on it.
why_fits_zh: 提供一个容器化的公开 CTF 题目集，其中包含逆向工程子集；EnIGMA 等后续智能体研究在其上开展评测。
metadata_notes: The 13-author order follows the NeurIPS proceedings page, the PDF, arXiv and Crossref. NeurIPS volume 37 lists pages 57472–57498; arXiv v3 (2025-02-18) matches the reviewed proceedings text. The NeurIPS checklist gives the Zenodo software DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13930622 for the v20241008 benchmark release; it is an artifact identifier, not the paper DOI. The reviewed NYU_CTF_Bench snapshot (2025-09-22) is GPL-2.0, holds the 200-challenge test split and a 55-challenge development split, and is installed through the nyuctf Python package, which clones the repository; challenges need Docker. The paper’s llm_ctf_automation link now redirects to NYU-LLM-CTF/nyuctf_agents, whose reviewed 2026-07-17 snapshot is MIT-licensed and also contains the later D-CIPHER multi-agent system alongside the baseline. Challenge files keep their original authors’ terms.
metadata_notes_zh: 13 位作者的顺序以 NeurIPS 论文集页面、PDF、arXiv 与 Crossref 为准。NeurIPS 第 37 卷列出页码 57472–57498；arXiv v3（2025-02-18）与所审阅的论文集文本一致。NeurIPS 检查清单给出 Zenodo 软件 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13930622，对应 v20241008 基准发布版本；它是研究产物标识符，并非论文 DOI。所审阅的 NYU_CTF_Bench 快照（2025-09-22）采用 GPL-2.0，包含 200 道题的测试集和 55 道题的开发集，通过会克隆该仓库的 nyuctf Python 包安装，题目需要 Docker。论文中的 llm_ctf_automation 链接现重定向至 NYU-LLM-CTF/nyuctf_agents；其所审阅的 2026-07-17 快照采用 MIT 许可证，除基线外还包含后来的 D-CIPHER 多智能体系统。题目文件沿用原作者的条款。

title: From Obfuscated to Obvious: A Comprehensive JavaScript Deobfuscation Tool for Security Analysis
title_zh: 从混淆到清晰：面向安全分析的综合性 JavaScript 反混淆工具
date_basis: The Internet Society's Crossref deposit and the official NDSS paper identify publication year 2026. The PDF footer names the 23–27 February 2026 symposium; no finer publication date is asserted from the event dates.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据与 NDSS 官方论文标明出版年份为 2026。PDF 页脚标注研讨会于 2026 年 2 月 23–27 日举行；不根据会议举办日期推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: JSimplifier recovers readable JavaScript from obfuscated scripts in three stages. A preprocessor normalizes malformed or mixed-encoding input; a deobfuscator combines AST-based static simplification with selective execution of obfuscated call sites in a Node.js vm context, feeding the results back into the AST; and an optional humanizer renames identifiers with an LLM, adapting HumanifyJS, then formats the output with Prettier. The authors catalog 20 obfuscation techniques in four categories and assemble MalJS (23,212 malicious scripts) and BenignJS (21,209 scripts). They report that JSimplifier processes all 44,421 samples and reduces Halstead length by 88.2% on 1,296 multi-technique JsDeObsBench samples.
description_zh: JSimplifier 分三个阶段从混淆脚本中恢复可读的 JavaScript：预处理器规范化格式错误或混合编码的输入；反混淆器将基于 AST 的静态简化与在 Node.js vm 上下文中有选择地执行混淆调用点相结合，并把执行结果写回 AST；可选的人性化模块借鉴 HumanifyJS，利用大语言模型重命名标识符，再用 Prettier 格式化输出。作者将混淆技术归纳为四大类共 20 种，并构建了 MalJS（23,212 个恶意脚本）与 BenignJS（21,209 个脚本）数据集。作者报告 JSimplifier 能处理全部 44,421 个样本，并在 JsDeObsBench 中 1,296 个组合多种技术的样本上将 Halstead 长度降低 88.2%。
scope_limitations_en: The headline “100% correctness” is syntactic validity on 400 samples (100 BenignJS, 300 MalJS) checked by parser and by hand; behavioral consistency, judged with Joern CFG/DDG comparison and manual review, holds for 83 of 100 samples. The 20-technique capability test applies each technique to one representative snippet, and the static and dynamic stages alone handle 19; identifier renaming needs the LLM stage. Readability gains come from four LLMs (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-R1 and GPT-o3) scoring 60 MalJS pairs on a 0–10 scale; a separate check of GPT-4o-mini renaming on 100 samples found 12% hallucinated names, and the user study had 9 participants. The entropy comparison excludes the LLM stage. MalJS was collected with a security company and BenignJS mixes Tranco top-site scripts with 2,000 clean samples obfuscated by the authors. The authors exclude cryptographic packing, custom interpreters and time-dependent decryption, and note that ES6+ syntax may be downgraded and that vm-based execution carries escape risk. The output is readable JavaScript, not a reconstructed website.
scope_limitations_zh: 论文标题性的“100% 正确”指 400 个样本（100 个 BenignJS、300 个 MalJS）经解析器与人工检查后的语法有效性；借助 Joern 控制流图／数据依赖图比较和人工复核判断的行为一致性，在 100 个样本中有 83 个成立。20 种技术的能力测试是把每种技术分别施加在同一段代表性代码上；仅靠静态与动态阶段可处理其中 19 种，标识符重命名需要大语言模型阶段。可读性提升来自四个大语言模型（Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek-R1 与 GPT-o3）对 60 组 MalJS 样本按 0–10 分打分；另对 100 个样本的 GPT-4o-mini 重命名进行检查，发现 12% 的名称属于幻觉，用户研究仅有 9 名参与者。熵比较未包含大语言模型阶段。MalJS 是与一家安全公司合作收集的，BenignJS 则混合了 Tranco 热门网站脚本和作者自行混淆的 2,000 个干净样本。作者说明该工具不处理加密打包、自定义解释器和依赖时间的解密，ES6+ 语法可能被降级，基于 vm 的执行也存在逃逸风险。输出是可读的 JavaScript，而非重建的网站。
why_fits_en: Adds an open-source end-to-end JavaScript deobfuscator with a large real-world evaluation set, complementing the JsDeObsBench benchmark and LLM-based deobfuscation work in recovering readable client-side code.
why_fits_zh: 补充一款开源的端到端 JavaScript 反混淆工具及大规模真实评测数据，与 JsDeObsBench 基准和基于大语言模型的反混淆研究共同服务于恢复可读的客户端代码。
metadata_notes: The four-author order follows the PDF, the NDSS paper page and Crossref. The PDF footer gives ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0 and the DOI; Crossref lists no pages, and no page range was verified. arXiv v1 (2025-12-16) carries the same DOI in its metadata and no venue comment; the reviewed text is the NDSS final PDF. The paper links XingTuLab/JSIMPLIFIER and Zenodo artifact 10.5281/zenodo.17531662, whose DOI identifies the artifact, not the paper. At the reviewed 2025-12-17 commit the repository's LICENSE is GPL-3.0, while package.json still declares MIT; the Zenodo record states GPL-3.0-or-later. The CLI needs Node.js 20 or later, and LLM renaming needs the user's OpenAI or Gemini API key; --model=none runs the AST stages only. Per the artifact appendix, the roughly 3 GB Zenodo archive includes the MalJS malicious samples. The paper credits HumanifyJS for its renaming approach.
metadata_notes_zh: 四位作者的顺序以 PDF、NDSS 论文页面与 Crossref 为准。PDF 页脚给出 ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0 及 DOI；Crossref 未列出页码，本条目未核实页码范围。arXiv v1（2025-12-16）的元数据带有同一 DOI，但没有发表场所注释；本次审阅的是 NDSS 最终版 PDF。论文链接 XingTuLab/JSIMPLIFIER 与 Zenodo 产物 10.5281/zenodo.17531662，后者 DOI 标识的是产物而非论文。在所审阅的 2025-12-17 提交中，仓库 LICENSE 为 GPL-3.0，package.json 却仍声明 MIT；Zenodo 记录标注 GPL-3.0-or-later。命令行工具需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本，大语言模型重命名需要用户自备 OpenAI 或 Gemini API 密钥；--model=none 仅运行 AST 阶段。据产物附录，约 3 GB 的 Zenodo 压缩包包含 MalJS 恶意样本。论文说明其重命名方法借鉴 HumanifyJS。

title: CLAP: Learning Transferable Binary Code Representations with Natural Language Supervision
title_zh: CLAP：借助自然语言监督学习可迁移的二进制代码表示
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2024-09-11; the September 16–20 ISSTA 2024 conference dates and the arXiv date are not substituted for it.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-09-11；本条目不以 ISSTA 2024 于 9 月 16–20 日举行的会议日期或 arXiv 日期替代该日期。
description_en: CLAP (Contrastive Language-Assembly Pre-training) learns assembly-function embeddings aligned with natural-language explanations. A dataset engine compiles Ubuntu C/C++ packages with GCC and Clang at O0–O3 and Os, has GPT-3.5 explain about 2.6 million matching source functions, and fine-tunes a Vicuna-13B “shadow model” on half of those explanations to label more code, yielding 195 million assembly–explanation pairs. A 110M-parameter assembly encoder, using address rebasing, a WordPiece tokenizer and jump-aware embeddings, is first pre-trained on assembly and then contrastively aligned with a text encoder. The embeddings support zero-shot classification by matching code against text prompts. On BinaryCorp-3M similarity search in pools of 10,000 functions, zero-shot CLAP reports 0.836 average recall@1 against 0.571 for fine-tuned jTrans.
description_zh: CLAP（对比式语言—汇编预训练）学习与自然语言解释对齐的汇编函数嵌入。其数据引擎以 GCC 和 Clang 在 O0–O3 与 Os 下编译 Ubuntu 的 C/C++ 软件包，由 GPT-3.5 为约 260 万个对应的源码函数生成解释，再用其中一半解释微调 Vicuna-13B“影子模型”为更多代码生成说明，最终得到 1.95 亿对汇编—解释数据。采用地址重定基、WordPiece 分词与跳转感知嵌入的 1.1 亿参数汇编编码器先在汇编上预训练，再与文本编码器进行对比对齐。所得嵌入可通过将代码与文本提示匹配来实现零样本分类。在候选池为 10,000 个函数的 BinaryCorp-3M 相似性检索中，零样本 CLAP 的平均 recall@1 为 0.836，经微调的 jTrans 为 0.571。
scope_limitations_en: Training explanations are generated by GPT-3.5 and a fine-tuned Vicuna model from source code, not written by humans; five experts scored 50 explanations per model, mostly as acceptable. The authors name the Ubuntu-only build environment and the GPT-3.5 explanations as possible sources of bias. Functions are disassembled with IDA Pro 7.6, and functions with fewer than three basic blocks are excluded. Similarity results use BinaryCorp-3M optimization-level pairs, where baselines get a linear probe and jTrans is also fully fine-tuned while CLAP is not; crypto identification (17 algorithms, about 70K functions labeled by name and package metadata) and protocol categorization (18 types) use datasets the authors built from Ubuntu packages, where fine-tuned CLAP beats the baselines while zero-shot CLAP trails the best baseline on crypto. The malware and sorting results are single case studies. Training used 32 A100 GPUs. CLAP produces embeddings and label scores; it is not a decompiler or a malware detector.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练用的解释由 GPT-3.5 和经微调的 Vicuna 模型依据源码生成，并非人工撰写；五位专家为每个模型的 50 条解释打分，多数被评为可接受。作者指出，仅使用 Ubuntu 构建环境以及采用 GPT-3.5 生成解释都可能带来偏差。函数由 IDA Pro 7.6 反汇编，少于三个基本块的函数被排除。相似性结果使用 BinaryCorp-3M 中不同优化级别的函数对，各基线采用线性探测，jTrans 另做了完整微调，CLAP 则未经微调；密码算法识别（17 种算法，约 7 万个依据函数名与软件包元数据标注的函数）和协议分类（18 种类型）使用作者从 Ubuntu 软件包构建的数据集，其中微调后的 CLAP 超过基线，零样本 CLAP 在密码算法识别上则略逊于最佳基线。恶意软件与排序算法结果仅为个案研究。训练使用 32 块 A100 GPU。CLAP 输出的是嵌入和标签分数，既不是反编译器，也不是恶意软件检测器。
why_fits_en: Adds assembly representation learning aligned with natural language, which supports zero-shot and few-shot function labeling and similarity search in binary analysis, complementing jTrans and the LLM-based decompilation and summarization records.
why_fits_zh: 补充与自然语言对齐的汇编表示学习方法，可在二进制分析中支持零样本和少样本函数标注及相似性检索，与 jTrans 以及基于大语言模型的反编译和摘要研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the ISSTA '24 proceedings article, pages 503–515, and a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license; its ten-author order matches arXiv. The ACM landing page refused automated access, so publication facts follow Crossref and the reviewed text is arXiv v1 (2024-02-26), the only version, which carries the ISSTA 2024 header with a placeholder DOI. Table 1 gives zero-shot CLAP an average recall@1 of 0.836, while the introduction states 83.3%. The paper links Hustcw/CLAP. At the reviewed 2024-09-28 commit the repository has no license file and holds a case-study notebook, IDA databases and rebased assembly for a bubble sort, SHA-3 and a malware sample identified by its VirusTotal hash, prompt files, human-evaluation screenshots and an IDA processing script; it does not include training code or the 195-million-pair dataset. The README links the Hugging Face models hustcw/clap-asm and hustcw/clap-text, whose cards declare MIT and which load with trust_remote_code.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录该文为 ISSTA '24 论文集文章，页码 503–515，许可证为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；十位作者顺序与 arXiv 一致。ACM 文章页面拒绝自动访问，因此出版信息以 Crossref 为准，所审阅的文本是唯一版本 arXiv v1（2024-02-26），其页眉带有 ISSTA 2024 标识及占位 DOI。表 1 给出零样本 CLAP 的平均 recall@1 为 0.836，引言则写作 83.3%。论文链接 Hustcw/CLAP。在所审阅的 2024-09-28 提交中，仓库没有许可证文件，包含案例研究笔记本、冒泡排序、SHA-3 及一个以 VirusTotal 哈希标识的恶意样本的 IDA 数据库与重定基汇编、提示词文件、人工评估截图和 IDA 处理脚本，但不含训练代码或 1.95 亿对数据集。README 链接 Hugging Face 模型 hustcw/clap-asm 与 hustcw/clap-text，其模型卡声明 MIT 许可证，加载时需启用 trust_remote_code。

title: CodeArt: Better Code Models by Attention Regularization When Symbols Are Lacking
title_zh: CodeArt：在缺少符号时通过注意力正则化改进代码模型
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2024-07-12. The July 2024 issue date in the reference format and the FSE 2024 conference dates are not substituted for it.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-07-12；本条目不以引用格式中的 2024 年 7 月期号日期或 FSE 2024 会议日期替代该日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (FSE 2024)
description_en: CodeArt pre-trains a BERT-sized encoder from scratch on 26 million stripped x86-64 functions built from jTrans's BinaryCorp. Instead of relying on symbols, it uses IDA Pro control-flow graphs and a binary data-flow analysis to compute control and data dependences, then restricts self-attention with masks so a token attends only to instructions it transitively depends on or that depend on it, to tokens in its own instruction, and to a global [CLS] token; pre-training masks tokens and perturbs the dependence graph. The authors fine-tune it for binary similarity, malware family classification and type inference. They report improvements over prior models from 53% to 64% recall@1 for similarity in pools of 500, from 49% to 60% LRAP for malware families, and from 74% to 94% average F1 for type inference.
description_zh: CodeArt 基于 jTrans 的 BinaryCorp 构建的 2,600 万个剥离符号的 x86-64 函数，从零开始预训练一个 BERT 规模的编码器。它不依赖符号，而是利用 IDA Pro 控制流图和面向二进制的数据流分析计算控制依赖与数据依赖，再通过注意力掩码，使每个词元只能关注与其存在传递依赖关系的指令、同一条指令内的词元以及全局 [CLS] 词元；预训练时同时遮蔽词元并扰动依赖图。作者将其微调用于二进制相似性分析、恶意软件家族分类和类型推断，报告相对已有模型的提升为：在 500 个函数的候选池中相似性 recall@1 由 53% 升至 64%，恶意软件家族分类 LRAP 由 49% 升至 60%，类型推断平均 F1 由 74% 升至 94%。
scope_limitations_en: The model handles x86-64 only, with functions disassembled by IDA Pro and inputs capped at 512 tokens. Similarity is fine-tuned on BinaryCorp-3M and tested on six projects (Curl, Binutils, ImageMagick, SQLite, OpenSSL and PuTTY), with Coreutils for validation, against GNN, GMN, jTrans and DiEmph baselines; on PuTTY, whose functions are short, CodeArt is only comparable to DiEmph. Type inference uses the x86-64 part of StateFormer's dataset with 35 labels and compares with StateFormer's reported results rather than a rerun. Malware classification uses 5,484 VirusTotal and VirusShare samples from the 100 most frequent families, against jTrans and a re-implemented CNN. All gains are relative to these baselines and settings. CodeArt produces embeddings and task-specific predictions; it is neither a decompiler nor a malware detector.
scope_limitations_zh: 模型仅处理 x86-64，函数由 IDA Pro 反汇编，输入上限为 512 个词元。相似性任务在 BinaryCorp-3M 上微调，以 Coreutils 作验证集，在 Curl、Binutils、ImageMagick、SQLite、OpenSSL 和 PuTTY 六个项目上测试，基线为 GNN、GMN、jTrans 与 DiEmph；PuTTY 的函数较短，CodeArt 在其上仅与 DiEmph 相当。类型推断使用 StateFormer 数据集中的 x86-64 部分及 35 个标签，并与 StateFormer 已报告的结果比较，而非重新运行。恶意软件分类使用来自 VirusTotal 与 VirusShare、属于最常见 100 个家族的 5,484 个样本，对比 jTrans 和重新实现的 CNN。所有提升都是相对这些基线和设定而言。CodeArt 输出嵌入及特定任务的预测，既不是反编译器，也不是恶意软件检测器。
why_fits_en: Adds general-purpose pre-training for stripped binary functions that uses program dependences in place of missing symbols, evaluated on similarity, type inference and malware-family tasks that support reverse engineering.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向剥离符号二进制函数的通用预训练方法，以程序依赖关系代替缺失的符号，并在支持逆向工程的相似性分析、类型推断和恶意软件家族分类任务上评估。
metadata_notes: Crossref records Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering volume 1, issue FSE, pages 562–585, and the seven-author order matches arXiv. The ACM landing page refused automated access, so publication facts follow Crossref and the reviewed text is arXiv v1 (2024-02-19), the only version, which carries the PACMSE reference format and DOI. The abstract lists the three gains in the order similarity, type inference, malware; the contribution list and evaluation assign 49%→60% LRAP to malware family classification and 74%→94% F1 to type inference. The paper links ziansu/codeart. At the reviewed 2025-03-10 commit the repository declares MIT and its README points to an artifacts branch; README-docker.md describes a 3.8 GB Docker image with a Gradio demo and links the PurCL CodeArt-Artifacts collection on Hugging Face, whose checkpoints and datasets, including top-100 malware-family data, declare no license. The REQUIREMENTS file asks for Docker, 64 GB RAM, a 24 GB GPU and up to 100 GB of disk.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录该文刊于 Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering 第 1 卷 FSE 期，页码 562–585，七位作者顺序与 arXiv 一致。ACM 文章页面拒绝自动访问，因此出版信息以 Crossref 为准，所审阅的文本是唯一版本 arXiv v1（2024-02-19），其中带有 PACMSE 引用格式与 DOI。摘要按相似性分析、类型推断、恶意软件的顺序列出三项提升；贡献列表与评估部分则将 LRAP 49%→60% 归于恶意软件家族分类，将 F1 74%→94% 归于类型推断。论文链接 ziansu/codeart。在所审阅的 2025-03-10 提交中，仓库声明 MIT 许可证，README 指向 artifacts 分支；README-docker.md 介绍了一个 3.8 GB、带 Gradio 演示界面的 Docker 镜像，并链接 Hugging Face 上的 PurCL CodeArt-Artifacts 合集，其中的检查点与数据集（包括最常见 100 个恶意软件家族的数据）均未声明许可证。REQUIREMENTS 文件要求 Docker、64 GB 内存、24 GB 显存 GPU 及最多 100 GB 磁盘空间。

title: On Benchmarking Code LLMs for Android Malware Analysis
title_zh: 面向 Android 恶意软件分析的代码大语言模型基准评测
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit gives online publication and the issued date as 2025-06-11, with a print date of 2025-06-25, the first day of the June 25–28 conference. This entry uses the publisher's online date; the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线出版日期及发布日期列为 2025-06-11，纸质出版日期为 2025-06-25，即 6 月 25–28 日会议的首日。本条目采用出版方的在线出版日期，不以 arXiv 日期替代。
description_en: CAMA is a framework for benchmarking how code LLMs read decompiled Android malware. Androguard decompiles each APK into Java functions, and each model returns a structured output per function: a summary, a refined function name and a 0–10 maliciousness score. Two analysis tasks build on these outputs. Malicious-function identification is scored by consistency (whether scores and names stay stable when the model is re-prompted with its own summaries) and by fidelity (how much a LightGBM malware-category classifier loses confidence when the top-scored function descriptors are removed). Malware-purpose summarization is scored by semantic relevance (BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L against reference app descriptions). The benchmark holds 118 APKs from 6 categories and 13 families, with 7,542,799 decompiled functions. Of the four models evaluated, StarChat-Beta has the highest maliciousness consistency (0.813, against 0.381 for CodeLlama) and narrowly the highest semantic-relevance scores, while fidelity varies widely across models and removal sizes. Renaming functions with model-suggested names raises fidelity for CodeLlama and StarChat but lowers METEOR by about 10%.
description_zh: CAMA 是一个评测代码大语言模型理解反编译 Android 恶意软件能力的基准框架。它使用 Androguard 将每个 APK 反编译为 Java 函数，并要求模型为每个函数输出结构化结果：功能摘要、改进后的函数名以及 0–10 分的恶意程度评分。两项分析任务以这些输出为基础。恶意函数识别以一致性（模型依据自身摘要再次作答时评分与命名是否稳定）和保真度（移除评分最高的函数描述后，LightGBM 恶意软件类别分类器的置信度下降多少）衡量；恶意软件用途摘要则以语义相关性（与参考应用描述之间的 BLEU、METEOR 和 ROUGE-L）衡量。基准包含来自 6 个类别、13 个家族的 118 个 APK，共 7,542,799 个反编译函数。在四个受测模型中，StarChat-Beta 的恶意程度一致性最高（0.813，CodeLlama 为 0.381），语义相关性得分也以微弱优势居首；保真度则随模型和移除数量大幅波动。用模型建议的名称重命名函数会提高 CodeLlama 和 StarChat 的保真度，但会使 METEOR 下降约 10%。
scope_limitations_en: This is an eight-page workshop paper that evaluates four open-source code LLMs: CodeLlama-7b-Instruct, StarChat-Beta and the base-size CodeT5 and PLBART, not current frontier models. CodeT5 and PLBART were fine-tuned for three epochs to produce the output fields, and their maliciousness scores come from a separate DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B model, so score-based results do not measure those two models alone; both are also excluded from the renaming study. No function-level ground truth exists: malicious-function identification is measured indirectly through classifier confidence, and the reference app descriptions are GPT-4-generated summaries from the earlier LAMD dataset; the authors note that these surrogates can add noise and bias. The 118 samples are de-duplicated LAMD malware decompiled only with Androguard, and obfuscation is not studied separately. Fidelity scores have standard deviations close to their means, for example 0.332 ± 0.30 for CodeT5 at k = 2. The Zenodo record holds the structured model outputs (function summaries, refined names and maliciousness scores); neither it nor the LAMD record states that it contains the APK samples. CAMA does not detect malware and is not a decompiler.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一篇 8 页的研讨会论文，评测四个开源代码大语言模型：CodeLlama-7b-Instruct、StarChat-Beta 以及基础规模的 CodeT5 和 PLBART，并非当前的前沿模型。CodeT5 与 PLBART 经过三轮微调后才能输出所需字段，其恶意程度评分由另一个 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 模型给出，因此基于评分的结果并非单独衡量这两个模型；二者也未纳入重命名实验。研究缺少函数级真实标签：恶意函数识别通过分类器置信度间接衡量，参考应用描述则是此前 LAMD 数据集中由 GPT-4 生成的摘要；作者指出这些替代方法可能引入噪声与偏差。118 个样本是经过去重的 LAMD 恶意软件，仅使用 Androguard 反编译，也未单独研究混淆的影响。保真度得分的标准差与均值相近，例如 CodeT5 在 k = 2 时为 0.332 ± 0.30。Zenodo 记录保存的是结构化模型输出（函数摘要、改进名称与恶意程度评分）；该记录与 LAMD 记录均未说明包含 APK 样本。CAMA 不是恶意软件检测系统，也不是反编译器。
why_fits_en: Adds a benchmark of code LLMs reading decompiled Android malware, complementing DeGuard's identifier recovery and the single Android case study in the USENIX Security 2024 code-analysis study elsewhere in the bibliography.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个评测代码大语言模型阅读反编译 Android 恶意软件的基准，与书目中 DeGuard 的标识符恢复研究以及 USENIX Security 2024 代码分析研究中的单个 Android 案例互补。
metadata_notes: ACM's Crossref deposit gives the ISSTA Companion '25 proceedings, pages 153–160, a CC BY 4.0 license and the same seven authors in order; the arXiv v2 PDF prints the ACM reference and DOI. The workshop name rests on the arXiv comment and the Zenodo description, which both state acceptance to the LLMSC Workshop 2025 of the 34th ACM SIGSOFT ISSTA Companion; Crossref names only the companion proceedings. arXiv v1 is dated 2025-04-01 and v2 2025-04-23. The paper links no code repository. Its outputs are the Zenodo dataset 10.5281/zenodo.15155917 (2025-04-05, CC BY 4.0, a 710 MB CAMA.zip); that dataset DOI is not used as the paper identifier. The samples and reference descriptions come from the LAMD dataset 10.5281/zenodo.14884736, whose 2 MB archive is described as CSV sample information and logs. The ACM landing page refused automated requests, so the review relied on Crossref and the arXiv PDF.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据列出 ISSTA Companion '25 论文集、第 153–160 页、CC BY 4.0 许可，以及顺序相同的七位作者；arXiv v2 PDF 印有 ACM 引用格式与 DOI。研讨会名称依据 arXiv 注释与 Zenodo 说明，二者均称论文被第 34 届 ACM SIGSOFT ISSTA Companion 的 LLMSC Workshop 2025 接收；Crossref 只列出配套论文集名称。arXiv v1 发布于 2025-04-01，v2 为 2025-04-23。论文未链接代码仓库。其输出发布为 Zenodo 数据集 10.5281/zenodo.15155917（2025-04-05，CC BY 4.0，710 MB 的 CAMA.zip）；该数据集 DOI 不用作论文标识符。样本与参考描述来自 LAMD 数据集 10.5281/zenodo.14884736，其 2 MB 压缩包被描述为 CSV 样本信息与日志。ACM 页面拒绝自动请求，因此本次审阅依据 Crossref 与 arXiv PDF。

title: Fool Me If You Can: On the Robustness of Binary Code Similarity Detection Models against Semantics-Preserving Transformations
title_zh: 有本事就骗过我：二进制代码相似性检测模型对语义保持变换的鲁棒性研究
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2026-06-30. The PDF footer's July 2026 publication date and the FSE 2026 conference dates are not substituted for it.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2026-06-30；本条目不以 PDF 页脚标注的 2026 年 7 月出版日期或 FSE 2026 会议日期替代该日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
description_en: The paper builds asmFooler to test whether learned binary code similarity detection (BCSD) models keep matching functions after semantics-preserving changes. From 620 baseline x86-64 ELF binaries (coreutils, binutils, PuTTY, nginx, SPEC2006 and others, built with Clang at O0–O3), it generates 9,565 variants using in-place instruction rewriting, basic-block reordering, Obfuscator-LLVM, semantic NOPs and junk code, and it adds a greedy search for dead-code sequences that make dissimilar functions look similar. Across Genius, Gemini, Asm2Vec, SAFE, Trex and BinShot, robustness depends on each model's preprocessing, architecture and features: block reordering drops BinShot's recall from 0.972 to 0.036 but lowers it by under 0.05 for the CFG-based Genius and Gemini. The false-positive attack reaches up to 100% success with 14.75 inserted instructions on average.
description_zh: 论文构建 asmFooler，用于检验基于学习的二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）模型在语义保持的改动后能否继续匹配函数。它以 620 个基准 x86-64 ELF 二进制（包括 coreutils、binutils、PuTTY、nginx、SPEC2006 等，均由 Clang 以 O0–O3 编译）为起点，通过原地指令改写、基本块重排、Obfuscator-LLVM、语义空操作和垃圾代码插入生成 9,565 个变体，并加入一种贪心搜索，寻找能让不相似函数显得相似的死代码序列。在 Genius、Gemini、Asm2Vec、SAFE、Trex 与 BinShot 上的结果表明，鲁棒性取决于各模型的预处理、架构与特征：基本块重排使 BinShot 的召回率从 0.972 降至 0.036，而基于控制流图的 Genius 与 Gemini 召回率降幅不足 0.05。误报攻击的成功率最高可达 100%，平均只需插入 14.75 条指令。
scope_limitations_en: All samples are x86-64 ELF binaries compiled by the authors from open-source packages and SPEC2006; some packages failed to compile or transform, and the in-place transformation is non-deterministic and not formally verified. The six models evaluated (Genius, Gemini, Asm2Vec, SAFE, Trex and BinShot) exclude jTrans and LLM-based similarity models, so the findings are not shown to transfer to newer or LLM-based systems. Results depend on the transformation budgets the authors set to fit each model's input limits, and semantic NOPs and junk code are inserted only at function entry. Packing, encryption, string obfuscation and commercial protectors such as VMProtect and Themida are out of scope, and adversarial training is left to future work.
scope_limitations_zh: 所有样本都是作者由开源软件包和 SPEC2006 编译的 x86-64 ELF 二进制；部分软件包未能成功编译或变换，原地变换具有不确定性，也未经形式化验证。评测的六个模型（Genius、Gemini、Asm2Vec、SAFE、Trex 与 BinShot）不包括 jTrans 及基于大语言模型的相似性模型，因此研究结论未被证明适用于更新的或基于大语言模型的系统。结果取决于作者为适应各模型输入上限而设定的变换预算，语义空操作与垃圾代码也只插入在函数入口处。加壳、加密、字符串混淆以及 VMProtect、Themida 等商业保护工具不在研究范围内，对抗训练留待后续工作。
why_fits_en: Adds a measured study of how code diversification and obfuscation mislead learned binary similarity models, which matters when reverse engineers rely on such models to match functions in transformed binaries.
why_fits_zh: 补充一项关于代码多样化与混淆如何误导基于学习的二进制相似性模型的量化研究；当逆向工程依靠此类模型在经过变换的二进制中匹配函数时，这一问题尤为重要。
metadata_notes: Crossref records Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering volume 3, issue FSE, pages 1957–1980, with a CC BY 4.0 license; the PDF footer gives article FSE088. The ACM title capitalizes 'Semantics-Preserving', while arXiv writes 'Semantics-preserving'; the four-author order matches. The ACM landing page refused automated access, so publication facts follow Crossref and the reviewed text is arXiv v1 (2026-02-13), the only version, whose comment states FSE 2026 acceptance. The Data Availability section links Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17116512, a software record named asmFooler (2025-09-11, CC BY 4.0) whose creator is listed as 'anonymous', with a 159 KB artifact archive and a 5 GB dataset archive. No author-identified code repository was found, and the Zenodo DOI is recorded here as an artifact identifier, not a paper identifier.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录该文刊于 Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering 第 3 卷 FSE 期，页码 1957–1980，许可证为 CC BY 4.0；PDF 页脚标注文章编号 FSE088。ACM 标题写作“Semantics-Preserving”，arXiv 则为“Semantics-preserving”；四位作者顺序一致。ACM 文章页面拒绝自动访问，因此出版信息以 Crossref 为准，所审阅的文本是唯一版本 arXiv v1（2026-02-13），其注释说明论文已被 FSE 2026 接收。数据可用性章节链接 Zenodo 记录 10.5281/zenodo.17116512，这是名为 asmFooler 的软件记录（2025-09-11，CC BY 4.0），创建者显示为“anonymous”，包含 159 KB 的产物压缩包和 5 GB 的数据集压缩包。未找到署名作者的代码仓库，该 Zenodo DOI 仅作为产物标识记录于此，而非论文标识。

title: Malsight: Exploring Malicious Source Code and Benign Pseudocode for Iterative Binary Malware Summarization
title_zh: Malsight：结合恶意源代码与良性伪代码的二进制恶意软件迭代式摘要生成
date_basis: IEEE's Crossref deposit gives only the 2025 publication year for volume 20. The 2025-06-26 DOI-registration date and the arXiv dates are not used to assert a month or day.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据仅给出第 20 卷的出版年份 2025。本条目不依据 2025-06-26 的 DOI 注册日期或 arXiv 日期推定月份或日期。
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
description_en: MALSIGHT writes natural-language summaries of stripped binary malware one function at a time. IDA Pro produces pseudocode and a call graph, and functions are summarized callees first, so each caller receives its callees' summaries as context; a sequence-labeling model also marks key API calls and strings, which drive code-search retrieval and LLM-written annotations. The summarizer, MalT5, is a 0.77B-parameter CodeT5+ model fine-tuned first on MalS, 89,609 malicious C source functions from GitHub with LLM-generated summaries refined by human reviewers, and then on annotated benign pseudocode from the Capybara dataset. The authors also introduce MalP, 500 pseudocode functions for testing, and BLEURT-sum, a fine-tuned BLEURT metric, and report that MalT5 performs comparably to much larger Code Llama models.
description_zh: MALSIGHT 以函数为单位，为剥离符号的二进制恶意软件生成自然语言摘要。它先用 IDA Pro 生成伪代码和调用图，再按先被调用者、后调用者的顺序生成摘要，使每个调用者都能获得其被调用函数的摘要作为上下文；另有一个序列标注模型标记关键 API 调用和字符串，据此进行代码检索并由大语言模型生成注释。摘要模型 MalT5 是 0.77B 参数的 CodeT5+，先在 MalS 上微调，即来自 GitHub 的 89,609 个恶意 C 源码函数，其摘要由大语言模型生成并经人工审阅完善，再在 Capybara 数据集带注释的良性伪代码上微调。作者还提出了包含 500 个伪代码函数的测试集 MalP 和微调 BLEURT 得到的评测指标 BLEURT-sum，并报告 MalT5 的表现与规模大得多的 Code Llama 模型相当。
scope_limitations_en: Training summaries are LLM-generated and then reviewed and refined by five experts rather than written from scratch. MalP's 500 test functions come from compiling and decompiling 20 of the same GitHub malware repositories, not from wild samples, and the authors note that loose filtering may let training and test data overlap and inflate results. Quality is scored mainly with the authors' own BLEURT-sum metric. On ten real malware samples, with 79 functions also rated by three reverse engineers, BLEURT-sum was about 30% lower than on MalP, which the authors attribute to long functions: 15.8% exceed 1,000 tokens, while most training functions are under 300. The pipeline depends on IDA Pro pseudocode, and static annotation relies on online code search and a general-purpose LLM. MALSIGHT summarizes behavior; it is not a malware detector or classifier.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练用摘要由大语言模型生成，再经五位专家审阅完善，并非从零开始人工撰写。MalP 的 500 个测试函数来自对同一批 GitHub 恶意代码仓库中 20 个仓库的编译与反编译，而非野外样本；作者也指出，过滤不够严格可能导致训练集与测试集重叠，从而使结果偏高。质量评估主要采用作者自行提出的 BLEURT-sum 指标。在十个真实恶意软件样本上（其中 79 个函数另由三名逆向工程人员评分），BLEURT-sum 比在 MalP 上低约 30%，作者将其归因于函数过长：15.8% 的函数超过 1,000 个词元，而大多数训练函数不足 300 个。该流程依赖 IDA Pro 伪代码，静态注释依赖在线代码搜索和通用大语言模型。MALSIGHT 用于概括行为，既不是恶意软件检测器，也不是分类器。
why_fits_en: Adds LLM-based summarization of stripped malware pseudocode that follows the call graph, complementing decompilation, symbol-recovery and benchmark records that include binary code summarization.
why_fits_zh: 补充沿调用图对剥离符号的恶意软件伪代码进行摘要的大语言模型方法，与反编译、符号恢复以及包含二进制代码摘要任务的基准记录互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records volume 20, pages 6733–6747, and the nine-author order, which matches arXiv; it spells the title 'Malsight', while arXiv and the paper write MALSIGHT. IEEE Xplore could not be retrieved, so publication facts follow Crossref and the reviewed text is arXiv v3 (2025-06-17), whose comment states acceptance by IEEE TIFS; v1 is dated 2024-06-26 and v2 2024-11-06. The paper reports extracting close to 30K functions from 2,289 repositories before giving the 89,609-function MalS total, and calls MalT5 0.7B in its contribution list and 0.77B elsewhere. Footnote 1 promises a source-code release but gives no link. The repository lhl7/Malsight, described as 'code for Malsight', is owned by an account whose profile name matches the first author, but neither the paper nor an author page links it. At the reviewed 2025-07-24 commit it has no license file and links Apache-2.0 Hugging Face models (sequence labeling, CodeT5+ 770M, BLEURT) and datasets.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录第 20 卷、页码 6733–6747 及九位作者顺序，与 arXiv 一致；其标题写作“Malsight”，arXiv 与论文正文则写作 MALSIGHT。IEEE Xplore 无法访问，因此出版信息以 Crossref 为准，所审阅的文本是 arXiv v3（2025-06-17），其注释说明论文已被 IEEE TIFS 接收；v1 发布于 2024-06-26，v2 为 2024-11-06。论文先称从 2,289 个仓库中提取了近 3 万个函数，随后又给出 MalS 共 89,609 个函数；贡献列表称 MalT5 为 0.7B 参数，其他部分则为 0.77B。脚注 1 承诺发布源码，但未给出链接。仓库 lhl7/Malsight 的描述为“code for Malsight”，其所属账号的个人资料名称与第一作者一致，但论文和作者页面均未链接该仓库。在所审阅的 2025-07-24 提交中，该仓库没有许可证文件，并链接采用 Apache-2.0 许可的 Hugging Face 模型（序列标注、CodeT5+ 770M、BLEURT）与数据集。

title: Cybench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities and Risks of Language Models
title_zh: Cybench：评估语言模型网络安全能力与风险的框架
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2025-05-01 is not adopted, and the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不主张更精确的出版日期。本条目不采用论文集页面中 2025-05-01 的引用日期，也不以 arXiv 日期替代。
description_en: Cybench turns 40 professional-level capture-the-flag tasks from four competitions (HackTheBox Cyber Apocalypse 2024, SekaiCTF 2022–23, GlacierCTF and HKCert) into runnable agent tasks. Each task has a description, starter files, a Kali Linux container for the agent with task servers in Docker, and the time the first human team needed to solve it, from 2 minutes to 24 hours 54 minutes. Each task is also split into subtasks that grade intermediate steps. The authors evaluate eight models with a structured bash agent and compare four scaffolds for GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Without subtask guidance, the best agents solved only tasks whose first human solve took at most 11 minutes, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet reached 17.5% unguided success.
description_zh: Cybench 将来自四项竞赛（HackTheBox Cyber Apocalypse 2024、SekaiCTF 2022–23、GlacierCTF 与 HKCert）的 40 道专业级夺旗赛题目整理为可运行的智能体任务。每道题目都包含题目描述、初始文件、供智能体使用的 Kali Linux 容器及以 Docker 运行的题目服务器，并记录首个人类队伍的解题用时（2 分钟至 24 小时 54 分钟）。每道题目还被拆分为若干子任务，用于评估中间步骤。作者使用结构化 bash 智能体评测了八个模型，并为 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 比较了四种智能体框架。在没有子任务引导时，表现最好的智能体只解出了人类首解用时不超过 11 分钟的题目；Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的无引导成功率为 17.5%。
scope_limitations_en: Only 6 of the 40 tasks are reverse engineering; the rest are cryptography (16), web (8), forensics (4), miscellaneous (4) and pwn (2), so aggregate rates are not reverse-engineering accuracy, and Cybench is not a reverse-engineering-only benchmark. In the unguided structured-bash runs, six or seven of the eight models solved the two easiest reversing tasks (first human solves in 2 and 6 minutes), and none solved the other four. Results cover 2024 models (GPT-4o, o1-preview, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3 and 3.1, Mixtral 8x22b) with the authors' scaffolds: 15 iterations unguided or 5 per subtask, short memory, no decompiler tools, one attempt in the main comparison and the best of three in the scaffold comparison. First-solve times come from competition records and are not directly comparable across competitions. The authors judge train–test overlap by model knowledge cutoffs and cannot rule it out for Claude 3.5 Sonnet. CTF tasks are short, small-codebase competition problems, and capturing a flag does not show recovered program structure.
scope_limitations_zh: 40 道题目中只有 6 道属于逆向工程，其余为密码学（16）、Web（8）、取证（4）、杂项（4）与漏洞利用（2），因此总体成功率并不代表逆向工程准确率，Cybench 也不是专门的逆向工程基准。在无引导的结构化 bash 实验中，八个模型中有六到七个解出了两道最简单的逆向题（人类首解用时分别为 2 分钟和 6 分钟），其余四道均无模型解出。结果仅涵盖 2024 年的模型（GPT-4o、o1-preview、Claude 3 Opus、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Llama 3 与 3.1、Mixtral 8x22b）及作者的智能体框架：无引导模式 15 轮、子任务模式每个子任务 5 轮，记忆较短，未提供反编译器工具；主比较只尝试一次，框架比较取三次尝试中的最好结果。首解用时来自各竞赛记录，不同竞赛之间不能直接比较。作者依据模型知识截止日期判断训练—测试重叠，无法排除 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 存在重叠。夺旗赛题目是用时较短、代码规模较小的竞赛问题，夺得旗标并不表明恢复了程序结构。
why_fits_en: Adds a CTF agent benchmark with reverse-engineering tasks and subtask-level grading; EnIGMA in this section reports results on it, and it complements the reverse-engineering-specific benchmarks here.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个含逆向工程题目并按子任务评分的夺旗赛智能体基准；本节收录的 EnIGMA 也报告了在该基准上的结果，它与本节专门面向逆向工程的基准互补。
metadata_notes: Authors follow the byline of the proceedings PDF, which matches arXiv v4. The proceedings page metadata instead lists 25 names: it omits Polycarpos Yiorkadjis and Gautham Raghupathi, gives Haoxiang Yang, Aolin Zhang and Kenny Oseleononmen where the PDF prints Mike Yang, Teddy Zhang and Kenny Osele, and drops middle initials. The proceedings list pages 25094–25243 and no DOI. arXiv v1 is dated 2024-08-15, v2 2024-10-06, v3 2024-12-05 and v4 2025-04-12; v4 carries the comment 'ICLR 2025 Oral'. The OpenReview forum could not be retrieved past a browser check, so the oral designation rests on that comment. The proceedings abstract links anonymized Google Drive archives, while the PDF points to cybench.github.io, which links andyzorigin/cybench. At the reviewed 2026-09-24 commit the repository is Apache-2.0; runs need model API keys, Python 3.9–3.10 and Docker with the cybench/cybench image. Its task_list.txt names all 40 tasks, but the nine GlacierCTF tasks, including the reversing tasks RPGO and SOP, are not in the repository tree.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者以论文集 PDF 的署名为准，与 arXiv v4 一致。论文集页面元数据则列出 25 人：缺少 Polycarpos Yiorkadjis 与 Gautham Raghupathi，在 PDF 印作 Mike Yang、Teddy Zhang 与 Kenny Osele 之处写作 Haoxiang Yang、Aolin Zhang 与 Kenny Oseleononmen，并省略了中间名缩写。论文集列出页码 25094–25243，没有 DOI。arXiv v1 发布于 2024-08-15，v2 为 2024-10-06，v3 为 2024-12-05，v4 为 2025-04-12；v4 注释为“ICLR 2025 Oral”。OpenReview 论坛页因浏览器验证无法获取，因此口头报告身份依据该注释。论文集摘要链接的是匿名 Google Drive 压缩包，而 PDF 指向 cybench.github.io，该网站链接 andyzorigin/cybench。在所审阅的 2026-09-24 提交中，仓库采用 Apache-2.0 许可证；运行需要模型 API 密钥、Python 3.9–3.10 以及使用 cybench/cybench 镜像的 Docker。其 task_list.txt 列出全部 40 道题目，但九道 GlacierCTF 题目（包括逆向题 RPGO 与 SOP）不在仓库目录中。

title: Code is not Natural Language: Unlock the Power of Semantics-Oriented Graph Representation for Binary Code Similarity Detection
title_zh: 代码并非自然语言：释放面向语义的图表示在二进制代码相似性检测中的潜力
date_basis: Publication month in the official USENIX proceedings BibTeX; the August 14–16, 2024 symposium dates are not used to assert a publication day.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方论文集 BibTeX 中的出版月份；不以 2024 年 8 月 14–16 日的会议日期推定具体出版日。
description_en: HermesSim detects binary code similarity by lifting each function to Ghidra P-code and building a semantics-oriented graph that exposes operand structure inside instructions, def-use, control-flow and effect-order relations, while dropping semantics-independent details such as which register temporarily holds a value. A gated graph neural network with a multi-head softmax aggregator embeds the graph, and functions are compared by embedding similarity. On the Dataset-1 benchmark of Marcelli et al., the authors report 48.1% RECALL@1 for x64 cross-compiler retrieval in pools of 10,000 functions, against 31.4% for a fine-tuned jTrans, with a 388K-parameter model.
description_zh: HermesSim 将每个函数提升为 Ghidra P-code，并构建面向语义的图，以显式表示指令内部的操作数结构、定义—使用关系、控制流及副作用顺序，同时舍弃与语义无关的细节，例如由哪个寄存器临时保存某个值。它使用带多头 softmax 聚合器的门控图神经网络对图进行嵌入，再按嵌入相似度比较函数。作者在 Marcelli 等人发布的 Dataset-1 基准上报告：在 10,000 个函数的候选池中进行 x64 跨编译器检索时，RECALL@1 为 48.1%，经微调的 jTrans 为 31.4%；HermesSim 模型参数量为 388K。
scope_limitations_en: Laboratory results reuse Dataset-1 from Marcelli et al.: 257K, 13K and 522K training, validation and test functions for x86, ARM and MIPS in 32 and 64 bits, built at O0–O3 and Os by GCC and Clang. HermesSim keeps that dataset's IDA Pro 7.3 control flow and basic-block boundaries and uses Ghidra only to disassemble and lift each block, so the results do not measure function or CFG recovery. Each setting samples 1,000 queries against pools of up to 10,000 functions, and the gains are relative to the paper's own runs of SAFE, Asm2Vec, GMN, Trex and jTrans, which supports x86 only and was compared on the x64 subset. The real-world study searches 62,605 ARM32 and MIPS32 functions from 12 RTOS firmware images of three vendors for 10 functions linked to 5 CVEs; its ground truth comes from manually examining the top 20 results of the compared methods. String, integer and external-symbol references are not encoded, only memory effects are modeled, and unresolved indirect branches leave graphs incomplete. Similarity ranks candidates for review; it does not establish equivalence or vulnerability.
scope_limitations_zh: 实验室结果沿用 Marcelli 等人的 Dataset-1：训练、验证与测试集分别含 257K、13K 与 522K 个函数，覆盖 x86、ARM 和 MIPS 的 32 位与 64 位代码，由 GCC 和 Clang 以 O0–O3 及 Os 编译。HermesSim 保留该数据集由 IDA Pro 7.3 恢复的控制流和基本块边界，仅用 Ghidra 反汇编并提升各基本块，因此结果并不衡量函数或控制流图的恢复能力。每项设置抽取 1,000 个查询函数，候选池最多为 10,000 个函数；性能提升是相对于论文自行运行的 SAFE、Asm2Vec、GMN、Trex 和 jTrans 而言，其中 jTrans 仅支持 x86，只在 x64 子集上比较。真实场景实验在来自三家厂商 12 个 RTOS 固件映像的 62,605 个 ARM32 与 MIPS32 函数中，检索与 5 个 CVE 相关的 10 个函数；其真实标签来自对各比较方法前 20 个结果的人工检查。方法不编码字符串、整数及外部符号引用，只建模内存副作用，未解析的间接跳转也会使图不完整。相似度用于为人工审查排列候选，并不能证明等价性或存在漏洞。
why_fits_en: Adds learned binary code similarity search, which reverse engineers use to match functions across builds, recover library functions in stripped binaries and locate known vulnerable code, complementing decompilation and symbol-recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于学习的二进制代码相似性检索；逆向工程中常借此跨版本匹配函数、在剥离符号的二进制中识别库函数并定位已知漏洞代码，与反编译和符号恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: The USENIX page, its BibTeX entry and the final PDF agree on the nine-author order, pages 1759–1776 and ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1; the page also lists a prepublication PDF. USENIX assigns no paper DOI and no arXiv version was found. The paper links github.com/NSSL-SJTU/HermesSim. At the reviewed 2024-12-10 commit its LICENSE file is MIT for the project and reproduces MIT and Apache-2.0 notices for included Cisco Talos and DeepMind code, which is why GitHub reports no single license. The README's paper link uses /presentation/he, which redirects to the he-haojie page. Lifting calls the separate GPL-3.0 GSAT Ghidra toolkit (gsat-1.0.jar). Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.10369788 (CC BY 4.0), linked from the README, holds the Dataset-RTOS binaries and archives of about 17 GB, 19 GB and 5 GB with extracted features, model inputs and outputs; that DOI identifies the data, not the paper. Dataset-1 binaries come from the Cisco Talos binary_function_similarity repository. The pinned requirements target Python 3.10, PyTorch 1.13.1 with CUDA 11.6 and PyTorch Geometric 2.3.0.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 页面、其 BibTeX 条目与最终 PDF 的九位作者顺序、页码 1759–1776 及 ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1 一致；该页面另列有预发表版 PDF。USENIX 不为论文分配 DOI，也未找到 arXiv 版本。论文链接 github.com/NSSL-SJTU/HermesSim。在所审阅的 2024-12-10 提交中，其 LICENSE 文件为项目声明 MIT 许可证，并附有所含 Cisco Talos 与 DeepMind 代码的 MIT 和 Apache-2.0 声明，因此 GitHub 未识别出单一许可证。README 中的论文链接使用 /presentation/he，该地址会重定向至 he-haojie 页面。提升步骤调用独立的 GPL-3.0 GSAT Ghidra 工具包（gsat-1.0.jar）。README 链接的 Zenodo 记录 10.5281/zenodo.10369788（CC BY 4.0）包含 Dataset-RTOS 二进制，以及约 17 GB、19 GB 和 5 GB 的压缩包，内含提取的特征、模型输入与输出；该 DOI 标识的是数据，而非论文。Dataset-1 的二进制来自 Cisco Talos 的 binary_function_similarity 仓库。固定版本的依赖面向 Python 3.10、PyTorch 1.13.1（CUDA 11.6）及 PyTorch Geometric 2.3.0。

title: TYGR: Type Inference on Stripped Binaries using Graph Neural Networks
title_zh: TYGR：基于图神经网络的剥离符号二进制类型推断
date_basis: Publication month in the official USENIX proceedings BibTeX; the August 14–16, 2024 symposium dates are not used to assert a publication day.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方论文集 BibTeX 中的出版月份；不以 2024 年 8 月 14–16 日的会议日期推定具体出版日。
description_en: TYGR infers the types of stack and heap variables in stripped binaries by running an architecture-agnostic, intra-procedural data-flow analysis on angr's VEX IR and classifying each variable's data-flow graph with a graph neural network. It predicts base types, pointers and struct member layouts, covering 97.1% of the types observed in its data. The authors also build TyDa, 163,643 binaries compiled with debug information from Gentoo and Debian C packages for x86, x64, AArch64, Arm32 and MIPS at O0–O3, and deduplicate functions in the evaluated subset before splitting it. On x64 across O0–O3 they report 76.6% overall and 45.2% struct accuracy, and say TYGR beats prior work by at least 26.1% overall and 10.2% on structs.
description_zh: TYGR 在 angr 的 VEX 中间表示上执行与架构无关的过程内数据流分析，并用图神经网络对每个变量的数据流图进行分类，从而推断剥离符号二进制中栈变量与堆变量的类型。它可预测基本类型、指针及结构体成员布局，覆盖其数据中观察到的 97.1% 的类型。作者还构建了 TyDa：由 Gentoo 与 Debian 的 C 软件包以 O0–O3 编译、保留调试信息的 163,643 个二进制，涵盖 x86、x64、AArch64、Arm32 与 MIPS，并在划分评测子集前对其中函数去重。作者报告在 x64 的 O0–O3 上整体准确率为 76.6%、结构体准确率为 45.2%，并称整体准确率与结构体准确率分别至少超出已有工作 26.1% 和 10.2%。
scope_limitations_en: Ground truth comes from DWARF information in binaries compiled by the authors, and training and testing use TyDa-min, about 8% of TyDa's binaries, so the results do not cover wild, obfuscated or C++ code. The analysis is intra-procedural and covers stack and heap variables only, not globals; unresolved indirect jumps can leave code unexplored, and adjacent stack structs are predicted as one struct, though the authors find this rare in TyDa. Accuracy plateaus near 80% as training data grows, which the authors attribute to rare types and types that usage alone cannot distinguish. Comparisons follow each baseline's original setting: DIRTY and OSPREY on x64 only, and OSPREY through results its authors supplied for Coreutils x64-O0. Accuracy is not compared directly with Ghidra or IDA Pro. Predictions choose from a fixed set of base, pointer and struct-member types; they do not recover type names or full struct declarations.
scope_limitations_zh: 真实标签来自作者自行编译的二进制中的 DWARF 信息，训练与测试使用 TyDa-min，即约 8% 的 TyDa 二进制，因此结果不涵盖野外样本、混淆代码或 C++ 代码。分析是过程内的，仅覆盖栈变量与堆变量，不包括全局变量；未解析的间接跳转可能使部分代码未被分析，相邻的栈上结构体会被预测为一个结构体，但作者发现这种情况在 TyDa 中很少见。随着训练数据增加，准确率在 80% 左右趋于平稳，作者将其归因于罕见类型以及仅凭使用方式无法区分的类型。比较按各基线的原始设定进行：DIRTY 与 OSPREY 仅在 x64 上比较，OSPREY 则使用其作者提供的 Coreutils x64-O0 结果。准确率未直接与 Ghidra 或 IDA Pro 比较。预测结果取自固定的基本类型、指针类型与结构体成员类型集合，并不恢复类型名称或完整的结构体声明。
why_fits_en: Adds graph-neural-network type inference over data-flow graphs and a multi-architecture type-recovery dataset, complementing decompiler-output, LLM-based and synthesis-based type recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于数据流图和图神经网络的类型推断方法及多架构类型恢复数据集，与基于反编译输出、大语言模型及程序合成的类型恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: The USENIX page, its BibTeX entry and the final PDF agree on the 14-author order, pages 4283–4300 and ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1. USENIX assigns no paper DOI and no arXiv version was found. The paper releases its artifacts at github.com/sefcom/TYGR. At the reviewed 2024-08-22 commit the repository has no license file; it ships trained MODEL_base and MODEL_struct models, and its environment pins Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.8.1 with CUDA 10.2 and angr 9.0.7491. TyDa is not in the repository: the README links two Dropbox folders, one described as Gentoo C and C++ x86-64 binaries with per-optimization JSON metadata and one with the remaining C binaries, and notes that the dataset still contains duplicate functions.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 页面、其 BibTeX 条目与最终 PDF 的 14 位作者顺序、页码 4283–4300 及 ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1 一致。USENIX 不为论文分配 DOI，也未找到 arXiv 版本。论文在 github.com/sefcom/TYGR 发布研究产物。在所审阅的 2024-08-22 提交中，该仓库没有许可证文件；仓库附带训练好的 MODEL_base 与 MODEL_struct 模型，环境文件固定 Python 3.8、PyTorch 1.8.1（CUDA 10.2）与 angr 9.0.7491。TyDa 不在仓库内：README 链接了两个 Dropbox 文件夹，其一被描述为附有各优化级别 JSON 元数据的 Gentoo C 与 C++ x86-64 二进制，另一个包含其余 C 二进制，并说明数据集中仍有重复函数。

title: ShieldedCode: Learning Robust Representations for Virtual Machine Protected Code
title_zh: ShieldedCode：学习虚拟机保护代码的鲁棒表示
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2026-04-20 is not adopted, and the arXiv date is not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不主张更精确的出版日期。本条目不采用论文集页面中 2026-04-20 的引用日期，也不以 arXiv 日期替代。
description_en: ShieldedCode studies software protection from the defender's side: it trains code language models on pairs of C source functions and their virtualization-protected (VMP) x86-64 code so that the models can generate, compare and rank protected variants. Training pairs come from AnghaBench functions compiled at O0–O3, protected at levels L0–L3 by a commercial VMP tool, then disassembled and normalized. The model adds attention masks for dependencies within, between adjacent and across virtual instructions, contrastive objectives for functional equivalence and protection strength, and a protection-effectiveness task that ranks variants of the same source. Continual pre-training starts from CodeLlama 34B and adds The Stack to the corpus, and fine-tuning uses 2.5 million source–VM pairs. On HumanEval-compile, VM code generation reaches 26.95% Pass@1 at level L0 (GPT-4o: 22.58%) and 14.71% at L3. On BinaryCorp-VirtualAssembly similarity detection, Recall@1 for the O0+L1 setting is 0.488, against 0.333 for jTrans with a linear probe. The authors also run a manual reverse-engineering study and pattern-matching and angr attacks on the generated protection.
description_zh: ShieldedCode 从防御方角度研究软件保护：它以 C 源代码函数及其经虚拟化保护（VMP）后的 x86-64 代码组成的配对数据训练代码语言模型，使模型能够生成、比较和排序受保护的变体。训练配对取自 AnghaBench 函数，经 O0–O3 编译后由一款商业 VMP 工具按 L0–L3 级别保护，再反汇编并规范化。模型为单条虚拟指令内部、相邻虚拟指令之间以及跨虚拟指令的依赖加入注意力掩码，采用面向功能等价和保护强度的对比学习目标，并设置对同一源代码不同变体排序的保护效果任务。持续预训练从 CodeLlama 34B 起步，语料另加入 The Stack；微调使用 250 万组源代码—虚拟机代码配对。在 HumanEval-compile 上，L0 级虚拟机代码生成的 Pass@1 为 26.95%（GPT-4o 为 22.58%），L3 级为 14.71%。在 BinaryCorp-VirtualAssembly 相似性检测中，O0+L1 设置下的 Recall@1 为 0.488，采用线性探针的 jTrans 为 0.333。作者还对生成的保护代码开展了人工逆向研究，以及模式匹配和 angr 攻击。
scope_limitations_en: All data is x86-64, and every training pair is produced with one commercial VMP tool that the paper does not name, so results may not carry over to other architectures, protectors or virtual-instruction designs. Generated VM code is checked with HumanEval-compile test cases, not formal equivalence, and Pass@1 stays between 14.71% and 26.95% across protection levels. The similarity gain over jTrans holds only in the O0+L1 setting: in the other five BinaryCorp-VirtualAssembly settings the linear-probe jTrans has higher Recall@1 (for example 0.715 against 0.309 for O2+L1), and the paper's summaries of the comparison differ (a 10% gain in the abstract, 15.5 points in the introduction, competitive in the results). The ablation table reports scores for ContraBin, CLAP and CEBin that the paper says are estimated from their architectures rather than measured. Protection-strength claims rest on the authors' own attacks and manual study: 12 graduate students and 3 professional reverse engineers analyzing 20 functions for 30–45 minutes each, with 17% success on ShieldedCode output against 67% for VMProtect and 58% for Themida.
