ShieldedCode is not a devirtualizer or deobfuscator, and the paper links no code, models or generated training data.
scope_limitations_zh: 全部数据均为 x86-64，所有训练配对都由论文未具名的同一款商业 VMP 工具生成，因此结果未必适用于其他架构、保护工具或虚拟指令设计。生成的虚拟机代码通过 HumanEval-compile 测试用例检验，而非形式化等价验证；各保护级别的 Pass@1 仅在 14.71% 至 26.95% 之间。相对 jTrans 的相似性优势只出现在 O0+L1 设置中：在 BinaryCorp-VirtualAssembly 的其余五种设置中，采用线性探针的 jTrans 的 Recall@1 更高（例如 O2+L1 下为 0.715，ShieldedCode 为 0.309）；论文对这一比较的概括也不一致（摘要称提升 10%，引言称提升 15.5 个百分点，结果部分则称性能相当）。消融表中 ContraBin、CLAP 与 CEBin 的得分据论文说明是依其架构估计而非实测。保护强度的结论依赖作者自行开展的攻击和人工研究：12 名研究生与 3 名专业逆向工程师分析 20 个函数，每个函数限时 30–45 分钟，对 ShieldedCode 输出的成功率为 17%，对 VMProtect 和 Themida 分别为 67% 与 58%。ShieldedCode 不是去虚拟化工具或反混淆工具，论文也未链接代码、模型或生成的训练数据。
why_fits_en: Adds protection-side research that uses learned models to generate VM-protected code and to measure how it resists reversing, complementing the BAR 2026 protection study and SRE-Bench, which measure how agents cope with protected binaries.
why_fits_zh: 补充保护方视角的研究：利用学习模型生成虚拟机保护代码并衡量其抗逆向能力，与 BAR 2026 保护研究和 SRE-Bench 这类衡量智能体如何应对受保护二进制的工作互补。
metadata_notes: The ICLR proceedings page lists the five authors in this order, pages 23529–23552 and no DOI; its PDF carries the header "Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026". arXiv has only v1, dated 2026-01-28, with the comment "Accepted to ICLR 2026". The OpenReview forum 9F9UFVcDkV returned a browser challenge to automated requests. Neither the paper nor the proceedings page links code, models or data; the reproducibility statement only says the implementation uses PyTorch and open-source libraries. A same-name GitHub repository, Clon5676/ShieldedCode, is an unrelated Unreal Engine project. The commercial tool used to build the training data is unnamed; VMProtect and Themida appear only as comparisons in the resistance study.
metadata_notes_zh: ICLR 论文集页面按此顺序列出五位作者，页码为 23529–23552，没有 DOI；其 PDF 页眉为“Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026”。arXiv 只有 v1，发布于 2026-01-28，注释为“Accepted to ICLR 2026”。OpenReview 论坛 9F9UFVcDkV 对自动请求返回浏览器验证。论文与论文集页面均未链接代码、模型或数据；可复现性声明只说明实现基于 PyTorch 与开源库。GitHub 上同名仓库 Clon5676/ShieldedCode 是无关的 Unreal Engine 项目。用于构建训练数据的商业工具未具名；VMProtect 与 Themida 仅作为抗逆向研究中的对照出现。

title: STRIDE: Simple Type Recognition In Decompiled Executables
title_zh: STRIDE：反编译可执行文件中的简单类型识别
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission on 2024-07-03, the only version at review time. No later venue publication was found, so no publication date beyond the preprint is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv v1 的 2024-07-03 提交日期，审阅时这是唯一版本。未找到后续正式发表记录，因此不主张预印本之外的出版日期。
description_en: STRIDE predicts the names and types of variables in decompiler output without a neural model. From training decompilation with known labels, it builds a database mapping the token sequences (N-grams, with N from 2 to 60) immediately left and right of each variable occurrence to the five most frequent names or types. Variable placeholders are canonicalized, and address-like tokens and large constants are bucketed so that N-grams can match. At prediction time it looks up the longest matching N-gram on each side of every occurrence, scores the returned labels by how specific the match is, and sums the scores across the function. The prototype is about 1,000 lines of Python and runs on a CPU. On DIRT functions not seen in training, the authors report 66.4% retyping accuracy, against 52.3% for DIRTY with beam search, and 56.2% renaming accuracy, against 51.3% reported for VarBERT. Across 16 VarCorpus splits, renaming accuracy is higher than VarBERT on 11 and 1.55 points higher on average. Prediction takes 8.2 ms per function on a CPU, against 43.7 ms for VarBERT on an NVIDIA L4 GPU.
description_zh: STRIDE 不使用神经网络模型，而是预测反编译器输出中变量的名称和类型。它基于带已知标签的训练反编译结果构建数据库，将每处变量出现位置紧邻左右两侧的词元序列（N-gram，N 取 2 至 60）映射到出现频率最高的五个名称或类型。变量占位名会被规范化，类似地址的词元和较大的常量会被分桶，以便 N-gram 能够匹配。预测时，它在每处出现位置的两侧查找最长的匹配 N-gram，按匹配的特异程度为返回的标签打分，并在整个函数内累加得分。原型约有 1,000 行 Python 代码，在 CPU 上运行。作者报告，在训练集中未出现的 DIRT 函数上，类型恢复准确率为 66.4%（启用束搜索的 DIRTY 为 52.3%），重命名准确率为 56.2%（VarBERT 的已报告结果为 51.3%）。在 16 个 VarCorpus 划分中，其重命名准确率在 11 个划分上高于 VarBERT，平均高 1.55 个百分点。预测在 CPU 上每个函数耗时 8.2 毫秒，而 VarBERT 在 NVIDIA L4 GPU 上为 43.7 毫秒。
scope_limitations_en: An arXiv preprint with no stated venue. STRIDE classifies by exact N-gram matches, so its predictions depend on token sequences seen in the training data: it cannot fuzzy-match or predict a name or type absent from training, and a model trained on one decompiler's token format is not expected to transfer to another. Results are reported on decompiler output from the DIRT, DIRE and VarCorpus benchmark datasets. DIRT pairs Hex-Rays output for GCC -O0 builds of GitHub projects with DWARF-derived labels, the older DIRE dataset was prepared similarly, and VarCorpus covers Gentoo packages decompiled with Hex-Rays and Ghidra at -O0 to -O3. Retyping is evaluated only on DIRT, and only x86 C/C++ code is covered. Accuracy is exact match, so near-synonyms count as errors. About 60% of DIRT test functions also appear in training, where STRIDE reaches about 99% by memorization; the not-in-train figures are the more representative ones. DIRT keeps function and global names, and removing them lowers renaming accuracy by a few points. Several baseline numbers are copied from earlier publications rather than rerun. The authors' README expects poor results on custom closed-source binaries with structures absent from training. The repository is a research prototype with no decompiler plugin or trained databases.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一篇未标明发表场所的 arXiv 预印本。STRIDE 依据完全一致的 N-gram 匹配进行分类，因此预测取决于训练数据中出现过的词元序列：它无法模糊匹配，也无法预测训练中未出现的名称或类型；基于某一反编译器词元格式训练的模型预计不能迁移到其他反编译器。结果基于 DIRT、DIRE 与 VarCorpus 三个基准数据集中的反编译器输出。DIRT 使用 GitHub 项目经 GCC -O0 编译后的 Hex-Rays 输出，并以 DWARF 信息生成标签，较早的 DIRE 数据集以类似方式构建；VarCorpus 覆盖以 Hex-Rays 和 Ghidra 在 -O0 至 -O3 下反编译的 Gentoo 软件包。类型恢复只在 DIRT 上评测，且仅覆盖 x86 C/C++ 代码。准确率按完全匹配计算，近义名称也算作错误。约 60% 的 DIRT 测试函数同样出现在训练集中，STRIDE 在这部分依靠记忆达到约 99% 的准确率；训练集中未出现的函数上的结果更具代表性。DIRT 保留了函数名与全局变量名，去除这些标识符后重命名准确率会下降几个百分点。部分基线数据摘自既有论文，并未重新运行。作者在 README 中预计，对包含训练中未出现结构体的自定义闭源二进制文件效果不佳。仓库是研究原型，不含反编译器插件或训练好的数据库。
why_fits_en: Adds a non-neural, sequence-matching baseline for decompiled variable name and type recovery, complementing the transformer-based DIRTY and VarBERT records it compares against.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个非神经网络、基于序列匹配的反编译变量名称与类型恢复基线，与书目中作为其比较对象、基于 Transformer 的 DIRTY 和 VarBERT 互补。
metadata_notes: arXiv v1 (2024-07-03), the only version at review time; the abstract page lists no comment or journal reference, and the PDF names Carnegie Mellon University and the CMU Software Engineering Institute as affiliations. A Crossref bibliographic search and an OpenAlex search found only the arXiv preprint; DBLP's search API returned a bot check and could not be consulted. The abstract links hgarrereyn/STRIDE, reviewed at its latest commit ebaab25 (2024-07-04): MIT license, copyright 2024 Harrison Green. The README documents converters for the DIRE, DIRT and VarCorpus datasets, which are downloaded separately from Google Drive, Amazon S3 and Dropbox; the repository ships no trained N-gram databases or requirements file, and its FAQ says no decompiler plugin exists yet. The paper says the N-gram database takes a few gigabytes of memory.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v1（2024-07-03），审阅时这是唯一版本；摘要页没有注释或期刊引用信息，PDF 列出的单位为卡内基梅隆大学及其软件工程研究所。Crossref 书目检索与 OpenAlex 检索只找到该 arXiv 预印本；DBLP 检索接口返回机器人验证页面，无法查询。摘要链接的 hgarrereyn/STRIDE 按其最新提交 ebaab25（2024-07-04）审阅：采用 MIT 许可证，版权归 Harrison Green（2024）。README 说明了 DIRE、DIRT 与 VarCorpus 数据集的转换脚本，这些数据集需另行从 Google Drive、Amazon S3 和 Dropbox 下载；仓库不含训练好的 N-gram 数据库或依赖清单，其常见问题说明尚无反编译器插件。论文指出 N-gram 数据库会占用数 GB 内存。

title: Exploring the Potential of LLMs for Code Deobfuscation
title_zh: 探索大语言模型在代码去混淆中的潜力
date_basis: Springer's Crossref deposit gives first online publication on 2025-07-10, during the July 9–11 conference; its print and issued dates give only the year. This entry uses the publisher's online date, not the conference schedule or the later CISPA repository date.
date_basis_zh: Springer 提交的 Crossref 元数据将首次在线出版日期列为 2025-07-10，处于 7 月 9–11 日会议期间；其纸质出版与发布日期只给出年份。本条目采用出版方的在线出版日期，不依据会议日程或之后的 CISPA 存储库日期。
description_en: Studies LLMs as source-to-source deobfuscators for C functions protected with the Tigress obfuscator. Functions from ExeBench, with identifiers randomized, are obfuscated with five transformations: MBA arithmetic encoding, branch encoding, control-flow flattening, opaque predicates and argument randomization. Each model receives a whole obfuscated function and returns simplified C. DeepSeek Coder 6.7B and Code Llama 7B are fine-tuned on obfuscated–original pairs, GPT-4 is prompted, and Clang optimization at -O0 to -O3 serves as a compiler baseline. Simplification is scored with Halstead program length relative to the original and obfuscated code, syntactic correctness by compiling ExeBench wrappers and semantic correctness by ExeBench input/output samples. The fine-tuned models reduce complexity more than GPT-4 on every transformation and more than Clang except on arithmetic encoding and argument randomization, where Clang is on par. Trained on chains of up to five transformations, they keep stable scores on chains of six and seven, and the best model cuts Halstead program length by 89.21% on average in the hardest scenario. A test with randomized constants found one sample that reproduced memorized code.
description_zh: 研究将大语言模型用作源码到源码的去混淆器，处理经 Tigress 混淆器保护的 C 函数。研究从 ExeBench 选取函数并随机化标识符，再施加五种变换：MBA 算术编码、分支编码、控制流平坦化、不透明谓词和参数随机化。模型每次读入一个完整的混淆函数并输出简化后的 C 代码。DeepSeek Coder 6.7B 与 Code Llama 7B 在“混淆—原始”代码对上微调，GPT-4 通过提示使用，Clang 的 -O0 至 -O3 优化则作为编译器基线。简化效果以 Halstead 程序长度相对于原始代码与混淆代码的变化衡量，语法正确性通过编译 ExeBench 包装程序检查，语义正确性则用 ExeBench 输入／输出样例检查。微调模型在每种变换上降低复杂度的幅度都大于 GPT-4，除算术编码和参数随机化（Clang 与之相当）外也大于 Clang。模型在最多五个变换组成的链上训练，在六个和七个变换的链上得分仍保持稳定；最佳模型在最困难场景中平均将 Halstead 程序长度缩减 89.21%。随机化常量的记忆测试只发现一个样本复现了记忆中的代码。
scope_limitations_en: The obfuscation is Tigress (version 3.3.3 in the released scripts) applied source-to-source to single C functions. Compiled binaries, decompiler output, commercial protectors, inter-procedural obfuscation, VM-based packing and self-modifying code are not evaluated; the authors only note that decompilation can approximate C from binaries. This is source-level simplification, not binary deobfuscation or VM devirtualization. Semantic correctness is the main weakness: for single transformations the fine-tuned models preserve behavior in 50% to 94.5% of samples, mostly below GPT-4 and, except for branch encoding, below Clang, and it falls as transformation chains grow longer. Complexity scores count only samples that are both syntactically and semantically correct. Behavior is checked with ExeBench input/output samples rather than equivalence proofs, inputs are limited to a 6,144-token context, and models were fine-tuned with 8-bit quantization. Only one obfuscator is used, so generalization to other obfuscators, versions, machine code or bytecode is left open, and baselines are GPT-4 and Clang rather than dedicated deobfuscation tools.
scope_limitations_zh: 混淆使用 Tigress（发布脚本中为 3.3.3 版），以源码到源码的方式作用于单个 C 函数。研究未评估已编译二进制、反编译器输出、商业保护器、跨过程混淆、基于虚拟机的加壳或自修改代码；作者仅指出可通过反编译从二进制得到近似的 C 代码。这是源码级简化，并非二进制去混淆或虚拟机去虚拟化。语义正确性是主要短板：在单一变换场景中，微调模型保持行为的样本比例为 50% 至 94.5%，大多低于 GPT-4，除分支编码外也低于 Clang，并且随着变换链变长而下降。复杂度得分只统计语法与语义均正确的样本。行为通过 ExeBench 输入／输出样例检查，而非等价性证明；输入受 6,144 个词元的上下文限制，模型微调时还使用了 8 位量化。研究只使用一种混淆器，因此对其他混淆器、版本、机器码或字节码的泛化仍待验证；基线是 GPT-4 与 Clang，而非专用去混淆工具。
why_fits_en: Adds source-level deobfuscation of protected C code with fine-tuned code LLMs, complementing the JavaScript (JsDeObsBench, CASCADE) and Android (DeGuard) deobfuscation papers and the LLM decompilation research in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充利用微调代码大语言模型对受保护 C 代码进行源码级去混淆的研究，与书目中的 JavaScript（JsDeObsBench、CASCADE）和 Android（DeGuard）去混淆论文以及本节的大语言模型反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: Springer's Crossref deposit gives the Lecture Notes in Computer Science proceedings of the 22nd DIMVA (Graz, 9–11 July 2025), pages 267–286, and the nine authors in the order of the PDF byline. The Springer landing page returned a browser challenge to automated requests, so the review used Crossref and the open-access PDF from the CISPA repository record 10.60882/cispa.32771220.v1 (CC BY 4.0, deposited 2026-06-23). That record and the CISPA publication page list "Antonio Emanuele" and "Sébastian Bardin"; the authors here follow Crossref and the PDF. An arXiv API search for Beste with deobfuscation in the title returned no record. The PDF links DavidBeste/llm-code-deobfuscation, reviewed at commit 00c9c45 (2026-02-27), which added the MIT LICENSE after publication. Its README links the dataset 10.5281/zenodo.15831457 (2025-07-10, CC BY 4.0, a 17 MB deobfuscation_dataset.zip); that dataset DOI is not used as the paper identifier. The scripts call a separately installed Tigress 3.3.3, load ExeBench from Hugging Face and query the OpenAI API for GPT-4 (gpt-4-32k-0314 in the README examples); requirements.txt pins clang 14.0 and torch 2.4.1 but lists two conflicting versions each of peft and transformers.
metadata_notes_zh: Springer 提交的 Crossref 元数据列出第 22 届 DIMVA（格拉茨，2025 年 7 月 9–11 日）的 Lecture Notes in Computer Science 论文集、第 267–286 页，以及与 PDF 署名顺序一致的九位作者。Springer 页面对自动请求返回浏览器验证，因此本次审阅依据 Crossref，以及 CISPA 存储库记录 10.60882/cispa.32771220.v1 中的开放获取 PDF（CC BY 4.0，2026-06-23 存入）。该记录与 CISPA 出版物页面将作者写作“Antonio Emanuele”和“Sébastian Bardin”；本条目的作者姓名以 Crossref 和 PDF 为准。以 Beste 为作者、标题含 deobfuscation 的 arXiv API 检索没有结果。PDF 链接 DavidBeste/llm-code-deobfuscation，审阅的提交为 00c9c45（2026-02-27），该提交在论文发表后才加入 MIT LICENSE。其 README 链接数据集 10.5281/zenodo.15831457（2025-07-10，CC BY 4.0，17 MB 的 deobfuscation_dataset.zip）；该数据集 DOI 不用作论文标识符。脚本调用另行安装的 Tigress 3.3.3，从 Hugging Face 加载 ExeBench，并通过 OpenAI API 调用 GPT-4（README 示例中为 gpt-4-32k-0314）；requirements.txt 固定了 clang 14.0 与 torch 2.4.1，但 peft 和 transformers 各列出两个相互冲突的版本。

title: Lares: LLM-driven Code Slice Semantic Search for Patch Presence Testing
title_zh: Lares：面向补丁存在性测试的大语言模型驱动代码切片语义搜索
date_basis: Publication year from IEEE's Crossref deposit for the 2025 ASE proceedings. Its only date, 2025-11-16, is the first day of the November 16–20 conference, so no publication month or day is asserted; the arXiv date is not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 出版年份依据 IEEE 为 2025 年 ASE 论文集提交的 Crossref 元数据。其中唯一的日期 2025-11-16 是 11 月 16–20 日会议的首日，因此本条目不主张出版月份或日期，也不以 arXiv 日期替代。
description_en: Lares tests whether a known 1-day vulnerability fix is present in a target binary function without recompiling the project. Its inputs are the target binary, the project source and the patch commit diff. A patch-enhancement step adds data- and control-flow context from the source (via Tree-sitter and Joern) to patches with few changed statements. An LLM then locates the pseudocode slice in the IDA Pro decompilation of the target function that corresponds to each patch slice. Finally, matched slices are normalized into equations and checked for equivalence with the Z3 SMT solver, and the LLM judges the cases Z3 cannot model, deciding whether the function matches the pre-patch or the patched version. On 4,480 test cases from 73 CVEs in OpenSSL, FreeType, tcpdump and libxml2, compiled with GCC 9.4.0 and Clang 6 at O0–O3 for x86, x64 and ARM, the authors report an average F1 of 0.77 on x86 with Claude 3.5 Sonnet, against 0.67 for Robin and 0.68 for PS3, and F1 from 0.71 to 0.77 across five compiler–architecture settings.
description_zh: Lares 在不重新编译项目的情况下，测试目标二进制函数中是否已包含某个已知 1-day 漏洞的修复。其输入为目标二进制、项目源码和补丁提交差异。补丁增强步骤借助 Tree-sitter 与 Joern 从源码中为改动语句较少的补丁补充数据流和控制流上下文。随后由大语言模型在目标函数的 IDA Pro 反编译伪代码中定位与每个补丁切片对应的伪代码切片。最后，匹配的切片被规范化为等式并交由 Z3 SMT 求解器检验等价性，Z3 无法建模的情况由大语言模型判断，从而确定该函数对应修复前版本还是已修复版本。在来自 OpenSSL、FreeType、tcpdump 和 libxml2 中 73 个 CVE 的 4,480 个测试用例上（使用 GCC 9.4.0 和 Clang 6 以 O0–O3 为 x86、x64 与 ARM 编译），作者报告使用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 时 x86 上的平均 F1 为 0.77，Robin 与 PS3 分别为 0.67 和 0.68；在五种编译器—架构组合下 F1 为 0.71 至 0.77。
scope_limitations_en: Lares answers a narrow question: given a specific CVE patch diff, the project source with its history and a candidate function, is that function pre-patch or patched? It needs both the patch diff and the project source, and assumes a separate binary code similarity tool (the paper names BinaryAI as an example) has already located the candidate function. It does not find vulnerable functions, discover new vulnerabilities or diff arbitrary binaries. Its judgments rest on an LLM plus SMT reasoning over decompiler pseudocode: Z3 handles only about 21% of test cases (Z3-only verification has recall 0.221), so most decisions come from the LLM, and the authors list hallucinated comparisons, stealthy edit-type patches and repeated patch statements as failure modes. Results use IDA Pro 7.5 and a commercial model at about $0.20 per case; GPT-3.5-Turbo and DeepSeek-Coder score lower. The evaluation covers four C projects, 73 CVEs and binaries the authors compiled themselves, plus 20 vulnerabilities disclosed after October 2024 (400 cases) to check training-data contamination; firmware, other languages and real vendor builds are not evaluated. The repository has no license file, so no reuse terms are granted.
scope_limitations_zh: Lares 回答的问题范围很窄：给定某个 CVE 的补丁差异、带有版本历史的项目源码以及候选函数，判断该函数属于修复前版本还是已修复版本。它同时需要补丁差异与项目源码，并假定已由另外的二进制代码相似性工具（论文以 BinaryAI 为例）定位候选函数。它不负责发现漏洞函数、挖掘新漏洞或比较任意二进制。其判断依赖大语言模型与基于反编译伪代码的 SMT 推理：Z3 只能处理约 21% 的测试用例（仅用 Z3 验证时召回率为 0.221），多数判断来自大语言模型；作者列出的失败原因包括大语言模型在比较时产生幻觉、隐蔽的修改型补丁以及重复出现的补丁语句。结果使用 IDA Pro 7.5 与商用模型，每个用例约花费 0.20 美元；GPT-3.5-Turbo 与 DeepSeek-Coder 的得分更低。评测覆盖四个 C 项目、73 个 CVE 及作者自行编译的二进制，另以 2024 年 10 月之后披露的 20 个漏洞（400 个用例）检验训练数据污染；未评测固件、其他语言或真实厂商构建。仓库没有许可证文件，因此未授予任何复用条款。
why_fits_en: Adds binary patch presence testing, using LLM-located slices of decompiled pseudocode, to the decompilation and binary-analysis research; it complements the curated BinDiff diffing tool rather than replacing it.
why_fits_zh: 为反编译与二进制分析研究补充二进制补丁存在性测试方向，利用大语言模型在反编译伪代码中定位切片；它与精选目录中的 BinDiff 差异比较工具互补，而非替代。
metadata_notes: IEEE's Crossref deposit gives the 2025 40th IEEE/ACM ASE proceedings, pages 919–931, and the same ten authors in order; the DOI resolves to IEEE Xplore document 11334274. arXiv v1 (2025-11-03) is the only version and carries no venue comment, so it may differ from the IEEE version. The abstract links Siyuan-Li201/Lares; at the 2025-09-16 commit the repository has no license file, and its README gives the inputs as the binary, the project source path and the patch diff file. The repository commits IDA databases for stripped OpenSSL test builds, zipped tcpdump, FreeType and libxml2 sources and patch files, links the evaluation binaries on Google Drive, and requires an IDA Pro 7.5 path and an LLM API key in settings.py; settings.py preconfigures a third-party API relay with an author-supplied test key.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据列出 2025 年第 40 届 IEEE/ACM ASE 论文集、第 919–931 页，以及顺序相同的十位作者；该 DOI 解析至 IEEE Xplore 文档 11334274。arXiv v1（2025-11-03）是唯一版本，且没有发表场所注释，可能与 IEEE 版本存在差异。摘要链接了 Siyuan-Li201/Lares；在 2025-09-16 提交中，仓库没有许可证文件，其 README 将输入列为二进制、项目源码路径和补丁差异文件。仓库提交了已剥离符号的 OpenSSL 测试构建的 IDA 数据库、tcpdump、FreeType 与 libxml2 的源码压缩包及补丁文件，并通过 Google Drive 链接评测用二进制；运行时需要在 settings.py 中设置 IDA Pro 7.5 路径与大语言模型 API 密钥。settings.py 预置了第三方 API 中转服务及作者提供的测试密钥。

title: No More Gotos: Decompilation Using Pattern-Independent Control-Flow Structuring and Semantics-Preserving Transformations
title_zh: 告别 goto：基于模式无关控制流结构化与语义保持变换的反编译
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2015; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 8–11 February 2015 symposium, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2015；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2015 年 2 月 8—11 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: DREAM is a decompiler whose control-flow structuring recovers loops, conditionals and switch statements from a recovered control-flow graph without matching predefined region patterns. For acyclic regions it computes each node's reaching condition, then refines the resulting conditions into if-then-else and switch constructs; cyclic regions are structured as loops whose type and continuation condition are inferred. Semantics-preserving transformations first rewrite cyclic regions with multiple entries or successors into single-entry, single-successor regions, and a Boolean variable keeps a repeated test equivalent when its operands may change. On GNU coreutils the authors report no goto statements, against thousands from Hex-Rays and Phoenix, and more compact code than Hex-Rays for 72.7% of functions and than Phoenix for 98.8% in one-to-one comparisons.
description_zh: DREAM 是一种反编译器，其控制流结构化方法无需匹配预定义的区域模式，即可从恢复出的控制流图中还原循环、条件语句与 switch 语句。对于无环区域，它计算每个节点的可达条件，再将这些条件细化为 if-then-else 与 switch 结构；有环区域被结构化为循环，并推断循环类型及继续条件。语义保持变换先将具有多个入口或多个后继的有环区域改写为单入口、单后继区域；当重复测试的条件中变量可能被修改时，引入布尔变量以保持语义等价。作者在 GNU coreutils 上报告其输出不含 goto 语句，而 Hex-Rays 与 Phoenix 各产生数千个；在一对一比较中，DREAM 有 72.7% 的函数比 Hex-Rays 更紧凑，与 Phoenix 相比该比例为 98.8%。
scope_limitations_en: Correctness was measured on source-level control-flow graphs: the authors extracted CFGs of the preprocessed coreutils 8.22 source with joern, restructured the 1,530 functions joern parsed (208 of 1,738 failed to parse), recompiled and passed the coreutils tests. That experiment checks the structuring algorithm, not end-to-end decompilation of binaries, variable or type recovery. Structuredness and compactness were measured on the coreutils 8.17 binaries from the Phoenix evaluation, using functions decompiled by all three tools, with line counts as the compactness metric. Phoenix was unreleased, so its output came from its authors, and the 2014 Hex-Rays v2.0.0.140605 baseline is long superseded. The malware case studies cover one sample each from ZeusP2P, SpyEye and Cridex and compare against Hex-Rays only. The authors leave open whether more compact code is always easier to understand. The paper links no implementation, and these results do not describe current decompilers.
scope_limitations_zh: 正确性在源码级控制流图上评估：作者使用 joern 从经过预处理的 coreutils 8.22 源码中提取控制流图，对 joern 成功解析的 1,530 个函数重新结构化（1,738 个函数中有 208 个解析失败），重新编译后通过 coreutils 测试。该实验检验的是结构化算法，而不是对二进制的端到端反编译，也不涉及变量或类型恢复。结构化程度与紧凑度在 Phoenix 评测所用的 coreutils 8.17 二进制上测量，只统计三种工具都能反编译的函数，并以代码行数衡量紧凑度。Phoenix 当时尚未发布，其输出由其作者提供；2014 年的 Hex-Rays v2.0.0.140605 基线早已过时。恶意软件案例分析分别覆盖 ZeusP2P、SpyEye 与 Cridex 各一个样本，且只与 Hex-Rays 比较。作者也指出，更紧凑的代码是否总是更易理解仍有待研究。论文没有链接实现，这些结果也不代表当前反编译器的表现。
why_fits_en: Adds control-flow structuring, the decompiler stage that turns a recovered control-flow graph into structured high-level code, beneath the collection's neural and LLM-based decompilation research.
why_fits_zh: 补充控制流结构化这一反编译阶段，即把恢复出的控制流图转换为结构化高级代码，为合集中的神经网络与大语言模型反编译研究提供基础。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the title, the four-author order and year 2015 with no pages; the DOI resolves to the NDSS programme page, which links the 15-page PDF and slides. The PDF footer identifies NDSS ’15, 8–11 February 2015, San Diego, and carries the DOI. Its evaluation section names a supplemental document of decompiled malware listings hosted at the University of Bonn. The paper gives no code or project link, so both stay null.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 给出标题、四位作者顺序及年份 2015，未列页码；DOI 解析至 NDSS 会议议程页面，该页面链接 15 页 PDF 与幻灯片。PDF 页脚标明 NDSS ’15 于 2015 年 2 月 8—11 日在圣迭戈举行，并载有 DOI。评测部分提到一份托管在波恩大学的补充文档，收录反编译后的恶意软件代码清单。论文未提供代码或项目链接，因此两者均为 null。

title: Lifting Optimized Binaries to Canonical Compiler IR via Structure-Aware Retrieval and Iterative Verification
title_zh: 基于结构感知检索与迭代验证将优化二进制提升为规范编译器 IR
date_basis: The official ACL Anthology citation and BibTeX give July 2026. Crossref records only the year; the July 2–7 conference dates printed in the PDF are not treated as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: ACL Anthology 官方引文与 BibTeX 给出 2026 年 7 月。Crossref 仅记录年份；PDF 中印有的 7 月 2–7 日会议日期不作为具体出版日。
description_en: BRIDGE lifts stripped, optimized x86-64 and ARM64 functions, given as llvm-objdump disassembly, to LLVM IR. Its target is the unoptimized IR that a fixed clang -O0 configuration emits for the original source. Offline, it builds a retrieval database from 69,253 ExeBench functions compiled at -O0 to -O3, using LLVM pseudo-probe instrumentation to align assembly fragments with the matching -O0 IR regions. At inference it splits each function's angr-recovered control-flow graph into control-flow segments such as loops and if–else regions, retrieves the three nearest aligned assembly–IR pairs per segment from a FAISS index of Nova-1.3B embeddings, and prompts a hosted general-purpose LLM (DeepSeek-chat) to write the IR. Up to five refinement rounds then feed LLVM verifier and compiler diagnostics and unit-test failures back to the model. On HumanEval-Decompile and MBPP compiled with Clang 19 at -O0 to -O3, average re-executability is 65.2% and 65.4% on x86-64 and 45.6% and 42.1% on ARM64. The rule-based MCTOLL reaches 62.1% and 64.9% on x86-64, and the five directly prompted API LLMs reach at most 21.5%.
description_zh: BRIDGE 将以 llvm-objdump 反汇编形式给出的、已剥离符号并经过优化的 x86-64 与 ARM64 函数提升为 LLVM IR，目标是固定 clang -O0 配置为原始源码生成的未优化 IR。离线阶段，它将 69,253 个 ExeBench 函数分别以 -O0 至 -O3 编译并构建检索数据库，借助 LLVM 伪探针插桩将汇编片段与对应的 -O0 IR 区域对齐。推理时，它把 angr 恢复的函数控制流图划分为循环、if–else 等控制流片段，从基于 Nova-1.3B 嵌入的 FAISS 索引中为每个片段检索三个最相近的已对齐汇编—IR 对，再提示托管的通用大语言模型（DeepSeek-chat）生成 IR。随后最多进行五轮修正，把 LLVM 校验器与编译器诊断信息以及单元测试失败结果反馈给模型。在以 Clang 19 按 -O0 至 -O3 编译的 HumanEval-Decompile 与 MBPP 上，其平均可重新执行率在 x86-64 上为 65.2% 和 65.4%，在 ARM64 上为 45.6% 和 42.1%。基于规则的 MCTOLL 在 x86-64 上为 62.1% 和 64.9%，五个直接提示的 API 大语言模型最高为 21.5%。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation is function-level on short benchmark programs: HumanEval-Decompile and an MBPP subset, with inputs of 2 to 628 assembly instructions, built by the authors with one LLVM/Clang 19 toolchain on Linux. Canonical means matching one fixed clang -O0 configuration, not recovering the original source. Refinement and the re-executability metric both use the unit tests these benchmarks supply; the authors note that such test oracles are rarely available in practical reverse engineering. On x86-64 HumanEval-Decompile, re-executability falls from 65.2% to 60.8% with LLM-generated tests and to 53.5% with no tests. Output still diverges structurally from the reference: average edit similarity stays below 50%, and exact control-flow-graph matches reach 25.9% on that benchmark. The pipeline calls a hosted LLM API, as do the LLM baselines; results are geometric means of five runs and can shift as hosted models change. Forklift and LLM Compiler FTD are excluded from the baselines because the authors treat them as lifting compiler-emitted assembly text, and MCTOLL is compared only on x86-64. Other instruction sets need a rebuilt retrieval database. BRIDGE produces LLVM IR, not C source, so it is not a decompiler to C. The code repository has no license.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测在函数级别、针对短小的基准程序进行：HumanEval-Decompile 与 MBPP 子集，输入为 2 至 628 条汇编指令，由作者在 Linux 上使用单一 LLVM/Clang 19 工具链构建。“规范”指与一个固定的 clang -O0 配置输出一致，而非恢复原始源码。修正过程与可重新执行率指标都使用这些基准自带的单元测试；作者指出，实际逆向工程中很少有这类测试预言。在 x86-64 HumanEval-Decompile 上，改用大语言模型生成的测试时可重新执行率从 65.2% 降至 60.8%，不使用测试时降至 53.5%。输出在结构上仍与参考结果存在差异：平均编辑相似度低于 50%，该基准上控制流图完全匹配率为 25.9%。流水线调用托管的大语言模型 API，大语言模型基线同样如此；结果为五次运行的几何平均值，可能随托管模型变化而改变。作者认为 Forklift 与 LLM Compiler FTD 处理的是编译器生成的汇编文本，因此未将其列为基线；MCTOLL 仅在 x86-64 上参与比较。支持其他指令集需要重建检索数据库。BRIDGE 输出的是 LLVM IR 而非 C 源码，因此不是面向 C 的反编译器。代码仓库没有许可证。
why_fits_en: Adds retrieval-guided LLM lifting of optimized machine code to compiler IR with verifier and test feedback, complementing rule-based lifters such as rev.ng and the assembly-to-C neural decompilation papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助检索引导、并以校验器与测试反馈修正的大语言模型方法，将优化后的机器码提升为编译器 IR，与 rev.ng 等基于规则的提升工具及本节中从汇编生成 C 的神经反编译论文互补。
metadata_notes: The ACL Anthology page and BibTeX give the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the ACL (Volume 1: Long Papers), pages 11498–11516, San Diego, published by the ACL, and the same six authors in order; the Crossref DOI record matches the title, authors and pages and gives only the year. No arXiv version was found by arXiv title and keyword searches, so no arXiv identifier is listed. In §6.1 the text gives 42.1% average re-executability for ARM64 HumanEval-Decompile, while Table 1 lists 45.6% for that benchmark and 42.1% for ARM64 MBPP; this record follows the table. The PDF's online-materials note links Azhu-c/BRIDGE-rag. At the 2026-07-06 commit the repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub reports no license. Its README recommends Python 3.10 and requires a DeepSeek API key, and the LLM wrapper defaults to the deepseek-chat model through an OpenAI-compatible client. requirements.txt pins openai 1.57.0, angr 9.2.162, torch 2.5.1 and faiss-gpu 1.7.2. The knowledge-base configuration expects ExeBench samples under ./data/exebench_samples and a local Nova-1.3b model path; neither is in the repository. Evaluation_datasets holds HumanEval-Decompile and MBPP-subset inputs for both instruction sets with BRIDGE and baseline outputs, and docs/ holds a copy of the paper.
metadata_notes_zh: ACL Anthology 页面与 BibTeX 列出第 64 届 ACL 年会论文集（第 1 卷：长文）、第 11498–11516 页、圣迭戈、由 ACL 出版，作者为顺序相同的六人；Crossref DOI 记录的标题、作者与页码一致，但只给出年份。arXiv 标题与关键词检索均未找到该论文，因此未列出 arXiv 标识符。§6.1 正文称 ARM64 HumanEval-Decompile 的平均可重新执行率为 42.1%，而表 1 列出该基准为 45.6%、ARM64 MBPP 为 42.1%；本条目以表格为准。PDF 的在线材料说明链接 Azhu-c/BRIDGE-rag。在 2026-07-06 提交中，仓库没有 LICENSE 文件，GitHub 也未识别出许可证。README 推荐 Python 3.10 并要求 DeepSeek API 密钥，大语言模型封装代码默认通过 OpenAI 兼容客户端调用 deepseek-chat 模型。requirements.txt 固定 openai 1.57.0、angr 9.2.162、torch 2.5.1 与 faiss-gpu 1.7.2。知识库配置要求在 ./data/exebench_samples 下提供 ExeBench 样本，并指定本地 Nova-1.3b 模型路径；二者都不在仓库中。Evaluation_datasets 包含两种指令集的 HumanEval-Decompile 与 MBPP 子集输入，以及 BRIDGE 和基线的输出；docs/ 中存有论文副本。

title: Polyglot: Automatic Extraction of Protocol Message Format using Dynamic Binary Analysis
title_zh: Polyglot：基于动态二进制分析的协议报文格式自动提取
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records both print and online publication on 2007-10-28. This entry uses that date, not the October 29–November 2 conference dates printed on the paper.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2007-10-28。本条目采用该日期，而非论文所印 10 月 29 日至 11 月 2 日的会议日期。
description_en: Polyglot infers the format of a message that a program receives by monitoring how the program binary processes it, an approach the authors call shadowing. An execution monitor taints network input and records an instruction trace; offline analyses then find direction fields, such as length and pointer fields, from tainted memory accesses and loop conditions, separators from comparisons between tainted bytes and constants, multi-byte fixed-length fields from how instructions group input bytes, and protocol keywords from successful comparisons. It works on stripped IA-32 binaries without source code or debugging information.
description_zh: Polyglot 通过监测程序二进制如何处理接收到的报文来推断其格式，作者称这一方法为“影随”（shadowing）。执行监控器对网络输入施加污点标记并记录指令轨迹；离线分析再依据受污点数据参与的内存访问与循环条件识别长度字段、指针字段等指向字段，依据受污点字节与常量之间的比较识别分隔符，依据指令如何组合输入字节识别多字节定长字段，并依据成功的比较提取协议关键字。该方法适用于剥离符号的 IA-32 二进制，无需源码或调试信息。
scope_limitations_en: It extracts the format of one received message at a time and only of messages given to the analysis; messages that never appear stay unknown, and messages the program sends are not analyzed. It does not infer the protocol state machine. The evaluation covers eleven 2007-era programs implementing DNS, HTTP, IRC, ICQ and Samba, mostly Windows servers plus an ICQ client and a Linux Samba server, with one representative message per protocol, compared against Wireshark 0.99.5 dissectors. Field formats omit data types and encodings, analysis is at byte granularity so sub-byte flags are missed, and field semantics are limited to direction fields; timestamps, checksums and addresses are not identified. Message boundaries rely on assuming a synchronous protocol, unused fixed-length fields after an ICQ length field were merged into the variable-length field, and the authors state that the techniques are not fully resistant against obfuscation.
scope_limitations_zh: 方法每次提取一条接收报文的格式，且只覆盖提供给分析的报文；从未出现的报文仍然未知，程序发送的报文也不在分析范围内。它不推断协议状态机。评测覆盖 11 个 2007 年前后的程序，实现 DNS、HTTP、IRC、ICQ 与 Samba 五种协议，以 Windows 服务端为主，另含一个 ICQ 客户端和一个 Linux 上的 Samba 服务端；每种协议选取一条代表性报文，并与 Wireshark 0.99.5 的解析器对比。字段格式不包括数据类型与编码；分析以字节为粒度，因此会遗漏不足一字节的标志位；字段语义仅限于指向字段，不识别时间戳、校验和或地址。报文边界依赖同步协议这一假设；ICQ 长度字段之后未使用的定长字段被并入了变长字段。作者也说明这些技术尚不能完全抵御混淆。
why_fits_en: Adds binary-analysis inference of protocol message formats from a running implementation, the line of work that the collection's BinPRE record continues, complementing its trace-based protocol research.
why_fits_zh: 补充依据运行中的实现、以二进制分析推断协议报文格式的研究，合集中的 BinPRE 条目延续了这一方向，并与合集里基于流量的协议研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the title as “Polyglot” with the lowercase subtitle “automatic extraction of protocol message format using dynamic binary analysis”, the four-author order and pages 317–329; this entry follows the capitalization printed on the paper. The 13-page ACM-formatted copy hosted on Dawn Song’s Berkeley site carries the CCS’07 copyright notice and page numbers from 317. A 15-page author version with appendices is hosted at UC Riverside and says the definitive version was published at CCS’07. The execution monitor is cited as the authors’ earlier work and is not released with the paper. The paper gives no code or project link, so both stay null.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 将标题记为“Polyglot”，副标题为小写的“automatic extraction of protocol message format using dynamic binary analysis”，并记录四位作者顺序及页码 317–329；本条目采用论文所印的大小写。托管在 Dawn Song 伯克利网站上的 13 页 ACM 排版副本载有 CCS’07 版权声明，页码从 317 起。加州大学河滨分校托管有一份含附录的 15 页作者版本，注明正式版本发表于 CCS’07。执行监控器引自作者此前的工作，并未随论文发布。论文未提供代码或项目链接，因此两者均为 null。

title: Avatar: A Framework to Support Dynamic Security Analysis of Embedded Systems’ Firmwares
title_zh: Avatar：支持嵌入式系统固件动态安全分析的框架
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2014; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 23–26 February 2014 symposium, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2014；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2014 年 2 月 23—26 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: Avatar runs embedded firmware in an instrumented emulator, S²E on QEMU, while forwarding memory-mapped I/O to the real device and injecting the device's interrupts back into the emulator, so firmware that depends on undocumented peripherals can still be analyzed dynamically. The device is reached through JTAG via OpenOCD or through a small debugging stub over a serial line. Because forwarding every access over a 38400-baud serial link is very slow, about five instructions per second in one of the authors' measurements, Avatar also keeps memory that never behaves like I/O local to the emulator, migrates selected code to run natively on the device, and switches state between the two. With S²E's selective symbolic execution, the authors probe a hard-disk mask-ROM bootloader for hidden commands, an IEEE 802.15.4 sensor node for an injected overflow, and the SMS decoding routines of a GSM feature phone.
description_zh: Avatar 在插桩模拟器（基于 QEMU 的 S²E）中运行嵌入式固件，同时把内存映射 I/O 转发给真实设备，并将设备产生的中断注入回模拟器，使依赖无文档外设的固件仍可接受动态分析。框架经由 OpenOCD 通过 JTAG 访问设备，或通过串口上的小型调试桩访问。由于经 38400 波特串口转发每次访问非常缓慢（作者的一次测量中约为每秒五条指令），Avatar 还会把从不表现为 I/O 的内存保留在模拟器本地，将选定代码迁移到设备上原生运行，并在两者之间切换状态。结合 S²E 的选择性符号执行，作者检查了硬盘掩膜 ROM 引导程序中的隐藏命令、一个 IEEE 802.15.4 传感器节点中人为注入的溢出，以及一部 GSM 功能手机的短信解码例程。
scope_limitations_en: Avatar needs the physical device and a working debug channel or an injectable stub; it does not model peripherals, so it is not standalone rehosting. The three case studies are all ARM devices (a hard disk with an ARM966 core, a Redwire Econotag and a Motorola C118 phone), and each needed manual work to choose hook points and code regions. Full-separation mode is too slow for time-critical code such as DRAM initialization, and the authors report that memory changed by DMA, or by code migrated to the device, is hard to keep synchronized with the emulator. The sensor-node vulnerability was artificially inserted into a demonstration program, the bootloader study confirmed documented commands rather than finding a backdoor, and the phone's GSM stack was too complex for symbolic execution: 42 subroutines were explored without an exploitable condition before state explosion. These are 2014 results on an S²E port the authors extended for ARM.
scope_limitations_zh: Avatar 需要实体设备以及可用的调试通道或可注入的调试桩；它不对外设建模，因此不是独立的固件重托管。三个案例均为 ARM 设备（采用 ARM966 内核的硬盘、Redwire Econotag 与 Motorola C118 手机），每个案例都需人工选择挂钩点与代码区域。完全分离模式过慢，无法处理 DRAM 初始化等时间敏感代码；作者也指出，由 DMA 或迁移到设备上运行的代码修改的内存，难以与模拟器保持同步。传感器节点中的漏洞是人为插入演示程序的，引导程序研究确认的是已有文档的命令，而非发现后门；手机的 GSM 协议栈对符号执行而言过于复杂，在状态爆炸前探索了 42 个子程序，未发现可利用条件。这些是 2014 年的结果，所用 S²E 由作者扩展了 ARM 支持。
why_fits_en: Adds hardware-in-the-loop firmware analysis, which forwards emulator I/O to the real device, alongside the collection's emulation-based firmware rehosting research.
why_fits_zh: 补充将模拟器 I/O 转发至真实设备的硬件在环固件分析方法，与合集中基于仿真的固件重托管研究互为补充。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the title, the four-author order and year 2014 with no pages. The DOI’s registered target, a /ndss2014/programme/ URL ending in an encoded apostrophe, returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-19; the working NDSS programme page links the 16-page PDF and slides. The PDF footer identifies NDSS ’14, 23–26 February 2014, San Diego, with ISBN 1-891562-35-5, but its DOI line is the placeholder “http://dx.doi.org/OETT”; the Crossref DOI is recorded here. The paper gives the framework’s location as the EURECOM project page, which now carries a deprecation notice pointing to the successor Avatar² (avatartwo/avatar2), a later, separate project. That page links the Python core, whose eurecom-s3 URL redirects to avatarone/avatar-python; the 2016-10-18 commit is Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2013–2014 Institut Eurecom) and points to separate repositories for the NDSS’14 samples, the patched S²E and OpenOCD.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 给出标题、四位作者顺序及年份 2014，未列页码。DOI 登记的目标地址是一个以编码撇号结尾的 /ndss2014/programme/ 链接，2026-10-19 访问时返回 HTTP 404；可访问的 NDSS 会议议程页面链接 16 页 PDF 与幻灯片。PDF 页脚标明 NDSS ’14 于 2014 年 2 月 23—26 日在圣迭戈举行，载有 ISBN 1-891562-35-5，但 DOI 一行为占位符“http://dx.doi.org/OETT”；本条目记录的是 Crossref DOI。论文指明框架位于 EURECOM 项目页面，该页面现已注明项目停止维护，并指向后续项目 Avatar²（avatartwo/avatar2）；后者是较晚的独立项目。该页面链接 Python 核心库，其 eurecom-s3 地址重定向至 avatarone/avatar-python；2016-10-18 提交采用 Apache-2.0 许可（版权归 Institut Eurecom 2013–2014），并指向另行存放的 NDSS’14 示例、修改版 S²E 与 OpenOCD 仓库。

title: Tupni: Automatic Reverse Engineering of Input Formats
title_zh: Tupni：输入格式的自动逆向工程
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2008-10-27, and an archived copy of the ACM article page shows the same date. The CCS meeting dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将印刷与在线出版日期均记为 2008-10-27，ACM 论文页面的存档副本显示相同日期。本条目不以 CCS 会议日期替代。
description_en: Tupni infers an input format from an execution trace of an x86 program parsing one input, using byte-level dynamic taint tracking. It segments the input into fields from the instructions that operate on tainted bytes, finds record sequences from parsing loops, groups records into types by the code that handles them, and emits an enhanced BNF grammar with length, value and some inter-message constraints. Grammars from several inputs can be merged into a more complete specification. The evaluation covers five file formats (WMF, BMP, JPG, PNG, TIF) and five network protocols (DNS, RPC, TFTP, HTTP, FTP), and the output is used for zero-day vulnerability signature generation with ShieldGen.
description_zh: Tupni 利用字节级动态污点跟踪，从 x86 程序解析单个输入时的执行轨迹推断输入格式。它依据处理污点字节的指令把输入切分为字段，从解析循环中找出记录序列，按处理代码将记录归为不同记录类型，并输出带有长度、取值及部分跨报文约束的增强 BNF 文法。多个输入得到的文法可以合并为更完整的规范。评测覆盖五种文件格式（WMF、BMP、JPG、PNG、TIF）和五种网络协议（DNS、RPC、TFTP、HTTP、FTP），并将输出用于 ShieldGen 的零日漏洞签名生成。
scope_limitations_en: Tupni needs the parsing program and a recorded execution trace for every input; it does not work from captured traffic or files alone. The prototype combined iDNA traces with a re-implemented Vigilante taint engine, and the traces came from Windows XP SP2 binaries such as gdi32.dll, gdiplus.dll, nslookup.exe and IIS components. Single-input accuracy uses one input per format, scored by the authors against published specifications; WMF, DNS and HTTP guided the design, compressed image data was skipped in favor of container structure, and no quantitative baseline was run because earlier tools were unavailable. All record sequences were found, with some false-positive sequences, and 889 of 1,551 PNG fields were misidentified because the program ignored repeated chunk data. Coverage depends on input diversity, constraints can be specific to the samples, byte-level taint handles fields that do not align with bytes poorly (including many encrypted or compressed formats), and formats beyond regular expressions are out of scope. Inter-message constraints were evaluated only for TFTP, and multi-input aggregation only on 150 WMF files.
scope_limitations_zh: Tupni 需要解析程序以及每个输入对应的已记录执行轨迹，不能仅凭捕获的流量或文件工作。原型将 iDNA 轨迹与重新实现的 Vigilante 污点引擎结合，轨迹来自 Windows XP SP2 上的二进制，例如 gdi32.dll、gdiplus.dll、nslookup.exe 及 IIS 组件。单输入准确性评测每种格式只用一个输入，由作者对照公开规范判定；WMF、DNS 与 HTTP 用于指导设计，压缩图像数据被跳过，只分析容器结构；由于早期工具不可获得，未运行定量基线。所有记录序列均被识别，但存在部分误报序列；PNG 的 1,551 个字段中有 889 个识别错误，原因是程序忽略了重复数据块的内容。覆盖范围取决于输入的多样性，约束可能只适用于样本；字节级污点难以处理与字节边界不对齐的字段（包括许多加密或压缩格式），超出正则表达式描述能力的格式也不在适用范围内。跨报文约束只在 TFTP 上评估，多输入聚合只在 150 个 WMF 文件上评估。
why_fits_en: Adds a classic execution-based input-format inference method that recovers record sequences, record types and field constraints, complementing the collection’s traffic-based and binary-assisted protocol-format research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种经典的基于执行的输入格式推断方法，可恢复记录序列、记录类型与字段约束，与合集中基于流量及借助二进制的协议格式研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the archived ACM page give the five authors in this order, CCS ’08 pages 391–402, and the main title “Tupni” with subtitle “automatic reverse engineering of input formats”; the record uses the paper’s capitalization. The 12-page copy on the Microsoft Research publication page spells the fifth author “Luiz Irun-Briz”; the record follows the ACM and Crossref spelling. The paper states that the prototype has 14,000 lines of C++ and 4,100 lines of Perl outside Vigilante and iDNA, and it links no code or data; the Windows test binaries and the 150 WMF files from an internal Microsoft repository are not public artifacts.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 ACM 页面存档按此顺序列出五位作者，记载 CCS ’08 第 391–402 页，主标题为“Tupni”，副标题为“automatic reverse engineering of input formats”；本条目采用论文中的大小写。Microsoft Research 出版物页面提供的 12 页副本将第五位作者写作“Luiz Irun-Briz”；本条目沿用 ACM 与 Crossref 的拼写。论文说明，不计 Vigilante 与 iDNA，原型含 14,000 行 C++ 与 4,100 行 Perl；论文未链接代码或数据，Windows 测试二进制及来自 Microsoft 内部库的 150 个 WMF 文件也不是公开产物。

title: Prospex: Protocol Specification Extraction
title_zh: Prospex：协议规范提取
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit and an archived copy of the IEEE Xplore page give May 2009, represented at month precision. The symposium dates are not substituted for a publication day.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据及 IEEE Xplore 页面存档副本均给出 2009 年 5 月，本条目按月精度记录，不以研讨会日期替代具体出版日。
description_en: Prospex infers message formats and a protocol state machine from execution traces of a Linux server handling client sessions. Dynamic taint analysis splits each session into messages and recovers their formats; messages are then clustered into types by input-format, execution and server-impact similarity, such as the system calls, outputs and file paths a message triggers. The observed type sequences form an augmented prefix tree acceptor, which prerequisite and end-state heuristics label before Exbar computes a minimal consistent automaton. The resulting specifications are translated for the Peach fuzzer to reach later protocol states. The evaluation covers the Agobot command-and-control protocol, SMTP on Sendmail, SMB on Samba and SIP on Asterisk.
description_zh: Prospex 从 Linux 服务端处理客户端会话时的执行轨迹推断报文格式与协议状态机。它利用动态污点分析把每个会话切分为报文并恢复其格式；再依据输入格式、执行过程及对服务端影响（如报文触发的系统调用、输出与文件路径）的相似度将报文聚类为不同类型。观察到的类型序列构成增广前缀树接受器，先由前置条件与结束状态启发式标注，再用 Exbar 求出一致的最小自动机。所得规范被转换供 Peach 模糊测试器使用，以到达协议的后续状态。评测覆盖 Agobot 命令与控制协议、Sendmail 上的 SMTP、Samba 上的 SMB 以及 Asterisk 上的 SIP。
scope_limitations_en: Prospex traces one endpoint, the server, and its taint tool runs only on Linux, so only Linux server binaries were analyzed. It cannot handle encrypted traffic: TLS sessions made up the 6.5% of 31,903 Postfix sessions that the inferred SMTP specification could not parse. Training sets are small (for example 16 SMTP and 31 SMB sessions), and the inferred machines cover only behavior exercised during training; two SMB states are artifacts of limited training variety, and SMB recall against the reference automaton is 0.58. Reference state machines were built manually by the authors, and soundness was checked with 50,000 random walks per protocol; the sk-strings and beams baselines are state-machine learners, not full protocol reverse-engineering systems. The fuzzing case studies found previously known issues in an older Samba release and in Asterisk, not new vulnerabilities in the latest Samba or Windows XP SMB versions tested.
scope_limitations_zh: Prospex 只跟踪服务端一侧，其污点工具仅在 Linux 上运行，因此只分析了 Linux 服务端二进制。它无法处理加密流量：在 31,903 个 Postfix 会话中，推断的 SMTP 规范无法解析的 6.5% 均为 TLS 会话。训练集规模较小（例如 16 个 SMTP 会话、31 个 SMB 会话），推断出的状态机只覆盖训练中出现过的行为；两个 SMB 状态是训练数据多样性不足造成的伪状态，SMB 相对参考自动机的召回率为 0.58。参考状态机由作者手工构建，可靠性检验对每种协议进行 50,000 次随机游走；sk-strings 与 beams 基线是状态机学习算法，并非完整的协议逆向系统。模糊测试案例发现的是旧版 Samba 与 Asterisk 中已知的问题，而非所测最新 Samba 或 Windows XP SMB 实现中的新漏洞。
why_fits_en: Adds an execution-based method that extracts both message formats and protocol state machines from observed sessions, complementing the collection’s active state-machine learning and format-only protocol inference research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种基于执行、可从观察到的会话中同时提取报文格式与协议状态机的方法，与合集中的主动状态机学习及仅推断格式的协议研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the archived IEEE Xplore page agree on the four authors, the 2009 30th IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy proceedings, pages 110–125 and May 2009; Xplore does not mark the paper open access. The PDF is the 16-page copy on Christopher Kruegel’s UCSB site, with the same title and author order; its file metadata shows a September 2008 creation date and a 2009 IEEE PDF eXpress certification, and IEEE Xplore holds the version of record. The paper reports that its Peach statefulness extensions were integrated into Peach release 2.2 but links no Prospex code, traces or reference state machines.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 IEEE Xplore 页面存档在四位作者、2009 年第 30 届 IEEE 安全与隐私研讨会论文集、第 110–125 页及 2009 年 5 月等信息上一致；Xplore 未将该论文标为开放获取。PDF 为 Christopher Kruegel 在 UCSB 网站上提供的 16 页副本，标题与作者顺序相同；其文件元数据显示创建于 2008 年 9 月，并带有 2009 年的 IEEE PDF eXpress 认证信息，版本记录以 IEEE Xplore 为准。论文称其为 Peach 增加的状态支持已并入 Peach 2.2 版，但未链接 Prospex 代码、轨迹或参考状态机。

title: SoK: Enabling Security Analyses of Embedded Systems via Rehosting
title_zh: SoK：通过重托管实现嵌入式系统的安全分析
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print-publication date; the online-publication date is recorded separately in metadata notes. The June 7–11 conference dates are not used.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期；在线出版日期在元数据说明中单独记录。本条目不采用 6 月 7—11 日的会议日期。
description_en: Systematizes rehosting: moving embedded firmware from its physical hardware into a virtual environment that models enough hardware behavior for dynamic analysis such as fuzzing and symbolic execution. The authors measure why whole-system emulation does not scale using 2,574 hardware configurations, 1,956 device tree blobs from Linux 5.11.4 and 618 vendor ARM Cortex SVD files. They compare corpus CPU models with QEMU support, count unique peripherals, use driver source lines as a complexity proxy, and run a Monte Carlo simulation of adding peripheral models SoC by SoC. Supporting a random 10% of the SoCs would need about 3,947 peripherals for the Linux corpus and 1,730 for the ARM Cortex corpus, against 1,083 implemented in QEMU 5.2. The paper then classifies prior systems by how they emulate, replace, symbolically model, pass through to hardware or leave each layer unmodified, describes an iterative rehosting process with fidelity evaluation, and sets out open problems.
description_zh: 系统化梳理“重托管”：把嵌入式固件从实体硬件迁移到虚拟环境中，该环境对硬件行为的建模足以支持模糊测试、符号执行等动态分析。作者以 2,574 个硬件配置衡量全系统仿真为何难以扩展，包括来自 Linux 5.11.4 的 1,956 个设备树二进制文件（DTB）和 618 个厂商提供的 ARM Cortex SVD 文件。他们将语料中的 CPU 型号与 QEMU 的支持情况对比，统计不同外设的数量，以驱动源码行数作为复杂度的近似指标，并以蒙特卡罗模拟逐个 SoC 添加外设模型。若要支持随机抽取的 10% SoC，Linux 语料约需 3,947 种外设，ARM Cortex 语料约需 1,730 种，而 QEMU 5.2 实现的外设为 1,083 种。论文随后按各系统在每一层采用仿真、替换、符号建模、透传至硬件或保持不变的方式对既有工作分类，描述含保真度评估的迭代式重托管流程，并列出开放问题。
scope_limitations_en: This is a systematization with a measurement study, not a new rehosting tool. The measurements use hardware descriptions rather than firmware images: device trees cover Linux-based (Type-1) systems and SVD files cover only ARM Cortex hardware, and only architectures or vendors with ten or more samples are counted. Driver source lines are an explicitly rough proxy for the effort of modeling a peripheral, and closed-source drivers are assigned an architecture average. The conclusion that manually written hardware emulators will not scale rests on these proxies and on QEMU 5.2 and OVPsim as of early 2021. The authors note that rehosting fidelity lacks a formal definition and that no large-scale fidelity evaluations exist, so the taxonomy compares approaches qualitatively; a concurrent survey covers fidelity in more detail.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一项结合测量研究的系统化综述，并非新的重托管工具。测量基于硬件描述而非固件镜像：设备树覆盖基于 Linux 的（Type-1）系统，SVD 文件只涵盖 ARM Cortex 硬件，且只统计样本数不少于十个的架构或厂商。驱动源码行数被明确作为外设建模工作量的粗略近似，闭源驱动则按所属架构的平均值计。“手工编写的硬件仿真器难以扩展”这一结论依赖于这些近似指标以及 2021 年初的 QEMU 5.2 与 OVPsim。作者指出，重托管保真度缺乏正式定义，也没有大规模保真度评估，因此分类法只对各方法作定性比较；同期的另一篇综述对保真度有更详细的讨论。
why_fits_en: Adds a field-defining survey of firmware rehosting, giving the collection's individual rehosting systems such as Firmadyne, FirmAE and HALucinator a shared vocabulary and taxonomy.
why_fits_zh: 补充一篇界定固件重托管领域的综述，为合集中的 Firmadyne、FirmAE、HALucinator 等具体重托管系统提供共同的术语与分类框架。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata records print publication on 2021-05-24 and online publication on 2021-06-04, pages 687–701, with the twelve-author order shown here. The paper is published under CC BY 4.0. dl.acm.org refused automated requests during this review, so the 15-page ACM PDF was read from a Wayback Machine capture of its own URL. Footnote 3 links igloo-re/rehosting_sok, which now redirects to rehosting/rehosting_sok. The reviewed 2021-06-08 commit is MIT-licensed and builds an Ubuntu 20.04 Docker image with QEMU 5.2.0, generates the 1,956 DTBs and prints the data behind Tables 1–3 and the Monte Carlo results. Its SVD analysis clones the current posborne/cmsis-svd repository, and the README warns that results change slightly as that repository grows. The repository reproduces these measurements; it is not a rehosting tool.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 元数据记载印刷出版于 2021-05-24，在线出版于 2021-06-04，页码为 687–701，十二位作者顺序如本条目所列。论文以 CC BY 4.0 许可发布。审阅期间 dl.acm.org 拒绝自动请求，因此 15 页 ACM PDF 依据 Wayback Machine 对其原地址的存档副本阅读。脚注 3 链接 igloo-re/rehosting_sok，现已重定向至 rehosting/rehosting_sok。所审阅的 2021-06-08 提交采用 MIT 许可，构建基于 Ubuntu 20.04、含 QEMU 5.2.0 的 Docker 镜像，生成 1,956 个 DTB，并输出表 1–3 与蒙特卡罗模拟结果所依据的数据。其 SVD 分析会克隆最新的 posborne/cmsis-svd 仓库，README 提醒结果会随该仓库更新而略有变化。该仓库用于复现上述测量，并非重托管工具。

title: Towards Automated Protocol Reverse Engineering Using Semantic Information
title_zh: 利用语义信息实现自动化协议逆向工程
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2014-06-04. The HAL record gives the same date as the first day of the June 4–6 conference; the conference dates alone are not used as the basis.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将印刷与在线出版日期均记为 2014-06-04。HAL 记录给出相同日期，即 6 月 4–6 日会议的首日；本条目并非仅依据会议日期。
description_en: Infers the vocabulary of an undocumented protocol, its message types and formats, from communication traces. The approach uses contextual information embedded in the messages to improve message clustering and the identification of field boundaries; the HAL record lists contextual clustering and semantic sequence alignment as keywords. The authors motivate the work with parsers and traffic generators for network security products, and compare it with their own reimplementations of ASAP, Discoverer and ScriptGen. The first two authors are the authors of Netzob, the open-source protocol reverse-engineering framework.
description_zh: 从通信流量记录中推断未公开协议的词汇，即报文类型与格式。该方法利用报文中嵌入的上下文信息改进报文聚类和字段边界识别；HAL 记录列出的关键词为上下文聚类与语义序列比对。作者以为网络安全产品构建解析器与流量生成器作为研究动机，并与自行重新实现的 ASAP、Discoverer 和 ScriptGen 进行比较。前两位作者也是开源协议逆向框架 Netzob 的作者。
scope_limitations_en: The method starts from captured traces and addresses the protocol’s vocabulary, not its grammar or state machine; contextual hints help only where such information appears in the observed messages. Baseline results come from the authors’ reimplementations of ASAP, Discoverer and ScriptGen rather than the original tools. The comparative study and its results are the authors’ 2014 evaluation. Netzob has changed substantially since 2014.
scope_limitations_zh: 该方法以捕获的流量记录为起点，处理的是协议词汇，而非其语法或状态机；只有当观察到的报文中出现上下文信息时，这些线索才有帮助。基线结果来自作者对 ASAP、Discoverer 和 ScriptGen 的重新实现，而非原始工具。比较研究及其结果属于作者 2014 年的评测。Netzob 自 2014 年以来变化很大。
why_fits_en: Documents the trace-based inference approach from the authors of Netzob, already curated as a protocol-analysis tool, and complements the collection’s other traffic-based and executable-assisted format inference research.
why_fits_zh: 记录 Netzob 作者提出的基于流量记录的推断方法（Netzob 已作为协议分析工具收录），并与合集中其他基于流量及借助可执行程序的格式推断研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref, the archived ACM page and the HAL record agree on the three authors, the ASIA CCS ’14 proceedings and pages 51–62; the ACM metadata uses sentence case, and the record follows the capitalization in the HAL record. Crossref lists this paper under DOI 10.1145/2590296.2590346; the neighboring 10.1145/2590296.2590338 is a different paper. The HAL record has no attached file. The code link is the authors’ Netzob repository, whose AUTHORS.txt names Georges Bossert and Frédéric Guihéry; its 2023 head ships the GPL-3.0 license text.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref、ACM 页面存档与 HAL 记录在三位作者、ASIA CCS ’14 论文集及第 51–62 页上一致；ACM 元数据采用句首大写，本条目沿用 HAL 记录中的大小写。Crossref 将本论文登记为 DOI 10.1145/2590296.2590346；相邻的 10.1145/2590296.2590338 是另一篇论文。HAL 记录未附文件。代码链接指向作者的 Netzob 仓库，其 AUTHORS.txt 列出 Georges Bossert 与 Frédéric Guihéry；2023 年最新提交附有 GPL-3.0 许可文本。

title: How far we have come: testing decompilation correctness of C decompilers
title_zh: 我们走了多远：C 反编译器反编译正确性测试
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2020-07-18, and the ACM article page gives the same publication date. This entry uses that date, not the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2020-07-18，ACM 论文页面给出的出版日期相同。本条目采用该日期，而非会议日程。
description_en: Tests whether C decompilers preserve program behavior. The authors' DecFuzzer compiles a Csmith-generated program, decompiles the executable, substitutes the decompiled function for the original in the source, recompiles, and compares the two programs' outputs; equivalence-modulo-inputs (EMI) mutation then derives further test programs from the seeds. Across four popular decompilers the authors report 1,423 inputs that trigger decompilation errors and, after manual analysis, 13 bugs in two open-source decompilers. They argue that modern decompilers are making real progress on functional correctness, while type recovery and optimization still hinder accurate output.
description_zh: 测试 C 反编译器能否保持程序行为。作者的 DecFuzzer 编译由 Csmith 生成的程序，反编译所得可执行文件，在源码中用反编译出的函数替换原函数后重新编译，并比较两个程序的输出；随后通过模输入等价（EMI）变异，从种子程序派生更多测试程序。作者在四种常用反编译器上报告了 1,423 个触发反编译错误的输入，并经人工分析在两个开源反编译器中确认 13 个缺陷。他们认为现代反编译器在功能正确性上取得了切实进展，但类型恢复与优化仍妨碍其输出准确的代码。
scope_limitations_en: The tests use small generated programs, not real-world binaries, and a failed recompilation is recorded separately from a behavioral mismatch. In the authors' artifact, test programs are compiled as 32-bit x86 with GCC at -O0, and Csmith is restricted to a single function without arrays, structs, unions, pointers or long long types, so optimized code and richer data types are outside that configuration. The four decompilers (IDA Pro, JEB3, RetDec and Radare2's r2ghidra plugin) were tested as of 2020; the error counts and bugs describe those releases, not current ones. IDA Pro and JEB3 are commercial and not included in the artifact, which sets up only RetDec and r2ghidra.
scope_limitations_zh: 测试使用规模较小的生成程序，而非真实二进制；重新编译失败与行为不一致分开记录。在作者的产物中，测试程序以 GCC 在 -O0 下编译为 32 位 x86 代码，Csmith 被限制为生成单个函数，且不含数组、结构体、联合体、指针或 long long 类型，因此优化代码和更丰富的数据类型不在该配置范围内。四种反编译器（IDA Pro、JEB3、RetDec 及 Radare2 的 r2ghidra 插件）均按 2020 年时的版本测试；错误数量与缺陷针对这些版本，而非当前版本。IDA Pro 与 JEB3 属商业软件，未包含在产物中，产物只配置了 RetDec 与 r2ghidra。
why_fits_en: Adds differential testing of decompiler correctness through recompilation, complementing the collection's decompiler benchmarks, such as DecompileBench, that evaluate output on real functions.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助重新编译对反编译器正确性开展差分测试的研究，与 DecompileBench 等在真实函数上评估输出的反编译基准互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the ACM page give the two-author order, pages 475–487 and the title in the lowercase form used here; the conference programme and the artifact README capitalize it “How Far We Have Come: Testing Decompilation Correctness of C Decompilers”. dl.acm.org refused automated requests during this review and no other copy of the paper text was found, so the method and results above follow the abstract on the ISSTA 2020 programme page, the ACM page captured by the Wayback Machine (abstract, reference list and an Artifacts Evaluated – Functional badge) and the artifact itself. Reference [9] of the paper links monkbai/DecFuzzer. The reviewed 2020-04-23 commit is the ISSTA’20 artifact-evaluation package: it targets Ubuntu 18.04, needs MySQL for EMI mutation, a prebuilt RetDec v4.0 and Radare2 with r2ghidra, and links seed and result data on Dropbox. The repository has no license file and GitHub reports none.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 ACM 页面给出两位作者的顺序、页码 475–487，以及本条目采用的小写标题；会议日程页与产物 README 将其写作“How Far We Have Come: Testing Decompilation Correctness of C Decompilers”。审阅期间 dl.acm.org 拒绝自动请求，也未找到论文正文的其他副本，因此上述方法与结果依据 ISSTA 2020 日程页上的摘要、Wayback Machine 存档的 ACM 页面（摘要、参考文献列表及“Artifacts Evaluated – Functional”徽章）以及产物本身。论文参考文献 [9] 链接 monkbai/DecFuzzer。所审阅的 2020-04-23 提交是 ISSTA’20 产物评审包：面向 Ubuntu 18.04，EMI 变异需要 MySQL，还需预编译的 RetDec v4.0 以及带 r2ghidra 的 Radare2，并在 Dropbox 上提供种子与结果数据的链接。仓库没有许可证文件，GitHub 也未识别出许可证。

title: rev.ng: A Unified Binary Analysis Framework to Recover CFGs and Function Boundaries
title_zh: rev.ng：用于恢复控制流图与函数边界的统一二进制分析框架
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records both print and online publication on 2017-02-05. This entry uses that date, not the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2017-02-05。本条目采用该日期，而非会议日程。
description_en: rev.ng lifts binaries to LLVM IR through QEMU's tiny code generator, so one front end covers every architecture QEMU supports and the output is compilable IR. On that IR the authors build architecture-independent analyses that recover a program's control-flow graph and function boundaries without symbols or debugging information. A value-range analysis (OSRA) bounds indirect jump targets such as switch tables, and further analyses handle predicated instructions, noreturn functions, tail calls and context-dependent control flow. On coreutils built for MIPS, ARM and x86-64 with GCC and clang at -O2, -O3 and -Os, its function-boundary accuracy is close to IDA Pro and better than BAP/ByteWeight and angr.
description_zh: rev.ng 借助 QEMU 的微型代码生成器（TCG）将二进制提升为 LLVM 中间表示，因此同一前端可覆盖 QEMU 支持的全部架构，输出的是可编译的中间表示。作者在此基础上构建与架构无关的分析，在没有符号或调试信息的情况下恢复程序的控制流图与函数边界。一种值域分析（OSRA）用于限定 switch 跳转表等间接跳转的目标，其他分析则处理谓词执行指令、noreturn 函数、尾调用以及依赖上下文的控制流。在为 MIPS、ARM 与 x86-64 构建、分别使用 GCC 与 clang 以 -O2、-O3 和 -Os 编译的 coreutils 上，其函数边界恢复的准确度接近 IDA Pro，并优于 BAP/ByteWeight 与 angr。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation measures function boundaries, not the CFG directly: the authors could not collect CFG ground truth from GCC or LLVM, so boundary accuracy (Jaccard index against ELF function symbols) is presented as a lower bound on CFG quality. It covers 105 statically linked, stripped coreutils programs for Linux on three of the architectures QEMU supports; the other architectures and dynamically linked binaries were not evaluated. The prototype misses some nested-switch jump tables on x86-64 and jump-table addresses spilled to the stack on MIPS, needs more memory than the other tools on ARM and MIPS, and does not report dead code that IDA Pro finds through prologue heuristics, which the authors treat as a design choice. Baselines are IDA Pro 6.6, BAP 0.9.9 and angr as of November 2016. The paper does not decompile to C.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测衡量的是函数边界，而非直接衡量控制流图：作者无法从 GCC 或 LLVM 获取控制流图的真实标签，因此以函数边界准确度（相对 ELF 函数符号的 Jaccard 指数）作为控制流图质量的下界。评测覆盖为 Linux 构建、静态链接并去除调试信息的 105 个 coreutils 程序，只涉及 QEMU 所支持架构中的三种；其他架构及动态链接二进制未经评测。原型会遗漏 x86-64 上部分嵌套 switch 的跳转表，以及 MIPS 上被溢出到栈中的跳转表地址；在 ARM 与 MIPS 上比其他工具占用更多内存；也不会报告 IDA Pro 凭借函数序言启发式找到的死代码，作者将此视为设计取舍。基线为 IDA Pro 6.6、BAP 0.9.9 以及 2016 年 11 月时的 angr。论文本身不涉及反编译为 C。
why_fits_en: Adds lifting of machine code to compiler IR with architecture-independent CFG and function-boundary recovery, the analysis layer beneath the collection's curated rev.ng decompiler.
why_fits_zh: 补充将机器码提升为编译器中间表示，并以与架构无关的方式恢复控制流图与函数边界的研究，这一分析层是合集所收录 rev.ng 反编译器的基础。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the three-author order and pages 131–141; Crossref writes the title in lowercase, and this entry follows the capitalization of the author-hosted 11-page PDF, the same length as the ACM version. The paper reports a C++ prototype of 8,011 lines built on LLVM 3.8 and QEMU 2.5.0, and its acknowledgements give https://rev.ng/ as the Free Software release. The revng/revng repository has since become the full rev.ng decompiler: at commit 57d81a3, the README describes a decompiler developed by rev.ng Labs, licensed GPLv2 as a whole with individual files under MIT.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 给出三位作者的顺序及页码 131–141；Crossref 的标题为小写，本条目采用作者托管的 11 页 PDF 中的大小写，其页数与 ACM 版本相同。论文报告的原型为 8,011 行 C++ 代码，基于 LLVM 3.8 与 QEMU 2.5.0；致谢部分给出 https://rev.ng/ 作为其自由软件发布地址。revng/revng 仓库此后已发展为完整的 rev.ng 反编译器：在提交 57d81a3 中，README 将其描述为由 rev.ng Labs 开发的反编译器，整体采用 GPLv2 许可，单个文件采用 MIT 许可。

title: Jetset: Targeted Firmware Rehosting for Embedded Systems
title_zh: Jetset：面向嵌入式系统的定向固件重托管
date_basis: The official USENIX proceedings citation gives August 2021. Month precision is retained; the August 11–13 symposium dates on the proceedings cover are not substituted for a publication day.
date_basis_zh: USENIX 官方论文集引用信息给出 2021 年 8 月。本条目保留月精度，不以论文集封面上 8 月 11–13 日的研讨会日期替代具体出版日。
description_en: Jetset rehosts firmware only as far as an analyst-chosen goal address, such as the point where a fuzzer can inject input. Given the architecture, the MMIO address range, an entry point and the goal, it symbolically executes the firmware with angr against a modified QEMU, treating peripheral reads as symbolic, cycling interrupts, and steering toward the goal with CFG distances and Tabu search. Solved constraints become C peripheral models for QEMU that replay the inferred values and interrupts so the firmware boots concretely to the goal. The authors evaluate 13 targets across x86, ARM and Motorola ColdFire, including Linux on a Raspberry Pi 2, a BeagleBoard-xM bootloader, a SEL-751 relay, a Boeing 737 CMU-900 and nine P²IM firmware, and use the CMU model with AFL to find a privilege escalation in its VRTX kernel.
description_zh: Jetset 只将固件重托管到分析人员指定的目标地址，例如模糊测试器可以注入输入的位置。给定体系结构、MMIO 地址范围、入口点与目标地址后，它使用 angr 配合修改过的 QEMU 对固件进行符号执行，将外设读取视为符号值、轮流触发中断，并借助控制流图距离与禁忌搜索向目标推进。求解得到的约束被转换为供 QEMU 使用的 C 语言外设模型，重放推断出的取值与中断，使固件以具体执行方式启动到目标处。作者在 x86、ARM 与 Motorola ColdFire 上评测了 13 个目标，包括 Raspberry Pi 2 上的 Linux、BeagleBoard-xM 引导程序、SEL-751 继电器、波音 737 的 CMU-900 以及九个 P²IM 固件，并利用 CMU 模型结合 AFL 在其 VRTX 内核中发现一个提权漏洞。
scope_limitations_en: This is targeted rehosting, not full device emulation or firmware decompilation. The analyst supplies the MMIO range, entry point and goal address, and the synthesized models replay one satisfying path and then the last satisfying value for each address, so they need not match real hardware and may mishandle stateful or complex peripheral interaction after the goal. DMA is unsupported; the two targets that needed it relied on an existing QEMU device model or a manually symbolic memory region. Incomplete CFGs, for example across virtual calls or x86 task switches, weaken the distance heuristic, and the BeagleBoard-xM emulator crashed when synthesized serial data was executed as code. Fidelity checks compare against hardware or a manually built QEMU model for selected targets. The VRTX privilege escalation is described by the authors as primarily of academic interest.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是定向重托管，并非完整的设备仿真或固件反编译。MMIO 范围、入口点和目标地址需由分析人员提供；合成模型先重放一条满足约束的路径，之后对每个地址返回最后一个满足约束的值，因此不必与真实硬件一致，到达目标后也可能无法正确处理有状态或复杂的外设交互。不支持 DMA；需要 DMA 的两个目标分别依赖已有的 QEMU 设备模型或人工标为符号值的内存区域。控制流图不完整（例如跨越虚函数调用或 x86 任务切换）会削弱距离启发式，BeagleBoard-xM 仿真也因把合成的串口数据当作代码执行而崩溃。保真度检验只在部分目标上与硬件或人工构建的 QEMU 模型对比。作者称 VRTX 提权漏洞主要具有学术意义。
why_fits_en: Adds symbolic-execution-based peripheral model synthesis for booting firmware to an analysis point, complementing the section’s HAL replacement, MMIO-modeling fuzzing and Linux user-space rehosting research.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于符号执行合成外设模型、使固件启动到分析位置的方法，与本节的 HAL 替换、MMIO 建模模糊测试及 Linux 用户态重托管研究互补。
metadata_notes: The USENIX presentation page and final proceedings PDF give the seven authors in this order, the 30th USENIX Security Symposium, pages 321–338, ISBN 978-1-939133-24-3 and month August; the 19-page PDF includes a proceedings cover page. The page also links a separate prepublication PDF. No DOI or arXiv identifier was found. The paper cites jetset.aerosec.org as its open-source release, but that host did not resolve during review. The aerosec GitHub organization, whose site lists the paper, hosts aerosec/jetset with commits from the first two authors; its README says it contains the code and data to reproduce the paper’s results, except the proprietary or security-critical CMU-900 and ICS binaries. The 2024-03-21 commit is GPL-2.0, and its Makefile clones the jetset_engine, jetset_qemu and jetset_public_data repositories over SSH; GitHub does not identify a single license for the modified-QEMU repository jetset_qemu, and jetset_public_data declares none.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 报告页面与最终论文集 PDF 按此顺序列出七位作者，记载第 30 届 USENIX 安全研讨会、第 321–338 页、ISBN 978-1-939133-24-3 及 8 月；19 页的 PDF 含一页论文集封面。该页面另链接一份预发表 PDF。未找到 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符。论文将 jetset.aerosec.org 列为开源发布地址，但审阅时该主机名无法解析。aerosec GitHub 组织的网站列出了该论文，其 aerosec/jetset 仓库含前两位作者的提交；README 称仓库包含复现论文结果所需的代码与数据，但不含属于专有或安全敏感的 CMU-900 与 ICS 二进制。2024-03-21 提交采用 GPL-2.0，其 Makefile 通过 SSH 克隆 jetset_engine、jetset_qemu 与 jetset_public_data 仓库；GitHub 未能为修改版 QEMU 仓库 jetset_qemu 识别出单一许可证，jetset_public_data 则未声明许可证。

title: BinRec: Dynamic Binary Lifting and Recompilation
title_zh: BinRec：动态二进制提升与重编译
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print-publication date; the online-publication date is recorded separately in metadata notes. The April 27–30 conference dates are not used.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期；在线出版日期在元数据说明中单独记录。本条目不采用 4 月 27—30 日的会议日期。
description_en: BinRec lifts an executable to LLVM IR from dynamic traces instead of static disassembly, then lowers the IR back to a recovered binary, so compiler passes can optimize, harden or otherwise transform it. Tracing runs the binary under S²E, which translates the executed code through QEMU into LLVM IR; BinRec removes the emulation instrumentation, merges traces from several inputs into one program, and adds optimizations such as register de-aliasing and promotion of emulated state to locals. When the recovered binary reaches a path that was not traced, a configurable handler stops it, falls back to the original code, or lifts the new path incrementally. The authors report recovering all SPEC CINT2006 benchmarks, including C++ programs, and apply it to reoptimization, control-flow integrity, AddressSanitizer and SafeStack hardening, and partial deobfuscation of virtualization-obfuscated code.
description_zh: BinRec 依据动态执行轨迹而非静态反汇编，将可执行文件提升为 LLVM 中间表示，再将其降级为恢复出的二进制，从而可用编译器优化遍对其进行优化、加固或其他变换。追踪阶段在 S²E 中运行二进制，由 S²E 经 QEMU 将执行到的代码翻译为 LLVM 中间表示；BinRec 去除仿真插桩，将多个输入的轨迹合并为一个程序，并加入寄存器去别名、将仿真状态提升为局部变量等优化。恢复出的二进制若进入未被追踪的路径，可配置的处理程序会停止执行、回退到原始代码，或增量提升新路径。作者报告恢复了全部 SPEC CINT2006 基准程序（包括 C++ 程序），并将其用于重新优化、控制流完整性、AddressSanitizer 与 SafeStack 加固，以及对虚拟化混淆代码的部分去混淆。
scope_limitations_en: The prototype handles only single-threaded 32-bit x86 Linux ELF binaries and does not support self-modifying code. A recovered binary supports only control-flow paths observed during lifting, so behavior on untraced inputs depends on the chosen miss handler and on input coverage. Lifting through S²E is slow, and floating-point instructions are emulated in lifted code; across the SPEC benchmarks, recovered binaries ran at a geometric-mean 0.98x the time of unoptimized inputs and 1.29x that of optimized inputs. BinRec does not map stack slots to variables. The deobfuscation case uses two small programs obfuscated with the authors' own virtualizer, not commercial obfuscators. The McSema and rev.ng comparisons reflect 2020 versions.
scope_limitations_zh: 原型只支持单线程的 32 位 x86 Linux ELF 二进制，也不支持自修改代码。恢复出的二进制只支持提升时观察到的控制流路径，因此在未被追踪的输入上的行为取决于所选的缺失处理程序及输入覆盖率。经由 S²E 的提升速度较慢，浮点指令在提升后的代码中以仿真方式执行；在 SPEC 基准上，恢复出的二进制运行时间的几何平均值为未优化输入的 0.98 倍、已优化输入的 1.29 倍。BinRec 不建立栈槽与变量之间的映射。去混淆案例使用的是由作者自己的虚拟化器混淆的两个小程序，而非商业混淆器。与 McSema 和 rev.ng 的比较反映的是 2020 年的版本。
why_fits_en: Adds dynamic lifting of executables to compiler IR and recompilation back to working binaries, complementing the collection's decompilation research, which recovers source-level code rather than a rebuildable IR.
why_fits_zh: 补充将可执行文件动态提升为编译器中间表示、再重编译为可运行二进制的研究，与合集中恢复源码级代码而非可重建中间表示的反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata records print publication on 2020-04-15 and online publication on 2020-04-17, pages 1–16; Crossref lists the title as “BinRec” with the subtitle “dynamic binary lifting and recompilation”, and the twelve-author order shown here, the first three marked as equal-contribution joint first authors. The VUSec-hosted PDF is the 16-page ACM-formatted version created on 2020-03-30. The paper gives github.com/securesystemslab/BinRec, whose README (2022-11-29) now says the source is available at trailofbits/binrec-tob. The Trail of Bits commit (2022-11-22; the repository was last pushed 2023-09-18) carries an MIT license with an ONR DFARS acknowledgment and documents Ubuntu 20.04.03 or Debian 11.3, LLVM 14, Python 3.9 and s2e-env at 4bd6a45, with x86 Linux as the only supported environment.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 元数据记载印刷出版于 2020-04-15，在线出版于 2020-04-17，页码为 1–16；Crossref 将标题记为“BinRec”，副标题为“dynamic binary lifting and recompilation”，十二位作者顺序如本条目所列，前三位被标注为同等贡献的共同第一作者。VUSec 托管的 PDF 是 2020-03-30 生成的 16 页 ACM 排版版本。论文给出的地址是 github.com/securesystemslab/BinRec，其 README（2022-11-29）现说明源码发布于 trailofbits/binrec-tob。Trail of Bits 提交（2022-11-22；仓库最后推送于 2023-09-18）采用 MIT 许可，并附 ONR DFARS 资助声明；文档列出 Ubuntu 20.04.03 或 Debian 11.3、LLVM 14、Python 3.9 及 4bd6a45 版本的 s2e-env，且 x86 Linux 是唯一受支持的环境。

title: Egalito: Layout-Agnostic Binary Recompilation
title_zh: Egalito：与布局无关的二进制重编译
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref print-publication date; the online-publication date is recorded separately in metadata notes. The March 16–20 conference dates are not used.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ACM 在 Crossref 登记的印刷出版日期；在线出版日期在元数据说明中单独记录。本条目不采用 3 月 16—20 日的会议日期。
description_en: Egalito statically recompiles stripped x86-64 and ARM64 binaries, using the metadata that position-independent executables and libraries carry to recover a complete disassembly in which every code and data cross-reference becomes an explicit link. Its layout-agnostic intermediate representation, EIR, stays close to machine code, so regenerated output is predictable, while a higher-level view supports analysis; data-flow analyses infer jump tables, which have no metadata. Because the original layout imposes no constraints, tools can move or rewrite code freely; the authors build nine, including continuous code randomization in which Egalito transforms itself, a retpoline defense, and software emulation of Intel CET. They report recovering the compiler's jump tables in 866 of 867 executables and libraries from 172 Debian packages, all tests passing in 90 of 149 transformed packages, and a 1.7% speedup on SPEC CPU 2006.
description_zh: Egalito 对去除符号的 x86-64 与 ARM64 二进制进行静态重编译，借助位置无关的可执行文件和库所携带的元数据，恢复完整的反汇编，使每一处代码与数据交叉引用都成为显式链接。其与布局无关的中间表示 EIR 贴近机器码，因此重新生成的输出可预测，同时提供更高层的视图用于分析；对于没有元数据的跳转表，则借助数据流分析推断。由于不受原始布局约束，工具可以自由移动或改写代码；作者构建了九种工具，包括由 Egalito 变换自身的持续代码随机化、retpoline 防御以及 Intel CET 的软件模拟。作者报告，在来自 172 个 Debian 软件包的 867 个可执行文件与库中，有 866 个的跳转表与编译器给出的真实结果一致；变换后的 149 个软件包中有 90 个通过全部测试；在 SPEC CPU 2006 上性能提升 1.7%。
scope_limitations_en: Egalito requires position-independent code for sufficient metadata; non-PIC inputs are outside the method except where full relocations are supplied, as in the authors' Fuchsia kernel experiment. Jump-table recovery uses data-flow analysis and an adjacency heuristic, so disassembly is not guaranteed to be complete; the one failure in the Debian study was heavily nested jump tables. The authors list obfuscated code, inline assembly that embeds data in code symbols, C++ exceptions, symbol versioning, and Go or V8 binaries among unsupported cases. Package test failures are partly attributed to these features. RISC-V support was incomplete at publication. The columbia/egalito main branch has had no commits since June 2020, so no current maintenance is implied.
scope_limitations_zh: Egalito 依赖位置无关代码提供足够的元数据；除非像作者对 Fuchsia 内核的实验那样提供完整重定位信息，非位置无关的输入不在该方法范围内。跳转表恢复依靠数据流分析和相邻性启发式，因此不能保证反汇编完整；Debian 研究中唯一的失败案例是深度嵌套的跳转表。作者列出的不支持情形包括混淆代码、将数据嵌入代码符号的内联汇编、C++ 异常、符号版本控制，以及 Go 或 V8 二进制。部分软件包测试失败即归因于这些特性。论文发表时 RISC-V 支持尚未完成。columbia/egalito 的主分支自 2020 年 6 月以来没有新提交，因此不代表项目仍在维护。
why_fits_en: Adds static whole-binary recompilation, which regenerates a working program from a recovered low-level IR without the original layout, complementing the collection's decompilation and lifting research.
why_fits_zh: 补充静态整体二进制重编译研究：在不保留原始布局的前提下，从恢复出的低层中间表示重新生成可运行程序，与合集中的反编译及提升研究互补。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata records print publication on 2020-03-09 and online publication on 2020-03-13, pages 133–147, with the eight-author order shown here; Crossref splits the title into “Egalito” and the subtitle “Layout-Agnostic Binary Recompilation”. The Columbia-hosted PDF is the 15-page ACM-formatted version with the DOI. The paper says Egalito is released under GPL v3 at egalito.org. The columbia/egalito commit (2020-06-01; the repository was last pushed 2023-08-01) is GPL-3.0; its README describes x86_64 and aarch64 support with experimental RISC-V and builds with make and g++ on Debian-style systems.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 元数据记载印刷出版于 2020-03-09，在线出版于 2020-03-13，页码为 133–147，八位作者顺序如本条目所列；Crossref 将标题拆分为“Egalito”与副标题“Layout-Agnostic Binary Recompilation”。哥伦比亚大学托管的 PDF 是带 DOI 的 15 页 ACM 排版版本。论文称 Egalito 以 GPL v3 发布于 egalito.org。columbia/egalito 提交（2020-06-01；仓库最后推送于 2023-08-01）采用 GPL-3.0 许可；其 README 说明支持 x86_64 与 aarch64、RISC-V 支持仍属实验性，并在 Debian 类系统上以 make 与 g++ 构建。

title: GUI ripping: reverse engineering of graphical user interfaces for testing
title_zh: GUI 抓取：面向测试的图形用户界面逆向工程
date_basis: IEEE Xplore gives the publication date as 2003 and the proceedings title as WCRE 2003; the Crossref deposit has no publication date. Year precision is retained, and the conference dates and the 2004 Xplore insertion date are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: IEEE Xplore 给出的出版日期为 2003 年，论文集名称为 WCRE 2003；Crossref 元数据未记载出版日期。本条目保留年精度，不以会议日期或 2004 年的 Xplore 收录日期替代。
description_en: GUI ripping reverse engineers a test model from a running desktop application rather than from its source code or specifications. Starting from the top-level windows, a ripper opens each child window by programmatically clicking executable widgets, records every window’s widgets, properties and values, and builds a GUI forest of windows. From that forest it derives event-flow graphs, which record which events can follow one another within a component, and an integration tree of component invocations. The paper describes rippers for Microsoft Windows applications, using window handles and the Windows API, and for Java Swing applications, using Java’s AWT and Swing APIs. It applies them to WordPad, Notepad, Yahoo Messenger and four applications of the TerpOffice student office suite, with the models feeding automated test generation in the authors’ GUITAR and DART systems.
description_zh: GUI 抓取从运行中的桌面应用程序逆向工程出测试模型，而不依赖其源码或规格说明。抓取器从顶层窗口开始，以编程方式点击可执行控件逐一打开子窗口，记录每个窗口的控件、属性与取值，并构建由窗口组成的 GUI 森林。它再从森林推导出事件流图（记录组件内哪些事件可以相继发生）以及表示组件调用关系的集成树。论文介绍了两种抓取器：面向 Microsoft Windows 应用、基于窗口句柄与 Windows API 的实现，以及面向 Java Swing 应用、基于 Java AWT 与 Swing API 的实现。作者将其应用于 WordPad、Notepad、Yahoo Messenger 及学生开发的 TerpOffice 办公套件中的四个应用，所得模型用于作者 GUITAR 与 DART 系统中的自动化测试生成。
scope_limitations_en: The targets are 2003-era desktop GUIs on Microsoft Windows and Java Swing, not mobile apps or web interfaces; the model assumes deterministic events on widgets with discrete property values and excludes timing-dependent, continuous-media or nondeterministic GUIs. The recovered model is a window, widget and event structure for test generation, not UI code or application logic, and the paper does not establish complete behavioral coverage. Ripping can miss windows and widgets: the Windows ripper misses widgets that bypass the Windows API and cannot distinguish modal from modeless windows, while the Java ripper cannot extract the Print dialog structure. In the case studies, testers added missed windows manually, taking 5 to 10 minutes per application, and identified top-level windows by hand for Windows applications. Results come from seven applications and the authors’ own test pipeline.
scope_limitations_zh: 目标是 2003 年前后 Microsoft Windows 与 Java Swing 上的桌面 GUI，而非移动应用或网页界面；模型假定控件上的事件结果确定且属性取值离散，不涵盖依赖时序、连续媒体或非确定性的 GUI。恢复出的模型是供测试生成使用的窗口、控件与事件结构，并非 UI 代码或应用逻辑，论文也未证明覆盖了全部行为。抓取可能遗漏窗口与控件：Windows 抓取器会遗漏绕过 Windows API 的控件，且无法区分模态与非模态窗口；Java 抓取器则无法提取打印对话框的结构。在案例研究中，测试人员需手动补充遗漏的窗口，每个应用耗时 5 至 10 分钟，并需为 Windows 应用手动指定顶层窗口。结果来自七个应用以及作者自己的测试流程。
why_fits_en: Adds a classic execution-based method for recovering an application’s GUI structure and event model, complementing the section’s screenshot-to-code and app-analysis research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种经典的基于执行恢复应用 GUI 结构与事件模型的方法，与本节的截图转代码及应用分析研究互补。
metadata_notes: IEEE Xplore and Crossref list the authors only as A. Memon, I. Banerjee and A. Nagarajan, with pages 260–269 in the 10th Working Conference on Reverse Engineering proceedings (Victoria, BC); the record uses the full names printed in the paper. The title follows IEEE’s sentence case; the paper capitalizes it as “GUI Ripping: Reverse Engineering of Graphical User Interfaces for Testing”. The PDF is the 10-page copy on Atif Memon’s University of Maryland page; IEEE Xplore holds the version of record and does not mark it open access. The paper says the GUI Ripper was made available as a downloadable tool and cites guitar.cs.umd.edu, but that host did not resolve during review.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE Xplore 与 Crossref 仅以 A. Memon、I. Banerjee 和 A. Nagarajan 列出作者，页码为第 10 届逆向工程工作会议（Victoria, BC）论文集第 260–269 页；本条目采用论文中印出的作者全名。标题沿用 IEEE 的句首大写形式；论文中的写法为“GUI Ripping: Reverse Engineering of Graphical User Interfaces for Testing”。PDF 为 Atif Memon 在马里兰大学页面上提供的 10 页副本；版本记录以 IEEE Xplore 为准，后者未将其标为开放获取。论文称 GUI Ripper 已作为可下载工具提供，并引用 guitar.cs.umd.edu，但审阅时该主机名无法解析。

title: Ramblr: Making Reassembly Great Again
title_zh: Ramblr：让二进制重汇编重新可行
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2017; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 26 February–1 March 2017 symposium, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
