date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2017；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2017 年 2 月 26 日至 3 月 1 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: Ramblr produces reassembleable disassembly: assembly recovered from a stripped binary that can be edited and assembled again with an off-the-shelf assembler. Starting from angr's CFG recovery, it classifies the contents of data regions, then decides which immediates and data values are references to code or data that must become symbols. Base-pointer reattribution handles compiler-optimized references that point outside their target object, and sanity checks let Ramblr refuse to reassemble a binary it cannot handle safely, such as one that encrypts pointers. The authors evaluate 106 GNU Coreutils programs for x86 and x86-64 and 143 DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge binaries at six optimization levels. They report that Uroboros broke 22.64% of 32-bit Coreutils binaries at -O0 and 56.61% at -O1, while Ramblr broke none, and that Ramblr reassembled over 98% of CGC binaries at every level.
description_zh: Ramblr 生成可重汇编的反汇编结果，即从去除符号的二进制中恢复出、可以修改并用现成汇编器重新汇编的汇编代码。它以 angr 的控制流图恢复为基础，对数据区内容进行分类，再判断哪些立即数和数据值是对代码或数据的引用、必须转换为符号。基址指针重归属用于处理经编译器优化后指向目标对象之外的引用；健全性检查则使 Ramblr 能够拒绝重汇编无法安全处理的二进制，例如对指针进行加密的程序。作者在为 x86 与 x86-64 编译的 106 个 GNU Coreutils 程序，以及 143 个 DARPA 网络超级挑战赛（CGC）二进制上，按六种优化级别进行评测。他们报告，Uroboros 会破坏 22.64% 的 -O0 及 56.61% 的 -O1 32 位 Coreutils 二进制，而 Ramblr 一个也未破坏；在 CGC 二进制上，Ramblr 在每种优化级别下的重汇编成功率均超过 98%。
scope_limitations_en: The prototype handles x86 and x86-64 ELF binaries produced by GCC or Clang, whose code regions contain no inline data; binaries from compilers such as MSVC, which place jump tables inline, need further work. The authors stress that static content classification is infeasible in general: Ramblr is an empirical approach that is likely to fail if, for example, a binary is linked at a base address chosen so its addresses collide with ordinary constants. The Uroboros comparison covers only 32-bit binaries and, on Coreutils, only -O0 and -O1, because Uroboros failed on 64-bit inputs and its failure rate above -O1 was not meaningful. Correctness is measured by symbolization against linker ground truth and by each program's test cases, which do not prove full equivalence. Results are from 2017 versions of angr and the evaluated toolchains.
scope_limitations_zh: 原型适用于由 GCC 或 Clang 生成的 x86 与 x86-64 ELF 二进制，这类二进制的代码区不含内联数据；MSVC 等编译器会把跳转表放在代码中，处理其生成的二进制仍需进一步工作。作者强调静态内容分类在一般情况下不可行：Ramblr 是一种经验性方法，例如当二进制被链接到特定基址、使其地址与普通常量冲突时，很可能失败。与 Uroboros 的比较只覆盖 32 位二进制，在 Coreutils 上也只比较 -O0 与 -O1，因为 Uroboros 无法处理 64 位输入，且在高于 -O1 时的失败率已无比较意义。正确性依据相对链接器真实信息的符号化结果以及各程序的测试用例衡量，不能证明完全等价。这些结果基于 2017 年时的 angr 及所评测的工具链。
why_fits_en: Adds reassembleable disassembly, the basis of static binary rewriting that emits modifiable assembly instead of patching bytes, alongside the collection's decompilation and binary-recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充可重汇编反汇编研究，这是一种输出可修改汇编代码而非直接修补字节的静态二进制改写基础技术，与合集中的反编译及二进制恢复研究并列。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the title, the eight-author order and year 2017 with no pages; the DOI resolves to the NDSS programme page, which links the 15-page PDF and slides. The PDF footer identifies NDSS ’17, 26 February–1 March 2017, San Diego. The paper says the entire Ramblr toolchain is open source, with Ramblr included in angr as a Python analysis and other parts in the Patcherex binary-patching platform, but it gives no repository URL, version or commit. angr currently ships a Reassembler analysis (reviewed at commit ae9f578). The evaluation ran under PyPy 5.3.1 on Ubuntu Server 16.04.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 给出标题、八位作者顺序及年份 2017，未列页码；DOI 解析至 NDSS 会议议程页面，该页面链接 15 页 PDF 与幻灯片。PDF 页脚标明 NDSS ’17 于 2017 年 2 月 26 日至 3 月 1 日在圣迭戈举行。论文称整个 Ramblr 工具链均已开源，Ramblr 以 Python 分析模块的形式包含在 angr 中，其余部分包含在二进制修补平台 Patcherex 中，但未给出仓库地址、版本或提交。angr 目前提供一个 Reassembler 分析（审阅于提交 ae9f578）。评测在 Ubuntu Server 16.04 上的 PyPy 5.3.1 中进行。

title: Crawling Ajax-Based Web Applications through Dynamic Analysis of User Interface State Changes
title_zh: 通过动态分析用户界面状态变化爬取基于 Ajax 的 Web 应用
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit gives March 2012 for print and online publication, matching the article footer’s “Publication date: March 2012”. The archived ACM page’s 01 March 2012 is read as the issue month, so month precision is retained.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将印刷与在线出版日期均记为 2012 年 3 月，与文章页脚的“Publication date: March 2012”一致。ACM 页面存档中的 2012 年 3 月 1 日被视为期号月份，因此保留月精度。
description_en: Crawljax infers a state-flow graph of an Ajax web application by driving it in a real browser. It scans the DOM for candidate clickable elements, fires events on them, compares the resulting DOM against known states with configurable comparison and similarity thresholds, and records new states and the event transitions between them, backtracking by reloading and replaying paths. A concurrent variant partitions the crawl across browser instances. The Java tool uses Selenium WebDriver and plugins; one plugin writes a static mirror of the crawled states. The authors evaluate six open-source and industrial sites and measure how the number of concurrent browsers affects crawling runtime on Google AdSense.
description_zh: Crawljax 在真实浏览器中驱动 Ajax Web 应用，以推断其状态流图。它扫描 DOM 中候选的可点击元素并触发事件，再用可配置的比较方法与相似度阈值将得到的 DOM 与已知状态比对，记录新状态及状态间的事件转换，并通过重新加载与重放路径进行回溯。并发版本将爬取任务划分给多个浏览器实例。该 Java 工具基于 Selenium WebDriver 与插件机制，其中一个插件可为已爬取的状态生成静态镜像。作者评测了六个开源与工业网站，并在 Google AdSense 上测量并发浏览器数量对爬取耗时的影响。
scope_limitations_en: Crawljax recovers client-side UI states and navigation transitions, not application source code, server-side logic or a complete behavioral model. The inferred graph is one snapshot instance: click order, server-side factors and state-explosion limits such as depth, time and state caps affect what is found. With default settings it clicks each element once and missed elements that only appear after repeated clicks: 33 of 36 annotated elements were found in Pet Store, and 38 of 40 sampled clickables across four external sites. No gold standard or comparable Ajax crawler was available, so accuracy was assessed by injected elements, a manual reference model and spot checks. External sites change over time, and the concurrent study ran at Google on AdSense. The reviewed 2023 repository is a later Java 11 and Selenium 4 codebase, not the 2012 evaluation build.
scope_limitations_zh: Crawljax 恢复的是客户端 UI 状态与导航转换，而非应用源码、服务端逻辑或完整的行为模型。推断出的图只是某一时刻的快照实例：点击顺序、服务端因素以及深度、时间与状态数上限等状态爆炸控制都会影响结果。默认设置下每个元素只点击一次，因而遗漏了需要多次点击才出现的元素：在 Pet Store 中找到 36 个标注元素中的 33 个，在四个外部网站抽样的 40 个可点击元素中找到 38 个。由于缺少黄金标准与可比较的 Ajax 爬虫，准确性通过注入元素、人工参考模型及抽查评估。外部网站会随时间变化，并发实验则在 Google 内部基于 AdSense 进行。所审阅的 2023 年仓库是后来基于 Java 11 与 Selenium 4 的代码，并非 2012 年评测所用版本。
why_fits_en: Adds a classic dynamic-analysis method for recovering a running web application’s UI state machine, complementing the section’s screenshot-, video- and code-based reconstruction research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种经典的动态分析方法，可恢复运行中 Web 应用的 UI 状态机，与本节基于截图、视频及代码的重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the archived ACM page give the three authors, ACM Transactions on the Web volume 6, issue 1, pages 1–30; the article’s reference format gives Article 3 (March 2012), 30 pages. The text was reviewed in the 30-page author copy on Ali Mesbah’s UBC site; the ACM page holds the version of record. The article is a revised and expanded version of the authors’ ICWE 2008 paper. It describes Crawljax as Apache-licensed and available from crawljax.com. The code link is the crawljax/crawljax repository, whose largest contributor is the first author; the reviewed 2023-06-19 commit carries an Apache-2.0 LICENSE, version 5.2.4-SNAPSHOT, Java 11 and Selenium 4.9.0.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 ACM 页面存档给出三位作者，以及 ACM Transactions on the Web 第 6 卷第 1 期第 1–30 页；文章的引用格式标为 Article 3（2012 年 3 月），共 30 页。正文审阅依据 Ali Mesbah 在 UBC 网站上提供的 30 页作者版本；版本记录以 ACM 页面为准。本文是作者 ICWE 2008 论文的修订扩展版。文中称 Crawljax 采用 Apache 许可，可从 crawljax.com 获取。代码链接指向 crawljax/crawljax 仓库，其最大贡献者为第一作者；所审阅的 2023-06-19 提交附有 Apache-2.0 LICENSE，版本为 5.2.4-SNAPSHOT，使用 Java 11 与 Selenium 4.9.0。

title: RetroWrite: Statically Instrumenting COTS Binaries for Fuzzing and Sanitization
title_zh: RetroWrite：为模糊测试与内存检测静态插桩商用现成二进制
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit and the IEEE Xplore record give only May 2020 as the publication date. Xplore separately records insertion on 30 July 2020, and the May 18–21 symposium dates are not used to assert a day.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据及 IEEE Xplore 记录只给出出版日期 2020 年 5 月。Xplore 另记载该文于 2020 年 7 月 30 日收录，本条目不据 5 月 18—21 日的研讨会日期推定具体日期。
description_en: RetroWrite statically rewrites 64-bit position-independent Linux binaries by generating reassembleable assembly, so instrumentation can be inserted as if at compile time. Instead of heuristics, it symbolizes references from the binary's own metadata: control-flow operands, PC-relative addressing that position-independent code must use, and data relocations become assembler labels, which separates references from scalars. On this base the authors build AFL coverage instrumentation and a binary-only AddressSanitizer. They report fuzzing throughput matching compiler instrumentation and 4.5x faster than AFL's QEMU mode, with more bugs found on LAVA-M, and binary ASan that runs 3x faster than Valgrind memcheck on SPEC CPU2006 and detects 80% more bugs in their evaluation, whose coverage tests use Juliet memory-corruption cases.
description_zh: RetroWrite 通过生成可重汇编的汇编代码，对 64 位位置无关的 Linux 二进制进行静态改写，从而像在编译时一样插入插桩代码。它不依赖启发式规则，而是依据二进制自身的元数据进行符号化：控制流操作数、位置无关代码必须使用的 PC 相对寻址以及数据重定位均被转换为汇编标签，从而区分引用与标量。作者在此基础上实现了 AFL 覆盖率插桩和仅针对二进制的 AddressSanitizer。他们报告其模糊测试吞吐量与编译器插桩相当，比 AFL 的 QEMU 模式快 4.5 倍，并在 LAVA-M 上发现更多缺陷；在 SPEC CPU2006 上，二进制 ASan 比 Valgrind memcheck 快 3 倍，并在作者的评测中多检测出 80% 的缺陷，其检测覆盖率测试采用 Juliet 内存破坏用例。
scope_limitations_en: The method depends on position-independent code; the paper's implementation targets Linux x86-64 and uses the symbol table for function starts and sizes, so stripped binaries need function boundaries from another tool. It cannot safely rewrite C++ binaries with exception handling, because the DWARF unwind information is not symbolized, and it does not address obfuscated or adversarial binaries. Binary ASan instruments the stack only at stack-frame granularity and adds no redzones around globals, so it misses some overflows that compiler ASan catches, and it remains slower than compiler ASan. Results are from 2019–2020 tool versions on the authors' benchmarks. The repository's later aarch64 rewriter, described in a separate thesis, uses a different algorithm, and the paper's x86-64 results do not apply to it.
scope_limitations_zh: 该方法依赖位置无关代码；论文的实现面向 Linux x86-64，并借助符号表确定函数起点与大小，因此去除符号的二进制需要由其他工具提供函数边界。由于未对 DWARF 栈展开信息进行符号化，它无法安全改写含异常处理的 C++ 二进制，也不处理混淆或对抗性二进制。二进制 ASan 对栈只按栈帧粒度插桩，也不在全局变量周围添加红区，因此会遗漏部分编译器 ASan 能发现的溢出，且仍慢于编译器 ASan。这些结果基于 2019—2020 年的工具版本和作者的基准。仓库中后来加入的 aarch64 改写器在另一篇学位论文中描述，采用不同的算法，论文中的 x86-64 结果不适用于它。
why_fits_en: Adds static binary rewriting through reassembleable assembly, which reconstructs symbolized assembly so new code can be inserted without source, complementing the collection's decompilation and binary-recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于可重汇编汇编代码的静态二进制改写研究：重建符号化的汇编代码，从而在没有源码的情况下插入新代码，与合集中的反编译及二进制恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the four-author order, pages 1497–1511 and May 2020; IEEE Xplore, read through a Wayback Machine capture because the live page served a bot challenge, gives the same pages and month and a 30 July 2020 insertion date. The 15-page HexHive PDF is byte-identical to the nebelwelt.net copy that the repository README links; it lacks IEEE page numbers and is used as the author-hosted copy. The paper names github.com/HexHive/retrowrite and says its results can be reproduced with the repository’s Docker image. At the reviewed 2025-04-26 commit, the repository has an MIT LICENSE file, though GitHub reports no recognized license, and the README lists Python 3.6 with pyelftools and capstone. Its feature table marks stripped binaries, non-PIE binaries and C++ as unsupported for the x64 rewriter and points to a separate thesis for the aarch64 version.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 给出四位作者顺序、页码 1497–1511 及 2020 年 5 月；IEEE Xplore 的实时页面返回机器人验证，因此通过 Wayback Machine 存档阅读，其页码与月份相同，并记载 2020 年 7 月 30 日收录。HexHive 托管的 15 页 PDF 与仓库 README 所链接的 nebelwelt.net 副本逐字节相同；该副本没有 IEEE 页码，作为作者托管副本使用。论文给出 github.com/HexHive/retrowrite，并称其结果可借助仓库的 Docker 镜像复现。在所审阅的 2025-04-26 提交中，仓库包含 MIT LICENSE 文件，但 GitHub 未识别出许可证；README 列出 Python 3.6 以及 pyelftools 与 capstone。其功能表将去除符号的二进制、非 PIE 二进制与 C++ 标为 x64 改写器尚不支持，并为 aarch64 版本指向另一篇学位论文。

title: Game Engine Learning from Video
title_zh: 从视频中学习游戏引擎
date_basis: The IJCAI-deposited Crossref record gives August 2017 for print publication, represented at month precision. The IJCAI proceedings page gives no publication day, and the conference dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: IJCAI 提交的 Crossref 记录将印刷出版日期记为 2017 年 8 月，本条目按月精度记录。IJCAI 论文集页面未给出具体出版日，本条目也不以会议日期替代。
description_en: Learns a rule-based forward simulator of a 2D game from gameplay video. Using a supplied sprite palette, OpenCV locates sprites in each frame; matched sprites are converted into hand-designed fact types for animation, position, relative distance, x and y velocity and camera offset. Game Engine Search then scans the frames, and whenever the current engine’s predicted next frame differs from the real one by more than a threshold, it runs a greedy search over engines that add or modify condition–effect rules or mark them as player-controlled. Engines are ranked by pixel error and rule count. Trained on one Super Mario Bros. Level 1-1 video, the learned engine predicts frames of a different player’s video more accurately than a CNN frame predictor and a previous-frame baseline, and a value-iteration agent planning with it shows no significant difference from one using the Infinite Mario engine’s native forward simulation.
description_zh: 从游戏录像中学习二维游戏的基于规则的前向模拟器。系统借助提供的精灵图集，用 OpenCV 定位每帧中的精灵；匹配后的精灵被转换为人工设计的事实类型，包括动画、位置、相对距离、x 与 y 方向速度及镜头偏移。随后 Game Engine Search 逐帧扫描，每当当前引擎预测的下一帧与真实帧的差异超过阈值时，便对引擎进行贪心搜索：新增或修改“条件—效果”规则，或将规则标记为玩家控制。引擎按像素误差与规则数量排序。在一段《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1 关卡视频上训练后，所学引擎预测另一位玩家视频帧的准确度高于 CNN 帧预测器与沿用上一帧的基线，基于它进行规划的价值迭代智能体，其表现与使用 Infinite Mario 引擎原生前向模拟的智能体无显著差异。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers one level of one game: training uses a single “speedrunner” video of Super Mario Bros. Level 1-1 (1,569 frames), and testing uses an “explorer” video of the same level. Frame parsing depends on a fan-authored sprite sheet and hand-authored fact types, which the authors say makes the method less applicable to more complex domains such as real video. The learned engine is a set of search-derived rules for on-screen sprite behavior, not recovered game code or a binary; it does not represent player death or level transitions, and mechanics absent from Level 1-1 are not expected to transfer. Search can be slow at low thresholds, up to two weeks for one level on a 2013 iMac, and the reported run used a zero threshold. The CNN comparison used downscaled grayscale frames, and the gameplay comparison is indirect, through agents in the Infinite Mario engine.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测只涵盖一款游戏的一个关卡：训练使用《超级马力欧兄弟》1-1 关卡的一段“速通玩家”视频（1,569 帧），测试使用同一关卡的“探索型玩家”视频。帧解析依赖爱好者制作的精灵图集与人工编写的事实类型，作者也指出这使方法较难应用于真实视频等更复杂的领域。所学引擎是通过搜索得到的、描述屏幕上精灵行为的规则集合，并非恢复的游戏代码或二进制；它不表示玩家死亡与关卡切换，1-1 关卡中未出现的机制也不应期望能够迁移。阈值较低时搜索可能很慢，在 2013 年的 iMac 上单个关卡最长需两周，报告的实验使用零阈值。CNN 比较使用缩小后的灰度帧，游戏表现比较则通过 Infinite Mario 引擎中的智能体间接进行。
why_fits_en: Adds a search-based method for reconstructing game rules from gameplay video, complementing the section’s neural and LLM-based world-model and code-synthesis research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种基于搜索、从游戏录像重建游戏规则的方法，与本节基于神经网络及大语言模型的世界模型与代码合成研究互补。
metadata_notes: The IJCAI proceedings page and the 7-page PDF give the three authors, the IJCAI-17 main track and pages 3707–3713; the Crossref record matches the authors and DOI. The paper links no code, learned engines or parsed data, and the Super Mario Bros. footage and fan-made sprite sheet are third-party materials.
metadata_notes_zh: IJCAI 论文集页面与 7 页 PDF 给出三位作者、IJCAI-17 主赛道及第 3707–3713 页；Crossref 记录的作者与 DOI 与之一致。论文未链接代码、学得的引擎或解析数据，《超级马力欧兄弟》录像与爱好者制作的精灵图集均属第三方材料。

title: Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments with GameGAN
title_zh: 使用 GameGAN 学习模拟动态环境
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit and an archived copy of the IEEE Xplore page give June 2020, represented at month precision. The May 2020 arXiv submission and the conference dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据及 IEEE Xplore 页面存档副本均给出 2020 年 6 月，本条目按月精度记录，不以 2020 年 5 月的 arXiv 提交日期或会议日期替代。
description_en: GameGAN learns an action-conditioned neural simulator of a game from recorded frames and the actions taken, without access to the game’s logic or engine. An action-conditioned LSTM dynamics engine with a stochastic latent variable predicts the next state, an optional external memory module builds an internal map so that revisited locations stay consistent, and a rendering engine decodes frames while separating static from dynamic components. Training is end-to-end with adversarial losses, including an action-conditioned discriminator, and a temporal cycle loss for memory consistency. The authors evaluate on a modified Pac-Man, a ghost-free Pac-Man-Maze and VizDoom “take cover”, training RL agents inside the learned simulators and testing them in the real games, and measure long-term consistency with a come-back-home task; a human-playable model of the official Pac-Man is shown qualitatively.
description_zh: GameGAN 从录制的画面帧及对应动作中学习游戏的动作条件神经模拟器，无需访问游戏逻辑或引擎。带随机潜变量的动作条件 LSTM 动力学引擎预测下一状态；可选的外部记忆模块构建内部地图，使重新访问的位置保持一致；渲染引擎在解码画面时区分静态与动态成分。模型以端到端方式训练，采用包括动作条件判别器在内的对抗损失，并用时间循环损失保持记忆一致性。作者在修改版 Pac-Man、无幽灵的 Pac-Man-Maze 及 VizDoom “take cover” 上进行评测：在学得的模拟器中训练强化学习智能体并在真实游戏中测试，并用“返回原点”任务衡量长期一致性；论文还定性展示了可由人类游玩的官方 Pac-Man 模型。
scope_limitations_en: GameGAN imitates a game’s pixels and dynamics; it does not recover game code, symbolic rules, assets or an executable. Training needs large logged datasets with actions: 40K Pac-Man episodes from a high-entropy DQN agent that sees the full environment, and 10K random-policy VizDoom episodes, at 84×84 and 64×64 resolution. Quantitative results cover small grid-based Pac-Man variants and one VizDoom scenario, with an external classifier supplying game outcomes. Agents trained in the simulators can exploit modeling errors: the full model sometimes let Pac-Man pass through walls, and its Pac-Man agents scored below those of the memoryless variant, while on VizDoom the World Model baseline scored higher than GameGAN. The released code supports VizDoom training only, relies on a deprecated WorldModels data setup, and is under the non-commercial NVIDIA Source Code License; Pac-Man data and the official Pac-Man model are not included.
scope_limitations_zh: GameGAN 模仿的是游戏的画面与动态，并不恢复游戏代码、符号规则、素材或可执行程序。训练需要带动作的大量日志数据：Pac-Man 使用 4 万个由能观察完整环境、高熵策略的 DQN 智能体生成的回合，VizDoom 使用 1 万个随机策略回合，分辨率分别为 84×84 与 64×64。定量结果只覆盖小型网格化的 Pac-Man 变体与一个 VizDoom 场景，并借助外部分类器给出游戏结果。在模拟器中训练的智能体可能利用建模误差：完整模型有时让 Pac-Man 穿过墙壁，其 Pac-Man 智能体得分低于无记忆版本；在 VizDoom 上，World Model 基线的得分高于 GameGAN。发布的代码只支持 VizDoom 训练，依赖已弃用的 WorldModels 数据准备流程，并采用仅限非商业用途的 NVIDIA Source Code License；其中不含 Pac-Man 数据及官方 Pac-Man 模型。
why_fits_en: Adds a neural approach to reconstructing a playable game simulator from observed frames and actions, complementing the section’s program-synthesis and black-box game-replication research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种从观察到的画面与动作中重建可游玩游戏模拟器的神经网络方法，与本节的程序合成及黑盒游戏复刻研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the archived IEEE Xplore page give the five authors, CVPR 2020 and pages 1228–1237; IEEE metadata capitalizes the title as “Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments With GameGAN”, while the CVF open-access paper and arXiv print “with”. The 10-page CVF PDF is the Computer Vision Foundation’s open-access version; IEEE Xplore holds the version of record. arXiv has only v1, submitted 2020-05-25 with the comment “CVPR 2020”. The repository README at the reviewed 2021-11-11 commit gives BibTeX pages 1231–1240, which differ from IEEE, and its Project Page link points to an unrelated lift-splat-shoot page. The README lists Ubuntu 18.04 and Python 3.8.3, and requirements pin torch 1.4.0 and torchvision 0.5.0. LICENSE section 3.3 limits use to non-commercial research or evaluation.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 IEEE Xplore 页面存档给出五位作者、CVPR 2020 及第 1228–1237 页；IEEE 元数据将标题写作“Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments With GameGAN”，而 CVF 开放获取论文与 arXiv 中为小写“with”。10 页的 CVF PDF 是计算机视觉基金会提供的开放获取版本，版本记录以 IEEE Xplore 为准。arXiv 只有 2020-05-25 提交的 v1，备注为“CVPR 2020”。所审阅的 2021-11-11 提交中，仓库 README 的 BibTeX 页码为 1231–1240，与 IEEE 不同；其 Project Page 链接指向无关的 lift-splat-shoot 页面。README 列出 Ubuntu 18.04 与 Python 3.8.3，requirements 固定 torch 1.4.0 与 torchvision 0.5.0。LICENSE 第 3.3 条将使用限定为非商业的研究或评估用途。

title: Combining Functional and Automata Synthesis to Discover Causal Reactive Programs
title_zh: 结合函数合成与自动机合成以发现因果反应式程序
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records print publication on 2023-01-09; the online-publication date of 2023-01-11, also shown on the ACM article page, is recorded separately in metadata notes. The POPL meeting dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将印刷出版日期记为 2023-01-09；ACM 论文页面同样显示的 2023-01-11 在线出版日期在元数据说明中单独记录。本条目不以 POPL 会议日期替代。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (POPL 2023)
description_en: AutumnSynth synthesizes a program in Autumn, a functional reactive language for Atari-style grid worlds, from a trace of observed frames and user actions such as clicks and arrow keys. Heuristic perception parses each frame into typed objects and tracking links them across time steps. The synthesizer then finds an update function for each observed change and searches for the event that triggers it. When no event over the observed state explains an update, automata synthesis invents latent state, such as counters or modes, using a SAT-based Sketch encoding or a faster heuristic. The authors introduce the 30-program Causal Inductive Synthesis Corpus (CISC), on which the heuristic variant synthesizes 27 programs. A slightly modified version synthesizes 21 of 27 games from the third-party EMPA grid-world corpus.
description_zh: AutumnSynth 根据观察到的画面帧及用户动作（如点击和方向键）构成的轨迹，合成 Autumn 程序；Autumn 是面向 Atari 风格网格世界的函数式反应式语言。基于启发式的感知步骤将每帧解析为带类型的对象，跟踪步骤再将对象跨时间步关联起来。随后，合成器为每个观察到的变化寻找更新函数，并搜索触发该变化的事件。当基于可观察状态的事件都无法解释某次更新时，自动机合成会借助基于 SAT 的 Sketch 编码或更快的启发式方法，引入计数器、模式等潜在状态。作者提出了含 30 个程序的 Causal Inductive Synthesis Corpus（CISC），启发式版本在其中合成出 27 个程序；经少量修改的版本在第三方 EMPA 网格世界语料库的 27 个游戏中合成出 21 个。
scope_limitations_en: Targets are small, fully observed grid worlds expressible in Autumn, not games with continuous physics, rich graphics or compiled code. Perception and tracking are heuristic, and because Autumn renders objects partially transparent, perception does not address occlusion. CISC input traces were constructed manually to exercise each model’s dynamics, and success means the synthesized program reproduces the given trace, not semantic equivalence to the ground truth. Heuristic runtimes range from about two minutes to 9–13 hours; the Sketch variants time out after 24 hours on several benchmarks, and EMPA runs time out after 40 hours on some games. EMPA required domain-specific changes for random events. Because most EMPA games are nondeterministic, their results were checked by manual inspection, and only the first level of each game was used. On new CISC test traces, four synthesized programs diverged from the ground truth because their training traces did not show all dynamics, and concatenating several traces recovered the ground-truth program for the three that were retested. For random events AutumnSynth detects nondeterminism but does not infer the underlying probability distributions. The method is symbolic program synthesis and does not use an LLM.
scope_limitations_zh: 目标是可用 Autumn 表达、完全可观察的小型网格世界，而非具有连续物理、复杂图形或已编译代码的游戏。感知与跟踪基于启发式；由于 Autumn 将对象渲染为部分透明，感知步骤不处理遮挡。CISC 的输入轨迹由人工构造，以覆盖各模型的动态；“成功”指合成程序能复现给定轨迹，而非与真实程序语义等价。启发式版本的运行时间从约两分钟到 9–13 小时不等；Sketch 版本在若干基准上 24 小时后超时，部分 EMPA 游戏也在 40 小时后超时。EMPA 需要针对随机事件做领域特定修改；由于多数 EMPA 游戏具有非确定性，其结果通过人工检查确认，且每个游戏只使用第一关。在新的 CISC 测试轨迹上，有四个合成程序因训练轨迹未展示全部动态而偏离真实程序，对其中三个重新测试时，拼接多条轨迹后恢复出了真实程序。对于随机事件，AutumnSynth 只检测非确定性，并不推断其背后的概率分布。该方法属于符号程序合成，并未使用大语言模型。
why_fits_en: Adds symbolic synthesis of game programs, including latent state, from observed play, complementing the section’s LLM-based code world-model and game-reconstruction research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种从观察到的游玩过程中合成游戏程序（包括潜在状态）的符号方法，与本节基于大语言模型的代码世界模型及游戏重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref, the archived ACM page and the 31-page article give the four authors, Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages volume 7, issue POPL, Article 56, pages 1628–1658. Crossref records print publication on 2023-01-09 and online publication on 2023-01-11, and the article footer gives January 2023. The ACM article is open access under CC BY 4.0. The paper says the Autumn language and AutumnSynth were implemented in Julia but links no code or artifact. The author’s publication page links only papers. The riadas/AutumnSynth.jl repository under the first author’s account contained only a one-line README at its single 2023-03-15 commit.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref、ACM 页面存档与 31 页的论文给出四位作者，以及 Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages 第 7 卷 POPL 期 Article 56、第 1628–1658 页。Crossref 记载印刷出版于 2023-01-09、在线出版于 2023-01-11，论文页脚标为 2023 年 1 月。ACM 论文以 CC BY 4.0 开放获取。论文称 Autumn 语言与 AutumnSynth 以 Julia 实现，但未链接代码或产物；作者的出版物页面也只链接论文。第一作者账户下的 riadas/AutumnSynth.jl 仓库在其唯一一次 2023-03-15 提交中只有一行 README。

title_zh: StructEval：评测大语言模型生成结构化输出的能力
description_en: Evaluates generation and conversion of structured outputs, including HTML, React and SVG, with separate checks for format adherence and structural correctness.
description_zh: 评测结构化输出的生成与转换，包括 HTML、React 和 SVG，并分别检查格式遵循和结构正确性。
why_fits_en: A supporting method for checking structured and rendered artifacts produced during frontend reconstruction; parseability alone does not establish correct content.
why_fits_zh: 可辅助检查前端重建产出的结构化与渲染工件；能够解析并不代表内容正确。
scope_limitations_en: Not a software reverse-engineering or GUI-navigation benchmark. Structured-output scores do not prove recovered source identity, backend reconstruction or behavioral equivalence; aggregate scores are not fully correct-output percentages.
scope_limitations_zh: 并非软件逆向工程或 GUI 导航基准；结构化输出得分不证明源码身份、后端恢复或行为等价，综合得分也不是完全正确输出的百分比。
title: StructEval: Benchmarking LLMs' Capabilities to Generate Structural Outputs
date_basis: Original arXiv first-submission date; reviewed preprint edition retained.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期，并保留本次核验的预印本版本。
metadata_notes: This record describes the original arXiv edition. Supporting method.
metadata_notes_zh: 本条描述原始 arXiv 版本。属于配套方法。

title_zh: WebWorld：将浏览器作为自改进网页代码的世界模型
description_en: Uses typed browser interaction contracts to check progress and preserve previously verified capabilities while improving generated web code. Only accepted transitions become training examples.
description_zh: 将网页改进目标编译成类型化浏览器交互契约，检查目标进展并保持已验证能力，只把通过验收的转移用于训练。
why_fits_en: A supporting validation method for reconstructed web interfaces: test executable behavior and regressions instead of relying on visual similarity alone.
why_fits_zh: 可为重建网页界面提供配套验证方法：检查可执行行为与功能退化，而不只比较视觉相似性。
scope_limitations_en: The study concerns web-code generation and self-improvement, not recovery of original source code. Acceptance covers declared interactions and preserved capabilities, not equivalence to an arbitrary original application. Distinct from the other WebWorld web-simulator paper.
scope_limitations_zh: 该研究讨论网页代码生成与自改进，并非恢复原始源码；验收覆盖声明的交互和已验证能力，不证明与任意原应用等价。它与另一篇同名 WebWorld 网页模拟器论文不同。
title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code
date_basis: Original arXiv first-submission date; reviewed preprint edition retained.
date_basis_zh: 采用 arXiv 首次提交日期，并保留本次核验的预印本版本。
metadata_notes: This record describes the original arXiv edition. Supporting method.
metadata_notes_zh: 本条描述原始 arXiv 版本。属于配套方法。

title: Training Language Model Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo
title_zh: 使用 CTF-Dojo 训练语言模型智能体发现漏洞
date_basis: PMLR states that Volume 306 was published on 29 September 2026, matching the paper page's citation_publication_date of 2026/09/29. The July 6–11 conference dates and the arXiv dates are not used.
date_basis_zh: PMLR 说明第 306 卷于 2026 年 9 月 29 日出版，与论文页面 citation_publication_date 所载 2026/09/29 一致；本条目不采用 7 月 6–11 日的会议日期，也不采用 arXiv 日期。
description_en: CTF-Dojo is an execution environment for training LLM agents on capture-the-flag tasks: 658 challenges from 50 competitions held between 2011 and 2025, taken from pwn.college's CTF Archive and containerized with Docker. Its CTF-Forge pipeline prompts DeepSeek-V3-0324 to write each challenge's Dockerfile, docker-compose file and challenge metadata; across three independent runs, 650 challenges consistently built and answered on their expected ports. Qwen3-Coder and DeepSeek-V3-0324 agents in the EnIGMA+ scaffold, capped at 40 turns, collected trajectories. Matched CTFtime writeups served as hints during collection and were removed afterwards, and ports, paths, distractor code and other runtime details were randomized per rollout. Rejection-sampling fine-tuning of Qwen3 8B, 14B and 32B on 486 flag-capturing trajectories from 274 solved challenges raises average Pass@1 on InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench and Cybench by up to 11.6 points; the 32B model reaches 31.9%.
description_zh: CTF-Dojo 是用于在夺旗赛任务上训练大语言模型智能体的可执行环境：它从 pwn.college 的 CTF Archive 中选取 658 道题目，来自 2011 年至 2025 年举办的 50 项竞赛，并以 Docker 容器化。其 CTF-Forge 流水线提示 DeepSeek-V3-0324 为每道题目编写 Dockerfile、docker-compose 文件和题目元数据；在三次独立运行中，650 道题目均能稳定构建并在预期端口上响应。Qwen3-Coder 与 DeepSeek-V3-0324 智能体在上限为 40 轮的 EnIGMA+ 框架中收集轨迹。收集过程中以匹配到的 CTFtime 题解作为提示，之后再从轨迹中删除；每次运行还会随机化端口、路径、干扰代码及其他运行时细节。作者以拒绝采样微调方式，用来自 274 道已解题目的 486 条成功夺旗轨迹训练 Qwen3 8B、14B 与 32B 模型，使其在 InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench 与 Cybench 上的平均 Pass@1 最多提高 11.6 个百分点；32B 模型达到 31.9%。
scope_limitations_en: The environments span general CTF categories, not reverse engineering alone: of the 658 challenges, 228 are cryptography, 163 pwn, 123 reverse engineering, 85 miscellaneous, 38 forensics and 21 web. Among the 274 challenges with successful trajectories, cryptography is the largest category (141), followed by reverse engineering (52). Benchmark gains are reported per benchmark over 323 tasks, at temperature 0 with 40 turns, not per category, so they do not measure reverse-engineering accuracy. Decontamination matched competition and challenge names and removed 3 overlapping challenges; the authors note that it cannot exclude broader similarity between tasks. Only 150 challenges (23%) matched a writeup, all trajectories come from two teacher models, and only supervised fine-tuning is studied; the authors name the static 658-challenge scale as a limit. Hashed flag checkers in the upstream archive can be wrong, and the authors report four such bugs. The repository code is CC BY-NC 4.0. It holds CTF-Forge, the metadata and writeup-matching scripts and a challenge index, but not the challenge files, which are cloned separately from pwn.college's CTF Archive and are not covered by the repository license. The reviewed tree has no trajectories or trained weights, and writeups must be collected separately. Capturing a flag does not show recovered program structure.
scope_limitations_zh: 这些环境涵盖夺旗赛的一般类别，并非只有逆向工程：658 道题目中，密码学 228 道、漏洞利用 163 道、逆向工程 123 道、杂项 85 道、取证 38 道、Web 21 道。在有成功轨迹的 274 道题目中，密码学是最大的类别（141 道），其次是逆向工程（52 道）。基准提升按基准（共 323 个任务，温度为 0、上限 40 轮）报告，而非按类别报告，因此不能衡量逆向工程准确率。去污染通过匹配竞赛名与题目名完成，移除了 3 道重叠题目；作者指出这无法排除任务之间更广泛的相似性。只有 150 道题目（23%）匹配到题解，所有轨迹都来自两个教师模型，研究也只考察监督微调；作者将 658 道题目的静态规模列为局限。上游归档中基于哈希的旗标检查程序可能有误，作者报告了四个此类错误。仓库代码采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可证，包含 CTF-Forge、元数据与题解匹配脚本以及题目索引，但不含题目文件；题目文件需另行从 pwn.college 的 CTF Archive 克隆，不受该仓库许可证覆盖。所审阅的目录中没有轨迹或训练好的权重，题解也需另行收集。夺得旗标并不表明恢复了程序结构。
why_fits_en: Adds execution-grounded training of open-weight CTF agents on a task pool that includes reverse-engineering challenges; trajectories are collected and evaluated in EnIGMA+, an extension of the EnIGMA scaffold in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充在包含逆向工程题目的任务池上、以执行结果为依据训练开放权重夺旗赛智能体的研究；其轨迹在 EnIGMA+ 中收集和评测，该框架扩展了本节收录的 EnIGMA。
metadata_notes: The PMLR page, its BibTeX and the proceedings PDF give the same five authors in order, the booktitle 'Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning', volume 306, pages 168265–168284 and no DOI. arXiv v1 is dated 2025-08-25 and v2 2025-09-23, with no comment or journal reference; v2 matches the PMLR title and headline numbers, though its training text says 7B where its tables and the PMLR text use 8B. At the reviewed 2026-01-10 commit, the LICENSE file is the CC BY-NC 4.0 text and NOTICE gives SPDX CC-BY-NC-4.0, while GitHub reports NOASSERTION. The README and NOTICE title the project 'Training Software Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo', and the README's second BibTeX entry gives the separate Cyber-Zero preprint (arXiv 2508.00910) the title 'CTF-Dojo: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime'. ctf_archive.json lists 658 challenges, with 229 cryptography and 162 pwn against the paper's 228 and 163. Building environments needs a model endpoint through litellm (default deepseek-v3-0324), a clone of pwncollege/ctf-archive, whose reviewed commit has no root license file, a separately gathered writeups JSONL, and EnIGMA+ from the Cyber-Zero repository for trajectory collection.
metadata_notes_zh: PMLR 页面、其 BibTeX 与论文集 PDF 均列出顺序相同的五位作者、书名“Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning”、第 306 卷、第 168265–168284 页，且没有 DOI。arXiv v1 发布于 2025-08-25，v2 为 2025-09-23，均无注释或期刊引用；v2 的标题与主要数字与 PMLR 版本一致，但其训练部分写作 7B，而其表格与 PMLR 正文均为 8B。在所审阅的 2026-01-10 提交中，LICENSE 文件为 CC BY-NC 4.0 文本，NOTICE 给出 SPDX 标识 CC-BY-NC-4.0，而 GitHub 显示为 NOASSERTION。README 与 NOTICE 将项目称为“Training Software Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo”，README 中第二条 BibTeX 则为另一篇 Cyber-Zero 预印本（arXiv 2508.00910）标注了“CTF-Dojo: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime”的标题。ctf_archive.json 列出 658 道题目，其中密码学 229 道、漏洞利用 162 道，论文中则为 228 道与 163 道。构建环境需要通过 litellm 访问模型端点（默认 deepseek-v3-0324）、克隆 pwncollege/ctf-archive（所审阅提交的根目录没有许可证文件）、另行收集的题解 JSONL，以及 Cyber-Zero 仓库中用于收集轨迹的 EnIGMA+。

title: Cyber-Zero: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime
title_zh: Cyber-Zero：无需运行环境训练网络安全智能体
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2026-04-20 is not adopted, and the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不主张更精确的出版日期。本条目不采用论文集页面中 2026-04-20 的引用日期，也不以 arXiv 日期替代。
description_en: Cyber-Zero synthesizes training trajectories for capture-the-flag (CTF) agents from public writeups instead of running the challenges. Writeups collected from CTFtime through the CTF Archives repository are cleaned, filtered and completed with DeepSeek-V3-0324, which fills in missing metadata and extracts flags; after removing 47 challenges that overlap the evaluation benchmarks, the corpus holds 6,188 writeups for 4,610 challenges from 543 competitions in six categories, 2017–2025. Two DeepSeek-V3-0324 personas then simulate each solve: a CTF player that sees only the challenge content, and a Bash terminal that sees the writeup and flag, invents plausible command output and may inject hints, which are removed before training. Trajectories use the EnIGMA scaffold format and are kept only if they reach the exact flag, pass format checks and are judged by an LLM filter to follow the writeup's approach. Qwen3, Qwen2.5-Instruct and SWE-agent-LM models are fine-tuned on 9,464 of these trajectories and evaluated with EnIGMA+, the authors' parallel version of EnIGMA, on InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench and Cybench. The fine-tuned Qwen3-32B (Cyber-Zero-32B) rises from 20.3% to 33.4% average Pass@1, the 13.1-point gain reported in the abstract.
description_zh: Cyber-Zero 依据公开的解题报告（writeup）合成夺旗赛（CTF）智能体的训练轨迹，而不实际运行题目。作者经由 CTF Archives 仓库从 CTFtime 收集解题报告，经过清洗与筛选后，再用 DeepSeek-V3-0324 补全缺失的元数据并提取旗标；移除与评测基准重叠的 47 道题目后，语料包含 6,188 篇解题报告，覆盖 543 场竞赛中六个类别的 4,610 道题目，时间跨度为 2017–2025 年。随后由两个 DeepSeek-V3-0324 角色模拟每次解题：CTF 选手只能看到题目内容；Bash 终端则能看到解题报告与旗标，负责编造合理的命令输出，并可插入提示，这些提示在训练前会被删除。轨迹采用 EnIGMA 智能体框架的格式，只有得出完全匹配的旗标、通过格式检查，并经 LLM 过滤器判定与解题报告思路一致的轨迹才会保留。作者用其中 9,464 条轨迹微调 Qwen3、Qwen2.5-Instruct 与 SWE-agent-LM 模型，并以自行开发的并行版 EnIGMA+ 在 InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench 与 Cybench 上评测。微调后的 Qwen3-32B（Cyber-Zero-32B）平均 Pass@1 从 20.3% 提升至 33.4%，即摘要所述的 13.1 个百分点增益。
scope_limitations_en: No training trajectory was executed: command outputs are simulated by an LLM that knows the writeup and flag, and trajectories are filtered by exact flag match, format checks and an LLM judge rather than by running commands. The authors acknowledge that the corpus may contain incorrect command traces and fabricated flags, that they report no quantitative error analysis, and that the simulated traces exclude interactive tools such as gdb, Python shells and browsers. The writeups and the evaluation tasks span six general CTF categories, not reverse engineering alone; the three test benchmarks hold 323 runnable tasks, 84 of them reverse engineering, and aggregate Pass@1 is not reverse-engineering accuracy. Results are single greedy Pass@1 runs in the authors' EnIGMA+ scaffold with a 40-turn cap, on benchmark copies the authors repaired; 17 tasks could not be set up. Contamination control removed 47 overlapping challenges by manual comparison. Capturing a flag does not show recovered program structure. The repository is archived and licensed CC BY-NC 4.0, and its benchmark README states that the bundled benchmark content remains the property of its original creators.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练轨迹均未实际执行：命令输出由一个知晓解题报告与旗标的 LLM 模拟，轨迹通过旗标完全匹配、格式检查和 LLM 评判筛选，而不是通过运行命令验证。作者承认语料可能包含错误的命令记录和编造的旗标，未报告定量错误分析，模拟轨迹也不包含 gdb、Python 交互环境和浏览器等交互式工具。解题报告与评测任务涵盖六个通用 CTF 类别，并非仅限逆向工程；三个测试基准共有 323 道可运行题目，其中 84 道属于逆向工程，总体 Pass@1 不代表逆向工程准确率。结果是在作者的 EnIGMA+ 框架中、以 40 轮为上限的单次贪心解码 Pass@1，所用基准副本经过作者修复；另有 17 道题目无法搭建。污染控制依靠人工比对移除了 47 道重叠题目。夺得旗标并不表明恢复了程序结构。仓库已归档，采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可证，其基准说明指出所附基准内容仍归原作者所有。
why_fits_en: Adds runtime-free trajectory synthesis for training open CTF agents whose tasks include reverse engineering; it formats its data for EnIGMA, also in this section, and evaluates on InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench and Cybench.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种无需运行环境、为训练开放 CTF 智能体合成轨迹的方法，其任务包含逆向工程；它按同样收录于本节的 EnIGMA 框架格式组织数据，并在 InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench 与 Cybench 上评测。
metadata_notes: The proceedings page, its PDF and arXiv list the same five authors in order. The proceedings page lists pages 154054–154184 and no DOI. Its 131-page PDF is headed 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026'; compared with arXiv v2 it adds an appendix of limitations, describes the 47-challenge contamination removal and moves Zijian Wang's affiliation to Meta Superintelligence Labs. Its abstract says Cyber-Zero-32B is comparable to frontier open-weight models, while arXiv v2 and the proceedings page abstract claim state-of-the-art results among open-weight models. arXiv v1 is dated 2025-07-29 and v2 2025-08-25; v2's comment links the repository. At the reviewed 2025-09-02 commit the GitHub repository is archived; its LICENSE is the CC BY-NC 4.0 legal code (GitHub reports NOASSERTION) and its NOTICE gives SPDX CC-BY-NC-4.0. It contains the generation, quality-filter and reformatting scripts (Python 3.8 or later, LiteLLM, with DeepSeek-V3-0324 as the default model, so runs need a model provider), the EnIGMA+ scaffold and repaired copies of the three benchmarks. The README links no released trajectory corpus or model weights.
metadata_notes_zh: 论文集页面、其 PDF 与 arXiv 列出的五位作者及顺序一致。论文集页面列出页码 154054–154184，没有 DOI。其 131 页的 PDF 页眉为“Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026”；与 arXiv v2 相比，该版本增加了局限性附录，说明了移除 47 道题目的污染控制，并将 Zijian Wang 的单位改为 Meta Superintelligence Labs。其摘要称 Cyber-Zero-32B 与前沿开放权重模型相当，而 arXiv v2 和论文集页面摘要称其在开放权重模型中达到最先进水平。arXiv v1 发布于 2025-07-29，v2 为 2025-08-25；v2 注释链接了代码仓库。在所审阅的 2025-09-02 提交中，GitHub 仓库已归档；LICENSE 为 CC BY-NC 4.0 法律文本（GitHub 显示为 NOASSERTION），NOTICE 标注 SPDX 标识 CC-BY-NC-4.0。仓库包含轨迹生成、质量过滤与格式转换脚本（需要 Python 3.8 或更高版本及 LiteLLM，默认模型为 DeepSeek-V3-0324，因此运行需要模型服务）、EnIGMA+ 框架，以及三个基准的修复副本。README 未链接已发布的轨迹语料或模型权重。

title: Binary Rewriting without Control Flow Recovery
title_zh: 无需控制流恢复的二进制重写
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2020-06-11, and an archived copy of the ACM article page shows the same date. The June 15–20 PLDI dates printed in the paper are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将印刷与在线出版日期均记为 2020-06-11，ACM 论文页面的存档副本显示相同日期。本条目不以论文所印 6 月 15–20 日的 PLDI 会议日期替代。
description_en: E9Patch statically rewrites x86-64 binaries by inserting jumps to trampolines without moving any other instruction, so the original set of jump targets is preserved and control-flow recovery, symbolization and debug information are not needed. Where a five-byte jump does not fit, instruction punning, padding and successor or neighbor eviction overlap the jump with existing bytes or relocate neighboring instructions into their own trampolines; physical page grouping reduces the memory and file-size cost of scattered trampolines. Instruction locations come from a separate frontend, a basic linear disassembler in the evaluation. The authors evaluate SPEC2006, Ubuntu 16.04 system binaries, and Chrome and Firefox builds over 100 MB, and demonstrate binary repair and heap-write hardening with low fat pointers.
description_zh: E9Patch 对 x86-64 二进制进行静态重写：插入跳转到跳板代码的指令，而不移动其他任何指令，从而保留原有跳转目标集合，无需控制流恢复、符号化或调试信息。当五字节跳转放不下时，它通过指令双关、填充以及后继或邻近指令驱逐，使跳转与已有字节重叠，或把邻近指令移入各自的跳板；物理页分组则降低分散跳板带来的内存与文件体积开销。指令位置由独立的前端提供，评测中使用的是基础线性反汇编器。作者评测了 SPEC2006、Ubuntu 16.04 系统二进制以及超过 100 MB 的 Chrome 与 Firefox，并演示了二进制修复和基于低胖指针的堆写加固。
scope_limitations_en: This is static binary rewriting and instrumentation, not decompilation or source recovery. It relies on the frontend’s instruction locations and sizes being correct, assumes patched code is not read as data or self-modified, and assumes the input does not already use overlapping instructions. Each tactic can fail: 1,098 of about 10.5 million patch locations were not patched, baseline coverage alone was 72.79% for jumps and 81.63% for heap writes, and non-PIE binaries are harder than PIE ones. Chrome’s mixed code and data required starting disassembly after ChromeMain, and Firefox’s code was patched in libxul.so. Reported overheads, such as about 113% for Chrome and 46% for Firefox on Dromaeo DOM benchmarks with heap-write instrumentation, were measured with the PLDI prototype, with SPEC2006 compiled by GCC in non-PIE mode; they do not describe the current release.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是静态二进制重写与插桩，而非反编译或源码恢复。它依赖前端提供正确的指令位置与长度，假定被修补的代码不会被当作数据读取或自修改，并假定输入本身未使用重叠指令。各项策略都可能失败：约 1,050 万个修补位置中有 1,098 个未能修补；仅用基线方法时，跳转指令覆盖率为 72.79%，堆写指令为 81.63%；非 PIE 二进制比 PIE 更难处理。由于 Chrome 的代码段混有数据，需从 ChromeMain 之后开始反汇编；Firefox 的代码则在 libxul.so 中修补。报告的开销（例如对堆写指令插桩后，在 Dromaeo DOM 基准上 Chrome 约 113%、Firefox 约 46%）是用 PLDI 原型测得的，SPEC2006 以 GCC 非 PIE 模式编译；这些数据不代表当前版本。
why_fits_en: Adds a control-flow-agnostic static rewriting technique for stripped x86-64 binaries, a foundation for patching and instrumenting binaries whose structure has not been recovered, complementing the section’s lifting and decompilation research.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种不依赖控制流的剥离符号 x86-64 二进制静态重写技术，可用于修补与插桩尚未恢复结构的二进制，与本节的提升及反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the archived ACM page give the three authors, the PLDI 2020 proceedings and pages 151–163; ACM metadata uses sentence case. The PDF is the 13-page author’s version on Gregory J. Duck’s NUS page, linked from the repository README, and the ACM page holds the version of record. The reviewed 2026-06-28 repository commit describes x86_64 Linux ELF executables and shared objects, GPL-3.0 with some MIT-licensed files, and states that the current version is significantly improved over the prototype evaluated in the PLDI paper, with new optimizations, improved physical page grouping and slightly higher coverage.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 ACM 页面存档给出三位作者、PLDI 2020 论文集及第 151–163 页；ACM 元数据采用句首大写。PDF 为 Gregory J. Duck 在 NUS 页面上提供的 13 页作者版本，仓库 README 亦链接此文件，版本记录以 ACM 页面为准。所审阅的 2026-06-28 仓库提交说明其适用于 x86_64 Linux ELF 可执行文件与共享库，采用 GPL-3.0，部分文件采用 MIT 许可，并说明当前版本相较 PLDI 论文评测的原型有显著改进，包括新的优化、改进的物理页分组以及略有提高的覆盖率。

title: LaTCoder: Converting Webpage Design to Code with Layout-as-Thought
title_zh: LaTCoder：以“布局即思维”将网页设计转换为代码
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives 3 August 2025 for both online and print publication; this date is not inferred solely from the August 3–7 conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2025 年 8 月 3 日；该日期并非仅根据 8 月 3 日至 7 日的会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2

description_en: LaTCoder converts webpage design images to HTML/CSS by making layout an explicit intermediate step. A rule-based divider recursively finds solid-colored horizontal or vertical lines that avoid OCR-detected text, then merges small regions into grid-aligned blocks. An MLLM writes code for each block with a chain-of-thought prompt. The blocks are then assembled by absolute positioning or by the MLLM, and a reference-free verifier combining MAE and CLIP picks the better result. The paper also introduces CC-HARD, 128 complex-layout pages manually sampled from Common Crawl.
description_zh: LaTCoder 将布局作为显式的中间步骤，把网页设计图转换为 HTML/CSS。基于规则的分割器递归寻找不穿过 OCR 识别文本的纯色水平或垂直线，再将过小区域合并为网格对齐的图块。多模态大语言模型使用思维链提示为每个图块编写代码；随后以绝对定位或由模型组装各图块，并由结合 MAE 与 CLIP、无需参考答案的验证器选出较优结果。论文还提出 CC-HARD，包含从 Common Crawl 人工抽取的 128 个复杂布局网页。
scope_limitations_en: Targets static HTML/CSS from a design image; JavaScript behavior, interactions, navigation and backends are outside the method, and it does not recover a site's original source. Evaluation uses Design2Code-HARD (80 pages) and CC-HARD (128 pages), scoring generated code and screenshots against references with TreeBLEU, CLIP, Visual Score and MAE. Reported gains are relative changes on small absolute scores: with DeepSeek-VL2 on CC-HARD, TreeBLEU rises from 0.09 to 0.15 (+66.67%), and CLIP falls slightly on Design2Code-HARD. The divider assumes rectangular, solid-colored separators and fixed pixel thresholds; the block-merge area was tuned on CC-HARD. Short-context models use absolute positioning only, which fixes block positions from the design. Block content can still be misplaced, and Gemini sometimes omitted blocks during assembly. Pairwise human preference (at least 60% for LaTCoder) covers GPT-4o on CC-HARD only, by majority vote of six annotators. GPT-4o, Gemini and DeepSeek-VL2 results are historical baselines, not current rankings.
scope_limitations_zh: 方法面向根据设计图生成静态 HTML/CSS；JavaScript 行为、交互、导航和后端均不在方法范围内，也不恢复网站原始源码。评测使用 Design2Code-HARD（80 个页面）与 CC-HARD（128 个页面），以 TreeBLEU、CLIP、Visual Score 和 MAE 将生成的代码与截图同参考答案比较。报告的提升是较小绝对分数上的相对变化：在 CC-HARD 上使用 DeepSeek-VL2 时，TreeBLEU 从 0.09 升至 0.15（+66.67%），而在 Design2Code-HARD 上 CLIP 略有下降。分割器假定存在矩形纯色分隔线，并使用固定像素阈值；图块合并面积阈值在 CC-HARD 上调定。短上下文模型只使用绝对定位，图块位置由设计图固定。图块内容仍可能错位，Gemini 在组装时有时会遗漏图块。成对人工偏好评测（LaTCoder 至少获 60% 偏好）仅覆盖 CC-HARD 上的 GPT-4o，由六名标注者多数投票决定。GPT-4o、Gemini 与 DeepSeek-VL2 的结果是历史基线，并非当前排名。
why_fits_en: Adds layout-first, block-wise screenshot-to-code generation with explicit assembly and verification, complementing DCGen's divide-and-conquer prompting and end-to-end website reconstruction benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 补充先确定布局、再按图块生成截图对应代码，并显式组装与验证的方法，与 DCGen 的分治提示及端到端网站重建基准互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and arXiv agree on the 13-author order and DOI. arXiv v1 of 2025-08-05 is the KDD-formatted paper, with comment “KDD 2025 v2”; the ACM landing page refused automated retrieval, so bibliographic details follow Crossref. The paper links examples/latcoder on the naturalcc main branch. The reviewed snapshot is main at 5f840620 (2026-06-02); the directory was added on 2025-09-25. The repository is MIT-licensed at its root; the example README also says MIT but links a LICENSE file absent from that directory, and its project-page link is malformed. The directory contains the divider, generation and assembly agents, adapted Design2Code baselines, evaluation for MAE, Visual Score, CLIP and TreeBLEU, a human-evaluation notebook, and data/CC-HARD.parquet. That file matches the byte size of the Hugging Face dataset xcodemind/CC-HARD, which has 128 image–HTML rows under a CC-BY-4.0 card. Design2Code-HARD and the DCGen baseline must be obtained separately. requirements.txt pins openai 1.55.3, google-generativeai 0.8.3 and transformers 4.45.2, but installs CLIP and DeepSeek-VL from moving main branches plus a vLLM nightly wheel. GPT-4o is called through Azure OpenAI with placeholder credentials; DeepSeek-VL2 is served through vLLM. The paper reports runs on four A800 80 GB GPUs.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 arXiv 的 13 位作者顺序及 DOI 一致。2025-08-05 的 arXiv v1 为 KDD 排版论文，备注为“KDD 2025 v2”；ACM 页面拒绝自动访问，因此书目信息以 Crossref 为准。论文链接至 naturalcc 主分支中的 examples/latcoder。所审阅的快照为 main 分支 5f840620（2026-06-02）；该目录于 2025-09-25 加入。仓库根目录采用 MIT 许可；示例 README 也称 MIT，但其链接的 LICENSE 文件不在该目录中，项目主页链接格式也有误。目录包含分割器、生成与组装代理、改编的 Design2Code 基线、MAE／Visual Score／CLIP／TreeBLEU 评测、人工评测笔记本以及 data/CC-HARD.parquet。该文件与 Hugging Face 数据集 xcodemind/CC-HARD 的字节大小一致；该数据集含 128 条图像—HTML 记录，数据卡声明 CC-BY-4.0。Design2Code-HARD 与 DCGen 基线需另行获取。requirements.txt 固定 openai 1.55.3、google-generativeai 0.8.3 与 transformers 4.45.2，但 CLIP 和 DeepSeek-VL 从变动的主分支安装，并使用 vLLM 夜间构建 wheel。GPT-4o 通过 Azure OpenAI 调用，凭据为占位值；DeepSeek-VL2 通过 vLLM 提供服务。论文报告在四张 A800 80 GB GPU 上运行。

title: Understanding JavaScript Event-Based Interactions
title_zh: 理解 JavaScript 基于事件的交互
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives 31 May 2014 for both online and print publication, which is also the first day of ICSE 2014; the date comes from the deposit, not from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2014 年 5 月 31 日，这也是 ICSE 2014 的首日；该日期取自出版方元数据，而非会议日程。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Software Engineering

description_en: Clematis helps developers understand a JavaScript web application's runtime behavior from a recorded user session. A proxy instruments JavaScript on the fly to log DOM events, timeouts, XMLHttpRequest phases, function calls and DOM mutations. The trace is grouped into episodes, each with its triggering event, executed functions and resulting DOM changes, linked by temporal and causal edges and shown in an interactive visualization. In an industrial study with 20 developers on the Phormer photo gallery, the authors report 61% higher task accuracy and 47% less completion time than developers using their preferred tools.
description_zh: Clematis 根据录制的用户会话，帮助开发者理解 JavaScript 网页应用的运行时行为。代理在传输过程中对 JavaScript 进行插桩，记录 DOM 事件、定时器、XMLHttpRequest 各阶段、函数调用及 DOM 变更。轨迹被划分为若干情节，每个情节包含触发事件、执行的函数及由此产生的 DOM 变化，情节之间以时间与因果边连接，并以交互式可视化呈现。在 Phormer 相册应用上开展、有 20 名开发者参加的工业研究中，作者报告其任务准确率比使用各自惯用工具的开发者高 61%，完成时间少 47%。
scope_limitations_en: A dynamic program-comprehension aid for client-side behavior exercised in one recorded session; it does not reconstruct server-side logic, generate a replacement application or establish behavioral equivalence. Code run through eval is not captured. Evaluation consists of two small controlled experiments on comprehension tasks: 16 UBC participants on a lab-built survey application against Firebug, and 20 professional developers on Phormer. The authors graded accuracy against a prewritten answer key. Overhead was measured only for one minute of Phormer activity. The 2014 prototype drives Firefox through Selenium and a WebScarab proxy; it is not shown to run on current browsers, and the comparison tools are historical.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是面向单次录制会话中所触发客户端行为的动态程序理解工具；它不重建服务端逻辑，不生成替代应用，也不确立行为等价性。通过 eval 执行的代码不会被捕获。评估包括两项小规模、针对理解任务的对照实验：16 名 UBC 参与者在实验室自建的问卷应用上与 Firebug 对比，以及 20 名专业开发者在 Phormer 上开展的实验。准确率由作者依据事先编写的答案要点评分。运行开销仅针对一分钟的 Phormer 操作进行测量。2014 年的原型通过 Selenium 与 WebScarab 代理驱动 Firefox；未证明其可在当前浏览器上运行，用于比较的工具也已是历史版本。
why_fits_en: Adds execution-trace recovery of a web application's event, timer, request and DOM causality, complementing the collection's screenshot-, design- and video-based website reconstruction research.
why_fits_zh: 补充从执行轨迹恢复网页应用事件、定时器、请求与 DOM 因果关系的研究，与本合集中基于截图、设计稿和视频的网站重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the four-author order, the ICSE ’14 proceedings and pages 367–377; it deposits the title in sentence case. The author-hosted PDF is an 11-page copy carrying the ICSE ’14 permission block. The extended ACM TOSEM 2016 article “Understanding JavaScript Event-Based Interactions with Clematis” (DOI 10.1145/2876441) is a separate work. The paper cites the lab page salt.ece.ubc.ca/software/clematis/, which no longer responds; its 2014-07-08 Internet Archive copy links github.com/saltlab/clematis and technical report UBC-SALT-2014-001. The reviewed repository is GPL-3.0, with master at 7b2479a0 committed on 2015-06-19 and no later pushes. README says the tool runs from Eclipse with the m2e plugin, Maven, a Jetty server and Mozilla Firefox; Chrome support was only planned. It was tested with Phormer and a downloadable survey application. pom.xml targets Java 1.6 and uses Crawljax 2.2 and Rhino 1.7R4, with open-ended ranges for Selenium (from 2.31.0) and WebScarab, so a build today may resolve different dependencies.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认四位作者顺序、ICSE ’14 会议论文集及第 367–377 页；其标题采用句首大写形式。作者托管的 PDF 共 11 页，含 ICSE ’14 版权许可声明。扩展版 ACM TOSEM 2016 文章《Understanding JavaScript Event-Based Interactions with Clematis》（DOI 10.1145/2876441）是独立作品。论文引用的实验室页面 salt.ece.ubc.ca/software/clematis/ 已无法访问；其 2014-07-08 的 Internet Archive 存档链接至 github.com/saltlab/clematis 及技术报告 UBC-SALT-2014-001。所审阅仓库采用 GPL-3.0 许可，master 分支位于 2015-06-19 提交的 7b2479a0，此后再无推送。README 说明该工具需在 Eclipse（含 m2e 插件）中运行，并需要 Maven、Jetty 服务器和 Mozilla Firefox；Chrome 支持仅在计划中。工具曾用 Phormer 和一个可下载的问卷应用测试。pom.xml 面向 Java 1.6，使用 Crawljax 2.2 与 Rhino 1.7R4，并对 Selenium（自 2.31.0 起）和 WebScarab 使用无上限版本范围，因此现在构建可能解析到不同依赖。

title: Is This the Same Code? A Comprehensive Study of Decompilation Techniques for WebAssembly Binaries
title_zh: 这还是同一份代码吗？WebAssembly 二进制反编译技术的全面研究
date_basis: Springer’s Crossref deposit gives published-online and issued date 2025-09-01, labelled First Online, and print year 2026. The October 2024 conference dates and the 2024-11-04 arXiv submission are not substituted for this publication date.
date_basis_zh: Springer 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线出版及 issued 日期记为 2025-09-01（标注为 First Online），纸质出版年份为 2026。本条目不以 2024 年 10 月的会议日期或 2024-11-04 的 arXiv 提交日期替代该出版日期。

citation.container_title: Security and Privacy in Communication Networks
citation.series: Lecture Notes of the Institute for Computer Sciences, Social Informatics and Telecommunications Engineering

description_en: Measures how well existing WebAssembly decompilers recover C, with native-binary decompilers as the baseline. The same C programs are compiled with Emscripten to WebAssembly and with clang to native code, then decompiled by wasm2c, w2c2 and wasm-decompile or by Ghidra and RetDec. Correctness reuses 1,000 Csmith programs from DecFuzzer, recompiling the output and comparing its execution with the original; code-complexity metrics and AST similarity to the original source are measured on PolyBenchC and CHStone at -O0 to -O2. wasm2c passed all 1,000 correctness programs, against 649 for wasm-decompile, 818 for Ghidra and 775 for RetDec.
description_zh: 以原生二进制反编译器为基线，衡量现有 WebAssembly 反编译器恢复 C 代码的能力。同一批 C 程序分别经 Emscripten 编译为 WebAssembly、经 clang 编译为原生代码，再由 wasm2c、w2c2 与 wasm-decompile，或由 Ghidra 与 RetDec 反编译。正确性评测复用 DecFuzzer 的 1,000 个 Csmith 程序，将输出重新编译并与原程序的执行结果比较；代码复杂度指标及与原始源码的 AST 相似度则在 PolyBenchC 和 CHStone 上以 -O0 至 -O2 测量。wasm2c 通过了全部 1,000 个正确性程序，wasm-decompile、Ghidra 和 RetDec 分别为 649、818 和 775 个。
scope_limitations_en: Correctness covers only generated single functions with local-variable arithmetic and no library calls, pointers or global state, so the wasm2c result does not establish correctness on general programs. w2c2 is excluded from the correctness test, and wasm-decompile output could be parsed for structural similarity only at -O0. Native baselines pass through DecFuzzer’s syntax rewriter, and the authors note that some Ghidra and RetDec failures may come from that evaluation step rather than the decompilers. Readability is estimated from metrics such as lines of code, nesting depth, cyclomatic and Halstead complexity, gotos and casts, not from a human study. The benchmarks are C suites compiled by the authors with one Emscripten/clang toolchain, not real-world WebAssembly modules, and tool versions are described only as the latest available at the time.
scope_limitations_zh: 正确性评测仅覆盖生成的单个函数，其中只有局部变量算术运算，不含库调用、指针或全局状态，因此 wasm2c 的结果不能证明其在一般程序上的正确性。w2c2 未纳入正确性评测，wasm-decompile 的输出仅在 -O0 下能被解析用于结构相似度评测。原生基线经过 DecFuzzer 的语法改写器处理，作者指出 Ghidra 与 RetDec 的部分失败可能源于这一评测步骤而非反编译器本身。可读性依据代码行数、嵌套深度、圈复杂度、Halstead 复杂度、goto 与类型转换数量等指标估计，并非人工研究。基准是作者使用单一 Emscripten／clang 工具链编译的 C 程序集，而非真实环境中的 WebAssembly 模块；工具版本仅说明为当时的最新版本。
why_fits_en: Adds an empirical baseline for existing WebAssembly decompilers, complementing the LLM-based WebAssembly decompilation papers and native decompiler correctness testing in this section.
why_fits_zh: 为现有 WebAssembly 反编译器提供实证基线，与本节基于大语言模型的 WebAssembly 反编译论文及原生反编译器正确性测试互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the chapter in the LNICST book Security and Privacy in Communication Networks, pages 108–130, with conference information for SecureComm 2024 (the 20th edition, Dubai, 28–30 October 2024). Crossref gives no series volume number, so none is recorded. The Springer landing page refused automated requests; the description and limitations rest on the 13-page arXiv v1 manuscript, whose footer names SecureComm 2024. The paper says its benchmark and analysis framework will be open-sourced but gives no URL, and no release was found.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 将该章节收录于 LNICST 丛书《Security and Privacy in Communication Networks》，第 108–130 页，会议信息为 SecureComm 2024（第 20 届，迪拜，2024 年 10 月 28–30 日）。Crossref 未给出丛书卷号，因此不予记录。Springer 文章页面拒绝自动化请求；简介与局限依据 13 页的 arXiv v1 稿件，其页脚标明 SecureComm 2024。论文称将开源其基准与分析框架，但未给出网址，也未找到相应发布。

title: Revisiting Binary Code Similarity Analysis Using Interpretable Feature Engineering and Lessons Learned
title_zh: 基于可解释特征工程重新审视二进制代码相似性分析及经验教训
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit gives the volume 49, issue 4 print issue date as 2023-04-01, represented at month precision. The 2020-11-21 arXiv v1 date and the June 2022 acceptance note are not substituted for the journal issue date.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 向 Crossref 登记的第 49 卷第 4 期纸本刊期日期为 2023-04-01，本目录采用月份精度；不以 2020-11-21 的 arXiv v1 日期或 2022 年 6 月的录用说明替代期刊刊期日期。

citation.container_title: IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
citation.publisher: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)

description_en: Builds BinKit, a reproducible cross-compilation benchmark of 243,128 binaries and 36,256,322 functions from 51 GNU packages, covering 1,352 combinations of eight architectures, nine GCC and Clang versions, five optimization levels, and PIE, LTO, no-inline and Obfuscator-LLVM options. TikNib, an interpretable baseline over simple presemantic function features, measures how compilers, options and architectures change those features. The authors report that a few basic features approach a deep-learning tool’s accuracy, that type features push AUC above 0.99, and trace failures to IDA Pro analysis errors, compiler back-end differences and architecture-specific code.
description_zh: 构建可复现的交叉编译基准 BinKit，包含由 51 个 GNU 软件包生成的 243,128 个二进制和 36,256,322 个函数，覆盖八种架构、九个 GCC 与 Clang 版本、五个优化级别，以及 PIE、LTO、禁止内联和 Obfuscator-LLVM 等选项构成的 1,352 种组合。可解释基线 TikNib 基于简单的前语义函数特征，衡量编译器、编译选项与架构如何改变这些特征。作者报告称，少量基本特征即可接近深度学习工具的准确率，加入类型特征后 AUC 超过 0.99，并将失败案例归因于 IDA Pro 分析错误、编译器后端差异和架构特定代码。
scope_limitations_en: Studies function-level, presemantic (syntactic and structural) features on Linux GNU packages compiled from source with debugging information for ground truth; semantic features, NLP-based models and whole-binary or other similarity tasks are outside the evaluation. The above-0.99 AUC uses argument and return types derived from source via Ctags and debugging information, not types recovered from stripped binaries. The state-of-the-art comparison sets TikNib’s AUC on VulSeeker’s ASE datasets against VulSeeker’s author-reported numbers rather than a re-run, and omits the original firmware images. Obfuscation covers Obfuscator-LLVM substitution, bogus control flow and flattening applied once. Experiments used IDA Pro 6.95, and the authors cannot rule out erroneous MIPS feature extraction. The results do not rank later learned or LLM-based models.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究对象是函数级的前语义（语法与结构）特征，样本为从源码编译、带调试信息以构建真实标签的 Linux GNU 软件包；语义特征、基于 NLP 的模型以及整个二进制或其他相似性任务不在评测范围内。AUC 超过 0.99 的结果所用参数与返回类型通过 Ctags 和调试信息从源码获得，并非从剥离符号的二进制中恢复。与现有最优方法的比较是将 TikNib 在 VulSeeker 的 ASE 数据集上的 AUC 与 VulSeeker 作者报告的数值对照，而非重新运行，并且省略了原论文使用的固件映像。混淆仅涵盖 Obfuscator-LLVM 的指令替换、虚假控制流和控制流平坦化，且只应用一次。实验使用 IDA Pro 6.95，作者也无法排除 MIPS 特征提取有误的可能。结果不能用于对后续学习模型或大语言模型方法排名。
why_fits_en: Adds a public, reproducible benchmark and interpretable baseline for binary function matching, and documents how compiler settings and disassembler errors bias similarity results, complementing learned models such as jTrans.
why_fits_zh: 补充二进制函数匹配的公开可复现基准与可解释基线，并记录编译设置和反汇编器错误如何使相似性结果产生偏差，与 jTrans 等学习模型互补。
metadata_notes: IEEE TSE 49(4), pages 1661–1682; Crossref records a CC BY 4.0 license from 2023-04-01. The reviewed arXiv v4 (2022-07-07) notes acceptance in June 2022; its running header still reads November 2020, a template date rather than the publication date. The IEEE and Crossref title capitalizes “Using”, while arXiv uses “using”. At reviewed BinKit commit f6565a3 (2023-12-15, MIT), the README describes BinKit 2.0 with 371,928 binaries, 1,904 option combinations, 23 compilers and an added Ofast level, which the paper did not evaluate; its BinKit 1.0 section matches the paper’s 243,128 binaries and 1,352 combinations, counting four obfuscation options as compilers (13 in total), and was tested on Ubuntu 16.04. Paper-version datasets, feature pickles and toolchains download from Google Drive. TikNib, the analysis tool, is a separate MIT repository reviewed at 3b7c165 (2025-05-18); its README gives IDA Pro 6.95 scripts for the paper setup and separate IDA Pro 7.5 scripts.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE TSE 第 49 卷第 4 期，页码 1661–1682；Crossref 记录自 2023-04-01 起适用 CC BY 4.0 许可。所审阅的 arXiv v4（2022-07-07）注明于 2022 年 6 月录用；其页眉仍为 2020 年 11 月，这是模板日期而非出版日期。IEEE 与 Crossref 标题中的 “Using” 首字母大写，arXiv 则写作 “using”。在所审阅的 BinKit 提交 f6565a3（2023-12-15，MIT）中，README 介绍了 BinKit 2.0，包含 371,928 个二进制、1,904 种选项组合、23 个编译器并新增 Ofast 级别，论文并未评测该版本；README 的 BinKit 1.0 部分与论文的 243,128 个二进制和 1,352 种组合一致，将四种混淆选项计为编译器（共 13 个），并在 Ubuntu 16.04 上测试。论文版数据集、特征 pickle 文件与工具链需从 Google Drive 下载。分析工具 TikNib 是独立的 MIT 仓库，审阅提交为 3b7c165（2025-05-18）；其 README 为论文设置提供 IDA Pro 6.95 脚本，另提供 IDA Pro 7.5 脚本。

title: Decompiling x86 Deep Neural Network Executables
title_zh: 反编译 x86 深度神经网络可执行文件
date_basis: The BibTeX on the USENIX presentation page gives August 2023 for the 32nd USENIX Security Symposium proceedings. Month precision is retained; the August 9–11 symposium dates are not substituted for a publication day, and the 2022 arXiv dates belong to the extended preprint.
date_basis_zh: USENIX 论文页面的 BibTeX 将第 32 届 USENIX Security 研讨会论文集的出版时间列为 2023 年 8 月。本条目保留月份精度，不以 8 月 9–11 日的会议日期代替具体出版日；2022 年的 arXiv 日期属于扩展版预印本。

citation.container_title: 32nd USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 23)

description_en: BTD (Bin to DNN) decompiles stripped 64-bit x86 executables emitted by deep-learning compilers into model specifications: operator types, network topology, dimensions and parameters. A learned classifier labels disassembled functions as DNN operators, Intel Pin dynamic analysis chains them, and taint-reduced, trace-based symbolic execution with per-operator patterns recovers dimensions and parameter layouts. The authors rebuild recovered models in PyTorch and recompile them to compare behaviour with the original executable.
description_zh: BTD（Bin to DNN）将深度学习编译器生成、已剥离符号的 64 位 x86 可执行文件反编译为模型规格：算子类型、网络拓扑、维度与参数。学习得到的分类器把反汇编函数标注为 DNN 算子，Intel Pin 动态分析将算子串联起来，再在经污点分析裁剪的执行轨迹上进行符号执行，借助针对各算子的模式恢复维度与参数布局。作者在 PyTorch 中重建恢复出的模型并重新编译，以便与原可执行文件比较行为。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluated only on 64-bit x86 executables from TVM v0.7, v0.8 and v0.9.dev (-O0 and -O3), three Glow snapshots from 2020–2022 and NNFusion v0.2/v0.3; GPU, accelerator and other-architecture executables are discussed, not decompiled. It assumes flawless disassembly and function recovery (IDA Pro 7.5 in the paper) and known compilation provenance, and dimension/parameter patterns are hand-designed per operator: 22 of 36 ONNX operators needing such patterns are covered, excluding quantized operators such as QLinearConv. The authors report correct specifications for 59 of 65 executables from seven CV models and FastText; one TVM -O3 ResNet18 Conv layout required manual fixing with ground truth, and NNFusion compiled only its own VGG11. Recompiled behaviour is compared on 100 ImageNet images or 50 crafted FastText inputs, not proven for all inputs. Obfuscated executables were not evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测仅覆盖由 TVM v0.7、v0.8、v0.9.dev（-O0 与 -O3）、2020–2022 年的三个 Glow 快照以及 NNFusion v0.2/v0.3 生成的 64 位 x86 可执行文件；GPU、加速器及其他架构的可执行文件只作讨论，未被反编译。方法假定反汇编与函数恢复完全正确（论文使用 IDA Pro 7.5），且编译来源已知；维度与参数模式需针对各算子人工设计：需要此类模式的 36 个 ONNX 算子中覆盖了 22 个，不含 QLinearConv 等量化算子。作者报告在来自七个计算机视觉模型和 FastText 的 65 个可执行文件中，有 59 个得到正确规格；一个 TVM -O3 ResNet18 卷积算子的参数布局需借助真实标签人工修正，NNFusion 也只能编译其自带的 VGG11。重新编译后的行为仅在 100 张 ImageNet 图片或 50 条人工构造的 FastText 输入上比较，并未证明对全部输入一致。未评测经过混淆的可执行文件。
why_fits_en: Extends decompilation beyond C/C++ programs to compiled machine-learning models, recovering a rebuildable high-level specification from optimized native code.
why_fits_zh: 将反编译从 C/C++ 程序扩展到已编译的机器学习模型，从优化后的本机代码中恢复可重建的高层规格。
metadata_notes: The USENIX presentation-page BibTeX establishes the five-author order, proceedings title, pages 7357–7374 and August 2023. arXiv v2 (2022-10-04; v1 2022-10-03) is the authors' 25-page extended version, which the 19-page final paper cites for omitted details; figures in this record follow the final paper. The paper-linked monkbai/DNN-decompiler snapshot reviewed at commit 33227a0 (2026-03-13) carries HKUST's Academic Software License, which limits use to academic or nonprofit research and directs commercial users to the institution; GitHub reports no SPDX license. README prerequisites include Ubuntu 18.04, Python 3.6.9+, PyTorch 1.9+, Intel Pin 3.14 and optionally IDA Pro 7.5, which is commercial and not included; disassembly outputs are supplied instead. The authors report more than a week of single-threaded trace logging and nearly 1 TB of storage for the full evaluation, so the artifact ships filtered traces via a Docker image and Dropbox/Zenodo archives. Zenodo dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7219867 (CC BY 4.0) identifies the artifact, not the paper. The README's 63-executable evaluation covers TVM and Glow only, omitting the paper's two NNFusion builds, and reports Available, Functional and Reproduced badges.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 论文页面的 BibTeX 确认了五位作者的顺序、论文集名称、页码 7357–7374 以及 2023 年 8 月。arXiv v2（2022-10-04；v1 为 2022-10-03）是作者 25 页的扩展版，19 页的正式论文以其补充省略的细节；本条目中的数据以正式论文为准。论文链接的 monkbai/DNN-decompiler 仓库在所审阅的提交 33227a0（2026-03-13）中采用香港科技大学的 Academic Software License，仅允许学术或非营利研究使用，商业用户需联系该机构；GitHub 未识别出 SPDX 许可证。README 列出的前提包括 Ubuntu 18.04、Python 3.6.9+、PyTorch 1.9+、Intel Pin 3.14，以及可选的 IDA Pro 7.5；IDA Pro 为商业软件且未随附，仓库改为提供反汇编结果。作者称完整评测需要单线程记录轨迹超过一周、占用近 1 TB 存储，因此产物通过 Docker 镜像与 Dropbox／Zenodo 压缩包提供过滤后的轨迹。Zenodo 数据集 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7219867（CC BY 4.0）标识的是产物而非论文。README 中 63 个可执行文件的评测只覆盖 TVM 与 Glow，未包括论文中的两个 NNFusion 构建，并说明产物获得 Available、Functional 与 Reproduced 徽章。

title: Decompiling Smart Contracts with a Large Language Model
title_zh: 利用大语言模型反编译智能合约
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no later version, journal reference or proceedings publication was found.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未找到后续版本、期刊引用信息或会议论文集出版记录。
description_en: Converts Ethereum Virtual Machine bytecode into Solidity in two stages. Static analysis first lifts the bytecode into three-address code with recovered control flow; a Llama-3.2-3B model fine-tuned with LoRA on 238,446 TAC-to-Solidity function pairs then writes each function. On 9,731 held-out functions from verified Ethereum contracts, the authors report average semantic similarity of 0.82 to the original source, with 78.3% of functions above 0.8. An ablation compares the untuned base model on 663 functions, and case studies decompile an unverified Dx Protocol contract and an exploited MEV bot.
description_zh: 分两个阶段将以太坊虚拟机字节码转换为 Solidity。首先通过静态分析把字节码提升为带有恢复控制流的三地址码；随后由基于 238,446 对三地址码—Solidity 函数、以 LoRA 微调的 Llama-3.2-3B 模型逐个生成函数。作者在来自已验证以太坊合约的 9,731 个留出函数上报告，与原始源码的平均语义相似度为 0.82，78.3% 的函数高于 0.8。消融实验在 663 个函数上比较未微调的基础模型，案例研究则反编译了一个未验证的 Dx Protocol 合约和一个遭攻击的 MEV 机器人合约。
scope_limitations_en: The 0.82 figure is the paper’s semantic-similarity score, whose computation v1 does not specify. With normalized edit distance and token-frequency comparisons, it measures resemblance to verified source, not behavioral equivalence; v1 reports no compilation, execution or differential tests of the generated Solidity. Training and test functions come from verified contracts, so closed-source deployments appear only in case studies. Comparisons with traditional decompilers are stated in general terms; no head-to-head experiment against a named decompiler such as Elipmoc is reported. The authors show a DeFi staking function whose output lost its fixed-point arithmetic and time-based reward logic (similarity 0.52), and report weaker results on very long functions and on contracts with deep inheritance or nested control flow.
scope_limitations_zh: 0.82 是论文自定的语义相似度分数，v1 未说明其计算方式。该分数与归一化编辑距离、词元频率比较一起，衡量的是与已验证源码的相似程度，而非行为等价性；v1 未报告对生成的 Solidity 进行编译、执行或差分测试。训练与测试函数均来自已验证合约，闭源部署仅出现在案例研究中。与传统反编译器的比较只是笼统表述，未报告与 Elipmoc 等具名反编译器的直接对比实验。作者展示了一个 DeFi 质押函数，其输出丢失了定点运算与基于时间的奖励逻辑（相似度 0.52），并报告在超长函数以及继承层次深或控制流嵌套深的合约上效果较弱。
why_fits_en: Adds fine-tuned LLM decompilation of EVM bytecode through an explicit three-address-code stage, complementing prompt-based EVM decompilation and the native-code LLM decompilers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充经由显式三地址码阶段、使用微调大语言模型反编译 EVM 字节码的方法，与本节基于提示词的 EVM 反编译及面向原生代码的大语言模型反编译器互补。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1, the only version, which has no comment, journal reference or DOI. Crossref and OpenAlex searches found no peer-reviewed version. The paper says its evaluation dataset and metrics code are publicly available but gives no URL, and it does not name the bytecode-to-TAC analysis it uses; no model weights, training data or code release was found. The project link is the service named in the paper. On 2026-10-20 its landing page described an LLM-based decompiler with pricing and API pages and linked no code or model.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 arXiv v1，即唯一版本，其中没有注释、期刊引用信息或 DOI。在 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 中检索未找到经同行评审的版本。论文称评估数据集与指标计算代码已公开，但未给出网址，也未说明所用的字节码到三地址码分析；未找到模型权重、训练数据或代码发布。项目链接是论文所述的在线服务。2026-10-20 其首页介绍的是基于大语言模型的反编译器，并设有定价与 API 页面，未链接代码或模型。

title: SCDBench: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Smart Contract Decompilers
title_zh: SCDBench：基于大语言模型的智能合约反编译器基准
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no later version, journal reference or proceedings publication was found.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未找到后续版本、期刊引用信息或会议论文集出版记录。
description_en: Benchmarks LLM-based EVM decompilation on 600 source-verified Ethereum Solidity contracts, sampled in easy, medium and hard thirds from 772,736 unique bytecode–source pairs after near-duplicate filtering. Each task supplies EVM assembly and optional four-byte selector hints and asks for self-contained Solidity with compiler settings. Outputs are scored in four cumulative stages: format completeness, compilation, ABI recovery, and semantic consistency, where 227,383 recorded test cases for 14,553 public functions are replayed on the recompiled output. With one compiler-feedback repair call, GPT-5.3-Codex compiled 90.3% of contracts, while the best semantic results were 29.4% of functions and 42 of 600 contracts recovered perfectly, both by Claude Opus 4.7.
description_zh: 在 600 个源码已验证的以太坊 Solidity 合约上评测基于大语言模型的 EVM 反编译。这些合约在近重复过滤后，从 772,736 对唯一的字节码—源码中按简单、中等、困难各三分之一抽样。每个任务提供 EVM 汇编及可选的四字节选择器提示，要求输出自包含的 Solidity 代码与编译器设置。输出按四个累进阶段评分：格式完整性、编译、ABI 恢复，以及语义一致性；最后一阶段在重新编译的输出上重放为 14,553 个公共函数记录的 227,383 个测试用例。借助一次基于编译器反馈的修复调用，GPT-5.3-Codex 使 90.3% 的合约成功编译；语义方面的最佳结果均来自 Claude Opus 4.7，即 29.4% 的函数一致，600 个合约中有 42 个被完全恢复。
scope_limitations_en: Replay compares return data, reverts, logs and touched storage on generated inputs that reach 77.8% average code coverage; passing it is not proof of equivalence, and replay needs an Ethereum archive node. The contracts are source-verified Ethereum Solidity from compiler v0.4 to v0.8, so unverified, obfuscated, Vyper or other-chain bytecode is not covered. Three models are evaluated zero-shot through OpenRouter: Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.3-Codex at high reasoning effort, and GLM-5 with and without extended thinking. Results and quoted costs describe those 2026 snapshots. Gigahorse and Heimdall-rs are scored only on selector and prototype recovery because they do not emit compilable Solidity; DiSCo and the fine-tuned decompiler of David et al. are discussed but not run.
scope_limitations_zh: 重放在生成的输入上比较返回数据、回滚、日志和被访问的存储变化，这些输入平均达到 77.8% 的代码覆盖率；通过重放并不能证明等价，而且重放需要以太坊归档节点。合约均为源码已验证、编译器版本 v0.4 至 v0.8 的以太坊 Solidity 合约，因此不覆盖未验证、经混淆、Vyper 或其他链上的字节码。论文通过 OpenRouter 对三个模型进行零样本评测：高推理强度的 Claude Opus 4.7 与 GPT-5.3-Codex，以及开启和关闭扩展思考的 GLM-5。结果与所列成本仅对应这些 2026 年的模型快照。Gigahorse 与 Heimdall-rs 因不生成可编译的 Solidity，仅评测选择器与函数原型恢复；DiSCo 和 David 等人的微调反编译器仅在文中讨论，并未运行。
why_fits_en: Adds a shared benchmark with execution-based semantic checks for smart-contract decompilers, complementing EVM decompilation papers that evaluate on separate datasets and metrics.
why_fits_zh: 为智能合约反编译器提供带有基于执行的语义检查的共同基准，与使用各自数据集和指标评测的 EVM 反编译论文互补。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1, the only version, which is labelled a preprint and has no comment, journal reference or DOI. The paper says the benchmark dataset and evaluation artifacts, including prompts, scripts and model outputs, are provided, and its broader-impact appendix describes a released dataset, but v1 gives no URL. GitHub and Hugging Face searches found no release. Compilation and replay use solc and Foundry.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 arXiv v1，即唯一版本，其标注为预印本，没有注释、期刊引用信息或 DOI。论文称提供基准数据集及评估产物（包括提示词、脚本和模型输出），其社会影响附录也提到已发布的数据集，但 v1 未给出网址。在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 上检索未找到相应发布。编译与重放使用 solc 和 Foundry。

title: Rico: A Mobile App Dataset for Building Data-Driven Design Applications
title_zh: Rico：用于构建数据驱动设计应用的移动应用数据集
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives 20 October 2017 for both online and print publication; this precedes the October 22–25 conference dates printed in the paper and is not inferred from them.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2017 年 10 月 20 日；该日期早于论文所印 10 月 22 日至 25 日的会议日期，并非据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 30th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology

description_en: Rico is a dataset of Android app designs and a runtime mining system that needs no access to or modification of app source code. Crowd workers used free Google Play apps through a web interface to a device farm, recording interaction traces. An automated crawler then replayed each trace and kept exploring, using a screenshot-and-resource-id similarity heuristic to identify new UI states. The paper reports 10,811 traces and 72,219 unique UIs from 9,772 apps in 27 categories. Each UI has a screenshot, augmented view hierarchy, explored interactions, transition animations and a 64-dimensional autoencoder layout vector.
description_zh: Rico 是一个 Android 应用设计数据集，也是一套无需获取或修改应用源码的运行时挖掘系统。众包人员通过网页界面使用设备农场中的免费 Google Play 应用，并记录交互轨迹。自动爬虫随后重放每条轨迹并继续探索，借助基于截图与 resource-id 的相似度启发式识别新的界面状态。论文报告共获得来自 27 个类别、9,772 个应用的 10,811 条轨迹和 72,219 个唯一界面。每个界面附有截图、增强的视图层级、已探索的交互、转场动画，以及由自编码器得到的 64 维布局向量。
scope_limitations_en: A dataset and collection system, not a reconstruction method: the paper proposes UI code generation and interaction modeling as possible uses but does not generate code or reconstruct apps. It records UIs and interactions reached during human sessions capped at 10 minutes, each followed by one hour of automated crawling, not complete app behavior, backend logic or source code. Multimedia, productivity and personalization categories were excluded, and only free apps were mined. Coverage was evaluated on 10 popular apps by counting unique UIs, a measure that depends on the similarity heuristic (6% false-positive and 3% false-negative rates on 1,044 labeled pairs). The demonstrated application is autoencoder-based layout similarity search with qualitative examples. The 2017 snapshot will age as apps change.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是数据集与采集系统，而非重建方法：论文将界面代码生成和交互建模列为可能用途，但本身并不生成代码或重建应用。它记录的是每次不超过 10 分钟的人工会话及其后各一小时自动爬取所触达的界面与交互，并非完整应用行为、后端逻辑或源码。多媒体、效率与个性化类别被排除，且只挖掘免费应用。覆盖率在 10 个热门应用上以唯一界面数衡量，该度量依赖相似度启发式（在 1,044 对标注样本上假阳性率 6%、假阴性率 3%）。论文展示的应用是基于自编码器的布局相似度检索，并以定性示例说明。随着应用更新，这份 2017 年快照会逐渐过时。
why_fits_en: Adds a large runtime-mined corpus of Android screenshots, view hierarchies and interaction traces that the paper proposes for UI code generation and interaction modeling, complementing the collection's screenshot-to-code app reconstruction papers.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个通过运行时挖掘获得的大规模 Android 截图、视图层级与交互轨迹语料，论文将其提出用于界面代码生成与交互建模，与本合集中从截图生成代码的应用重建论文互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref, the paper PDF and the project's BibTeX agree on the eight-author order, UIST ’17 proceedings and DOI; Crossref supplies pages 845–854. The author-hosted PDF is the 10-page ACM-formatted paper; no arXiv version was found. The paper's link interactionmining.org/rico now redirects to the archive page, while the older rico.html path returns 404. The archive page differs from the paper: its abstract and dataset description cite more than 9.3k apps and 66k unique UIs, so the released v0.1 files should not be assumed to match the paper's 9,772 apps and 72,219 UIs. Separate downloads include screenshots with view hierarchies (6 GB), traces (6 GB), animations (214 GB), metadata, layout vectors and later semantic annotations. The linked copyright notice says screenshots may contain copyrighted work and makes downloaders accept University of Illinois terms. These disclaim warranties, require the researcher to indemnify the Rico team and university, permit sharing with associates who accept the same terms, and bind a commercial employer. No separate code release is linked.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref、论文 PDF 与项目提供的 BibTeX 在八位作者顺序、UIST ’17 会议论文集及 DOI 上一致；页码 845–854 取自 Crossref。作者托管的 PDF 是 10 页 ACM 排版论文；未找到 arXiv 版本。论文中的链接 interactionmining.org/rico 现重定向至存档页面，旧路径 rico.html 返回 404。存档页面与论文不同：其摘要和数据集说明给出的是超过 9.3k 个应用与 66k 个唯一界面，因此不应假定发布的 v0.1 文件与论文中的 9,772 个应用和 72,219 个界面一致。可分别下载截图及视图层级（6 GB）、轨迹（6 GB）、动画（214 GB）、元数据、布局向量以及后来加入的语义标注。所链接的版权声明指出截图可能含受版权保护的作品，下载者须接受伊利诺伊大学的条款：条款不提供任何担保，要求研究者就使用产生的索赔为 Rico 团队与该大学提供补偿，允许与同样接受条款的合作者共享，并约束商业机构雇主。未链接单独的代码发布。

title: Binary Code Summarization: Benchmarking ChatGPT/GPT-4 and Other Large Language Models
title_zh: 二进制代码摘要：ChatGPT／GPT-4 及其他大语言模型的基准评测
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no later version, journal reference or proceedings publication was found.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未找到后续版本、期刊引用信息或会议论文集出版记录。
description_en: BinSum benchmarks LLMs on summarizing binary functions in natural language.
