The authors compile 44 GNU projects with GCC 7.5 for x86, x64, ARM and MIPS at -O0 to -O3, match 557,664 binary functions to developer comments as reference summaries, and present each function as raw bytes, assembly, IDA microcode or decompiled code with and without symbols. GPT-4, ChatGPT, Llama 2 and Code Llama receive prompts selected from 320 GPT-4-generated candidates, with the fine-tuned BinT5 as a baseline; outputs are scored by embedding similarity alongside BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L. Decompiled code is the most useful representation, and stripping symbols lowers the average similarity score from 0.449 to 0.202.
description_zh: BinSum 评测大语言模型以自然语言概括二进制函数的能力。作者使用 GCC 7.5 将 44 个 GNU 项目编译为 x86、x64、ARM 和 MIPS 架构、-O0 至 -O3 优化级别的二进制，把 557,664 个二进制函数与开发者注释匹配作为参考摘要，并以原始字节、汇编、IDA 微码，以及带或不带符号的反编译代码等形式呈现每个函数。GPT-4、ChatGPT、Llama 2 与 Code Llama 使用从 320 个由 GPT-4 生成的候选中选出的提示词，并以经过微调的 BinT5 作为基线；输出以嵌入相似度并结合 BLEU、METEOR 与 ROUGE-L 评分。反编译代码是最有用的表示形式，剥离符号会使平均相似度分数从 0.449 降至 0.202。
scope_limitations_en: Reference summaries are developer comments extracted from source, which the authors note may be inconsistent with the code. Embedding similarity with all-mpnet-base-v2 and n-gram metrics measure closeness to those comments, not whether a summary is correct or useful to an analyst, and no human evaluation is reported. All binaries are open-source GNU programs built with one GCC version, and the authors note that firmware, malware and obfuscated code are not covered. Prompts were chosen on 1,000 randomly sampled functions. The results describe the June 2023 gpt-4-0613 and gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 snapshots and the 7B and 13B Llama 2 and Code Llama models, so they do not rank current models.
scope_limitations_zh: 参考摘要是从源码中提取的开发者注释，作者指出这些注释可能与代码不一致。基于 all-mpnet-base-v2 的嵌入相似度和 n-gram 指标衡量的是与这些注释的接近程度，而非摘要是否正确或对分析人员有用；论文未报告人工评估。所有二进制均为使用同一 GCC 版本构建的开源 GNU 程序，作者指出固件、恶意软件和混淆代码不在覆盖范围内。提示词基于随机抽取的 1,000 个函数选出。结果对应 2023 年 6 月的 gpt-4-0613 与 gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 快照，以及 7B 和 13B 规模的 Llama 2 与 Code Llama 模型，不能据此对当前模型排名。
why_fits_en: Adds a dedicated large-scale benchmark for natural-language summaries of binary functions, a task that appears elsewhere in the bibliography only as one part of broader binary-analysis benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个专门针对二进制函数自然语言摘要的大规模基准；该任务在本书目的其他条目中仅作为更广泛二进制分析基准的一部分出现。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1, the only version, which has no comment, journal reference or DOI; a Crossref search found no peer-reviewed version. The paper says its code and dataset are released at github.com/xinjin95/BinSum, but at the reviewed commit, last pushed on 2023-12-18, that repository holds only a README whose Dataset section reads “Coming soon”. It has no license file, and its arXiv badge shows the wrong identifier 2312.02120 while linking to 2312.09601. The authors report 4,058,297,977 inference tokens, US$11,418 in model execution costs and 873 A100 GPU hours.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 arXiv v1，即唯一版本，其中没有注释、期刊引用信息或 DOI；在 Crossref 中检索未找到经同行评审的版本。论文称代码与数据集发布于 github.com/xinjin95/BinSum，但在所审阅的提交（最后推送于 2023-12-18）中，该仓库只有一个 README，其 Dataset 章节写着“Coming soon”。仓库没有许可证文件，其 arXiv 徽章显示错误的编号 2312.02120，链接却指向 2312.09601。作者报告共消耗 4,058,297,977 个推理词元、11,418 美元模型运行费用和 873 个 A100 GPU 小时。

title: How Far Have We Gone in Binary Code Understanding Using Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型理解二进制代码的能力已走多远
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit gives published/print and issued date 2024-10-06, which is also the first day of the conference listed there (6–11 October). This entry uses the publisher-deposited date and does not derive it from the conference schedule or the arXiv history.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版及 issued 日期记为 2024-10-06，这也是其中所列会议（10 月 6–11 日）的首日。本条目采用出版方提交的日期，并非依据会议日程或 arXiv 历史推定。

citation.container_title: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)

description_en: Benchmarks 16 code and general LLMs on function name recovery and summarization of stripped binaries. The benchmark takes 12 popular C projects built for x86-64, strips and decompiles 28 binaries with IDA Pro, aligns 81,185 functions with source through DWARF, and keeps 2,000 functions after expert review. Zero-shot LLMs are compared with SymLM, NER, BinT5 and HexT5. Code Llama 34B leads name recovery with token-level F1 of 27.59, and ChatGPT leads summarization with BLEU-4 7.37. The study also measures few-shot prompting, LoRA fine-tuning of two 7B models on GNU binaries, and a case study on a stripped open-source Linux remote-access trojan.
description_zh: 在剥离符号二进制的函数名恢复与代码摘要两项任务上，评测 16 个代码领域与通用领域的大语言模型。基准选取 12 个热门 C 项目编译为 x86-64，剥离并用 IDA Pro 反编译 28 个二进制，借助 DWARF 将 81,185 个函数与源码对齐，经专家审核后保留 2,000 个函数。零样本大语言模型与 SymLM、NER、BinT5 和 HexT5 进行比较。Code Llama 34B 在函数名恢复上以 27.59 的词元级 F1 领先，ChatGPT 在摘要任务上以 7.37 的 BLEU-4 领先。研究还考察了少样本提示、两个 7B 模型基于 GNU 二进制的 LoRA 微调，以及针对一个剥离符号的开源 Linux 远程访问木马的案例研究。
scope_limitations_en: The benchmark covers x86-64 builds with each project’s default compiler and optimization settings and IDA Pro pseudocode only, so the results do not establish behavior on other architectures, optimization levels, decompilers or obfuscated code, which the authors exclude. Reference summaries were generated by ChatGPT from source and screened by three experts, and ChatGPT is also an evaluated model. BLEU-4, METEOR and Rouge-L measure overlap with those references, which the authors say may not fit binary summarization. Name recovery uses token-level precision, recall and F1 rather than exact matches. Fine-tuning used 30,000 functions from O0 x86-64 GNU builds. Results describe model versions released between mid-2023 and early 2024, including gpt-3.5-turbo-16k.
scope_limitations_zh: 基准仅覆盖按各项目默认编译器与优化设置构建的 x86-64 二进制及 IDA Pro 伪代码，因此结果不能说明在其他架构、优化级别、反编译器或混淆代码上的表现；作者明确未考虑混淆。参考摘要由 ChatGPT 根据源码生成，并经三位专家筛查，而 ChatGPT 本身也是被评测的模型。BLEU-4、METEOR 与 Rouge-L 衡量的是与这些参考摘要的重合度，作者也指出这些指标未必适合二进制代码摘要。函数名恢复采用词元级精确率、召回率与 F1，而非完全匹配。微调使用来自 O0 级 x86-64 GNU 构建的 30,000 个函数。结果对应 2023 年中至 2024 年初发布的模型版本，包括 gpt-3.5-turbo-16k。
why_fits_en: Adds a benchmark of LLMs on two core reverse-engineering subtasks, recovering function names and summarizing decompiled functions, with comparisons against earlier learned symbol-recovery models.
why_fits_zh: 补充针对两项核心逆向子任务（恢复函数名与概括反编译函数）的大语言模型基准，并与早期基于学习的符号恢复模型进行比较。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the nine-author order, DOI, ICSME 2024 proceedings title and pages 1–12. Reviewed arXiv v3 (2024-10-24), whose comment reads “to be published in ICSME 2024”; v1 and v2 date from 15 and 16 April 2024. The IEEE Xplore page refused automated requests. The paper gives no download link for the benchmark, fine-tuning data or prompts, and no release was found. The evaluated pseudocode depends on IDA Pro, a commercial decompiler.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认九位作者顺序、DOI、ICSME 2024 论文集名称及第 1–12 页。审阅了 arXiv v3（2024-10-24），其注释为“to be published in ICSME 2024”；v1 与 v2 分别提交于 2024 年 4 月 15 日和 16 日。IEEE Xplore 页面拒绝自动化请求。论文未给出基准、微调数据或提示词的下载链接，也未找到相应发布。所评测的伪代码依赖商业反编译器 IDA Pro。

title: Cross-Inlining Binary Function Similarity Detection
title_zh: 跨内联的二进制函数相似性检测
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records published/print and online publication on 2024-04-12. The date comes from that publisher deposit, not from the April 14–20 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-04-12；该日期取自出版方元数据，而非 4 月 14–20 日的会议日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the IEEE/ACM 46th International Conference on Software Engineering

description_en: Studies binary function similarity when function inlining makes one binary function correspond to several source functions. From BinKit builds of 51 GNU projects with and without -fno-inline (9 GCC and Clang versions, O0–O3, six x86, ARM and MIPS targets; 216 combinations each), debug-line mappings label 5,621,140 cross-inlining pairs. The authors identify Leaf-, Root- and Internal-Inlining patterns, show that Gemini, SAFE and GMN lose accuracy on them, and propose CI-Detector, which trains one attributed-CFG graph neural network per pattern and aggregates their scores, reporting 81% precision and 97% recall.
description_zh: 研究函数内联使一个二进制函数对应多个源码函数时的二进制函数相似性检测。作者基于 BinKit，将 51 个 GNU 项目分别在启用与禁用 -fno-inline 的条件下编译（9 个 GCC 与 Clang 版本、O0–O3、x86、ARM 与 MIPS 共六种目标，各 216 种组合），并利用调试行号映射标注 5,621,140 个跨内联函数对。作者归纳出叶内联、根内联与内部内联三种模式，表明 Gemini、SAFE 与 GMN 在这些模式上准确率下降，并提出 CI-Detector：针对每种模式训练一个基于属性控制流图的图神经网络，再聚合各模型得分，报告精确率为 81%、召回率为 97%。
scope_limitations_en: The three patterns are derived from the authors’ own matrix of 51 GNU projects, and the authors note that other compilation settings, such as non-default optimizations, or projects with different inlining conventions may not fit the learned models. Labels depend on IDA Pro and DWARF debug tools, which the authors list as threats to construct validity, and ACFGs come from IDA Pro 7.3, so disassembly errors can affect results. Precision and recall come from balanced sets of 40,000 positive and 40,000 negative test pairs with a threshold tuned for F1, not from large-pool search. Baselines are released Gemini, SAFE and GMN models plus Bingo-style inlining strategies with Asm2Vec. Obfuscated binaries and LLM-based similarity models are not evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: 三种模式源自作者自行构建的 51 个 GNU 项目编译矩阵；作者指出，非默认优化等其他编译设置，或采用不同内联惯例的项目，可能不适用于已学习的模型。标签依赖 IDA Pro 与 DWARF 调试工具，作者将其列为构造效度威胁；属性控制流图由 IDA Pro 7.3 构建，反汇编错误可能影响结果。精确率与召回率来自各含 40,000 个正例与 40,000 个负例的平衡测试对，并按 F1 调整阈值，而非大规模候选池检索。基线为已发布的 Gemini、SAFE 与 GMN 模型，以及结合 Asm2Vec 的 Bingo 式内联策略。研究未评估混淆二进制或基于大语言模型的相似性模型。
why_fits_en: Adds inlining-aware function matching, complementing similarity studies that disable inlining and single-model records such as jTrans.
why_fits_zh: 补充考虑内联的函数匹配研究，与关闭内联的相似性测量研究及 jTrans 等单一模型条目互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the arXiv v1 PDF, the only version and marked as the ICSE 2024 camera-ready, agree on the six-author order; Crossref gives pages 1–13. The paper’s reference 16 prints the repository URL with a line break. At reviewed commit ff606dd (2026-04-20), the repository declares AGPL-3.0 in a LICENSE file added that day, about two years after publication, and earlier snapshots carried no license file. The README links two Google Drive archives built with BinKit and says the workflow reuses code from Cisco-Talos/binary_function_similarity; it requires IDA Pro, Docker and nvidia-docker. Its training step builds a NeuralNetwork/ Docker context that is absent from the reviewed tree, and no trained CI-Detector checkpoints are included.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 arXiv v1 PDF（唯一版本，标注为 ICSE 2024 定稿）的六位作者顺序一致；Crossref 给出页码 1–13。论文参考文献 16 中的仓库 URL 存在换行。在所审阅的提交 ff606dd（2026-04-20）中，仓库通过当日新增的 LICENSE 文件声明 AGPL-3.0，距论文发表约两年，此前的快照没有许可证文件。README 链接两个基于 BinKit 构建的 Google Drive 压缩包，并说明流程复用 Cisco-Talos/binary_function_similarity 的代码；运行需要 IDA Pro、Docker 与 nvidia-docker。其训练步骤构建的 NeuralNetwork/ Docker 上下文不在所审阅的目录树中，仓库也未包含已训练的 CI-Detector 检查点。

title: How Machine Learning Is Solving the Binary Function Similarity Problem
title_zh: 机器学习如何解决二进制函数相似性问题
date_basis: Publication month from the official USENIX BibTeX (month = aug) and the final PDF cover for the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, August 10–12, 2022; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方 BibTeX（month = aug）及第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium（2022 年 8 月 10–12 日）最终版 PDF 封面所载的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 31st USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 22)

description_en: Measures binary function similarity research by re-implementing ten representative approaches from the security, programming-language and machine-learning communities in one IDA Pro-based framework, from fuzzy hashing (Catalog1, FunctionSimSearch) to graph neural network, NLP-encoder and transformer models. Two new datasets support six tasks that vary optimization, compiler, bitness and architecture, scored by AUC and ranking metrics, plus a firmware vulnerability-search case. The authors report that fuzzy hashing fails in harder cross-architecture settings, GNN-based models perform best in almost all tasks, and many recent models score similarly on common data.
description_zh: 在统一的、基于 IDA Pro 的框架中重新实现来自安全、程序语言与机器学习三个研究社区的十种代表性方法，对二进制函数相似性研究开展测量，方法涵盖模糊哈希（Catalog1、FunctionSimSearch）以及图神经网络、NLP 编码器与 Transformer 模型。两个新数据集支撑六项改变优化级别、编译器、位宽与架构的任务，以 AUC 和排序指标评分，另含一项固件漏洞搜索案例。作者报告称，模糊哈希在较难的跨架构场景中失效，基于图神经网络的模型几乎在所有任务中表现最佳，许多近期模型在相同数据上的得分相近。
scope_limitations_en: A 2022 comparison of the authors’ re-implementations, not of the original papers’ code or reported numbers, which the authors did not try to reproduce; CodeCMR was run by its own authors, and Trex was tested only on Dataset-2 with its authors’ model. Dynamic-analysis, symbolic-execution and other slow direct-comparison approaches were excluded by design, and LLM-based similarity models are not covered. Dataset-1 compiles seven open-source projects (ClamAV, Curl, Nmap, OpenSSL, Unrar, Z3, Zlib) with GCC and Clang for x86-64, ARM and MIPS in 32 and 64 bit at O0–O3 and Os with function inlining disabled, and drops functions under five basic blocks. Dataset-2 reuses ten GCC 7.5 projects released by the Trex authors. Feature extraction depends on IDA Pro 7.3; BinaryAI covered only part of the data because a recent Hex-Rays MIPS decompiler license was unavailable. The firmware case searches ten OpenSSL functions in two images. Obfuscated code is not evaluated, and the results are not a current ranking.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是 2022 年对作者自行重新实现版本的比较，并非对原论文代码或所报告数值的比较，作者也未尝试复现这些数值；CodeCMR 由其原作者运行，Trex 仅在 Dataset-2 上使用其作者提供的模型测试。研究按设计排除了动态分析、符号执行及其他较慢的直接比较方法，也不涵盖基于大语言模型的相似性模型。Dataset-1 使用 GCC 与 Clang，在关闭函数内联的条件下，将七个开源项目（ClamAV、Curl、Nmap、OpenSSL、Unrar、Z3、Zlib）编译为 x86-64、ARM 与 MIPS 的 32 位及 64 位版本，优化级别为 O0–O3 与 Os，并剔除少于五个基本块的函数。Dataset-2 复用 Trex 作者发布的十个 GCC 7.5 项目。特征提取依赖 IDA Pro 7.3；由于缺少较新的 Hex-Rays MIPS 反编译器许可证，BinaryAI 仅覆盖部分数据。固件案例在两个映像中搜索十个 OpenSSL 函数。研究未评估混淆代码，结果也不代表当前排名。
why_fits_en: Adds a common-framework measurement of binary function matching, which reverse engineers use to transfer labels from known functions to stripped code, complementing single-model records such as jTrans and BinaryAI.
why_fits_zh: 补充在统一框架下对二进制函数匹配的测量研究；逆向工程人员借助函数匹配，将已知函数的标签迁移到剥离符号的代码上。该研究与 jTrans、BinaryAI 等单一模型条目互补。
metadata_notes: No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified; the record uses the reviewed USENIX Security presentation-page and sec22-marcelli.pdf profile. The USENIX BibTeX gives the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, pages 2099–2116, USENIX Association and month August; the presentation page also links a prepublication PDF and slides. The repository README lists errata for a Section 3.2 statement on BinDiff and Diaphora cross-architecture support and for the Figure 2 captions. At reviewed commit f0da093 (2024-05-15), repository code is MIT-licensed, but the README lists GPL-3.0 (Catalog1, SAFE, IDA CodeCMR plugin), LGPL-2.1 (Gensim-based Asm2vec), Apache-2.0 (FunctionSimSearch, GGSNN/GMN) and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (GNN-s2v) components; compiled binaries keep their own licenses. Binaries (about 15 GB) and extracted features (about 38 GB) download from Google Drive, and generating new IDBs or features requires IDA Pro.
metadata_notes_zh: 未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符；本条目采用经审阅的 USENIX Security 报告页面与 sec22-marcelli.pdf 配对规则。USENIX BibTeX 给出第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium、页码 2099–2116、出版方 USENIX Association 及八月份；报告页面另链接预发表版 PDF 与幻灯片。仓库 README 列出勘误，涉及第 3.2 节关于 BinDiff 与 Diaphora 跨架构支持的表述及图 2 说明。在所审阅的提交 f0da093（2024-05-15）中，仓库代码采用 MIT 许可证，但 README 列出 GPL-3.0（Catalog1、SAFE、IDA CodeCMR 插件）、LGPL-2.1（基于 Gensim 的 Asm2vec）、Apache-2.0（FunctionSimSearch、GGSNN/GMN）及 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（GNN-s2v）组件；编译出的二进制保留各自许可证。二进制（约 15 GB）与提取的特征（约 38 GB）需从 Google Drive 下载，生成新的 IDB 或特征需要 IDA Pro。

title: PoE-World: Compositional World Modeling with Products of Programmatic Experts
title_zh: PoE-World：基于程序化专家乘积的组合式世界建模
date_basis: The publisher-deposited Crossref record for the NeurIPS 2025 proceedings gives 2025; no publication month or day is asserted. Neither the proceedings page's 2026-04-23 citation date nor the November–December 2025 conference dates are used as a publication date.
date_basis_zh: 出版方为 NeurIPS 2025 论文集提交的 Crossref 记录给出 2025 年；不推定出版月份或日期。论文集页面元数据中的 2026-04-23 引用日期和 2025 年 11–12 月的会议日期均不作为出版日期。

citation.container_title: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

description_en: PoE-World represents an Atari world model as an exponentially weighted product of many small Python programs, or programmatic experts, each synthesized by an LLM to explain one aspect of the observed dynamics; learned weights and optional synthesized hard constraints combine them. From object lists that OCAtari parses out of a demonstration of fewer than 1,000 frames, the authors learn stochastic, partially observed models of Pong and Montezuma's Revenge and use them in a planning agent, including on rearranged Pong-Alt and Montezuma's Revenge-Alt variants that have no demonstrations.
description_zh: PoE-World 将 Atari 世界模型表示为许多小型 Python 程序（即程序化专家）的指数加权乘积，每个专家由大语言模型合成，用于解释观测动态中的一个方面；学习得到的权重和可选的合成硬约束把它们组合起来。作者从 OCAtari 在不足 1,000 帧的演示中解析出的对象列表出发，学习 Pong 与 Montezuma's Revenge 的随机、部分可观测模型，并将其用于规划智能体，包括没有演示的重排变体 Pong-Alt 和 Montezuma's Revenge-Alt。
scope_limitations_en: Models consume symbolic object lists, not pixels, and OCAtari had to be patched manually for each game, so evaluation covers only Pong and Montezuma's Revenge plus two author-built variants. The learned programs approximate observed dynamics and are not the games' original code: next-observation prediction accuracy on 1,000 random test frames is 0.06 for Pong and 0.31 for Montezuma's Revenge, and object-attribute accuracy is 0.66 and 0.76. Synthesized experts build on manually written helper classes and contact functions and were generated with gpt-4o-2024-08-06. Exploration and reward learning are outside the method; agent scores use 5 seeds and at most 3k training steps after the demonstration, and the planner reached the key in 5 of 9 Montezuma's Revenge tries.
scope_limitations_zh: 模型输入是符号化的对象列表而非像素，且每个游戏都需人工修补 OCAtari，因此评测仅覆盖 Pong 与 Montezuma's Revenge 以及作者构建的两个变体。学到的程序只是对观测动态的近似，并非游戏原始代码：在 1,000 个随机测试帧上，下一观测预测准确率在 Pong 上为 0.06，在 Montezuma's Revenge 上为 0.31；对象属性准确率分别为 0.66 和 0.76。合成的专家依赖人工编写的辅助类和接触判断函数，并由 gpt-4o-2024-08-06 生成。探索与奖励学习不在方法范围内；智能体得分基于 5 个随机种子，演示之后最多训练 3k 步；在 Montezuma's Revenge 上，规划器在 9 次尝试中有 5 次拿到钥匙。
why_fits_en: Adds compositional program synthesis of executable game-dynamics models for non-grid Atari games, extending the code-world-model line beyond grid, text and puzzle environments.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向非网格 Atari 游戏、以组合式程序合成构建可执行游戏动态模型的研究，将代码世界模型从网格、文本和谜题环境向外扩展。
metadata_notes: Title, author order and DOI agree across the NeurIPS proceedings page, the Crossref deposit, the final PDF and arXiv. The proceedings metadata and Crossref give the first author as Top Piriyakulkij; this record uses Wasu Top Piriyakulkij as printed in the final PDF, on arXiv and in the repository README. The proceedings page lists pages 26609–26638 while Crossref lists 30165–30194, so no page range is recorded. arXiv v4 (2025-11-19) was reviewed. The README headline calls the paper a NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight, which the proceedings page does not state, and its arXiv badge text reads 2401.02739 while linking to 2505.10819. The MIT-licensed repository snapshot at b499fb1 (2026-02-05) targets Python 3.10, pins most dependencies, and uses MIT-licensed submodules for OpenAI API access and a patched OCAtari fork; runs need a user-supplied OpenAI API key, and the Atari environments come through Gymnasium and the Arcade Learning Environment under their own terms. The snapshot includes seed-0 learned world models for Pong and Montezuma's Revenge and a Pitfall run script that the paper does not evaluate.
metadata_notes_zh: NeurIPS 论文集页面、Crossref 记录、正式 PDF 与 arXiv 的标题、作者顺序和 DOI 一致。论文集元数据与 Crossref 将第一作者记为 Top Piriyakulkij；本条目采用正式 PDF、arXiv 和仓库 README 中的 Wasu Top Piriyakulkij。论文集页面列出页码 26609–26638，Crossref 则为 30165–30194，因此不记录页码范围。核查的是 arXiv v4（2025-11-19）。README 标题称论文为 NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight，但论文集页面并未说明；其 arXiv 徽章文字写作 2401.02739，链接却指向 2505.10819。采用 MIT 许可的仓库快照 b499fb1（2026-02-05）面向 Python 3.10，固定了大部分依赖版本，并以同为 MIT 许可的子模块提供 OpenAI API 调用封装和修改过的 OCAtari 分支；运行需要用户自备 OpenAI API 密钥，Atari 环境经由 Gymnasium 与 Arcade Learning Environment 提供，适用其各自条款。该快照包含种子 0 下学到的 Pong 与 Montezuma's Revenge 世界模型，以及论文未评测的 Pitfall 运行脚本。

title: Guided GUI Testing of Android Apps with Minimal Restart and Approximate Learning
title_zh: 以最少重启与近似学习引导的 Android 应用图形界面测试
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata for the proceedings DOI gives 29 October 2013 for both online and print publication. The SIGPLAN Notices copy lists a separate print date of 12 November 2013; neither date is inferred from the SPLASH conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 为会议论文集 DOI 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2013 年 10 月 29 日。SIGPLAN Notices 版本另列印刷日期 2013 年 11 月 12 日；两者均非根据 SPLASH 会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2013 ACM SIGPLAN international conference on Object oriented programming systems languages & applications

description_en: SwiftHand generates test inputs for Android apps while learning an approximate GUI model during testing. It instruments Dalvik bytecode to read the GUI component tree and derive each screen's enabled touch, scroll, text, Back and Menu inputs; screens with the same enabled inputs are treated as equivalent states of an extended deterministic labeled transition system. The learned model steers execution toward unexplored frontier states and avoids restarts, since reinstalling an app took about 30 seconds. On 10 F-Droid apps, the authors report higher branch coverage than random and L*-based testing within the time budget, reached faster.
description_zh: SwiftHand 在为 Android 应用生成测试输入的同时，于测试过程中学习近似的图形界面模型。它对 Dalvik 字节码插桩，读取界面组件树，并推导每个屏幕可用的触摸、滚动、文本、返回键和菜单键输入；可用输入相同的屏幕被视为扩展确定性标记迁移系统中的等价状态。学习得到的模型引导执行进入尚未探索的前沿状态，并尽量避免重启，因为重新安装一次应用约需 30 秒。在 10 个 F-Droid 应用上，作者报告其在给定时间预算内的分支覆盖率高于随机测试和基于 L* 的测试，且达到覆盖率的速度更快。
scope_limitations_en: A test-generation technique whose learned model is an approximate abstraction for guiding exploration, not a complete or exact GUI specification or a reimplementation of the app. States are identified only by their sets of enabled inputs and merged heuristically; tab views and similar designs caused state explosion and low coverage. The implementation rejects apps with a native main entry, works correctly only on Android 4.1 or later, and cannot handle apps that store data on remote servers, so such apps were excluded from the benchmark. Evaluation covers 10 F-Droid apps under Android 4.1.2: eight ran on emulators with a 3-hour budget and two on a Galaxy Nexus phone with 1 hour. Random testing caught up on some small apps given more time. The 2013 tool is not shown to run on current Android releases.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一种测试生成技术，所学模型只是用于引导探索的近似抽象，并非完整或精确的图形界面规约，也不是应用的重新实现。状态仅以可用输入集合区分，并以启发式方式合并；标签页视图等设计会导致状态爆炸和覆盖率偏低。实现不支持主入口为原生代码的应用，只在 Android 4.1 及更高版本上正常工作，也无法处理在远程服务器上存储数据的应用，这些应用因此被排除在基准之外。评估覆盖 Android 4.1.2 上的 10 个 F-Droid 应用：其中八个在模拟器上运行、预算 3 小时，两个在 Galaxy Nexus 手机上运行、预算 1 小时。对部分小型应用，随机测试在更长时间后可追平覆盖率。未证明这款 2013 年的工具可在当前 Android 版本上运行。
why_fits_en: Adds execution-driven inference of an Android app's GUI state model, complementing the collection's screenshot- and design-based app reconstruction papers with behavioral model recovery.
why_fits_zh: 补充由执行驱动推断 Android 应用图形界面状态模型的研究，以行为模型恢复补足本合集中基于截图和设计稿的应用重建论文。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the three-author order, the OOPSLA 2013 proceedings within SPLASH ’13 and pages 623–640; it deposits the title in sentence case, while this entry keeps the capitalization printed in the paper. The same article also appears in ACM SIGPLAN Notices volume 48, issue 10, pages 623–640, under DOI 10.1145/2544173.2509552; this entry uses the proceedings DOI. The author-hosted PDF is a 17-page copy created on 2013-08-11 with the proceedings DOI. The paper names github.com/wtchoi/SwiftHand. The reviewed master snapshot b2b45acd is dated 2015-01-13, with no later pushes, and README describes it as a working demo of the version submitted to OOPSLA ’13. LICENSE.txt is a three-clause BSD-style text with a 2013 copyright of The Regents of the University of California; GitHub reports no recognized SPDX license. README requires JDK 6 or 7, Maven 3, Android SDK tools including chimpchat, Scala 2.9.1 and ASMDEX revision 1665 or older. To reproduce the paper, it recommends a Nexus S emulator at API level 16, with internet access disabled through a DNS setting. dist/ contains a prebuilt jar plus instrumented APKs of the ten benchmark apps and two unmodified APKs; those third-party apps keep their own terms.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认三位作者顺序、SPLASH ’13 中的 OOPSLA 2013 会议论文集及第 623–640 页；其标题采用句首大写形式，本条目保留论文所印的大小写。同一文章也收录于 ACM SIGPLAN Notices 第 48 卷第 10 期第 623–640 页，DOI 为 10.1145/2544173.2509552；本条目使用会议论文集 DOI。作者托管的 PDF 共 17 页，创建于 2013-08-11，载有会议论文集 DOI。论文指明代码位于 github.com/wtchoi/SwiftHand。所审阅的 master 快照 b2b45acd 日期为 2015-01-13，此后再无推送；README 称其为提交 OOPSLA ’13 版本的可运行演示。LICENSE.txt 为三条款 BSD 风格文本，版权归加州大学董事会（2013 年）；GitHub 未识别出 SPDX 许可证。README 要求 JDK 6 或 7、Maven 3、含 chimpchat 的 Android SDK 工具、Scala 2.9.1 以及 1665 或更早修订版的 ASMDEX。为复现论文，它建议使用 API 级别 16 的 Nexus S 模拟器，并通过 DNS 设置禁用网络访问。dist/ 包含预构建 jar、十个基准应用的插桩 APK 以及两个未修改的 APK；这些第三方应用保留各自条款。

title: WAFFLE: Fine-tuning Multi-Modal Model for Automated Front-End Development
title_zh: WAFFLE：面向自动化前端开发的多模态模型微调
date_basis: The official ACL Anthology record gives July 2025. Crossref records only the year; the July 27–August 1 conference dates printed in the PDF are not treated as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: ACL Anthology 官方记录给出 2025 年 7 月。Crossref 仅记录年份；PDF 所印 7 月 27 日至 8 月 1 日的会议日期不作为出版日。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

description_en: WAFFLE fine-tunes multimodal LLMs to generate HTML/CSS from UI screenshots. A quarter of the decoder's attention heads use a structure-aware mask that limits each element's tokens to its parent, preceding siblings and its own earlier tokens. A contrastive objective aligns image and code embeddings over groups of four mutated WebSight-v0.1 pages. With VLM-WebSight and Moondream2 backbones, the authors report up to 9.00 pp higher HTML-Match and 0.0982 higher CW-SSIM than standard fine-tuning on WebSight-Test, plus gains on every Design2Code metric.
description_zh: WAFFLE 微调多模态大语言模型，使其根据界面截图生成 HTML/CSS。解码器中四分之一的注意力头使用结构感知掩码，使每个元素的词元只关注其父元素、前序兄弟元素及自身此前的词元。对比学习目标以四个经变异的 WebSight-v0.1 页面为一组，对齐图像与代码嵌入。以 VLM-WebSight 和 Moondream2 为骨干模型时，作者报告在 WebSight-Test 上比标准微调最多高 9.00 个百分点的 HTML-Match 和 0.0982 的 CW-SSIM，在 Design2Code 的各项指标上也均有提升。
scope_limitations_en: Generates static HTML/CSS from a single screenshot; it does not recover a site's original source, scripts, interactions, navigation or backend. HTML-Match strips styles and attributes before requiring pixel-identical renders, while CW-SSIM, CLIP and LLEM are similarity scores; the authors note that these metrics do not fully capture human judgment. Training data and the 500-page WebSight-Test are synthetic WebSight-style pages; Design2Code supplies 484 real-world pages. Only two backbones were fine-tuned, and on Design2Code the Moondream2 model trained with WAFFLE stays below GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini. The Gemini 1.5 Pro baseline answered 384 Design2Code instances. Human ranking used 50 samples per dataset and two annotators. Commercial-model prompting results are historical baselines, not current rankings.
scope_limitations_zh: 方法根据单张截图生成静态 HTML/CSS，并不恢复网站原始源码、脚本、交互、导航或后端。HTML-Match 先去除样式和属性，再要求渲染结果逐像素一致；CW-SSIM、CLIP 与 LLEM 则是相似度分数，作者也指出这些指标不能完全反映人工判断。训练数据及含 500 个页面的 WebSight-Test 均为合成的 WebSight 风格页面；Design2Code 提供 484 个真实网页。仅微调了两种骨干模型；在 Design2Code 上，经 WAFFLE 训练的 Moondream2 模型仍低于 GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o mini。Gemini 1.5 Pro 基线只回答了 384 个 Design2Code 实例。人工排序每个数据集使用 50 个样本，由两名标注者完成。商业模型的提示结果是历史基线，并非当前排名。
why_fits_en: Adds a training method for screenshot-to-HTML website reconstruction that builds DOM hierarchy into attention, complementing the collection's screenshot-to-code benchmarks, datasets and prompting pipelines.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种将 DOM 层级结构引入注意力机制、用于截图到 HTML 网站重建的训练方法，与本合集中的截图转代码基准、数据集及提示流程互补。
metadata_notes: Publication identity follows the ACL Anthology record and PDF. Reviewed arXiv v3 of 2026-03-02 (v1 2024-10-24, v2 2025-06-24) is titled “WAFFLE: Finetuning Multi-Modal Models for Automated Front-End Development”; the repository README and model card use “WAFFLE: Multi-Modal Model for Automated Front-End Development” and cite the arXiv preprint. The paper's availability statement links lt-asset/Waffle. The reviewed 2025-05-28 snapshot is BSD-3-Clause and provides VLM-WebSight inference, Selenium/Chrome rendering, the HTML tree-attention utilities, a contrastive dataset class reading a local load_from_disk dataset, and 500 WebSight-Test PNG screenshots without reference HTML. Although README describes a training file, the snapshot has no training script, Moondream2 code, metric implementation or mutated training set; no public copy of the 231,940-pair set was found in the lt-asset Hugging Face organization. Weights are on Hugging Face as lt-asset/Waffle_VLM_WebSight (7B). The GitHub README releases them under Apache-2.0 subject to the base model's terms, while the model card declares bsd-3-clause-clear. Documented dependencies include Python 3.10.14, PyTorch 2.3.0, Transformers 4.41.1, PEFT 0.11.1 and DeepSpeed 0.14.1; the inference script expects a CUDA GPU and has placeholder paths.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版身份以 ACL Anthology 记录与 PDF 为准。所审阅的 2026-03-02 arXiv v3（v1 为 2024-10-24，v2 为 2025-06-24）题为“WAFFLE: Finetuning Multi-Modal Models for Automated Front-End Development”；仓库 README 和模型卡则使用“WAFFLE: Multi-Modal Model for Automated Front-End Development”，并引用 arXiv 预印本。论文的可用性声明链接至 lt-asset/Waffle。所审阅的 2025-05-28 快照采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可，提供 VLM-WebSight 推理、Selenium/Chrome 渲染、HTML 树注意力工具、读取本地 load_from_disk 数据集的对比学习数据集类，以及 500 张不含参考 HTML 的 WebSight-Test PNG 截图。README 虽提及训练文件，快照中并无训练脚本、Moondream2 代码、指标实现或变异训练集；在 lt-asset 的 Hugging Face 组织中也未找到含 231,940 对样本的数据集公开副本。权重以 lt-asset/Waffle_VLM_WebSight（7B）发布于 Hugging Face。GitHub README 称在遵守基础模型条款的前提下以 Apache-2.0 发布，模型卡则声明 bsd-3-clause-clear。文档列出的依赖包括 Python 3.10.14、PyTorch 2.3.0、Transformers 4.41.1、PEFT 0.11.1 与 DeepSpeed 0.14.1；推理脚本需要 CUDA GPU，路径仍为占位值。

title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
title_zh: 扩散模型即实时游戏引擎
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2025-05-01 is not adopted, and the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。论文集页面 2025-05-01 的引用日期未被采用，也不以 arXiv 日期代替。
description_en: GameNGen learns to simulate DOOM interactively with a diffusion model instead of game code. A PPO agent first plays the game in ViZDoom, and its recorded trajectories, from random to trained play, become the training data. Stable Diffusion v1.4 is then fine-tuned to predict the next frame from the last 64 frames and actions, with noise added to context frames to keep long autoregressive rollouts stable and a fine-tuned latent decoder for detail. With 4 sampling steps it runs at 20 frames per second on one TPU-v5. The authors report next-frame PSNR of 29.43 and human raters picking the real game in 58–60% of short clips.
description_zh: GameNGen 以扩散模型而非游戏代码交互式地模拟 DOOM。首先由 PPO 智能体在 ViZDoom 中游玩，记录下从随机策略到训练后期的轨迹作为训练数据。随后微调 Stable Diffusion v1.4，使其根据最近 64 帧画面与动作预测下一帧；训练时向上下文帧加入噪声，以保持长时间自回归生成的稳定，并微调潜空间解码器以改善细节。使用 4 步采样时，它在单个 TPU-v5 上以每秒 20 帧运行。作者报告下一帧预测 PSNR 为 29.43，人工评估者在短片段中辨认出真实游戏的比例为 58%–60%。
scope_limitations_en: A neural approximation trained on recorded gameplay of an existing game; it recovers no game logic, source code, assets or state representation and is not an exact simulation. The model sees just over 3 seconds of history, so state outside that window survives only through on-screen cues and learned heuristics, which can be wrong; for example, repeated shooting may spawn enemies. Locations and interactions the agent never explored are simulated poorly. Training used 128 TPU-v5e devices and 70M agent frames at 320×240, plus an environment-specific reward function. PSNR is a teacher-forced single-frame measure on 2,048 held-out trajectories from 5 levels; autoregressive rollouts diverge from ground truth after a few steps. Human evaluation used 10 raters on 1.6- and 3.2-second clips and 150 later 3-second clips; the authors say they could often spot the simulation within seconds. Only DOOM was tested, and the model cannot readily create new games.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是基于已有游戏的录制游玩数据训练的神经近似模型；它不恢复任何游戏逻辑、源码、素材或状态表示，也不是精确模拟。模型只能看到略多于 3 秒的历史，超出该窗口的状态只能依靠屏幕线索和习得的启发式维持，而这些启发式可能出错，例如连续射击可能导致生成敌人。对智能体从未探索过的位置与交互，模拟效果较差。训练使用 128 个 TPU-v5e 设备、7,000 万帧 320×240 的智能体数据，以及针对该环境的奖励函数。PSNR 是在 5 个关卡、2,048 条留出轨迹上以教师强制方式测得的单帧指标；自回归生成在数步后便会偏离真实轨迹。人工评估由 10 名评估者观看 1.6 秒和 3.2 秒片段，以及 150 段较晚时刻的 3 秒片段；作者表示自己常能在几秒内认出模拟画面。只在 DOOM 上做了测试，模型也无法便捷地创建新游戏。
why_fits_en: Adds learned, non-symbolic reconstruction of a game's interactive behavior from gameplay, contrasting with the collection's code-based world models and visual game replication research.
why_fits_zh: 补充从游戏过程学习、非符号化地重建游戏交互行为的研究，与本合集中基于代码的世界模型及视觉游戏复刻研究形成对照。
metadata_notes: Authors and title follow the ICLR 2025 proceedings page and PDF, which list pages 73754–73776 and print “Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025”; no DOI is listed. arXiv has two versions with the same title and authors: v1 of 2024-08-27 and v2 of 2025-04-24, whose comment reads “ICLR 2025”. The OpenReview forum P8pqeEkn1H could not be retrieved automatically because of a challenge page. The project page links the paper and videos but no code or weights, and no author-provided code release was found. The paper's reproducibility statement relies on open Stable Diffusion v1.4 weights, the open-source ViZDoom environment and documented training settings. Its reported 50 frames per second uses a distilled single-step model with some quality loss.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者与标题依据 ICLR 2025 论文集页面及 PDF；论文集列出第 73754–73776 页，PDF 印有“Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025”，未列出 DOI。arXiv 有两个标题与作者相同的版本：2024-08-27 的 v1 与 2025-04-24 的 v2，后者备注为“ICLR 2025”。OpenReview 论坛 P8pqeEkn1H 因验证页面无法自动获取。项目页面链接了论文与视频，但没有代码或权重，也未找到作者提供的代码发布。论文的可复现性说明依赖开放的 Stable Diffusion v1.4 权重、开源 ViZDoom 环境及文中记录的训练设置。其报告的每秒 50 帧使用经蒸馏的单步模型，画质有所下降。

title: Pop Quiz! Can a Large Language Model Help With Reverse Engineering?
title_zh: 随堂测验！大语言模型能帮助逆向工程吗？
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no later version, journal reference or proceedings publication was found.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未找到后续版本、期刊引用信息或会议论文集出版记录。
description_en: Tests whether OpenAI’s Codex model code-davinci-001 can answer reverse-engineering questions about C code in a zero-shot question-and-answer prompt. Programs come from templates the authors wrote, covering cybersecurity snippets and industrial-control algorithms such as PID controllers and filters, plus five single-file Linux malware samples from vx-underground. Each is presented as original or name-randomized source, or as Ghidra decompilation of gcc -O1 builds with debug information, without it, or stripped. After exploratory open-ended questions, generated true/false and short-answer questions about purpose, capabilities and key variables are graded against an answer oracle; Codex answered 72,754 of 136,260 questions correctly.
description_zh: 检验 OpenAI 的 Codex 模型 code-davinci-001 能否在零样本问答式提示中回答有关 C 代码的逆向工程问题。程序来自作者编写的模板，涵盖网络安全代码片段以及 PID 控制器、滤波器等工业控制算法，另有五个来自 vx-underground 的单文件 Linux 恶意软件样本。每个程序以原始或名称随机化的源码，或以 gcc -O1 构建（带调试信息、不带调试信息或剥离符号）经 Ghidra 反编译的形式呈现。在探索性的开放式提问之后，作者针对程序用途、能力与关键变量自动生成判断题和简答题，并依据答案标准评分；Codex 在 136,260 个问题中答对 72,754 个。
scope_limitations_en: All results come from one model, code-davinci-001, which OpenAI shut down on 2023-03-23, so they cannot be rerun against the original model and do not describe current LLMs. Accuracy is measured with a generated true/false and short-answer quiz, paired as positive and negated questions to expose answer bias, rather than with analyst tasks; the overall 53.4% led the authors to conclude that LLMs are not yet ready for zero-shot reverse engineering. Programs are small single-file C code that fits the model’s roughly 4,000-token window, compiled only at -O1; the real-malware class has five samples. The answer oracle combines the authors’ labels with capability matches from the capa tool.
scope_limitations_zh: 全部结果均来自单一模型 code-davinci-001，OpenAI 已于 2023-03-23 停用该模型，因此无法针对原模型重跑实验，结果也不代表当前的大语言模型。准确率依据自动生成的判断题与简答题测验衡量，判断题以正反两种表述成对提出以揭示回答偏向，并非真实分析任务；总体 53.4% 的正确率使作者得出大语言模型尚不能胜任零样本逆向工程的结论。程序均为可放入模型约 4,000 词元窗口的小型单文件 C 代码，且只以 -O1 编译；真实恶意软件类别仅有五个样本。答案标准结合了作者标注与 capa 工具的能力匹配结果。
why_fits_en: Records the earliest LLM-for-reverse-engineering evaluation in the bibliography, a baseline for the later LLM binary-analysis studies in this section.
why_fits_zh: 收录本书目中最早的大语言模型逆向工程评测，为本节后续的大语言模型二进制分析研究提供基线。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1, the only version; its comment reads “18 pages, 19 figures” and links Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.5949075, a dataset DOI that is not used as the paper identifier. No peer-reviewed version was found in Crossref. That record (CC BY 4.0, a 692 MB codex-reverse.zip by the same six creators) holds the test framework scripts, recorded Codex responses and generated program instances. The README requires Ghidra and an OpenAI API key, and the build log lists compiled instances under experiments/malware, so the archive appears to include the malware samples.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 arXiv v1，即唯一版本；其注释为“18 pages, 19 figures”，并链接 Zenodo 记录 10.5281/zenodo.5949075。该编号是数据集 DOI，不作为论文标识符。在 Crossref 中未找到经同行评审的版本。该记录（CC BY 4.0，由同样六位作者发布的 692 MB 文件 codex-reverse.zip）包含测试框架脚本、记录的 Codex 回答及生成的程序实例。README 要求 Ghidra 和 OpenAI API 密钥，构建日志列出了 experiments/malware 下的编译实例，可见压缩包似乎包含这些恶意软件样本。

title: D-Helix: A Generic Decompiler Testing Framework Using Symbolic Differentiation
title_zh: D-Helix：基于符号差分的通用反编译器测试框架
date_basis: Publication month from the official USENIX BibTeX (month = aug) and the final PDF cover for the 33rd USENIX Security Symposium, August 14–16, 2024; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方 BibTeX（month = aug）及第 33 届 USENIX Security Symposium（2024 年 8 月 14–16 日）最终版 PDF 封面所载的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 33rd USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 24)

description_en: Tests decompilers function by function on binaries without needing source code. RECOMPILER repairs decompiled C so individual functions recompile, SYMDIFF compares symbolic models of the original binary function and the recompiled decompiled function using patched angr and PROMPT symbolic executors, and TUNER toggles decompiler heuristic rules to locate, and sometimes work around, the rule behind an inaccuracy. On Ghidra 10.0 and angr 9.2.30, 2,004 binaries and object files from coreutils, util-linux and six popular GitHub C projects yield 93K decompiled functions; the authors report 4,515 incorrectly decompiled functions, 8 reproduced known bugs, 17 previously unknown bugs and 7 bugs fixed automatically.
description_zh: 在无需源码的前提下，逐函数测试反编译器对二进制的处理。RECOMPILER 修复反编译所得的 C 代码，使单个函数能够重新编译；SYMDIFF 借助打过补丁的 angr 与 PROMPT 符号执行器，比较原始二进制函数与重新编译后的反编译函数的符号模型；TUNER 通过切换反编译器的启发式规则，定位造成偏差的规则，并在部分情况下予以规避。作者在 Ghidra 10.0 与 angr 9.2.30 上，使用来自 coreutils、util-linux 及六个热门 GitHub C 项目的 2,004 个二进制与目标文件，得到 93K 个反编译函数；报告发现 4,515 个反编译错误的函数，复现 8 个已知缺陷，发现 17 个此前未知的缺陷，并自动修复 7 个缺陷。
scope_limitations_en: Only Ghidra and angr were tested; Hex-Rays, Binary Ninja, RetDec and LLM-based decompilers were not, and the authors estimate that supporting a decompiler with an unsupported IR would take at least 40 days of symbolic-engine work. Results are function-level symbolic equivalence checks on the authors’ 2,004 x86-64 Linux inputs, built with GCC 11.1.0 and Clang 16.0.0 at each project’s default optimization and excluding binaries over 30 MiB. Coverage is partial: RECOMPILER recompiled 72.4% of Ghidra’s and 45.0% of angr’s decompiled functions, and SYMDIFF analyzed 91.3% and 93.9% of those. Symbolic execution bounds loops, uses a two-minute default timeout, treats global variables as constants and does not parse floating-point constraints; accuracy trade-offs cause false positives, measured on 100-function samples per decompiler. TUNER automatically fixed 72 of the 443 inaccuracies it examined. A function passing the check is not proof of whole-program correctness.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅测试了 Ghidra 与 angr，未测试 Hex-Rays、Binary Ninja、RetDec 或基于大语言模型的反编译器；作者估计，若要支持中间表示尚未受支持的反编译器，至少需要 40 天的符号执行引擎开发工作。结果是对作者所选 2,004 个 x86-64 Linux 输入的函数级符号等价检查，这些输入由 GCC 11.1.0 与 Clang 16.0.0 按各项目默认优化选项构建，并排除了大于 30 MiB 的二进制。覆盖并不完整：RECOMPILER 能重新编译 Ghidra 反编译函数的 72.4% 与 angr 反编译函数的 45.0%，SYMDIFF 又分别成功分析其中的 91.3% 与 93.9%。符号执行限制循环次数，默认超时为两分钟，将全局变量视为常量，且不解析浮点约束；精度上的取舍会导致误报，误报情况基于每个反编译器 100 个函数的样本测量。TUNER 在其检查的 443 处偏差中自动修复了 72 处。函数通过检查并不能证明整个程序正确。
why_fits_en: Adds automated, binary-level correctness testing for decompilers, complementing output benchmarks such as DecompileBench and qualitative studies of decompiler fidelity.
why_fits_zh: 补充直接基于二进制的反编译器自动正确性测试，与 DecompileBench 等输出基准及反编译保真度的定性研究互补。
metadata_notes: No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified; the record uses the reviewed USENIX Security 2024 presentation-page and usenixsecurity24-zou.pdf profile. The USENIX BibTeX gives the 33rd USENIX Security Symposium, pages 397–414, USENIX Association and month August; the presentation page also links an appendix PDF, slides and a prepublication PDF. The paper prints github.com/purseclab/Dhelix, which the GitHub API reports as not found; the code link uses purseclab/D-helix, whose README cites this paper. At reviewed commit fda23ef (2024-09-12), the repository declares BSD-3-Clause. Its README pins angr, claripy and pyvex commits for P-code and VEX variants, supplies patches for angr, claripy, PROMPT (built with clang 3.8) and Ghidra commit 15d22e8, and uses Z3 4.9.1. A dataset directory holds 2,004 compiled input files, which remain subject to their upstream projects’ licenses.
metadata_notes_zh: 未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符；本条目采用经审阅的 USENIX Security 2024 报告页面与 usenixsecurity24-zou.pdf 配对规则。USENIX BibTeX 给出第 33 届 USENIX Security Symposium、页码 397–414、出版方 USENIX Association 及八月份；报告页面另链接附录 PDF、幻灯片与预发表版 PDF。论文印有 github.com/purseclab/Dhelix，GitHub API 报告该仓库不存在；代码链接采用 purseclab/D-helix，其 README 引用了本论文。在所审阅的提交 fda23ef（2024-09-12）中，仓库声明 BSD-3-Clause 许可证。README 为 P-code 与 VEX 两种变体固定 angr、claripy 与 pyvex 的提交，提供针对 angr、claripy、PROMPT（使用 clang 3.8 构建）及 Ghidra 提交 15d22e8 的补丁，并使用 Z3 4.9.1。dataset 目录包含 2,004 个已编译的输入文件，这些文件仍受其上游项目许可证约束。

title: Assemblage: Automatic Binary Dataset Construction for Machine Learning
title_zh: Assemblage：面向机器学习的二进制数据集自动构建
date_basis: The official NeurIPS proceedings and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata identify publication year 2024; Crossref provides no finer publication date. The first arXiv submission date is recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 官方论文集与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据标明出版年份为 2024；Crossref 未提供更精确的出版日期。arXiv 首次提交日期另行记录。

citation.container_title: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

description_en: Assemblage is a distributed system that crawls GitHub and vcpkg, builds C/C++ projects under many compiler configurations, and records source-to-binary mappings such as function addresses, source code, comments and PDB or DWARF debug information. Run on AWS for about a year, it produced 890k Windows PE binaries built with Visual Studio 2015–2022 across optimization levels, architectures and Debug/Release modes, plus 428k Linux ELF binaries from GCC and Clang, in 29 configurations. Case studies use the data for compiler provenance with PassTell, function similarity with a graph neural network and jTrans, and function-boundary identification comparing XDA with IDA.
description_zh: Assemblage 是一个分布式系统，从 GitHub 与 vcpkg 爬取 C/C++ 项目，在多种编译器配置下构建，并记录源码到二进制的映射，包括函数地址、源代码、注释以及 PDB 或 DWARF 调试信息。该系统在 AWS 上运行约一年，以 Visual Studio 2015–2022 在不同优化级别、架构及 Debug／Release 模式下构建出 89 万个 Windows PE 二进制，另以 GCC 与 Clang 构建出 42.8 万个 Linux ELF 二进制，共涵盖 29 种配置。案例研究将这些数据用于 PassTell 编译器溯源、图神经网络与 jTrans 函数相似性检测，以及比较 XDA 与 IDA 的函数边界识别。
scope_limitations_en: The binaries are builds of open-source GitHub and vcpkg projects, many of them small student projects or utilities, so they do not represent commercial, packed or obfuscated software. Assemblage does not independently scan for malware; the authors rely on GitHub’s policy against malware and plan scanning for a later version. The reported build success rate was about 30% on Windows and 7% on Linux. Public datasets include only repositories with permissive licenses, so the downloadable copy is a subset of the paper’s corpus, and repository links in the metadata tie binaries to authors’ GitHub profiles. The case studies retrain existing models under their original protocols with minimal changes; they show Windows/Linux generalization gaps, such as jTrans MRR of 0.52 on Windows against 0.83 on Linux, rather than new analysis methods.
scope_limitations_zh: 这些二进制均由 GitHub 与 vcpkg 上的开源项目构建，其中许多是小型学生项目或实用工具，因此不能代表商业、加壳或混淆软件。Assemblage 不独立检测恶意软件，作者依赖 GitHub 禁止恶意软件的政策，并计划在后续版本中加入扫描。论文报告的构建成功率在 Windows 上约为 30%，在 Linux 上为 7%。公开数据集仅包含采用宽松许可证的仓库，因此可下载的副本只是论文语料的子集；元数据中的仓库链接会把二进制与作者的 GitHub 主页关联起来。案例研究在原有协议下以最小改动重新训练现有模型，展示的是 Windows 与 Linux 之间的泛化差距（例如 jTrans 在 Windows 上的 MRR 为 0.52，在 Linux 上为 0.83），而非新的分析方法。
why_fits_en: Adds a dataset paper for Windows PE binaries with source and debug mappings, complementing the Linux ELF function corpora used by decompilation research in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充一篇提供源码与调试信息映射的 Windows PE 二进制数据集论文，与本节反编译研究所用的 Linux ELF 函数语料互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the NeurIPS proceedings page give the eight-author order, volume 37 and pages 58698–58715; Crossref records only the year. The proceedings page’s 2024-12-16 citation date also appears on another NeurIPS 2024 paper page, so year precision is kept. Reviewed arXiv v2 (2024-11-02), which carries the NeurIPS comment; v1 dates from 2024-05-07. At the reviewed f8ac584 commit (2026-08-08), the repository README says the code is MIT-licensed and the published dataset is a permissively licensed subset; pyproject.toml declares MIT, but there is no LICENSE file and GitHub detects none. The README also says the codebase was refactored in July 2026 and extended with a Rust worker, that Windows/MSVC builds sit under backend/assemblage/legacy/ and need a Windows host, and that a pre-refactor branch keeps the earlier code. The Hugging Face cards for changliu8541/Assemblage_PE, whose public copy has 91k Windows PE binaries, and Assemblage_LinuxELF declare license “other” and ask users to follow each source repository’s license.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与 NeurIPS 论文集页面给出八位作者顺序、第 37 卷及第 58698–58715 页；Crossref 只记录年份。论文集页面的 2024-12-16 引用日期也出现在另一篇 NeurIPS 2024 论文的页面上，因此保留年份精度。审阅了 arXiv v2（2024-11-02），其注释标明 NeurIPS；v1 提交于 2024-05-07。在所审阅的 f8ac584 提交（2026-08-08）中，仓库 README 称代码采用 MIT 许可证，公开数据集是宽松许可子集；pyproject.toml 声明 MIT，但没有 LICENSE 文件，GitHub 也未识别出许可证。README 还说明代码库于 2026 年 7 月重构并加入 Rust 构建器，Windows／MSVC 构建位于 backend/assemblage/legacy/ 下且需要 Windows 主机，pre-refactor 分支保留了此前的代码。Hugging Face 上的 changliu8541/Assemblage_PE（公开副本含 9.1 万个 Windows PE 二进制）与 Assemblage_LinuxELF 数据卡声明许可证为“other”，并要求用户遵守各源仓库的许可证。

title: Mechanics Automatically Recognized via Interactive Observation: Jumping
title_zh: 通过交互式观察自动识别游戏机制：跳跃
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives 14 August 2017 for both online and print publication, which is also the first day of FDG 2017; the date comes from the deposit, not from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2017 年 8 月 14 日，这也是 FDG 2017 的首日；该日期取自出版方元数据，而非会议日程。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 12th International Conference on the Foundations of Digital Games

description_en: Infers platform-game jump mechanics by running controlled experiments in a modified FCEUX NES emulator. A person first plays each game to a safe state; the system then repeatedly holds the jump button for 1 to 120 frames, waits 120 frames and resets, recording every sprite from the PPU sprite table. Sprites that usually touch one another are merged into characters and tracked. A hand-designed four-state jump automaton (ground, rising with and without the button, falling) is then fitted with linear support vector regression, giving per-state velocity and gravity parameters plus minimum and maximum button-hold durations. Across 48 games (about 30% of NES platformers) and 52 characters, the authors cluster the learned jumps into three styles.
description_zh: 该研究在修改后的 FCEUX NES 模拟器中开展受控实验，推断平台游戏的跳跃机制。先由人工将每款游戏玩到安全状态；系统随后反复按住跳跃键 1 至 120 帧、等待 120 帧并复位，同时从 PPU 精灵表记录所有精灵。经常相互接触的精灵被合并为角色并加以跟踪。随后以线性支持向量回归拟合人工设计的四状态跳跃自动机（地面、按键上升、松键上升、下落），得到各状态的速度与重力参数，以及按键持续时间的最小值和最大值。在 48 款游戏（约占 NES 平台游戏的 30%）、52 个角色上，作者将学得的跳跃聚类为三种风格。
scope_limitations_en: Models only vertical jumps from a standing position; horizontal movement, running jumps, double jumps and interactions with enemies or terrain are ignored, and no game code, assets or complete mechanics are recovered. The fixed automaton is assumed rather than learned, so non-physical jumps such as Castlevania's fit with systematic errors. Stair-step arcs, delayed jump starts, unusual landings and animation jitter are acknowledged problems. Each game needs human play to reach a safe state, prior knowledge that it has jumping, and a known jump button. The 48 games are not an exhaustive sample, and results are descriptive comparisons and clusters rather than tests against developer-specified parameters.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅建模原地起跳的垂直跳跃；忽略水平移动、助跑跳、二段跳以及与敌人或地形的交互，也不恢复任何游戏代码、素材或完整机制。固定的自动机是预先设定而非学习得到的，因此《恶魔城》等非物理跳跃的拟合存在系统性误差。阶梯状轨迹、延迟起跳、特殊落地及动画抖动都是作者承认的问题。每款游戏都需要人工游玩至安全状态，并预先知道其存在跳跃及跳跃按键。48 款游戏并非完整样本，结果是描述性的比较与聚类，并未与开发者设定的参数对照检验。
why_fits_en: Adds emulator-instrumented, black-box recovery of a game mechanic's parameters from controlled play, complementing the collection's code- and visuals-based game reconstruction research.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助模拟器插桩、通过受控游玩以黑盒方式恢复游戏机制参数的研究，与本合集中基于代码和画面的游戏重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the four-author order, FDG ’17 proceedings and page range 1–10; it deposits the title in sentence case with subtitle “jumping”, while this entry keeps the paper's printed capitalization. Crossref lists the second author as Joe Osborn; the paper and arXiv print Joseph C. Osborn, the form used here. arXiv has only v1 of 2017-07-12, with comment “10 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at Foundations of Digital Games 2017” and the same DOI. Its PDF is the 10-page ACM-formatted paper with the FDG ’17 reference block. Neither the paper nor arXiv links code, the modified emulator or the experiment data, and no author release was found.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认四位作者顺序、FDG ’17 会议论文集及第 1–10 页；其标题采用句首大写形式，副标题为“jumping”，本条目保留论文所印的大小写。Crossref 将第二作者记为 Joe Osborn；论文与 arXiv 印作 Joseph C. Osborn，本条目采用后者。arXiv 仅有 2017-07-12 的 v1，备注为“10 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at Foundations of Digital Games 2017”，并载有相同 DOI；其 PDF 为含 FDG ’17 引用格式的 10 页 ACM 排版论文。论文与 arXiv 均未链接代码、修改后的模拟器或实验数据，也未找到作者发布。

title: Sketch2Code: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Interactive Web Design Prototyping
title_zh: Sketch2Code：评估视觉语言模型的交互式网页设计原型生成能力
date_basis: The ACL Anthology record gives the proceedings month as April 2025; Crossref records only the year. The conference ran from 29 April to 4 May 2025, and no publication day is inferred.
date_basis_zh: ACL Anthology 记录的论文集出版月份为 2025 年 4 月；Crossref 只记录年份。会议于 2025 年 4 月 29 日至 5 月 4 日举行，本条目不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference of the Nations of the Americas Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (Volume 1: Long Papers)

description_en: Sketch2Code benchmarks vision-language models on turning rough hand-drawn wireframe sketches into HTML webpage prototypes. Crowd annotators drew 731 sketches of 484 real-world webpages from the Design2Code test set. Ten models, eight commercial and two 8B open-source, generate pages directly and in two multi-turn settings with a GPT-4o simulated user: following its feedback, or asking it clarification questions. Outputs are scored by Design2Code visual similarity and a new IoU-based layout similarity over component types such as text blocks, images, navigation bars, forms and buttons. Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o lead single-turn layout similarity, and feedback rounds help commercial models more than question asking does.
description_zh: Sketch2Code 评测视觉语言模型把粗略手绘线框草图转换为 HTML 网页原型的能力。众包标注者为来自 Design2Code 测试集的 484 个真实网页绘制了 731 张草图。十个模型（八个商业模型与两个 8B 开源模型）既直接生成页面，也在两种与 GPT-4o 模拟用户进行的多轮场景中工作：遵循其反馈，或向其提出澄清问题。输出依据 Design2Code 视觉相似度，以及基于文本块、图像、导航栏、表单与按钮等组件类型的新 IoU 布局相似度评分。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与 GPT-4o 在单轮布局相似度上领先，而反馈轮次对商业模型的帮助大于提问方式。
scope_limitations_en: The generated pages are prototypes scored by visual and layout similarity to reference screenshots, not recovered source code; behavior, interactivity and code equivalence are not evaluated, and page images are replaced with a placeholder. Sketches deliberately omit most text and styling, so similarity scores are low in absolute terms, with best single-turn layout similarity around 22%. The simulated user is GPT-4o, judged faithful in 83.3% of feedback and accurate in 86.7% of answers by human annotators. Only 8B open-source models were run, and a multi-turn example needs 40,000 to 160,000 input tokens. The user study interviewed eight UI/UX experts. Results describe 2024 model versions.
scope_limitations_zh: 生成的页面是原型，依据与参考截图的视觉和布局相似度评分，并非恢复的源代码；论文不评估行为、交互性或代码等价性，页面中的图片也被替换为占位图。草图有意省略了大部分文本与样式，因此相似度绝对值较低，单轮布局相似度最高约为 22%。模拟用户由 GPT-4o 担任，人工标注认为其 83.3% 的反馈可靠、86.7% 的回答准确。开源模型只运行了 8B 规模，每个多轮示例需要 40,000 至 160,000 个输入词元。用户研究访谈了八位 UI／UX 专家。结果对应 2024 年的模型版本。
why_fits_en: Adds sketch-based and multi-turn interactive webpage generation, complementing the screenshot- and design-based website reconstruction benchmarks in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于草图与多轮交互的网页生成研究，与本节基于截图和设计稿的网站重建基准互补。
metadata_notes: The ACL Anthology page, final PDF and Crossref establish the three-author order, DOI, NAACL 2025 Volume 1 proceedings and pages 3921–3955. Reviewed arXiv v1 (2024-10-21), the only version, commented “preprint, 9 pages”; the description follows the 35-page proceedings PDF. The paper links its code and data through the project page. At the reviewed 21dfd1d commit, SALT-NLP/Sketch2Code is MIT-licensed, pins Python packages including torch 2.4.0, transformers 4.44.1 and playwright 1.43.0, and requires OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini API keys for the commercial models. The Hugging Face dataset card declares ODC-By, and the paper says the source webpages were collected by Design2Code under ODC-By.
metadata_notes_zh: ACL Anthology 页面、最终 PDF 与 Crossref 确认三位作者顺序、DOI、NAACL 2025 第 1 卷论文集及第 3921–3955 页。审阅了 arXiv v1（2024-10-21），即唯一版本，注释为“preprint, 9 pages”；简介依据 35 页的论文集 PDF。论文通过项目页面链接代码与数据。在所审阅的 21dfd1d 提交中，SALT-NLP/Sketch2Code 采用 MIT 许可证，固定了 torch 2.4.0、transformers 4.44.1 与 playwright 1.43.0 等 Python 依赖版本，并需要 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 Gemini API 密钥来运行商业模型。Hugging Face 数据卡声明 ODC-By 许可，论文也说明源网页由 Design2Code 以 ODC-By 许可收集。

title: Decomperson: How Humans Decompile and What We Can Learn From It
title_zh: Decomperson：人类如何反编译以及我们能从中学到什么
date_basis: Publication month from the official USENIX BibTeX (month = aug) and the final PDF cover for the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, August 10–12, 2022; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方 BibTeX（month = aug）及第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium（2022 年 8 月 10–12 日）最终版 PDF 封面所载的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 31st USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 22)

description_en: Reframes manual reverse engineering as perfect decompilation: writing source that, compiled with the original toolchain and options, reproduces the target functions’ binary code exactly. The authors built Decomperson, a web editor that compiles, disassembles, tests and diffs each submission, and used it in Decompetition, a 24-hour Jeopardy-style competition in November 2020 with 23 unstripped challenge binaries written in C, C++, Go, Rust and Swift. Over 150 participants made more than 35,000 submissions, including over 300 perfect ones; all but one challenge was perfectly decompiled, and the recorded edit histories are analyzed to describe how humans decompile.
description_zh: 将人工逆向工程重新表述为“完美反编译”：编写源码，使其在原始工具链与编译选项下编译后，能完全复现目标函数的二进制代码。作者开发了 Decomperson——一个对每次提交进行编译、反汇编、测试与差异比对的网页编辑器，并在 2020 年 11 月举办的 24 小时 Jeopardy 式竞赛 Decompetition 中使用；竞赛包含 23 个未剥离符号、以 C、C++、Go、Rust 与 Swift 编写的挑战二进制。150 余名参与者提交了 35,000 多份代码，其中 300 多份达到完美反编译；除一个挑战外，其余均被完美反编译。作者分析记录下的编辑历史，以描述人类的反编译过程。
scope_limitations_en: Participants were self-selected competitors in a single 2020 event, mostly playing solo on teams of any size, and the follow-up survey drew only 12% of registrants. The challenges are 23 small competition binaries written by the organizers, not stripped and without debug information, and Decomperson assumed the original toolchain and compilation options were known. Perfect decompilation requires matching compiler output; the authors note that it is not a traditional reverse-engineering task, does not capture skills such as triaging large binaries, and can include time spent fighting compiler idiosyncrasies. The web editor took players out of their usual tools and may have influenced timings. Participants could paste automatic-decompiler output; about 20% of C function attempts resembled tool output, mostly Hex-Rays, Ghidra or Binary Ninja. The study observes humans and does not evaluate automated decompilers or agents.
scope_limitations_zh: 参与者是自愿参加 2020 年单次竞赛的选手，多数以单人队伍参赛（队伍人数不限），赛后问卷仅有 12% 的注册者填写。挑战为组织者编写的 23 个小型竞赛二进制，未剥离符号但不含调试信息，且 Decomperson 假定已知原始工具链与编译选项。完美反编译要求与编译器输出一致；作者指出，这并非传统的逆向工程任务，无法反映筛查大型二进制等技能，还可能包含与编译器特性“较劲”所花的时间。网页编辑器使选手离开了惯用工具，可能影响计时。选手可以粘贴自动反编译器的输出；约 20% 的 C 函数尝试与工具输出相似，主要来自 Hex-Rays、Ghidra 或 Binary Ninja。该研究观察的是人类，并未评估自动反编译器或智能体。
why_fits_en: Adds a large, programmatically analyzable record of human decompilation, complementing studies that compare human reverse engineers with LLMs and agents.
why_fits_zh: 补充可通过程序分析的大规模人类反编译记录，与比较人类逆向工程人员和大语言模型、智能体的研究互补。
metadata_notes: No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified; the record uses the USENIX Security presentation-page and sec22-burk.pdf profile. The USENIX BibTeX gives the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, pages 2765–2782, USENIX Association and month August. The paper states IRB exemption under Category 3 and that no personally identifiable information was used. Its Artifacts section links the challenges-2020, server, disassembler and data repositories and a Docker Hub builder image. The code link uses the Decomperson server, reviewed at commit 0d381d4 (2026-04-13), which carries an Apache-2.0 license whose copyright line was filled in that day; the challenges and disassembler repositories first received Apache-2.0 license files the same day. The anonymized submission data, decompetition/data at 4b339e5 (2022-06-02), is a PostgreSQL dump from a 2020-12-10 snapshot with a Docker-based serve.sh, and that repository declares no license.
metadata_notes_zh: 未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符；本条目采用 USENIX Security 报告页面与 sec22-burk.pdf 配对规则。USENIX BibTeX 给出第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium、页码 2765–2782、出版方 USENIX Association 及八月份。论文说明该研究经 IRB 审查被认定为第 3 类豁免，且未使用个人身份信息。其“产物”一节链接 challenges-2020、server、disassembler 与 data 仓库及一个 Docker Hub 构建镜像。代码链接采用 Decomperson 服务端，审阅提交为 0d381d4（2026-04-13），采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，其版权行于当日补全；challenges 与 disassembler 仓库则在同日首次加入 Apache-2.0 许可证文件。匿名化提交数据位于 decompetition/data 的 4b339e5（2022-06-02），是基于 2020-12-10 快照的 PostgreSQL 转储，并附基于 Docker 的 serve.sh；该仓库未声明许可证。

title: Unleashing the Power of LLM to Infer State Machine From the Protocol Implementation
title_zh: 释放大语言模型潜力：从协议实现推断状态机
date_basis: The publisher's Crossref deposit establishes publication year 2025. Its print date of 2 July 2025 is also the first day of the July 2–4 symposium recorded in the same deposit, and IEEE Xplore could not be retrieved automatically to confirm a publication day, so no finer date is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2025 年。其印刷日期 2025 年 7 月 2 日同时也是该元数据所记 7 月 2 日至 4 日研讨会的首日，且无法自动访问 IEEE Xplore 以确认具体出版日，因此不记录更精确的日期。

citation.container_title: 2025 IEEE/ACM 33rd International Symposium on Quality of Service (IWQoS)

description_en: ProtocolGPT infers protocol state machines from implementation source code with a retrieval-augmented LLM. It extracts state-machine-related code with regular expressions and a code filter, splits it into syntax-aware chunks stored in a FAISS vector store with OpenAI embeddings, and prompts GPT-4 step by step to recover states and message-triggered transitions. On six protocols in five open-source code bases (IKEv2, TLS 1.3, TLS 1.2, BGP, RTSP and L2TP), the authors report transition precision above 90%, more than 30% higher precision and 55% higher recall than baselines. Seeding AFLNet with the inferred machines raised coverage by more than 20% and found two previously unknown crash bugs in an RTSP server.
description_zh: ProtocolGPT 借助检索增强的大语言模型，从协议实现源码推断协议状态机。它先用正则表达式和代码过滤器提取与状态机相关的代码，再按语法感知方式切分，以 OpenAI 嵌入存入 FAISS 向量库，并逐步提示 GPT-4 恢复状态及由报文触发的迁移。在五个开源代码库中的六种协议（IKEv2、TLS 1.3、TLS 1.2、BGP、RTSP 与 L2TP）上，作者报告迁移精确率超过 90%，精确率比基线高 30% 以上、召回率高 55% 以上。以推断出的状态机为 AFLNet 生成种子后，覆盖率提升 20% 以上，并在一个 RTSP 服务器中发现两个此前未知的崩溃漏洞。
scope_limitations_en: Requires source code; it does not work from binaries or traffic alone. Each implementation was chosen for explicitly defined states, and results cover only the six evaluated protocols, two of which share the s2n-tls code base. Ground truth was built manually by three experts from repository code; precision and recall count only fully correct transitions. RFCNLP had higher precision on RTSP. Results depend on GPT-4 at temperature 0.2 through a commercial API, so outputs and costs may change. The inferred machines are LLM summaries, not proofs of implementation behavior or equivalence. Fuzzing gains come from AFLNet seeds; BGP's event-driven transitions limited message-based coverage. The two crash bugs are in the feng RTSP server.
scope_limitations_zh: 方法需要源码，不能仅依靠二进制或流量。每个实现都因具有明确定义的状态而入选，结果仅覆盖所评估的六种协议，其中两种共用 s2n-tls 代码库。真实标签由三名专家根据仓库代码人工构建；精确率与召回率只计算完全正确的迁移。RFCNLP 在 RTSP 上的精确率更高。结果依赖通过商业 API 调用、温度为 0.2 的 GPT-4，输出与成本可能变化。推断出的状态机是大语言模型的归纳，并非对实现行为或等价性的证明。模糊测试的提升来自 AFLNet 种子；BGP 由事件驱动的迁移限制了基于报文的覆盖率。两个崩溃漏洞均位于 feng RTSP 服务器中。
why_fits_en: Adds LLM-based protocol state-machine recovery from implementation source code, complementing the collection's traffic-based, binary-assisted and grey-box state inference research.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助大语言模型从协议实现源码恢复状态机的研究，与本合集中基于流量、借助二进制及灰盒的状态推断研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the ten-author order, the IWQoS 2025 proceedings, pages 1–10 and the DOI; the IEEE title capitalizes “From”, while arXiv uses “from”. arXiv v4 of 2025-03-27 (v1 2024-05-01) has no journal reference or venue comment. Its benchmark pins strongSwan f994e0a, s2n-tls 025f3b2, openbgpd 08b59c1, feng d302a1c and openl2tp be6c288; the experiments ran GPT-4 on a 32 GB i7-12700 Ubuntu 20.04 machine. That version says source code and experimental data would be released after acceptance; neither arXiv nor the paper links a release. A GitHub repository, s1awwhy/ProtocolGPT, uses the paper title and contains Python scripts, but has no license and is not linked by the paper. The developer is reported to have confirmed the two RTSP bugs; no CVE identifiers are given.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认十位作者顺序、IWQoS 2025 会议论文集、第 1–10 页及 DOI；IEEE 标题中“From”首字母大写，arXiv 则为“from”。2025-03-27 的 arXiv v4（v1 为 2024-05-01）没有期刊引用或会议备注。其基准固定了 strongSwan f994e0a、s2n-tls 025f3b2、openbgpd 08b59c1、feng d302a1c 与 openl2tp be6c288；实验在 32 GB 内存、i7-12700、Ubuntu 20.04 机器上调用 GPT-4。该版本称源码与实验数据将在论文录用后发布，但 arXiv 与论文均未链接任何发布。GitHub 仓库 s1awwhy/ProtocolGPT 使用论文标题并含 Python 脚本，但没有许可证，论文未链接。论文称开发者已确认两个 RTSP 漏洞，但未给出 CVE 编号。

title: Unlocking the conversion of Web Screenshots into HTML Code with the WebSight Dataset
title_zh: 借助 WebSight 数据集实现网页截图到 HTML 代码的转换
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission date; no later version, journal reference or proceedings publication was found.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；未找到后续版本、期刊引用信息或会议论文集出版记录。
description_en: WebSight is a synthetic dataset of 2 million HTML documents paired with full-page screenshots for training screenshot-to-HTML models. Mistral-7B-Instruct generates website concepts, Deepseek-Coder-33B-Instruct writes each page in HTML with Tailwind CSS, images come from keyword-based stock-photo URLs, and Playwright renders the screenshots after filtering. This v0.2 release replaces the 823K-pair v0.1, which used traditional CSS and colored rectangles instead of images. The authors fine-tune an 8B vision-language model, Sightseer, on the data with DoRA and show qualitative conversions, including one from a hand-drawn sketch.
description_zh: WebSight 是一个合成数据集，含 200 万份与整页截图配对的 HTML 文档，用于训练截图到 HTML 的模型。Mistral-7B-Instruct 生成网站构思，Deepseek-Coder-33B-Instruct 以 HTML 加 Tailwind CSS 编写每个页面，图片来自基于关键词的图库链接，经过筛选后由 Playwright 渲染截图。该 v0.2 版本取代了含 82.3 万对样本的 v0.1，后者使用传统 CSS，并以彩色矩形代替图片。作者用 DoRA 在该数据上微调了 8B 视觉语言模型 Sightseer，并展示了定性转换示例，其中包括一个由手绘草图转换的例子。
scope_limitations_en: The websites are synthetic, LLM-generated single pages, not crawled real sites, so training on them does not establish reconstruction of real websites, their source or their behavior. Evaluation is qualitative only: no benchmark scores are reported, checkpoints were selected by manual inspection because validation loss did not track output quality, and the authors note failures on complex layouts, long text and designs unlike the training data, as well as Tailwind syntax errors. v0.2 pages load Tailwind CSS from a CDN link and images from source.unsplash.com URLs, so re-rendering depends on those external services. The base model was unreleased at the time, and the report is not peer-reviewed.
scope_limitations_zh: 这些网站均为大语言模型生成的合成单页，并非爬取的真实网站，因此基于其训练并不能证明可以重建真实网站、其源码或其行为。评估仅为定性：论文未报告基准分数；由于验证损失与输出质量不一致，检查点通过人工检查选取；作者也指出模型在复杂布局、长文本以及与训练数据差异较大的设计上会失败，并存在 Tailwind 语法错误。v0.2 页面通过 CDN 链接加载 Tailwind CSS，并从 source.unsplash.com 链接加载图片，因此重新渲染依赖这些外部服务。基础模型当时尚未发布，该报告也未经同行评审。
why_fits_en: Adds the synthetic screenshot-to-HTML training dataset that later website reconstruction work, including Design2Code and Web2Code, builds on.
why_fits_zh: 补充后续网站重建研究（包括 Design2Code 与 Web2Code）所依托的合成截图到 HTML 训练数据集。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v1, the only version, a technical report with no comment, journal reference or DOI; a Crossref search found no peer-reviewed version. The project link pins the Hugging Face dataset card at revision b11f817 (last modified 2024-03-26). The card declares CC BY 4.0, asks users to follow the licenses of the source content and to disclose use when releasing trained models, documents v0.1 in detail and still marks the v0.2 split size and creation section “TO DO”. The paper does not link code or the Sightseer weights.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅了 arXiv v1，即唯一版本，这是一份技术报告，没有注释、期刊引用信息或 DOI；在 Crossref 中检索未找到经同行评审的版本。项目链接将 Hugging Face 数据卡固定在 b11f817 修订版（最后修改于 2024-03-26）。数据卡声明 CC BY 4.0，要求用户遵守源内容的许可证，并在发布训练所得模型时披露使用情况；其中详细记录了 v0.1，而 v0.2 的划分规模与构建章节仍标为“TO DO”。论文未链接代码或 Sightseer 权重。

title: Elipmoc: Advanced Decompilation of Ethereum Smart Contracts
title_zh: Elipmoc：以太坊智能合约的高级反编译
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records published/print and online publication on 2022-04-29; the article footer gives April 2022. The OOPSLA conference dates are not substituted for this publication date.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2022-04-29，文章页脚标注为 2022 年 4 月；本条目不以 OOPSLA 会议日期替代该出版日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (OOPSLA 2022)

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages

description_en: Elipmoc decompiles Ethereum Virtual Machine bytecode into a structured three-address intermediate representation for security analyses and reverse engineering. Built as an evolution of the Datalog-based Gigahorse decompiler, it adds transactional context sensitivity, path-sensitive inference of function arguments and returns with path merging, and fully context-sensitive reconstruction of private functions. On a uniform random sample of 5,000 unique mainnet contracts first deployed between April and September 2021, the authors report fully resolved operands for 99.5% of contracts versus 62.8% for Gigahorse, 67% more unique external-call signatures than Etherscan’s Panoramix, and over 5x faster decompilation.
description_zh: Elipmoc 将以太坊虚拟机字节码反编译为结构化的三地址中间表示，服务于安全分析与逆向工程。它由基于 Datalog 的 Gigahorse 反编译器演进而来，新增事务上下文敏感性、结合路径合并的路径敏感函数参数与返回值推断，以及完全上下文敏感的私有函数重建。作者在 2021 年 4 月至 9 月间首次部署于主网的 5,000 个唯一合约的均匀随机样本上，报告 99.5% 的合约操作数被完全解析（Gigahorse 为 62.8%），识别出的唯一外部调用签名比 Etherscan 的 Panoramix 多 67%，且反编译速度快 5 倍以上。
scope_limitations_en: Targets EVM bytecode only. The metrics are operand resolution, structured control flow, function and jump-target precision, external-call and event coverage, timeouts and speed against the 2022 Gigahorse artifact and Panoramix; they do not measure equivalence to or recovery of original Solidity source, and the output is three-address IR rather than recompilable code. Experiments used one 5,000-contract sample from a five-month 2021 deployment window, a 120-second per-contract cutoff and Souffle 2.0.2. JEB, Trustlook SECaaS and EtherSolve were not compared, and EtherVM, Porosity and Vandal were excluded as inferior or unmaintained. Reported vulnerability discoveries built on Elipmoc are described as end-to-end impact, not a systematic evaluation.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅面向 EVM 字节码。评测指标包括操作数解析、结构化控制流、函数与跳转目标精度、外部调用与事件覆盖率、超时及速度，对比对象为 2022 年的 Gigahorse 产物与 Panoramix；这些指标不衡量与原始 Solidity 源码的等价性或源码恢复，输出也是三地址中间表示而非可重新编译的代码。实验使用 2021 年五个月部署窗口内的一个 5,000 合约样本、每个合约 120 秒的时限以及 Souffle 2.0.2。未与 JEB、Trustlook SECaaS 和 EtherSolve 比较，EtherVM、Porosity 与 Vandal 则因较弱或已停止维护而被排除。基于 Elipmoc 的漏洞发现被描述为端到端影响，并非系统性评测。
why_fits_en: Adds a static EVM bytecode decompiler that DiSCo uses as a baseline, extending the bibliography’s smart-contract decompilation coverage.
why_fits_zh: 补充被 DiSCo 用作基线的静态 EVM 字节码反编译器，扩展本书目对智能合约反编译的覆盖。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the author-hosted final PDF agree on the four-author order, the DOI, volume 6, issue OOPSLA1 and pages 1–27; the PDF numbers the article 77, and Crossref records a CC BY 4.0 license. Crossref’s title is in sentence case, while the PDF uses title case. No arXiv preprint was found. The code link is the Gigahorse toolchain that implements Elipmoc; its README cites this paper and a later 2025 paper on further changes. At reviewed master commit 1b06cef (2026-09-14), the LICENSE file is BSD 3-Clause with material from the University of Sydney marked in individual files, while the GitHub API reports NOASSERTION. Current setup requires recursive submodules, Souffle 2.3 or 2.4.1, Boost, Z3 and Python 3.13 through uv, unlike the paper’s Souffle 2.0.2 and Python 3.8.2.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与作者托管的最终版 PDF 在四位作者顺序、DOI、第 6 卷、OOPSLA1 期及页码 1–27 上一致；PDF 将文章编号列为 77，Crossref 记录其采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。Crossref 标题为句首大写形式，PDF 则为标题式大写。未找到 arXiv 预印本。代码链接是实现 Elipmoc 的 Gigahorse 工具链，其 README 引用本论文及 2025 年介绍后续改动的另一篇论文。在所审阅的 master 提交 1b06cef（2026-09-14）中，LICENSE 文件为 BSD 3-Clause，并包含在各文件中标注的悉尼大学材料，而 GitHub API 报告为 NOASSERTION。当前环境需要递归子模块、Souffle 2.3 或 2.4.1、Boost、Z3，以及通过 uv 提供的 Python 3.13，不同于论文使用的 Souffle 2.0.2 与 Python 3.8.2。

title: MappyLand: Fast, Accurate Mapping for Console Games
title_zh: MappyLand：快速、准确的主机游戏地图构建
date_basis: The AAAI OJS article page gives publication on 2021-10-04, and the publisher-deposited Crossref record gives the same published-online and issued date. The conference dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: AAAI OJS 文章页面给出的出版日期为 2021-10-04，出版方提交的 Crossref 记录中的在线出版日期和发行日期与之相同。本条目不以会议日期代替。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment
citation.publisher: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AAAI)

description_en: MappyLand, a Rust rewrite of the earlier Mappy system, instruments the FCEUMM NES emulator core to map action/adventure games as they are played from controller inputs. It hooks accesses to the picture-processing unit's scrolling registers and reads emulator memory to register scrolling, separate the playfield from menus, detect and track sprites, build grid-based tile maps and recognize room transitions. An online merging step combines observed rooms into a consistent room graph across backtracking and multiple play sessions. In a 34,514-frame test the authors report about 1.5 ms of mapping overhead per frame, against about 0.2 ms for emulation alone.
description_zh: MappyLand 是早期 Mappy 系统的 Rust 重写版，它对 FCEUMM NES 模拟器核心进行插桩，在依据手柄输入运行动作／冒险游戏的同时绘制地图。系统拦截对图像处理单元滚动寄存器的访问并读取模拟器内存，据此完成滚动配准、区分游戏区域与菜单、检测和跟踪精灵、构建网格化图块地图并识别房间切换。一个在线合并步骤再把观测到的房间整合为一致的房间图，可覆盖折返路线和多次游玩会话。作者在一次 34,514 帧的测试中报告，地图构建每帧约增加 1.5 毫秒开销，而单纯模拟约为每帧 0.2 毫秒。
scope_limitations_en: Limited to NES action/adventure games in which the player controls characters moving through a 2D, tile-based space with a single physical layer; independently scrolling layers and parallax backgrounds are unsupported, and other consoles are left to future work. The method relies on emulator instrumentation and memory reads rather than pixels alone, and needs the game image plus controller inputs. Maps were judged accurate only by human inspection of the authors' play on a sample of games; with no reference dataset, no automated quantitative accuracy evaluation was performed. Areas not seen during play stay unmapped, and visually similar rooms can be ambiguous. Timing comes from individual reported runs; the authors expect, but do not measure, similar overhead across NES games. Output is maps, room graphs and entity tracks, not game code, rules or assets.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅适用于玩家操控角色在单一物理层的二维图块空间中移动的 NES 动作／冒险游戏；不支持各自独立滚动的图层和视差背景，其他主机平台留待后续工作。方法依赖模拟器插桩与内存读取，而非仅凭像素，并需要游戏映像及手柄输入。地图准确性仅由人工检查作者在部分游戏上的游玩结果来判断；由于缺少参考数据集，没有进行自动化的定量准确性评估。游玩中未见到的区域不会被绘制，外观相似的房间也可能产生歧义。耗时数据来自个别报告的运行；作者预期不同 NES 游戏的开销相近，但并未测量。输出是地图、房间图和实体轨迹，而非游戏代码、规则或资源。
why_fits_en: Adds emulator-instrumented recovery of game-world structure, namely maps, room graphs and entity tracks, from observed play, complementing pixel-only game replication and code-world-model research.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助模拟器插桩、从观测到的游玩过程中恢复游戏世界结构（地图、房间图与实体轨迹）的研究，与仅基于像素的游戏复刻和代码世界模型研究互补。
metadata_notes: The OJS page and Crossref establish the four-author order, DOI, volume 17, issue 1 and pages 66–73. Crossref types the record as a journal article because AIIDE proceedings appear as an OJS series. The paper's footnotes link faim-lab/mappy and faim-lab/fceumm-libretro-hooks. The reviewed mappy snapshot at bbf99dd (2025-07-21) includes commits made years after the paper, uses Rust edition 2024 and an unpinned retro-rs Git dependency, declares no license, and bundles prebuilt instrumented emulator cores for Linux, macOS and Windows; the core source in fceumm-libretro-hooks at 4b2001d (2025-02-14) is GPL-2.0. Graphviz renders the map images. The earlier Mappy system (FDG 2017 PCG workshop, arXiv:1707.03908) is a separate paper.
metadata_notes_zh: OJS 页面与 Crossref 确认了四位作者的顺序、DOI、第 17 卷第 1 期及页码 66–73。由于 AIIDE 论文集以 OJS 连续出版物形式发布，Crossref 将该记录归为期刊文章。论文脚注链接了 faim-lab/mappy 和 faim-lab/fceumm-libretro-hooks。所审阅的 mappy 快照 bbf99dd（2025-07-21）包含论文发表数年后的提交，使用 Rust 2024 版本和未固定版本的 retro-rs Git 依赖，未声明许可证，并附带适用于 Linux、macOS 与 Windows 的预编译插桩模拟器核心；fceumm-libretro-hooks 中的核心源码（4b2001d，2025-02-14）采用 GPL-2.0。地图图片由 Graphviz 渲染。早期的 Mappy 系统（FDG 2017 PCG 研讨会，arXiv:1707.03908）是另一篇论文。

title: DICE: Automatic Emulation of DMA Input Channels for Dynamic Firmware Analysis
title_zh: DICE：面向动态固件分析的 DMA 输入通道自动仿真
date_basis: The publisher's Crossref deposit records print publication in May 2021, the month of the May 24–27 symposium. IEEE Xplore could not be retrieved automatically, and no publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据记录印刷出版时间为 2021 年 5 月，即 5 月 24 日至 27 日研讨会所在月份。无法自动访问 IEEE Xplore，本条目不记录具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 2021 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (SP)

description_en: DICE adds DMA input emulation to microcontroller firmware emulators that model neither peripherals nor DMA controllers. It watches firmware writes to the memory-mapped DMA controller region for pairs of source and destination transfer pointers, and infers the transfer direction from later firmware accesses. When firmware reads a peripheral-to-RAM destination buffer, DICE answers with analyzer-supplied input such as fuzzer data, growing buffer bounds conservatively. Prototypes patch the QEMU forks of P2IM (ARM Cortex-M) and a PIC32 emulator (MIPS M4K/M-Class). On 83 sample firmware covering 9 DMA controllers from 5 vendors, the authors report 33 of 37 input channels detected with no false positives, correct input for 21 of 22 buffers and 3.4% average overhead. Fuzzing 7 real firmware for 48 hours found 5 previously unknown bugs.
description_zh: DICE 为既不模拟外设也不模拟 DMA 控制器的微控制器固件仿真器增加 DMA 输入仿真。它监视固件向内存映射 DMA 控制器区域写入的源与目的传输指针对，并根据固件随后的访问推断传输方向。当固件读取外设到 RAM 的目的缓冲区时，DICE 以分析器提供的输入（如模糊测试数据）作答，并以保守方式扩展缓冲区边界。原型修改了 P2IM（ARM Cortex-M）与一款 PIC32 仿真器（MIPS M4K/M-Class）所用的 QEMU 分支。在覆盖 5 家厂商 9 种 DMA 控制器的 83 个示例固件上，作者报告检测出 37 个输入通道中的 33 个且无误报，为 22 个缓冲区中的 21 个提供了正确输入，平均开销为 3.4%。对 7 个真实固件进行 48 小时模糊测试，发现 5 个此前未知的缺陷。
scope_limitations_en: Emulates DMA input channels only; it does not model peripheral behavior, recover peripheral semantics or produce a faithful device replica, and supplied inputs are analyzer data rather than real peripheral traffic. It assumes transfer descriptors are written to DMA controller registers, so descriptors stored in RAM are unsupported. Destination-only configurations, used by two controller models such as nRF52832 EasyDMA, are also missed, accounting for 7 of 52 stream configurations. Buffer sizes are heuristic estimates. Ground truth came from datasheets and firmware inspection, and results cover the authors' 83 sample firmware and 7 fuzzed firmware. Bugs were found in two of the seven fuzzed firmware with a basic memory sanitizer. The PIC32 prototype runs only firmware whose other peripherals can be handled by simple default register handlers.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅仿真 DMA 输入通道；它不模拟外设行为、不恢复外设语义，也不构建精确的设备复刻，所提供的输入是分析器数据而非真实外设流量。它假定传输描述符写入 DMA 控制器寄存器，因此不支持存放在 RAM 中的描述符。仅需目的地址的配置（如 nRF52832 EasyDMA 等两种控制器型号）也无法识别，占 52 个流配置中的 7 个。缓冲区大小为启发式估计。真实标签来自数据手册与固件检查，结果仅覆盖作者的 83 个示例固件及 7 个模糊测试固件。缺陷是在七个模糊测试固件中的两个里、借助简单的内存检测器发现的。PIC32 原型只能运行其他外设可由简单默认寄存器处理器应付的固件。
why_fits_en: Adds DMA input-channel emulation for firmware rehosting, complementing the collection's MMIO-modeling and fuzzing-oriented MCU rehosting research.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向固件重托管的 DMA 输入通道仿真研究，与本合集中侧重 MMIO 建模及模糊测试的微控制器重托管研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref establishes the four-author order, the 2021 IEEE S&P proceedings, pages 1938–1954 and the DOI; IEEE Xplore refused automated retrieval. Reviewed arXiv v3 of 2021-01-15 (v1 2020-07-03) carries journal reference “42nd IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy, S&P 2021” and links the repository. The reviewed master snapshot 2b3b8c8b was pushed on 2023-10-14. Its LICENSE releases DICE under Apache-2.0 unless otherwise stated, while AFL and P2IM's AFL changes are Apache-2.0 and QEMU, P2IM's QEMU changes, the PIC32 extensions and P2IM itself are GPL-2.0; GitHub reports no single SPDX license. The p2im and mips-emulator directories are submodules pinned to RiS3-Lab/p2im 0a4870b4 and sergev/qemu a2e0277d. README supports Ubuntu 16.04 or 18.04 only, noting problems on 20.04. It applies DICE as patches to QEMU and supplies precompiled QEMU binaries plus evaluation firmware binaries, sources and scripts; bundled vendor sample firmware keeps its own terms.
