metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 确认四位作者顺序、2021 年 IEEE S&P 会议论文集、第 1938–1954 页及 DOI；IEEE Xplore 拒绝自动访问。所审阅的 2021-01-15 arXiv v3（v1 为 2020-07-03）载有期刊引用“42nd IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy, S&P 2021”，并链接代码仓库。所审阅的 master 快照 2b3b8c8b 推送于 2023-10-14。其 LICENSE 规定除另有说明外 DICE 采用 Apache-2.0；AFL 及 P2IM 对 AFL 的修改为 Apache-2.0，QEMU、P2IM 对 QEMU 的修改、PIC32 扩展以及 P2IM 本身为 GPL-2.0；GitHub 未识别出单一 SPDX 许可证。p2im 与 mips-emulator 目录为子模块，分别固定在 RiS3-Lab/p2im 0a4870b4 与 sergev/qemu a2e0277d。README 仅支持 Ubuntu 16.04 或 18.04，并说明 20.04 上存在问题。DICE 以 QEMU 补丁形式应用，仓库还提供预编译 QEMU 二进制，以及评估用固件二进制、源码和脚本；其中收录的厂商示例固件保留各自条款。

title: DeepDi: Learning a Relational Graph Convolutional Network Model on Instructions for Fast and Accurate Disassembly
title_zh: DeepDi：在指令上学习关系图卷积网络模型以实现快速准确的反汇编
date_basis: Publication month from the official USENIX BibTeX (month = aug) and the final PDF cover for the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, August 10–12, 2022; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方 BibTeX（month = aug）及第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium（2022 年 8 月 10–12 日）最终版 PDF 封面所载的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 31st USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 22)

description_en: DeepDi disassembles x86 and x64 binaries by decoding a superset of candidate instructions, linking them in an Instruction Flow Graph of forward, backward and overlap relations, and classifying true instructions with a Relational Graph Convolutional Network; heuristics and a small classifier then recover function entry points. On BAP corpora, LLVM 11 built with MSVC on Windows, and SPEC CPU2006 and CPU2017, the authors report accuracy comparable or superior to IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, Ghidra, Datalog Disassembly and XDA, robustness on Linn–Debray and Hikari obfuscated binaries, single-core CPU throughput of 146 KB/s (about twice IDA Pro) and GPU throughput of 24.5 MB/s (about 350 times IDA Pro).
description_zh: DeepDi 对 x86 与 x64 二进制进行反汇编：先解码候选指令的超集，再以前向、后向与重叠关系将其连接成指令流图，并用关系图卷积网络识别真实指令；随后借助启发式规则和一个小型分类器恢复函数入口。作者在 BAP 语料、Windows 上以 MSVC 构建的 LLVM 11，以及 SPEC CPU2006 与 CPU2017 上报告，其准确率与 IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、Ghidra、Datalog Disassembly 和 XDA 相当或更优，在 Linn–Debray 与 Hikari 混淆二进制上表现稳健，单核 CPU 吞吐量为 146 KB/s（约为 IDA Pro 的两倍），GPU 吞吐量为 24.5 MB/s（约为 IDA Pro 的 350 倍）。
scope_limitations_en: Covers x86 and x64 ELF and PE binaries only. ELF ground truth assumes no data in code sections and uses linear disassembly plus symbol tables; PE ground truth comes from PDB files, with data lengths estimated because PDBs give only data addresses. Results are the authors’ 2022 comparisons against Binary Ninja 2.2, IDA Pro 7.2 and Ghidra 9.1.2 on their datasets and hardware, with one GTX 2080Ti GPU; Datalog Disassembly supports only x64 ELF and so covers part of the evaluation. Obfuscation tests use Linn–Debray samples and Hikari-built binaries; the authors note that a strong adversary using the model’s gradients could construct adversarial examples, which they leave to future work. The malware case reports 10-fold cross-validation accuracy on training data and log loss from the challenge’s online judge, because test labels are not public. Disassembly accuracy does not establish correct function boundaries in every case, decompilation or source recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅覆盖 x86 与 x64 的 ELF 和 PE 二进制。ELF 的真实标签假定代码节中没有数据，并基于线性反汇编与符号表获得；PE 的真实标签来自 PDB 文件，由于 PDB 只提供数据地址而无数据长度，数据长度为估计值。结果是作者 2022 年在自有数据集与硬件上与 Binary Ninja 2.2、IDA Pro 7.2 及 Ghidra 9.1.2 的比较，使用单块 GTX 2080Ti GPU；Datalog Disassembly 仅支持 x64 ELF，因此只覆盖部分评测。混淆测试使用 Linn–Debray 样本和以 Hikari 构建的二进制；作者指出，掌握模型梯度的强攻击者可能构造对抗样本，并将其留作后续工作。恶意软件案例报告训练数据上的十折交叉验证准确率，以及挑战赛在线评测系统返回的对数损失，因为测试标签并未公开。反汇编准确率不等于在所有情况下函数边界正确，也不代表反编译或源码恢复。
why_fits_en: Adds learned disassembly, the step whose errors several similarity and decompilation records list as a threat to validity, complementing IDA Pro-dependent pipelines such as jTrans.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于学习的反汇编研究；多个相似性与反编译条目将反汇编错误列为效度威胁，该研究与 jTrans 等依赖 IDA Pro 的流程互补。
metadata_notes: No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified; the record uses the USENIX Security presentation-page and sec22-yu-sheng.pdf profile. The USENIX BibTeX gives the 31st USENIX Security Symposium, pages 2709–2725, USENIX Association and month August; the presentation page also links a prepublication PDF and an abstract PDF. The paper describes a binary release. At reviewed commit e308252 (2026-05-01), the repository ships the model core as a prebuilt DeepDiCore.so under the DeepDi Trial Period Software Demonstration License Agreement, and license.txt applies MIT only to the other code, a Python wrapper, API notes and Dockerfiles; the GitHub API reports NOASSERTION, and the linked license PDF returned HTTP 404 when checked. The README calls this a community edition for non-commercial use, requires Docker and a free key from Deepbits, and supports optional CUDA GPUs. The model and training pipeline are not open source.
metadata_notes_zh: 未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符；本条目采用 USENIX Security 报告页面与 sec22-yu-sheng.pdf 配对规则。USENIX BibTeX 给出第 31 届 USENIX Security Symposium、页码 2709–2725、出版方 USENIX Association 及八月份；报告页面另链接预发表版 PDF 与摘要 PDF。论文称提供的是二进制发行版。在所审阅的提交 e308252（2026-05-01）中，仓库以预编译的 DeepDiCore.so 提供模型核心，适用 DeepDi Trial Period Software Demonstration License Agreement；license.txt 仅将其余代码（Python 封装、API 说明与 Dockerfile）列为 MIT 许可。GitHub API 报告为 NOASSERTION，所链接的许可证 PDF 在检查时返回 HTTP 404。README 称其为仅限非商业用途的社区版，需要 Docker 及从 Deepbits 免费获取的密钥，并可选用 CUDA GPU。模型与训练流程并未开源。

title: Noncompliance as Deviant Behavior: An Automated Black-box Noncompliance Checker for 4G LTE Cellular Devices
title_zh: 将不合规视为偏离行为：面向 4G LTE 蜂窝设备的自动化黑盒不合规检查器
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records published/print publication on 2021-11-12 and online publication on 2021-11-13. This entry uses the print date, not the November 15–19 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版日期记为 2021-11-12，在线出版日期为 2021-11-13。本条目采用纸质出版日期，而非 11 月 15–19 日的会议日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2021 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: DIKEUE checks 4G LTE control-plane (NAS and RRC) implementations in commercial phones and modems for noncompliance through differential testing rather than predefined security properties. Its FSM inference module runs TTT active automata learning in LearnLib through an LTE-specific adapter on a modified srsLTE network with a USRP B210 radio, adding a context checker, query cache, inconsistency resolver and reset without rebooting. An equivalence checker then encodes pairs of learned input-output finite state machines for the nuXmv model checker and enumerates diverse deviation-inducing input sequences, which the authors analyze manually.
description_zh: DIKEUE 通过差分测试而非预先定义的安全属性，检查商用手机和调制解调器中 4G LTE 控制面（NAS 与 RRC）实现的不合规之处。其状态机推断模块借助 LearnLib 中的 TTT 主动自动机学习，经由面向 LTE 的适配器在改造后的 srsLTE 网络和 USRP B210 无线电上运行，并加入上下文检查器、查询缓存、不一致消解器以及无需重启的复位机制。随后，等价性检查器将两两学到的输入输出有限状态机编码给 nuXmv 模型检查器，枚举多样的偏离诱发输入序列，再由作者人工分析。
scope_limitations_en: Covers control-plane NAS and RRC procedures with a chosen input alphabet and queries up to length 12; session management, data-plane protocols and 5G are left to future work. Learned machines are hypotheses bounded by Wp-method conformance testing and custom termination conditions. The authors list false-negative sources, including omitted message predicates, pruned infeasible sequences, models disconnected by removing deviating transitions, and devices that are noncompliant in the same way. Findings cover 14 devices with basebands from five vendors (Qualcomm, Intel, MediaTek, HiSilicon and Exynos): 17 deviations, 15 of them new, of which the authors class 11 as exploitable and 3 as potential interoperability issues. Deviations were triaged and attacks constructed manually, and the results do not establish the behaviour of other devices, firmware versions or networks.
scope_limitations_zh: 覆盖控制面的 NAS 与 RRC 流程，使用选定的输入字母表，查询长度最多为 12；会话管理、数据面协议和 5G 留待后续工作。学到的状态机只是假设，受 Wp 方法一致性测试和自定义终止条件的限制。作者列出了漏报来源，包括遗漏的报文谓词、被剪除的不可行序列、移除偏离迁移后断开的模型，以及以相同方式不合规的设备。研究发现覆盖基带来自五家厂商（高通、英特尔、联发科、海思与 Exynos）的 14 台设备：共 17 项偏离，其中 15 项为新发现，作者将其中 11 项归为可利用、3 项归为潜在互操作问题。偏离的甄别与攻击构造均为人工完成，结果不能代表其他设备、固件版本或网络的行为。
why_fits_en: Reconstructs protocol state machines of closed cellular basebands through black-box interaction and uses cross-implementation differences to locate noncompliance, extending the catalog's automata-learning work from Bluetooth Low Energy to 4G LTE devices.
why_fits_zh: 通过黑盒交互重建闭源蜂窝基带的协议状态机，并利用不同实现之间的差异定位不合规行为，将本目录中的自动机学习研究从低功耗蓝牙扩展到 4G LTE 设备。
metadata_notes: Crossref and the author-hosted PDF agree on the five-author order; pages 1082–1099 come from ACM's Crossref deposit. The 17-page author copy was uploaded in September 2021. The Apache-2.0 repository snapshot at 5975807 (2023-06-07) contains the FSM learner, modified srsLTE stack and configurations, device resetter and equivalence checker. Its README lists Ubuntu 18.04 (tested), a USRP B210 (tested SDR), adb, Graphviz, JDK 11, Maven, Python 2 and pydot; it also requires a SIM card programmed to srsLTE requirements and per-device airplane-mode reset functions, and reports about 40–45 minutes for the equivalence checker on two sample FSMs. The README bases the modified stack on srsLTE 19.03, whereas the paper names srsLTE v19.10. The authors report responsible disclosure to GSMA and the affected vendors.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与作者托管的 PDF 在五位作者顺序上一致；页码 1082–1099 来自 ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据。17 页作者版于 2021 年 9 月上传。采用 Apache-2.0 的仓库快照 5975807（2023-06-07）包含状态机学习器、改造后的 srsLTE 协议栈及配置、设备复位器和等价性检查器。其 README 列出 Ubuntu 18.04（已测试）、USRP B210（已测试的软件无线电）、adb、Graphviz、JDK 11、Maven、Python 2 与 pydot；还需要按 srsLTE 要求写入的 SIM 卡以及针对各设备的飞行模式复位函数，并称等价性检查器处理两个示例状态机约需 40–45 分钟。README 称改造的协议栈基于 srsLTE 19.03，而论文写的是 srsLTE v19.10。作者称已向 GSMA 及受影响厂商进行负责任披露。

title: LibreCAN: Automated CAN Message Translator
title_zh: LibreCAN：自动化 CAN 报文翻译器
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit gives 2019-11-06 for both print and online publication. The November 11–15 conference dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质和在线出版日期均记为 2019-11-06。本条目不以 11 月 11–15 日的会议日期代替。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2019 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: LibreCAN reverse-engineers proprietary CAN message formats from traffic recorded at a vehicle's OBD-II port, without the OEM's DBC translation files. Phase 0 extracts candidate signal boundaries from bit-flip behaviour, extending the earlier READ algorithm; Phase 1 correlates extracted signals with standard OBD-II PIDs and smartphone IMU data to identify kinematic signals and estimate their scale and offset; Phase 2 filters the CAN IDs recorded while a driver performs 53 scripted body-related events to shortlist candidate IDs for each event.
description_zh: LibreCAN 在没有整车厂 DBC 翻译文件的情况下，根据在车辆 OBD-II 接口记录的流量逆向专有的 CAN 报文格式。阶段 0 扩展早期的 READ 算法，依据比特翻转行为提取候选信号边界；阶段 1 将提取出的信号与标准 OBD-II PID 及智能手机惯性测量数据做相关分析，识别运动学相关信号并估计其比例系数和偏移量；阶段 2 对驾驶者执行 53 个预定车身相关事件时记录的 CAN ID 进行过滤，为每个事件筛选候选 ID。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluated on four newer vehicles from a single OEM, using DBC files the authors obtained as ground truth and their own judgement of which CAN signals correspond to each reference signal; they call the evaluation partly subjective because the OEM was not involved. Phase 0 recovered 51.6–62.4% of DBC signals, but only 21.0–36.4% of extracted signals had correct boundaries, partly because normal driving rarely exercises high value ranges. With extracted boundaries, Phase 1 precision was 61.1–78.1% and recall 25.6–57.3%; Phase 2 cut candidates more than tenfold, with 8.5–15.0% precision. Only buses reachable through OBD-II were analysed, so signals on other buses were missed. The system reads traffic only and recovers a partial translation table, not complete DBC files, ECU logic or validated injection.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测使用来自同一整车厂的四辆较新车辆，以作者获得的 DBC 文件作为真实标签，并由作者自行判断哪些 CAN 信号对应各参考信号；作者指出，由于整车厂未参与，评测带有一定主观性。阶段 0 提取了 DBC 中 51.6–62.4% 的信号，但提取结果中只有 21.0–36.4% 的边界正确，部分原因是正常驾驶很少覆盖较高的取值范围。使用提取出的边界时，阶段 1 的精确率为 61.1–78.1%，召回率为 25.6–57.3%；阶段 2 将候选数量减少十倍以上，精确率为 8.5–15.0%。只分析了可经 OBD-II 访问的总线，其他总线上的信号因此被遗漏。系统只读取流量，恢复的是部分翻译表，而非完整的 DBC 文件、ECU 逻辑或经过验证的注入能力。
why_fits_en: Adds automated reverse engineering of proprietary in-vehicle CAN message formats from passive traffic and reference signals, complementing the catalog's CAN tooling and network-protocol inference research.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助被动流量与参考信号自动逆向专有车载 CAN 报文格式的研究，与本目录中的 CAN 工具及网络协议推断研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the title LibreCAN with the subtitle Automated CAN Message Translator, the six-author order and pages 2283–2300. The 18-page copy on the University of Michigan Real-Time Computing Laboratory site is an ACM-formatted author version created on 2019-09-25. The paper reports roughly 40 minutes of manual data collection (a 30-minute drive and a 10-minute event session) and 70–79 seconds of computation per vehicle; its 10-participant event-recording study received IRB approval. Data came from an ELM327 dongle, an OpenXC dongle on a Y-cable and the Torque Pro Android app, and computation used Python 3 on Ubuntu 16.04. The mdp93/LibreCAN_CCS repository at e10aea7 contains only a project README and site configuration, with no license or implementation, and no DBC ground truth or vehicle traces were found in the reviewed sources.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录的标题为 LibreCAN，副标题为 Automated CAN Message Translator，并给出六位作者顺序和页码 2283–2300。18 页副本托管于密歇根大学实时计算实验室网站，是 2019-09-25 生成的 ACM 排版作者版。论文报告每辆车约需 40 分钟人工采集数据（30 分钟驾驶加 10 分钟事件操作）和 70–79 秒计算；其 10 名参与者的事件记录实验获得了 IRB 批准。数据来自 ELM327 适配器、经 Y 型线连接的 OpenXC 适配器和 Torque Pro 安卓应用，计算在 Ubuntu 16.04 上使用 Python 3 完成。mdp93/LibreCAN_CCS 仓库在 e10aea7 中只有项目 README 和站点配置，没有许可证或实现代码；在所审阅的来源中也未找到 DBC 真实标签或车辆轨迹数据。

title: Automatic Firmware Emulation through Invalidity-guided Knowledge Inference
title_zh: 基于无效性引导知识推断的自动化固件仿真
date_basis: The BibTeX on the USENIX presentation page gives August 2021 for the 30th USENIX Security Symposium proceedings. Month precision is retained; the symposium dates are not substituted for a publication day, and the July 2021 arXiv dates belong to the extended version.
date_basis_zh: USENIX 论文页面的 BibTeX 将第 30 届 USENIX Security 研讨会论文集的出版时间列为 2021 年 8 月。本条目保留月份精度，不以会议日期代替具体出版日；2021 年 7 月的 arXiv 日期属于扩展版。

citation.container_title: 30th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 21)

description_en: µEmu emulates ARM Cortex-M microcontroller firmware without real hardware or hand-written peripheral models by symbolically executing the image with unknown peripheral registers as symbols. Invalidity-guided exploration detects invalid states such as unexpected infinite loops and steers execution toward valid paths, caching the chosen responses at individual peripheral access points in a tiered knowledge base whose rules range from simple storage to PC- and calling-context-based matching. During dynamic analysis the knowledge base answers peripheral reads while an integrated, modified AFL fuzzer supplies data-register input. The prototype extends S2E 2.0 with Cortex-M support.
description_zh: µEmu 将未知外设寄存器表示为符号，对固件映像进行符号执行，从而在没有真实硬件或人工编写外设模型的情况下仿真 ARM Cortex-M 微控制器固件。无效性引导的探索会检测意外死循环等无效状态，并把执行引向有效路径；所选响应按单个外设访问点缓存在分层知识库中，规则从简单存储到基于程序计数器和调用上下文的匹配。动态分析阶段由知识库响应外设读取，集成的改造版 AFL 模糊测试器则提供数据寄存器输入。原型在 S2E 2.0 基础上增加了 Cortex-M 支持。
scope_limitations_en: Targets ARM Cortex-M firmware; the repository lists DMA and other architectures as unsupported help-wanted items. Responses only have to satisfy the firmware's own checks rather than reproduce real peripheral values, so successful emulation does not establish hardware equivalence. Invalidity checks can miss unhandled error paths, data registers can be mis-categorized (3 of 43 were missed against ground truth taken from chip manuals), and long loops whose concrete counters depend on symbols may go undetected. On P2IM's 66 unit tests the final paper reports 63 passes (95%) without manual help, and all after adding one invalid program point to each failure. Across 21 real-world firmware samples, 6 needed a user-defined invalid point and 3 a manually added data register. Coverage counts QEMU translation blocks against IDA-counted basic blocks, following P2IM.
scope_limitations_zh: 面向 ARM Cortex-M 固件；仓库将 DMA 及其他架构列为尚未支持、征求帮助的事项。响应只需通过固件自身的检查，而不必复现真实外设的取值，因此仿真成功不能证明与硬件等价。无效性检查可能漏掉未处理的错误路径，数据寄存器可能被错误分类（以芯片手册得出的真实标签衡量，43 个中漏掉 3 个），计数器为具体值但依赖符号的长循环也可能检测不到。在 P2IM 的 66 个单元测试上，正式论文报告无需人工协助即通过 63 个（95%），为每个失败样本添加一个无效程序点后全部通过。在 21 个真实固件样本中，6 个需要用户定义一个无效点，3 个需要人工补充一个数据寄存器。覆盖率沿用 P2IM 的做法，以 QEMU 翻译块数对比 IDA 统计的基本块数。
why_fits_en: Adds symbolic-execution-based inference of peripheral behaviour for rehosting microcontroller firmware, complementing the catalog's HAL-replacement and MMIO-modelling approaches.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助符号执行推断外设行为、用于重托管微控制器固件的方法，与本目录中替换硬件抽象层和建模 MMIO 的方法互补。
metadata_notes: The USENIX presentation-page BibTeX establishes the four-author order, proceedings title, pages 2007–2024 and August 2021. A footnote in the final PDF points to the authors' extended version on arXiv, titled with an "(Extended Version)" suffix (v1 2021-07-16, v2 2021-07-27), which is recorded as the arXiv identifier; no publisher DOI was found. The presentation-page abstract reports a 93% unit-test passing rate, whereas the final paper and the arXiv abstract report 95%. The MCUSec/uEmu snapshot at c82fc0a (2023-11-20) has mixed terms: its add-on plugins use the Cyberhaven Research License of S2E 2.0 (non-commercial use only), its AFL changes Apache-2.0, QEMU GPL-2.0, and other S2E libraries LGPL-2.1, BSD/MIT or NCSA licenses; GitHub reports NOASSERTION. The README supports Ubuntu 18.04 or 20.04 (64-bit) or a Vagrant VM, fetches sources through a repo manifest, estimates about an hour to build on four cores, keeps unit-test and real-world firmware configurations in separate repositories, and uses an IDA script to count basic blocks for coverage.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 论文页面的 BibTeX 确认了四位作者的顺序、论文集名称、页码 2007–2024 以及 2021 年 8 月。正式 PDF 的脚注指向作者在 arXiv 上的扩展版，标题带有“(Extended Version)”后缀（v1 为 2021-07-16，v2 为 2021-07-27），本条目将其记为 arXiv 标识；未找到出版方 DOI。论文页面摘要称单元测试通过率为 93%，正式论文与 arXiv 摘要则为 95%。MCUSec/uEmu 快照 c82fc0a（2023-11-20）的许可条款不一：附加插件采用 S2E 2.0 的 Cyberhaven Research License（仅限非商业用途），AFL 修改部分采用 Apache-2.0，QEMU 采用 GPL-2.0，其他 S2E 库分别采用 LGPL-2.1、BSD/MIT 或 NCSA 许可；GitHub 显示为 NOASSERTION。README 支持 Ubuntu 18.04 或 20.04（64 位）或 Vagrant 虚拟机，通过 repo 清单获取源码，在四核机器上构建约需一小时；单元测试与真实固件配置放在独立仓库中，并使用 IDA 脚本统计基本块以计算覆盖率。

title: What Your Firmware Tells You Is Not How You Should Emulate It: A Specification-Guided Approach for Firmware Emulation
title_zh: 固件所示并非应有的仿真方式：一种规范引导的固件仿真方法
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit gives 2022-11-07 for both print and online publication. The conference dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质和在线出版日期均记为 2022-11-07。本条目不以会议日期代替。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: SEmu builds microcontroller peripheral models from vendor reference manuals rather than from the firmware itself. An NLP pipeline built on the Stanford tagger and parser turns register descriptions, interrupt tables and DMA channel tables taken from the manuals into structured condition-action rules, which the emulator checks, executes and chains at run time to answer MMIO accesses and raise interrupts or DMA requests. A symbolic-execution diagnostic tool built on S2E and µEmu traces invalid states back to the rules likely responsible, so that a person can correct them. The authors also use the models for fuzzing and to check driver code against specification rules.
description_zh: SEmu 依据厂商参考手册而非固件本身构建微控制器外设模型。一条基于 Stanford 词性标注器和句法分析器的 NLP 流程，把取自手册的寄存器说明、中断表和 DMA 通道表转换为结构化的条件—动作规则；仿真器在运行时检查、执行并串联这些规则，以响应 MMIO 访问并触发中断或 DMA 请求。基于 S2E 和 µEmu 的符号执行诊断工具会把无效状态回溯到可能出错的规则，供人工修正。作者还将这些模型用于模糊测试，以及依据规范规则检查驱动代码。
scope_limitations_en: Rule extraction is not fully automatic. The NLP engine mishandles cross-sentence references and nested conditions, and the raw rules for the clock peripherals of all three unit-test chips broke booting, so every one of P2IM's 66 unit tests failed until those rules were revised. After diagnosis-guided manual correction (26 rules added, 21 fixed and 3 removed, against 3,602 rules extracted from 23,424 sentences), the authors report that all 66 unit tests and 17 additional samples were emulated. Users must identify the MCU, configure memory maps and copy the needed manual sections into the pipeline, and diagnosis needs prepared test firmware; three developers took about two hours on average to fix the F103 I2C rules. The prototype covers 26 peripherals on five boards from three vendors (STM32F1, F4 and L1, NXP K64 and Atmel SAM3X), and trace-fidelity comparisons used real-hardware traces from only the K64F and F103RB boards. Rules model documented behaviour and do not establish equivalence with the silicon.
scope_limitations_zh: 规则提取并非完全自动。NLP 引擎难以处理跨句指代和嵌套条件；三款单元测试芯片上时钟外设的原始规则都导致启动失败，因此在修订这些规则之前，P2IM 的 66 个单元测试全部失败。经诊断引导的人工修正后（在从 23,424 个句子中提取的 3,602 条规则中新增 26 条、修正 21 条、删除 3 条），作者报告全部 66 个单元测试以及另外 17 个样本均能仿真。用户需要识别 MCU、配置内存映射，并把所需的手册章节复制到流程中；诊断还需要事先准备测试固件。三名开发者修正 F103 I2C 规则平均约需两小时。原型覆盖三家厂商五款开发板（STM32F1、F4、L1，NXP K64 与 Atmel SAM3X）上的 26 种外设；轨迹保真度比较只在 K64F 和 F103RB 两块开发板上使用了真实硬件轨迹。规则所建模的是文档记载的行为，不能证明与芯片实物等价。
why_fits_en: Adds specification-derived peripheral modelling for rehosting microcontroller firmware, complementing firmware-guided approaches such as MMIO modelling and invalidity-guided inference.
why_fits_zh: 补充依据规范构建外设模型、用于重托管微控制器固件的方法，与 MMIO 建模和无效性引导推断等以固件为依据的方法互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the title, subtitle, five-author order, pages 3269–3283 and print and online publication on 2022-11-07; the ACM full text is not open access. arXiv v3 (2022-10-11; v1 2022-08-16) is the authors' 18-page extended version and states that Wei Zhou and Lan Zhang contributed equally; the figures in this record come from it. The MCUSec/SEmu snapshot at 6dc8be9 (2025-04-22) declares Apache-2.0 for the rule extractor and the non-commercial Cyberhaven Research License of S2E 2.0 for the S2E-based rule doctor, and points to IoTS-P/SEmu-Fuzz, which is Apache-2.0, for fuzzing; GitHub reports NOASSERTION for the main repository. The repository also redistributes vendor reference-manual PDFs, whose terms are separate, and directs users to a Google Drive copy of the Stanford tagger and parser. Building the rule doctor follows µEmu's S2E 2.0 package list and repo manifest, with an estimated 30–60 minutes on four cores.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录了标题、副标题、五位作者的顺序、页码 3269–3283，以及 2022-11-07 的纸质和在线出版日期；ACM 全文并非开放获取。arXiv v3（2022-10-11；v1 为 2022-08-16）是作者 18 页的扩展版，并注明 Wei Zhou 与 Lan Zhang 贡献相同；本条目中的数据取自该版本。MCUSec/SEmu 快照 6dc8be9（2025-04-22）声明规则提取器采用 Apache-2.0，基于 S2E 的规则诊断工具采用 S2E 2.0 的非商业 Cyberhaven Research License，模糊测试部分则指向采用 Apache-2.0 的 IoTS-P/SEmu-Fuzz；GitHub 对主仓库显示 NOASSERTION。仓库还转载了厂商参考手册 PDF，其使用条款另行适用，并引导用户从 Google Drive 获取 Stanford 词性标注器和句法分析器。构建规则诊断工具需按照 µEmu 的 S2E 2.0 软件包列表和 repo 清单进行，在四核机器上预计耗时 30–60 分钟。

title: Conware: Automated Modeling of Hardware Peripherals
title_zh: Conware：硬件外设的自动化建模
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records published/print publication on 2021-05-24 and online publication on 2021-06-04. This entry uses the print date, not the June 7–11 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版日期记为 2021-05-24，在线出版日期为 2021-06-04。本条目采用纸质出版日期，而非 6 月 7–11 日的会议日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2021 ACM Asia Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: Conware builds reusable software models of hardware peripherals from recordings of real firmware–peripheral interactions. An LLVM pass instruments Arduino source code to log MMIO reads, writes and interrupts on the real board, with existing hardware-in-the-loop recording as an alternative. Each recording becomes a per-peripheral graph whose read values are summarized as simple sub-models such as patterns; graphs are merged and optimized into automata that can be combined across peripherals and run in an Avatar²-based emulator. The authors model ten peripherals on an Arduino Due (SAM3X Cortex-M3) and emulate an uninstrumented smart-door-lock firmware from models trained only on vendor example code.
description_zh: Conware 根据真实固件与外设交互的记录，构建可复用的硬件外设软件模型。一个 LLVM 编译遍对 Arduino 源码插桩，在真实开发板上记录 MMIO 读写和中断；也可改用已有的硬件在环记录方法。每份记录被转换为按外设划分的图，读取值以模式等简单子模型概括；这些图再经合并与优化形成自动机，可跨外设组合，并在基于 Avatar² 的仿真器中运行。作者在 Arduino Due（SAM3X Cortex-M3）上为十种外设建模，并仅用基于厂商示例代码训练的模型，仿真了一个未经插桩的智能门锁固件。
scope_limitations_en: Training needs the real board with the peripherals attached, plus source code for the LLVM-based recorder. The evaluation covers bare-metal Arduino Due firmware with ten hobbyist peripherals, and port-mapped I/O systems are out of scope. Models encode only behaviour observed during recording, assume that state transitions follow MMIO writes, and attach interrupts to transitions rather than to the writes that trigger them, so read-triggered transitions and exact interrupt timing are not supported. The unseen-firmware result is a single door-lock program built from six peripheral models. Its UART output matched real hardware, and it executed 362 of the 609 basic blocks (59%) and 58 of the 68 functions (85%) reachable from loop(); the authors measure survivability of execution rather than full peripheral fidelity. Record-and-replay comparisons ran each sample once for 10 minutes, since replays are deterministic.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练需要接好外设的真实开发板，以及供基于 LLVM 的记录器使用的源代码。评测覆盖带有十种爱好者常用外设的裸机 Arduino Due 固件，端口映射 I/O 系统不在范围内。模型只编码记录期间观察到的行为，假定状态迁移由 MMIO 写操作驱动，并把中断附在状态迁移上而非触发它的写操作上，因此不支持由读操作触发的迁移和精确的中断时序。针对未见固件的结果只有一个由六个外设模型组合而成的门锁程序：其 UART 输出与真实硬件一致，执行了从 loop() 可达的 609 个基本块中的 362 个（59%）和 68 个函数中的 58 个（85%）；作者衡量的是执行能否持续，而非外设的完整保真度。由于重放是确定性的，记录与重放对比中每个样本只运行一次，每次 10 分钟。
why_fits_en: Adds record-and-model reconstruction of peripherals from real hardware interactions, complementing the catalog's HAL-replacement, firmware-guided and specification-guided rehosting approaches.
why_fits_zh: 补充依据真实硬件交互记录并重建外设模型的方法，与本目录中替换硬件抽象层、以固件为依据和以规范为依据的重托管方法互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the nine-author order, pages 95–109, print publication on 2021-05-24 and online publication on 2021-06-04. The 15-page copy on Christopher Kruegel's UCSB site carries the ACM reference format and DOI. The paper cites ucsb-seclab/conware for its code; the snapshot at 05dfdf5 (2020-07-19, committed as the submitted version of the code) declares no license. Its README pipeline instruments Arduino code with LLVM, runs it on a real Arduino with the peripheral attached, dumps logs over UART, and then generates, optimizes and emulates models with Avatar² and OpenOCD; the install script builds LLVM. Two submodules, pretender and avatar2-pretender, use SSH URLs on the UCSB lab's own Git server, and the pinned requirements include Python 2 backport packages such as enum34.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录了九位作者的顺序、页码 95–109、2021-05-24 的纸质出版日期和 2021-06-04 的在线出版日期。15 页副本托管在 Christopher Kruegel 的 UCSB 网站上，带有 ACM 引用格式和 DOI。论文引用 ucsb-seclab/conware 作为代码；快照 05dfdf5（2020-07-19，提交说明为代码的投稿版本）未声明许可证。其 README 流程是用 LLVM 对 Arduino 代码插桩，在接好外设的真实 Arduino 上运行，通过 UART 导出日志，再借助 Avatar² 和 OpenOCD 生成、优化并仿真模型；安装脚本会编译 LLVM。pretender 与 avatar2-pretender 两个子模块使用指向 UCSB 实验室自有 Git 服务器的 SSH 地址，固定的依赖中还包含 enum34 等 Python 2 向后移植包。

title: A Taxonomy of C Decompiler Fidelity Issues
title_zh: C 语言反编译器保真度问题分类
date_basis: Publication month from the official USENIX BibTeX (month = aug) and the final PDF cover for the 33rd USENIX Security Symposium, August 14–16, 2024; no exact publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方 BibTeX（month = aug）及第 33 届 USENIX Security Symposium（2024 年 8 月 14–16 日）最终版 PDF 封面所载的出版月份，不推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 33rd USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 24)

description_en: Open-codes decompiled/original C function pairs to classify how decompiler output departs from the source beyond missing names and types. Using a statement-alignment abstraction and thematic analysis, the authors build a hierarchical codebook of 15 top-level categories and 52 codes, covering correctness issues such as nonequivalent expressions and incorrect return behavior and readability issues such as extraneous variables, non-idiomatic control flow and decompiler-specific macros. The codebook, developed on Hex-Rays output, is applied to Ghidra, retdec and angr, and the authors suggest type prediction, rule-based fixes and whole-program learned techniques to address classes of defects.
description_zh: 对反编译所得与原始 C 函数构成的代码对进行开放式编码，归纳反编译器输出在缺失名称与类型之外如何偏离源码。作者借助语句对齐抽象与主题分析，构建包含 15 个顶层类别、共 52 个编码的层级化编码手册，既涵盖不等价表达式、错误返回行为等正确性问题，也涵盖多余变量、不符合惯用写法的控制流及反编译器特有宏等可读性问题。该编码手册基于 Hex-Rays 输出建立，并应用于 Ghidra、retdec 与 angr；作者据此提出以类型预测、基于规则的修正及整程序级学习技术来应对各类缺陷。
scope_limitations_en: A qualitative taxonomy, not a benchmark score or decompiler ranking. Coding centres on a random sample of 200 Hex-Rays decompiled/original pairs from the small-function set plus ten large functions; the authors report 235 coded pairs in total. Ghidra, retdec and angr were compared with Hex-Rays only on a 25-function subsample. Inputs are Hex-Rays decompilations of GHCC builds of majority-C GitHub repositories, biased toward projects with recognizable, working build scripts and filtered by a step that also removed some valid functions; the dataset contains no obfuscated binaries and is unlikely to include malware. Missing variable names and types were deliberately not labeled. The Java check applies the codebook to 25 Defects4J functions decompiled with JD-GUI as a side study. The issues’ effect on reverse-engineer productivity is left to future work.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是定性分类，并非基准分数或反编译器排名。编码主要基于从小函数集中随机抽取的 200 个 Hex-Rays 反编译／原始函数对，另加十个大型函数；作者报告共编码 235 个函数对。Ghidra、retdec 与 angr 仅在 25 个函数的子样本上与 Hex-Rays 比较。输入是对多数代码为 C 的 GitHub 仓库经 GHCC 构建后的 Hex-Rays 反编译结果，偏向具有可识别且可用构建脚本的项目，并经过一个也误删部分有效函数的过滤步骤；数据集不含混淆二进制，也不太可能包含恶意软件。缺失的变量名与类型被有意不作标注。Java 检查作为附带研究，将编码手册应用于 25 个经 JD-GUI 反编译的 Defects4J 函数。这些问题对逆向工程人员工作效率的影响留待后续研究。
why_fits_en: Adds an empirical taxonomy of what decompiled C gets wrong, complementing decompiler benchmarks with automated scores and LLM repair methods such as FidelityGPT.
why_fits_zh: 补充关于反编译 C 代码错在何处的实证分类，与采用自动评分的反编译基准及 FidelityGPT 等大语言模型修复方法互补。
metadata_notes: No paper DOI or arXiv identifier was verified; the record uses the USENIX Security 2024 presentation-page and usenixsecurity24-dramko.pdf profile. The USENIX BibTeX gives the 33rd USENIX Security Symposium, pages 379–396, USENIX Association and month August; the presentation page also links a prepublication PDF. The paper’s Availability section points to Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8419614, a CC BY 4.0 dataset record dated 2023-11-07 by the same five creators with codebook.pdf and dataset.zip; that DOI identifies the coded examples and codebook, not this paper. The paper versions only JD-GUI (1.6.6) and names no Hex-Rays, Ghidra, retdec or angr versions. Intercoder agreement is reported as Cohen’s kappa and is weaker for rare issues.
metadata_notes_zh: 未核实论文 DOI 或 arXiv 标识符；本条目采用 USENIX Security 2024 报告页面与 usenixsecurity24-dramko.pdf 配对规则。USENIX BibTeX 给出第 33 届 USENIX Security Symposium、页码 379–396、出版方 USENIX Association 及八月份；报告页面另链接预发表版 PDF。论文“可用性”一节指向 Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8419614，这是同五位作者于 2023-11-07 发布的 CC BY 4.0 数据集记录，包含 codebook.pdf 与 dataset.zip；该 DOI 标识编码示例与编码手册，并非本论文。论文只注明 JD-GUI 的版本（1.6.6），未给出 Hex-Rays、Ghidra、retdec 或 angr 的版本。编码者间一致性以 Cohen’s kappa 报告，罕见问题的一致性较弱。

title: Refining Decompiled C Code with Large Language Models
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper proposes a two-step hybrid LLM approach to refine IDA-Pro decompiled C code for recompilation. On popular C test cases, it reports a recompilation success rate above 75% with moderate effort.
description_zh: 论文提出一种两步混合方法，利用大语言模型改进 IDA-Pro 反编译生成的 C 代码，使其能够重新编译。在一组常见的 C 测试用例上，该方法以适度工作量实现了超过 75% 的重新编译成功率。
scope_limitations_en: The pilot study examines obstacles in recompiling IDA-Pro output; the evaluation uses a set of popular C test cases.
scope_limitations_zh: 先导研究考察了重新编译 IDA-Pro 输出时遇到的障碍；评估使用了一组常见的 C 测试用例。
why_fits_en: It addresses reverse engineering of executables by improving decompiled C code for recompilation.
why_fits_zh: 论文通过改进可执行文件反编译得到的 C 代码，使其能够重新编译，属于逆向工程研究。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 利用大语言模型改进反编译的 C 代码
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: ICSREF: A Framework for Automated Reverse Engineering of Industrial Control Systems Binaries
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings 2019 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium
description_en: ICSREF automates reverse engineering of PLC binaries compiled with CODESYS. It was evaluated on collected and in-house PLC binaries and used to generate an attack against a chemical process testbed.
description_zh: ICSREF 自动逆向分析由 CODESYS 编译的可编程逻辑控制器二进制文件。研究使用收集和自行开发的 PLC 二进制文件进行评估，并将其用于生成针对化工过程测试平台的攻击。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers CODESYS-compiled PLC binaries from public code repositories and in-house development, plus an attack orchestrated by a commercial smartphone against a chemical process testbed.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围包括来自公共代码仓库和自行开发的 CODESYS 编译 PLC 二进制文件，以及由商用智能手机协调、针对化工过程测试平台的攻击。
why_fits_en: It presents a framework and methodology for automated reverse engineering of industrial control system binaries.
why_fits_zh: 论文提出了自动逆向分析工业控制系统二进制文件的框架和方法。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: ICSREF：工业控制系统二进制文件自动化逆向工程框架
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: On Manually Reverse Engineering Communication Protocols of Linux Based IoT Systems
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: Presents a manual framework for reverse engineering communication protocols in embedded Linux IoT systems. It applies the framework to several systems and details a WeMo smart plug case study.
description_zh: 提出一种针对嵌入式 Linux 物联网系统通信协议的人工逆向工程框架，并将其应用于多个系统，详细展示了 WeMo 智能插座的案例。
scope_limitations_en: The detailed evaluation covers a WeMo smart plug: extracting firmware from flash, analyzing it statically and dynamically, and examining network traffic. The framework covers read-only and writable embedded Linux filesystems.
scope_limitations_zh: 详细案例针对 WeMo 智能插座，包括从闪存提取固件、对固件进行静态和动态分析，以及分析网络流量。框架适用于只读和可写的嵌入式 Linux 文件系统。
why_fits_en: It describes a practical workflow for discovering an IoT device’s communication protocol through firmware and traffic analysis.
why_fits_zh: 论文展示了结合固件与网络流量分析来发现物联网设备通信协议的实际流程。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 基于 Linux 的物联网系统通信协议的人工逆向工程
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Frankenstein: Advanced Wireless Fuzzing to Exploit New Bluetooth Escalation Targets
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; the arXiv comment names the venue.
description_en: Frankenstein emulates Bluetooth firmware dumps and fuzzes a virtual modem. It evaluates Broadcom and Cypress stacks, finding three zero-click vulnerabilities, host escalation issues, and BlueFrag on Android.
description_zh: Frankenstein 仿真蓝牙固件转储，并对虚拟调制解调器进行模糊测试。论文评估了博通和赛普拉斯蓝牙协议栈，发现三个零点击漏洞、涉及主机的权限提升问题，以及 Android 上的 BlueFrag 漏洞。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers Broadcom and Cypress Bluetooth stacks, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth coexistence, a Bluetooth 5.2 link-key flaw, and Android devices.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围包括博通和赛普拉斯蓝牙协议栈、Wi-Fi 与蓝牙共存机制、蓝牙 5.2 的链路密钥问题，以及 Android 设备。
why_fits_en: It uses emulation of closed-source firmware dumps to examine Bluetooth behavior and find vulnerabilities.
why_fits_zh: 论文通过仿真闭源固件转储来分析蓝牙行为并发现漏洞，符合逆向工程主题。
metadata_notes: The arXiv comment reads: To be published at USENIX Security
title_zh: Frankenstein：利用高级无线模糊测试攻击新的蓝牙权限提升目标
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期；arXiv 备注中写明发表场所。
metadata_notes_zh: 发表场所依据 arXiv 备注。

title: From Library Portability to Para-rehosting: Natively Executing Microcontroller Software on Commodity Hardware
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings 2021 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium
description_en: The paper uses a POSIX-based portable MCU and replaceable peripheral drivers to rehost MCU software for native execution and security testing on commodity hardware.
description_zh: 论文通过基于 POSIX 的可移植微控制器模型和可替换的外设驱动，将微控制器软件迁移到通用硬件上原生运行并进行安全测试。
scope_limitations_en: It rehosts nine MCU operating systems, including Amazon FreeRTOS, ARM Mbed OS, Zephyr, and LiteOS. AFL and ASAN testing found 28 previously unknown bugs; five received CVEs and 19 were confirmed by vendors at the time of writing.
scope_limitations_zh: 论文将九种微控制器操作系统迁移至通用硬件，包括 Amazon FreeRTOS、ARM Mbed OS、Zephyr 和 LiteOS。使用 AFL 和 ASAN 测试发现 28 个此前未知的漏洞；其中 5 个获得 CVE 编号，19 个在撰文时得到厂商确认。
why_fits_en: It presents a way to run MCU firmware on commodity hardware so existing dynamic analysis tools can find bugs.
why_fits_zh: 论文提出在通用硬件上运行微控制器固件的方法，使现有动态分析工具能够发现漏洞。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: 从库可移植性到辅助重宿主：在通用硬件上原生运行微控制器软件
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Trex: Learning Execution Semantics from Micro-Traces for Binary Similarity
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: Trex learns execution semantics from function micro-traces, then uses that knowledge to match semantically similar binary functions.
description_zh: Trex 从函数微轨迹中学习执行语义，再利用所学知识匹配语义相似的二进制函数。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers 1,472,066 function binaries from 13 software projects, across architectures, compiler optimizations, and obfuscations.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估涵盖 13 个软件项目的 1,472,066 个二进制函数，涉及不同架构、编译器优化和混淆方式。
why_fits_en: It addresses binary function similarity by learning execution behavior from traces.
why_fits_zh: 该研究通过从轨迹中学习执行行为，解决二进制函数相似性分析问题。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: Trex：从微轨迹中学习执行语义以识别相似二进制函数
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: A Cross-Architecture Instruction Embedding Model for Natural Language Processing-Inspired Binary Code Analysis
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper learns instruction embeddings that capture semantic relationships within and across architectures. It evaluates them on semantic basic-block comparison, outperforming a code-statistics approach.
description_zh: 论文学习指令嵌入，以捕捉架构内部及跨架构的指令语义关系，并将其用于基于语义的基本块比较；结果优于基于代码统计的方法。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluates semantic basic-block comparison across architectures on disassembled binary code.
scope_limitations_zh: 在反汇编的二进制代码上，评估跨架构的基本块语义比较。
why_fits_en: It addresses cross-architecture binary code analysis through learned instruction representations.
why_fits_zh: 论文通过学习指令表示来研究跨架构二进制代码分析。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 用于受自然语言处理启发的二进制代码分析的跨架构指令嵌入模型
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: D-LiFT: Improving LLM-based Decompiler Backend via Code Quality-driven Fine-tuning
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: D-LIFT uses D-Score to guide LLM fine-tuning and output selection, improving decompiled code while prioritizing accuracy. It evaluates Ghidra output from coreutils and util-linux.
description_zh: D-LIFT 使用 D-Score 指导大语言模型微调和输出选择，在优先保证准确性的同时改善反编译代码，并评估了 Ghidra 对 coreutils 和 util-linux 程序的输出。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers functions from coreutils and util-linux, using Ghidra and a range of LLMs. D-Score measured 55.3% more improved functions than baseline LLMs and improvements to 68.2% of native decompiler functions.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估涵盖 coreutils 和 util-linux 中的函数，使用 Ghidra 和多种大语言模型。按 D-Score 衡量，微调后的模型比基线模型多改善了 55.3% 的函数；D-LIFT 改善了原生反编译器输出中 68.2% 的函数。
why_fits_en: It addresses the accuracy and readability of source code reconstructed from binaries.
why_fits_zh: 该研究关注从二进制文件重建的源代码的准确性和可读性。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: D-LiFT：通过代码质量驱动的微调改进基于大语言模型的反编译器后端
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: BaseSAFE: Baseband SAnitized Fuzzing through Emulation
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings of the 13th ACM Conference on Security and Privacy in Wireless and Mobile Networks
description_en: BaseSAFE partially rehosts closed-source cellular baseband firmware for instrumented fuzzing and uses a sanitizing allocator to detect heap buffer overflows.
description_zh: BaseSAFE 将闭源蜂窝基带固件部分迁移到仿真环境中进行插桩模糊测试，并用净化分配器检测堆缓冲区溢出。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation fuzzed rogue-base-station-accessible parsers in a Nucleus RTOS-based MediaTek baseband, using LTE signaling message test cases. It found memory corruption and reached about 15,000 test cases per second in total.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估对象是基于 Nucleus RTOS 的联发科基带中可由伪基站触及的解析器，测试用例为 LTE 信令消息。测试发现了内存破坏问题，总吞吐量约为每秒 15,000 个测试用例。
why_fits_en: It reverse engineers and rehosts commercial baseband firmware to expose its parsers to off-device security testing.
why_fits_zh: 论文对商用基带固件进行逆向分析和重宿主，使其解析器能够在设备外接受安全测试。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: BaseSAFE：通过仿真实现基带净化模糊测试
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Towards Neural Decompilation
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper trains a neural machine translation decompiler using a compiler. It evaluates translation from LLVM IR and x86 assembly to C, successfully decompiling over 97% and 88% of its respective benchmarks.
description_zh: 论文利用编译器训练基于神经机器翻译的反编译器，并评估将 LLVM IR 和 x86 汇编转换为 C 代码的效果；两组基准的成功率分别超过 97% 和 88%。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers LLVM IR and x86 assembly translated to C on the paper's benchmarks.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围是在论文使用的基准上，将 LLVM IR 和 x86 汇编转换为 C 代码。
why_fits_en: It addresses reverse engineering by recovering human-readable source code from low-level program representations.
why_fits_zh: 论文从低级程序表示恢复人类可读的源代码，属于逆向工程研究。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 迈向神经网络反编译
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: FoC: Figure out the Cryptographic Functions in Stripped Binaries with LLMs
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: FoC uses FoC-BinLLM to summarize cryptographic functions in stripped binaries and FoC-Sim to retrieve similar implementations. It evaluates both models and applications to virus analysis and 1-day vulnerability detection.
description_zh: FoC 使用 FoC-BinLLM 概括去符号二进制文件中密码函数的语义，并使用 FoC-Sim 检索相似实现。论文评估了两个模型，以及它们在病毒分析和已披露一天的漏洞检测中的应用。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses a constructed cryptographic binary dataset and automatically generated semantic labels. It reports a 14.61% higher ROUGE-L score than ChatGPT for FoC-BinLLM and 52% higher Recall@1 than previous best methods for FoC-Sim.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估使用构建的密码函数二进制数据集和自动生成的语义标签。论文报告 FoC-BinLLM 的 ROUGE-L 分数比 ChatGPT 高 14.61%，FoC-Sim 的 Recall@1 比此前最佳方法高 52%。
why_fits_en: It addresses reverse engineering of cryptographic functions in stripped binaries through semantic analysis and similarity retrieval.
why_fits_zh: 论文通过语义分析和相似实现检索，研究去符号二进制文件中密码函数的逆向分析。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: FoC：利用大语言模型识别去符号二进制文件中的密码函数
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Asteria-Pro: Enhancing Deep-Learning Based Binary Code Similarity Detection by Incorporating Domain Knowledge
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: Asteria-Pro adds domain-knowledge pre-filtration and re-ranking to Tree-LSTM-based binary code similarity detection. It evaluates firmware vulnerability search across diverse IoT hardware architectures.
description_zh: Asteria-Pro 在基于 Tree-LSTM 的二进制代码相似性检测中加入领域知识预筛选和重排序，并评估其在不同物联网硬件架构的固件漏洞搜索中的表现。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers a firmware bug-search task: pre-filtration reduced calculation time by 96.9%; re-ranking improved MRR by 23.71% and Recall by 36.4%. A large-scale search found 1,482 vulnerable functions at 91.65% precision.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估涵盖固件漏洞搜索：预筛选将计算时间缩短 96.9%；重排序使 MRR 提升 23.71%、Recall 提升 36.4%。大规模搜索以 91.65% 的精确率发现了 1,482 个存在漏洞的函数。
why_fits_en: It studies binary function similarity and its use in finding vulnerable code in firmware.
why_fits_zh: 论文研究二进制函数相似性检测及其在固件漏洞代码搜索中的应用。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: Asteria-Pro：融合领域知识提升基于深度学习的二进制代码相似性检测
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Snipuzz: Black-box Fuzzing of IoT Firmware via Message Snippet Inference
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; the arXiv comment names the venue.
description_en: Snipuzz fuzzes IoT firmware as a client, using device responses to infer message snippets that guide mutations. It was evaluated on 20 real-world IoT devices and compared with four IoT fuzzing approaches.
description_zh: Snipuzz 作为客户端与物联网设备通信，根据设备响应推断消息片段，以指导固件黑盒模糊测试中的消息变异。论文在 20 款真实物联网设备上进行了评估，并与四种物联网模糊测试方法比较。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers 20 popular real-world IoT devices and comparisons with IoTFuzzer, BooFuzz, Doona, and Nemesys. It reports five newly discovered zero-day vulnerabilities, three exposed only by Snipuzz.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估涵盖 20 款流行的真实物联网设备，并与 IoTFuzzer、BooFuzz、Doona 和 Nemesys 比较。论文报告发现了 5 个新的零日漏洞，其中 3 个仅由 Snipuzz 发现。
why_fits_en: It infers message structure from device responses to guide black-box testing of IoT firmware.
why_fits_zh: 它从设备响应中推断消息结构，用于指导物联网固件的黑盒测试。
metadata_notes: The arXiv comment reads: Accepted to ACM CCS 2021
title_zh: Snipuzz：通过消息片段推断对物联网固件进行黑盒模糊测试
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期；arXiv 备注中写明发表场所。
metadata_notes_zh: 发表场所依据 arXiv 备注。

title: Asteria: Deep Learning-based AST-Encoding for Cross-platform Binary Code Similarity Detection
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: 2021 51st Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN)
description_en: ASTERIA uses a Tree-LSTM to encode function ASTs and compare binary functions across platforms. It was evaluated on function pairs and used to search IoT firmware for vulnerabilities.
description_zh: ASTERIA 使用 Tree-LSTM 编码函数的抽象语法树，以比较不同平台上的二进制函数。论文评估了函数对的相似性检测，并将其用于物联网固件漏洞搜索。
scope_limitations_en: The model was trained on 1,022,616 function pairs and evaluated on 95,078 pairs. Its cross-platform scope covers differing IoT architectures; a firmware search identified 75 vulnerable functions in 5,979 images.
scope_limitations_zh: 模型使用 1,022,616 对函数训练，并在 95,078 对函数上评估。跨平台范围涉及不同的物联网架构；固件搜索在 5,979 个镜像中识别出 75 个存在漏洞的函数。
why_fits_en: It studies reverse engineering through binary function similarity and vulnerability search in IoT firmware.
why_fits_zh: 论文研究二进制函数相似性检测及物联网固件中的漏洞搜索，属于逆向工程相关研究。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: Asteria：基于深度学习的抽象语法树编码，用于跨平台二进制代码相似性检测
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Exploring the Efficacy of Large Language Models (GPT-4) in Binary Reverse Engineering
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper evaluates GPT-4 for binary reverse engineering through interpretation of human-written and decompiled code, from basic code explanation to malware analysis.
description_zh: 论文评估 GPT-4 在二进制逆向工程中的表现，考察其对人工编写代码和反编译代码的理解与解释，涵盖基础代码解读和恶意软件分析。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers GPT-4, human-written and decompiled code, basic code interpretation, and more complex malware analysis.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围包括 GPT-4、人工编写代码和反编译代码，以及基础代码解读和较复杂的恶意软件分析。
why_fits_en: It directly studies the use of a language model to interpret code in binary reverse engineering.
why_fits_zh: 论文直接研究语言模型在二进制逆向工程中解读代码的能力。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 探索大型语言模型（GPT-4）在二进制逆向工程中的效能
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: InternalBlue - Bluetooth Binary Patching and Experimentation Framework
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings of the 17th Annual International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
description_en: The paper reverse engineers Broadcom Bluetooth controllers and presents InternalBlue for patching their firmware. It evaluates the framework through vulnerability tests, bug fixes, and added security features.
description_zh: 论文逆向分析博通蓝牙控制器，并提出用于修改其固件的 InternalBlue 框架。作者通过漏洞测试、漏洞修复和新增安全功能展示并评估该框架。
scope_limitations_en: The work covers multiple Broadcom Bluetooth chipsets used in smartphones, wearables, and IoT devices, with experiments on their controller firmware and Bluetooth stack.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究涵盖用于智能手机、可穿戴设备和物联网设备的多款博通蓝牙芯片，并在其控制器固件和蓝牙协议栈上开展实验。
why_fits_en: Examines commercial Bluetooth controller internals and uses the recovered functions to modify firmware.
why_fits_zh: 研究商用蓝牙控制器内部机制，并利用恢复出的函数修改固件。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: InternalBlue：蓝牙二进制补丁与实验框架
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Manticore: A User-Friendly Symbolic Execution Framework for Binaries and Smart Contracts
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: Manticore uses dynamic symbolic execution to analyze binaries and Ethereum smart contracts. The paper presents its architecture and demonstrates bug finding and code verification used for commercial clients.
description_zh: Manticore 使用动态符号执行分析二进制程序和以太坊智能合约。论文介绍其架构，并展示曾用于商业客户项目的漏洞发现和代码正确性验证能力。
scope_limitations_en: The paper covers the framework’s architecture, customizable API, and demonstrations involving binaries and Ethereum smart contracts.
scope_limitations_zh: 论文涵盖框架架构、可定制的 API，以及针对二进制程序和以太坊智能合约的能力展示。
why_fits_en: It presents a framework for systematically exploring binary program behavior through symbolic execution.
why_fits_zh: 它介绍了一个通过符号执行系统探索二进制程序行为的分析框架。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: Manticore：面向二进制程序和智能合约的易用符号执行框架
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: ECMO: Peripheral Transplantation to Rehost Embedded Linux Kernels
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings of the 2021 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security
description_en: ECMO transplants peripheral drivers into embedded Linux kernels to boot firmware in QEMU. It evaluated 815 firmware images across 20 kernel versions, 37 device models, and 24 vendors; 710 reached a user-space shell.
description_zh: ECMO 将外设驱动移植到嵌入式 Linux 内核中，使固件能够在 QEMU 中启动。研究评估了 815 个固件镜像，涵盖 20 个内核版本、37 种设备型号和 24 家厂商；其中 710 个成功启动用户空间 shell。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers embedded Linux firmware across differing SoCs, QEMU kernel rehosting, kernel crash analysis, rootkit forensics, and kernel fuzzing.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围包括采用不同 SoC 的嵌入式 Linux 固件、在 QEMU 中重托管内核，以及内核崩溃分析、Rootkit 取证和内核模糊测试。
why_fits_en: It presents a firmware rehosting technique that enables dynamic analysis of embedded Linux systems.
why_fits_zh: 论文提出一种固件重托管技术，支持对嵌入式 Linux 系统进行动态分析。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: ECMO：通过外设移植重托管嵌入式 Linux 内核
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Automated Dynamic Firmware Analysis at Scale: A Case Study on Embedded Web Interfaces
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper emulates firmware images and uses static and dynamic tools to find vulnerabilities in embedded web interfaces. It evaluated 1,925 images from 54 vendors and found vulnerabilities in 185 images.
description_zh: 论文通过全系统仿真运行固件镜像，并结合静态与动态工具发现嵌入式 Web 界面的漏洞。研究评估了来自 54 家厂商的 1,925 个固件镜像，在其中 185 个镜像中发现漏洞。
scope_limitations_en: The study covers embedded web interfaces and network services in COTS device firmware, including routers, modems, VoIP phones, and IP/CCTV cameras. Its method is designed for different vendors, devices, and architectures.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究范围是商用现成设备固件中的嵌入式 Web 界面和网络服务，设备包括路由器、调制解调器、VoIP 电话及 IP/CCTV 摄像头。其方法面向不同厂商、设备和架构。
why_fits_en: It presents a scalable firmware analysis method that combines full-system emulation with static and dynamic vulnerability discovery.
why_fits_zh: 论文提出可扩展的固件分析方法，将全系统仿真与静态、动态漏洞发现相结合。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 大规模自动化动态固件分析：嵌入式 Web 界面案例研究
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: REx86: A Local Large Language Model for Assisting in x86 Assembly Reverse Engineering
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: 2025 IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC)
description_en: The paper fine-tunes eight local models from CodeLlama, Qwen2.5-Coder, and CodeGemma on 5,981 x86 assembly examples and evaluates their help with binary reverse engineering.
description_zh: 论文使用 5,981 个 x86 汇编样例微调了 CodeLlama、Qwen2.5-Coder 和 CodeGemma 系列的八个本地模型，并评估它们辅助二进制逆向工程的效果。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers a curated x86 assembly dataset and a 43-person user case study of line-level understanding and problem solving.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围包括整理后的 x86 汇编数据集，以及针对逐行理解和解题的 43 人用户案例研究。
why_fits_en: It studies local language-model assistance for understanding and commenting on x86 disassembly used in binary reverse engineering.
why_fits_zh: 论文研究本地语言模型如何辅助理解和注释用于二进制逆向工程的 x86 反汇编代码。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: REx86：辅助 x86 汇编逆向工程的本地大语言模型
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: Towards usable automated detection of CPU architecture and endianness for arbitrary binary files and object code sequences
date_basis: Published date in the Crossref record for the DOI listed on arXiv.
venue: Proceedings of the Tenth ACM Conference on Data and Application Security and Privacy
description_en: The paper builds open datasets and tools to identify CPU architecture and endianness in binary files and object code. It evaluates classifiers on executable code sections, reporting over 98% accuracy.
description_zh: 论文构建开放数据集和工具，用于识别二进制文件及目标代码的 CPU 架构和字节序，并使用可执行文件的代码段评估分类器，报告准确率超过 98%。
scope_limitations_en: Classifier results use code sections from executable binary files.
scope_limitations_zh: 分类器结果基于可执行二进制文件的代码节。
why_fits_en: Identifying the correct instruction set and endianness helps reverse-engineering tools interpret binary code accurately.
why_fits_zh: 识别正确的指令集和字节序，有助于逆向工程工具准确解读二进制代码。
metadata_notes: The DOI comes from the arXiv record, and the venue and date from Crossref.
title_zh: 面向任意二进制文件和目标代码序列的实用化 CPU 架构与字节序自动检测
date_basis_zh: arXiv 所列 DOI 的 Crossref 记录中的发表日期。
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 来自 arXiv 记录，发表场所和日期来自 Crossref。

title: CEBin: A Cost-Effective Framework for Large-Scale Binary Code Similarity Detection
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: CEBin combines code embeddings to shortlist candidate functions with pairwise comparison to detect similar binary code, including vulnerable functions.
description_zh: CEBin结合代码嵌入筛选候选函数，再通过成对比较检测相似的二进制代码，包括含漏洞的函数。
scope_limitations_en: The paper evaluates CEBin on three binary code similarity datasets and a large-scale benchmark for 1-day vulnerability detection. It reports finding similar functions among millions of candidates in seconds, with 85.46% recall on the vulnerability task.
scope_limitations_zh: 论文在三个二进制代码相似性数据集和一个大规模 1-day 漏洞检测基准上评估了 CEBin。针对漏洞检测任务，论文报告其可在数秒内从数百万个候选函数中找到相似函数，召回率为 85.46%。
why_fits_en: It studies large-scale binary code similarity detection and its use in finding functions similar to vulnerable code.
why_fits_zh: 论文研究大规模二进制代码相似性检测，以及如何用它查找与含漏洞代码相似的函数。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: CEBin：面向大规模二进制代码相似性检测的低成本框架
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: HELIOS: Hierarchical Graph Abstraction for Structure-Aware LLM Decompilation
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: HELIOS gives an LLM a hierarchical summary of binary control flow and function calls alongside decompiler output, with optional compiler feedback. It evaluates compilability and functional correctness.
description_zh: HELIOS 将二进制程序的控制流和函数调用整理成分层摘要，与反编译器输出一同提供给大语言模型，并可加入编译器反馈。论文评估了生成代码的可编译性和功能正确性。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers HumanEval-Decompile on x86_64 with Gemini 2.0 and GPT-4.1 Mini, plus six architectures from x86, ARM, and MIPS.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估涵盖 x86_64 上的 HumanEval-Decompile，使用 Gemini 2.0 和 GPT-4.1 Mini，并覆盖来自 x86、ARM 和 MIPS 的六种架构。
why_fits_en: It addresses binary decompilation for reverse engineering by using program structure to help generate recompilable, functionally correct code.
why_fits_zh: 论文研究用于逆向工程的二进制程序反编译，利用程序结构帮助生成可重新编译且功能正确的代码。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: HELIOS：面向结构感知大语言模型反编译的分层图抽象
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: kTrans: Knowledge-Aware Transformer for Binary Code Embedding
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: kTrans uses a knowledge-aware Transformer to embed binary code. It evaluates the embeddings through outlier detection and visualization, and on binary code similarity, function type recovery, and indirect call recognition.
description_zh: kTrans 使用融合汇编语言知识的 Transformer 生成二进制代码嵌入。论文通过离群点检测和可视化考察嵌入，并评估其在二进制代码相似性检测、函数类型恢复和间接调用识别中的表现。
scope_limitations_en: Covers binary code and three downstream tasks: binary code similarity detection, function type recovery and indirect call recognition, with reported improvements of 5.2%, 6.8% and 12.6%.
scope_limitations_zh: 涵盖二进制代码及三项下游任务：二进制代码相似性检测、函数类型恢复和间接调用识别，报告的提升分别为 5.2%、6.8% 和 12.6%。
why_fits_en: It applies binary code embeddings to reverse-engineering tasks.
why_fits_zh: 论文将二进制代码嵌入用于逆向工程任务。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: kTrans：用于二进制代码嵌入的知识感知 Transformer
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Automated Attack Synthesis by Extracting Finite State Machines from Protocol Specification Documents
date_basis: First arXiv submission date; the arXiv comment names the venue.
venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2022
description_en: Extracts protocol FSMs from RFC prose using technical word representations, zero-shot text mapping, and rules, then uses the extracted FSMs to synthesize attacks.
description_zh: 从 RFC 文本中提取协议有限状态机，方法结合技术词表示学习、零样本文本映射和规则映射，并用提取的状态机合成攻击。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluates FSM extraction on RFCs for six protocols: BGPv4, DCCP, LTP, PPTP, SCTP, and TCP. Attack synthesis case studies cover TCP and DCCP.
scope_limitations_zh: 在 BGPv4、DCCP、LTP、PPTP、SCTP 和 TCP 六种协议的 RFC 上评估状态机提取，并以 TCP 和 DCCP 为攻击合成案例。
why_fits_en: Reconstructs protocol state machines from prose specifications for security analysis.
why_fits_zh: 从文字规范中重建协议状态机，用于安全分析。
metadata_notes: The arXiv comment reads: To appear in IEEE Security and Privacy, 2022
title_zh: 从协议规范文档中提取有限状态机以自动合成攻击
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期；arXiv 备注中写明发表场所。
metadata_notes_zh: 发表场所依据 arXiv 备注。

title: ReF Decompile: Relabeling and Function Call Enhanced Decompile
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: ReF Decompile relabels jump targets and uses function calls to recover variable information when converting binary code to source code. It was evaluated on the HumanEval-Decompile Benchmark.
description_zh: ReF Decompile 通过重标记跳转目标、利用函数调用恢复变量信息，将二进制代码转换为源代码。论文在 HumanEval-Decompile 基准上进行了评估。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers binary code decompilation on the HumanEval-Decompile Benchmark, with comparisons to similar methods and a reported performance of 61.43%.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围是 HumanEval-Decompile 基准上的二进制代码反编译；论文与同类方法进行了比较，报告的性能为 61.43%。
why_fits_en: Recovering source code and program logic from binaries is a reverse engineering task.
why_fits_zh: 从二进制文件恢复源代码和程序逻辑属于逆向工程任务。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: ReF Decompile：通过重标记和函数调用增强反编译
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Extracting Protocol Format as State Machine via Controlled Static Loop Analysis
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper extracts protocol message formats from parser code by analyzing parsing loops as state machines. It evaluates format inference and the use of the extracted machines in protocol fuzzers.
description_zh: 论文通过将解析循环分析为状态机，从解析器代码中提取协议消息格式，并评估格式推断效果及所提取状态机在协议模糊测试中的应用。
scope_limitations_en: The analysis targets protocols with constraint-enhanced regular-expression formats parsed by finite-state machines. Reported results include over 90% precision and recall in five minutes, 20%–230% higher fuzzer coverage, and ten additional zero-days detected.
scope_limitations_zh: 分析对象是格式由带约束的正则表达式描述、并由有限状态机解析的协议。报告的结果包括五分钟内超过90%的准确率和召回率、模糊测试覆盖率提高20%至230%，以及多发现十个零日漏洞。
why_fits_en: It reverse engineers protocol message formats from parser implementations and uses the recovered state machines to improve fuzzing.
why_fits_zh: 论文从解析器实现中逆向提取协议消息格式，并利用恢复的状态机改进模糊测试。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 通过受控静态循环分析将协议格式提取为状态机
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Assessing LLMs in Malicious Code Deobfuscation of Real-world Malware Campaigns
date_basis: First arXiv submission date.
description_en: The paper evaluates four LLMs on deobfuscating real-world malicious scripts from the Emotet malware campaign and examines their use in reverse engineering.
description_zh: 论文使用 Emotet 恶意软件活动中的真实恶意脚本，评估四种大语言模型的去混淆能力及其在逆向工程中的应用。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation covers four LLMs and malicious scripts from the Emotet campaign.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估范围为四种大语言模型和 Emotet 活动中的恶意脚本。
why_fits_en: Deobfuscating malicious scripts helps researchers understand code behavior during malware reverse engineering.
why_fits_zh: 对恶意脚本去混淆有助于研究人员在恶意软件逆向工程中理解代码行为。
metadata_notes: The date and venue come from the arXiv record.
title_zh: 评估大语言模型对真实恶意软件活动中恶意代码的去混淆能力
date_basis_zh: arXiv 首次提交日期。
metadata_notes_zh: 日期和发表场所来自 arXiv 记录。

title: Multimodal Representation Learning for Binary Code Similarity Analysis: A Systematic Review and Conceptual Framework
date_basis: Crossref issued date
description_en: This article systematically reviews multimodal representation learning for binary code similarity analysis and outlines a conceptual framework for that task. The subject is how learned representations compare binary code.
description_zh: 本文系统回顾用于二进制代码相似性分析的多模态表示学习，并勾画该任务的概念框架。主题是学习到的表示如何比较二进制代码。
scope_limitations_en: The summary is limited to the title, byline, and venue on the fetched PDF plus the Crossref date. Model results in the paper were not reproduced.
scope_limitations_zh: 摘要只依据已获取 PDF 上的题名、署名和刊物以及 Crossref 日期。论文中的模型结果没有复现。
why_fits_en: Binary code similarity is a reverse-engineering comparison problem, and this paper reviews representation-learning approaches to it.
why_fits_zh: 二进制代码相似性是逆向工程中的比较问题，本文回顾用表示学习处理该问题的方法。
metadata_notes: The DOI is the Crossref value 10.56578/ida050204.
title_zh: 面向二进制代码相似性分析的多模态表示学习：系统综述与概念框架
date_basis_zh: 日期取自 Crossref 登记的出版日期
metadata_notes_zh: DOI 采用 Crossref 中的 10.56578/ida050204。
